pmid-28367345.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者が治療後9年で、神経線維腫および悪性末梢神経鞘腫瘍の特徴を示す体細胞型悪性腫瘍として晩期再発した症例。FISH解析で12p等染色体が確認され、胚細胞腫瘍由来であることが示された。発生機序は依然として不明である。
pmid-28367345.summary_en: Case of seminoma patient with late relapse (9 years post-treatment) as somatic-type malignancy showing neurofibroma and malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor features. FISH analysis confirmed isochromosome 12p, establishing germ cell tumor origin. Pathogenic mechanism remains enigmatic.

pmid-28368923.summary_ja: 国際泌尿器病理学会の会議による、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の報告と病期分類に関する提言。主な提言として、リンパ管・血管侵襲を常に報告すること、精巣網の間質浸潤とパジェット様の浸潤を区別すること、混合型胚細胞腫瘍における腫瘍成分の割合を報告することが挙げられる。
pmid-28368923.summary_en: International Society of Urological Pathology conference recommendations on reporting and staging testicular germ cell tumors. Key recommendations include always reporting lymphovascular invasion, distinguishing rete testis stromal invasion from pagetoid involvement, and reporting percentages of different tumor elements in mixed germ cell tumors.

pmid-28369417.summary_ja: 症例報告。31歳男性の縦隔における転移性胚細胞腫瘍に対して、胸腔鏡下手術により切除に成功した。3ポートの後方胸腔鏡アプローチにより、内臓縦隔腫瘤の剥離について安全性と実現可能性が示された。
pmid-28369417.summary_en: Case report of successful video-assisted thoracic surgery for metastatic germ cell tumor resection in mediastinum of 31-year-old man. Three-port posterior thoracoscopic approach demonstrated safety and feasibility for dissection of visceral mediastinal masses.

pmid-28370831.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を検出する好中球リンパ球比の診断的有用性を検討。N/L比≥5.0、高齢、および大腫瘍が悪性転化の独立した予測因子として同定された。
pmid-28370831.summary_en: Evaluates neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio as a preoperative diagnostic marker for malignant transformation in mature cystic teratomas. N/L ratio ≥5.0, older age, and larger tumor size were independent predictors of malignant transformation with high hazard ratios.

pmid-28372870.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者171例における妊孕性温存手術後の腫瘍学的および生殖の転帰を解析した。5年全生存率は97%であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍、不完全な病期分類、および残存病変が独立した予後因子であった。妊娠成功率は75%と良好な生殖転帰が得られた。
pmid-28372870.summary_en: Analyzes oncologic and reproductive outcomes in 171 patients after fertility-sparing surgery for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. Five-year overall survival was 97%. Yolk sac tumor, incomplete staging, and residual disease were independent prognostic factors. Reproductive outcomes were excellent with 75% successful pregnancy rates.

pmid-28373885.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の胚性癌細胞の幹性と分化機構を検討した総説。転写因子によるプルリポテンシー制御、網膜酸シグナリング、エピジェネティック制御、および細胞代謝が幹細胞の多能性に与える影響を論じている。
pmid-28373885.summary_en: Review examining mechanisms regulating stemness and differentiation in embryonal carcinoma cells (ECCs) from teratocarcinomas. Emphasizes transcription factors controlling pluripotency and stem cell stemness, retinoic acid signaling, epigenetic regulation, and cellular metabolism's role in modulating the epigenetic landscape.

pmid-28375941.summary_ja: フランスの全国的な後方視的研究で、0〜18歳の小児15例における体細胞型悪性転化を伴う胚細胞腫瘍(GCT with SMT)を検討した。原発部位は卵巣、縦隔、松果体などで、併発する悪性腫瘍は神経外胚葉性腫瘍から横紋筋肉腫まで多岐にわたった。治療の基盤は外科的切除であるが、最適な化学療法戦略は依然として不明である。
pmid-28375941.summary_en: National retrospective study of germ cell tumors with somatic malignant transformation (GCT with SMT) in 15 children aged 0-18 years. Primary sites included ovary, mediastinum, and pineal gland; secondary malignancies ranged from neuroectodermal tumors to rhabdomyosarcomas. Surgical resection is cornerstone of treatment; optimal chemotherapy strategy remains unclear.

pmid-28377901.summary_ja: 41歳女性の侵入奇胎の症例報告で、卵巣転移、子宮破裂、急性腹症を伴う非典型的な経過を示した。hCGは224,000 mIU/mlで、病期3であった。化学療法と手術により治療は成功し、5年間のフォローアップで無病の状態が確認された。胞状奇胎後のフォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-28377901.summary_en: Case report of invasive mole with unusual presentation including ovarian metastasis, uterine rupture, and acute abdomen in 41-year-old woman. HCG 224,000 mIU/ml with stage 3 disease. Successful management with chemotherapy and surgery resulted in disease-free status at five-year follow-up. Highlights importance of surveillance after molar pregnancy.

pmid-28393093.summary_ja: 脳・肺・膣転移を伴う絨毛癌の治療例。頭蓋骨切除術とEMA-CO化学療法により脳転移を治療。脳放射線療法および髄腔内投与なしで成功。妊娠性絨毛疾患の治療指針を提供。
pmid-28393093.summary_en: Case report of choriocarcinoma with brain, lung, and vaginal metastases successfully treated with craniotomy and EMA-CO chemotherapy followed by high-dose intravenous methotrexate. Demonstrates that brain metastases from gestational trophoblastic neoplasia can be effectively managed without intrathecal chemotherapy or brain radiation.

pmid-28393096.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫のまれな良性合併症である腹膜神経膠腫症(GP)の症例報告と文献レビュー。GPは、他の非悪性の成熟奇形腫所見と異なり、PETで高い18F-FDG集積を示す。特徴的な画像所見により、選択された症例では積極的な治療ではなく積極的監視によるアプローチが可能となる。
pmid-28393096.summary_en: Case report and literature review of gliomatosis peritonei (GP), a rare benign complication of ovarian teratomas. GP exhibits high 18F-FDG uptake on PET unlike other non-malignant mature teratoma manifestations. Distinct imaging characteristics enable active surveillance approach in selected cases rather than aggressive intervention.

pmid-28394842.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫(異所性甲状腺組織を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の一型)が原因で、7年間の抗甲状腺薬治療にもかかわらず持続性甲状腺機能亢進症を呈した61歳女性の症例報告。SPECT/CTにより左骨盤内腫瘤への強い放射性ヨウ素集積が同定された。外科的切除により良性の卵巣甲状腺腫と確認され、予後は良好とされている。
pmid-28394842.summary_en: Case report of struma ovarii (mature cystic teratoma variant with ectopic thyroid tissue) causing persistent hyperthyroidism in 61-year-old woman despite seven years of antithyroid therapy. SPECT/CT imaging identified intense radioiodine uptake in left pelvic mass. Surgical resection confirmed benign struma ovarii with good prognosis.

pmid-28395668.summary_ja: 再発した非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性で、パクリタキセル、イホスファミド、カルボプラチン、エトポシドによる大量化学療法後に遅発性横紋筋融解症が生じた症例報告。合併症は自己幹細胞輸注後12日目に出現し、補液により良好に管理された。このレジメンでこの有害事象が報告されたのは初めてである。
pmid-28395668.summary_en: Case report of delayed rhabdomyolysis in 21-year-old with relapsed non-seminomatous germ cell tumor receiving high-dose chemotherapy with paclitaxel, ifosfamide, carboplatin, and etoposide. Complication occurred on day +12 post-autologous stem cell infusion and was successfully managed with hydration. First reported case of this adverse effect with this regimen.

pmid-28397201.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)50例を対象に、手術方法を決定する因子を分析した研究。40歳以下の若年患者では嚢胞径にかかわらず嚢胞摘出術が優先され、1年間のフォローアップ期間中に再発は認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術はMCT治療において安全であることが示された。年齢が手術法選択の唯一の独立した予測因子であった。
pmid-28397201.summary_en: This study analyzes factors determining surgical approach in 50 mature cystic teratoma (MCT) cases. Cystectomy was preferred in younger patients (≤40 years) regardless of cyst size, with no recurrence during one-year follow-up. Laparoscopy proved safe for MCT management. Age emerged as the only independent predictor of surgical technique selection.

pmid-28397369.summary_ja: 脳卒中精査時に偶然発見された原発性縦隔絨毛癌（6cm傍食道腫瘤）。EBUS-FNAで絨毛癌成分を有するGCT確認。β-HCG上昇だが精巣腫瘍なし。若年患者の完全神経学的検査の重要性を示唆。
pmid-28397369.summary_en: Rare case of primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma discovered incidentally during stroke workup (6 cm paraesophageal mass). EBUS-FNA confirmed GCT with choriocarcinoma component; elevated β-HCG with no testicular tumor. Underscores importance of complete neurological investigation in young patients.

pmid-28407803.summary_ja: 22歳男性の原発性縦隔セミノーマ（精巣外GCT）の症例。精巣炎と両側精巣生検の既往。精巣外セミノーマは手術的管理と詳細な生検が必要。
pmid-28407803.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old male with primary mediastinal thymic seminoma (extragonadal GCT) discovered incidentally on chest X-ray. History of orchitis with bilateral testicular biopsy. Extragonadal seminomas require surgical management and extensive biopsy sampling for diagnosis.

pmid-28411623.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の肺転移で喀血を呈する女性3症例報告。低危険因子（流産、胞状奇胎、異所性妊娠）を有する。β-HCG診断に重要。妊娠歴のある喀血患者の鑑別診断として考慮すべき。
pmid-28411623.summary_en: Case series of three women with gestational choriocarcinoma presenting with hemoptysis due to pulmonary metastasis. Low-risk factors including abortion, hydatidiform mole, and ectopic pregnancy. β-HCG crucial for diagnosis. Differential diagnosis consideration for women with pregnancy history and hemoptysis.

pmid-28412366.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌NCCIT細胞におけるNANOG遺伝子発現制御を、ETS転写因子ETV4の観点から検討した研究。ETV4は転写活性化因子として機能し、NANOG近位プロモーターとの相互作用が確認された。胚細胞腫瘍の生物学的理解に関連する知見である。
pmid-28412366.summary_en: Study of NANOG gene regulation by ETS transcription factor ETV4 in human embryonic carcinoma NCCIT cells. ETV4 acts as transcriptional activator; interaction with NANOG proximal promoter confirmed. Relevant to understanding GCT biology.

pmid-28414684.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび卵黄嚢腫瘍成分)により、肺に広範な「大砲の弾丸」様転移を呈した39歳男性の症例。小さな精巣腫瘤は初回の身体診察では見逃されたが、超音波検査で検出された。BEP化学療法により良好な反応が得られた。
pmid-28414684.summary_en: Case of 39-year-old male with testicular mixed germ cell tumor (seminoma and yolk sac components) presenting with extensive pulmonary 'cannonball' metastases. Small testicular mass initially missed on physical exam but detected by ultrasound. Treated with BEP chemotherapy with favorable response.

pmid-28415950.summary_ja: 初期卵巣未分化奇形腫43例研究。卵巣嚢胞切除術14例、単側卵管卵巣切除術29例。5年無病生存率はそれぞれ100%と88%。嚢胞切除術は妊孕性を保持して生存に影響しない。
pmid-28415950.summary_en: Retrospective study of 43 patients with apparent early-stage ovarian immature teratoma: 14 underwent ovarian cystectomy, 29 underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Five-year disease-free survival rates 100% and 88%, respectively. Cystectomy preserves fertility without compromising survival.

pmid-28415994.summary_ja: ガーナにおける原発性卵巣腫瘍706例の研究で、胚細胞腫瘍が最も多く(41.9%)、成熟奇形腫が優勢であった。平均受診年齢は30.7歳。患者の多くは症状出現から1か月以内に、下腹部の触知可能な腫瘤を主訴として受診していた。
pmid-28415994.summary_en: Study of 706 primary ovarian tumors in Ghana: germ cell tumors were most common (41.9%), dominated by mature teratomas (39.2%). Mean age of presentation 30.7 years. Patients predominantly presented with palpable abdominal mass within one month of symptom onset.

pmid-28421640.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた転移性胚細胞腫瘍の日本人患者86例を後方視的に解析した研究。推定糸球体濾過量の低値とアルブミン値の低値が、発熱性好中球減少症の独立した危険因子であった(378コース中81エピソード、21.4%)。発生率は西洋の研究より高い。
pmid-28421640.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 86 Japanese patients with metastatic germ cell tumors receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Low estimated glomerular filtration rate and albumin levels identified as independent risk factors for febrile neutropenia (21.4% of 378 cycles). Higher incidence than Western studies.

pmid-28423520.summary_ja: 精巣GCT患者240例のPD-L1陽性腫瘍浸潤リンパ球の予後的役割を検討。高PD-L1+ TIL浸潤（HS≥160）はセミノーマ、胎児性癌などで生存率向上と関連。
pmid-28423520.summary_en: Study of 240 testicular GCT patients examining PD-L1 expression on tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes. High PD-L1+ TIL infiltration (HS≥160) associated with significantly better progression-free and overall survival across seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and other GCT types.

pmid-28426398.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍43例(セミノーマ24例、非セミノーマ19例)におけるK-RASおよびN-RAS変異を解析した。RAS変異は27%で検出され、組織型による頻度に大きな差はなかった。白金製剤抵抗性の腫瘍に対する標的治療の選択肢となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-28426398.summary_en: Analysis of K-RAS and N-RAS mutations in 43 testicular germ cell tumor patients (24 seminoma, 19 non-seminoma). RAS mutations detected in 27%; similar frequencies between histological types. Findings suggest potential targeted therapy options for platinum-resistant tumors.

pmid-28428076.summary_ja: ミリセチンが絨毛癌細胞（JAR、JEG-3）の浸潤抑制と細胞死誘導を示す研究。酸化ストレス誘導と化学療法薬との相乗効果を実証。
pmid-28428076.summary_en: Study of myricetin, a bioactive polyphenol, suppressing invasion and promoting apoptosis in choriocarcinoma cell lines (JAR, JEG-3). Demonstrates induction of oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, and synergistic effects with etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy.

pmid-28429112.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者17例のシスプラチン化学療法による嗅覚機能の変化を検討。治療中・直後に嗅覚閾値の一時的低下を観察、180日後にほぼ回復。約4分の1が治療開始時に抑うつ気分を呈示。
pmid-28429112.summary_en: Study of olfactory function changes in 17 testicular cancer patients receiving cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Temporary olfactory threshold decline observed during/after treatment, with recovery by day 180. Significant depression in nearly 25% at baseline, requiring patient counseling.

pmid-28429716.summary_ja: ポリエンブリオーマが優勢であった精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の2症例と、文献から追加された14例(精巣5例、卵巣9例)をまとめた研究。ポリエンブリオーマは胚様体で構成され、奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分を伴うことが多い。
pmid-28429716.summary_en: Two cases of testicular polyembryoma predominating in mixed germ cell tumors, with literature review identifying 14 total cases (5 testicular, 9 ovarian). Polyembryoma composed of embryoid bodies frequently associated with teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor components.

pmid-28434637.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成の小児28例を対象とした臨床研究。そのうち6例が非モザイク型核型であり、3例が胚細胞腫瘍(両側性性腺芽腫、両側性ITGCN、ディスジャーミノーマ/性腺芽腫)を発症した。この集団では胚細胞腫瘍および関連する先天異常のリスクが高いことが示された。
pmid-28434637.summary_en: Clinical study of 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis in 28 pediatric patients. Six had non-mosaic karyotype; three developed germ cell neoplasms (bilateral gonadoblastoma, bilateral ITGCN, dysgerminoma/gonadoblastoma). High risk for GCT and associated congenital anomalies in this population.

pmid-28435402.summary_ja: 精巣二側性がん73症例をレビュー。セミノーマと混合組織型は予後良好だが、非セミノーマは予後不良。精巣温存手術、多重生検、ITGCN存在時の陰嚢放射線療法を推奨し、生涯フォローアップと心理的サポートの重要性を強調。
pmid-28435402.summary_en: Systematic review of 73 bilateral testicular cancer cases. Seminomas and mixed histology tumors showed favorable prognosis, while bilateral non-seminomas had poor outcomes. Emphasizes testis-sparing surgery when feasible, multiple biopsies, and scrotal radiotherapy for ITGCN management, with lifelong follow-up and psychological support.

pmid-28440090.summary_ja: 肉腫成分を伴う精原細胞腫瘍の症例報告。精原細胞腫瘍はセミノーマとは異なるGCT型で通常予後良好だが、本例は軟骨肉腫成分を含み予後不良。
pmid-28440090.summary_en: Case report of spermatocytic tumor with sarcoma component in testis. Spermatocytic tumor (formerly spermatocytic seminoma) is distinct clinicopathologic entity not associated with GCNIS or other GCTs. This case showed chondrosarcomatous component with poor prognosis despite typically excellent prognosis of spermatocytic tumor alone.

pmid-28443239.summary_ja: 精巣PNET混合成熟奇形種と後腹膜リンパ節転移患者の症例報告。根治的除睾と後腹膜郭清術後に交代的化学療法施行。PNET含有腫瘍の高再発率に対応。
pmid-28443239.summary_en: Case report of 38-year-old man with testicular primitive neuroectodermal tumor mixed with mature teratoma and retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy. Underwent radical orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection followed by alternating CAV and IE chemotherapy due to high recurrence rate of PNET-containing tumors.

pmid-28445278.summary_ja: 腹膜外郭症候群を合併した大型腹部悪性腫瘍小児患者6例報告。卵巣および腹部悪性奇形種を含む。外科的減圧が有効治療だが早期手術群は生存、非手術群は死亡。
pmid-28445278.summary_en: Report of 6 children with large abdominal malignancies complicated by abdominal compartment syndrome, including ovarian and abdominal malignant teratomas. Surgical tumor decompression was only effective treatment; 4 children with emergency surgery survived, while 2 without surgery died.

pmid-28445692.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣における性索間質腫瘍と、胚細胞および性索成分を併せ持つ腫瘍について包括的に概説した総説。性腺芽腫の亜型、混合型胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍、診断命名法の不整合、ならびに精巣腫瘍と卵巣腫瘍の遺伝的・後天的差異を検討している。
pmid-28445692.summary_en: Comprehensive review of sex cord-stromal tumors and tumors with germ cell-sex cord components in testis and ovary. Discusses gonadoblastoma variants, mixed germ cell-sex cord stromal tumors, diagnostic nomenclature inconsistencies, and genetic/epigenetic differences between testicular and ovarian neoplasms.

pmid-28446797.summary_ja: フェティフォーム奇形種の単為生殖起源を分子遺伝学で証明。SNPマイクロアレイおよびDMR解析により減数第二分裂後の成熟卵母細胞由来が確認。単為生殖腫瘍の初実証。
pmid-28446797.summary_en: Molecular genetic study of parthenogenetic origin of fetiform teratoma from 35-year-old woman. Genotyping, SNP microarray, and methylation analysis demonstrated homozygous genotypes with meiotic recombination and unmethylated IGF2-H19 locus, confirming origin from mature haploid ovum after meiosis II.

pmid-28449306.summary_ja: イタリアのAIEOP研究で、ディスジャーミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、非ディスジャーミノーマを含む小児の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍77例を検討した。5年全生存率は98.5%、無イベント生存率は84.5%であった。病期Iの患者7例が再発したが、化学療法により救済された。
pmid-28449306.summary_en: AIEOP study of 77 pediatric patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors including dysgerminoma, immature teratoma, and non-dysgerminoma types. Five-year overall survival was 98.5% and event-free survival 84.5%. Seven stage I patients relapsed but were successfully salvaged with chemotherapy.

pmid-28454241.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞（JEG-3）におけるトランスサイレチン（TTR）の役割検討。TTR過剰発現はMMP2/MMP9を上昇させ細胞浸潤を増加。子癇前症の分子機序への関与を示唆。
pmid-28454241.summary_en: Study of transthyretin (TTR) expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. TTR overexpression significantly increased cell migration and invasion through upregulation of matrix metalloproteinases MMP2 and MMP9, suggesting role in trophoblast invasion and preeclampsia pathogenesis.

pmid-28454250.summary_ja: 27歳女性の原発性縦隔セミノーマ症例である。シスプラチン併用化学療法6サイクルでは病勢進行を示したが、縦隔(50 Gy)および心嚢(30 Gy)への放射線療法により完全奏効が得られた。5年間の経過観察で無再発であった。
pmid-28454250.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old woman with primary mediastinal seminoma and massive pericardial effusion. Initial cisplatin-based chemotherapy (6 cycles) showed resistance with disease progression. Radiotherapy to mediastinum (50 Gy) and pericardium (30 Gy) achieved complete response with 5-year disease-free follow-up.

pmid-28454372.summary_ja: 子宮内膜外妊娠と絨毛癌の鑑別症例報告。高β-hCGと子宮内腫瘍で絨毛癌が疑われたが、病理診断で子宮内膜外妊娠と腺筋症確認。早期外科的介入で診断治療達成。
pmid-28454372.summary_en: Case report distinguishing intramural pregnancy from choriocarcinoma. Patient presented with amenorrhea, markedly elevated beta-hCG, and intrauterine mass resembling choriocarcinoma. Surgical pathology confirmed intramural pregnancy with adenomyosis. Early surgical intervention was diagnostic and therapeutic.

pmid-28454378.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍228例におけるカルボニックアンヒドラーゼIX(CA IX)発現を評価したトランスレーショナル研究である。CA IX発現は無増悪生存期間の短縮と関連していた。発現は奇形腫(39%)およびセミノーマ(22.7%)で高く、低酸素経路の活性化が治療不応に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-28454378.summary_en: Translational study evaluating carbonic anhydrase IX (CA IX) expression in 228 testicular germ cell tumors. CA IX expression associated with poorer progression-free survival. Highest expression in teratomas (39%) and seminomas (22.7%), suggesting hypoxia pathway activation in treatment failure.

pmid-28459202.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマTCam-2細胞におけるエストロゲン受容体β(ERβ)シグナル伝達の研究。E2はERβを介してミトコンドリア脱アセチル化酵素SIRT3を転写レベルで上方調節し、活性酸素種を減少させる。この保護的なERβ経路は、セミノーマ治療への応用可能性を示唆する。
pmid-28459202.summary_en: Study of estrogen receptor beta signaling in human seminoma TCam-2 cells. E2 via ERβ upregulates mitochondrial deacetylase SIRT3, reducing reactive oxygen species through transcriptional mechanisms. Findings suggest protective ER-beta pathway with therapeutic implications for seminoma treatment.

pmid-28462168.summary_ja: 膀胱の成熟嚢胞性奇形種の症例報告。初期には尿管結石と誤診されたが、膀胱鏡検査で毛髪を有する病変が検出。組織診断は成熟奇形種と確認。
pmid-28462168.summary_en: Case report of 27-year-old woman with mature cystic teratoma of bladder initially misdiagnosed as ureteral stone on imaging. Cystoscopy revealed pedunculated gray-white lesion with hair-covered surface. Histopathology confirmed mature teratoma; partial cystectomy and oophorectomy performed.

pmid-28462491.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞（JAR）に対するEGCGとErlotinibの古典的化学療法との併用効果検討。併用療法は単一薬剤より細胞増殖阻害とアポトーシス誘導が効果的で臨床応用の可能性。
pmid-28462491.summary_en: Study of combination therapy using EGCG and Erlotinib with methotrexate or actinomycin-D in JAR choriocarcinoma cells. Combined treatment increased apoptosis and reduced cell proliferation and metastatic HER2 expression more effectively than single agents, suggesting potential clinical benefit.

pmid-28467339.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群を呈した原始精巣外セミノーマの縦隔腫瘤症例報告。CT、PET-CT 検査、精巣超音波検査、腫瘍マーカー(β-hCG)、病理診断を含む診断戦略を記述。精巣外胚細胞腫瘍の診断の課題と原発精巣腫瘍除外の重要性を論じる。
pmid-28467339.summary_en: Case report of primitive extratesticular seminoma in mediastinum presenting with superior vena cava syndrome. Documents comprehensive diagnostic workup including CT, PET-CT imaging, testicular ultrasound, tumor markers (β-hCG), and pathologic diagnosis. Discusses challenges in diagnosing extragonadal germ cell tumors and importance of ruling out primary gonadal disease.

pmid-28469308.summary_ja: 43歳男性の原発性腎内卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。稀有な精巣外胚細胞腫瘍(EGGCT)。腎腫瘍の鑑別診断に胚細胞腫瘍を含めることの重要性を強調。この稀有な腫瘍の臨床経過と病理診断を記載。
pmid-28469308.summary_en: Case report of primary intrarenal yolk sac tumor in 43-year-old male, a rare extragonadal germ cell tumor (EGGCT) arising within kidney. Emphasizes importance of including germ cell tumors in differential diagnosis of renal neoplasms. Documents clinical presentation and pathologic diagnosis of this uncommon entity.

pmid-28469317.summary_ja: 婦人科悪性腫瘍における腹膜洗浄液のSurePath液状細胞診に関する研究。393例の腹膜液検体を組織病理学的相関で検討。ジスゲルミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む各種胚細胞腫瘍を含む卵巣・子宮悪性腫瘍の所見を記載。液状細胞診による検出精度改善を実証。
pmid-28469317.summary_en: Study of SurePath liquid-based cytology for peritoneal washing in gynecological malignancies. Examines 393 peritoneal fluid samples with histopathologic correlation. Documents various ovarian and uterine malignancies including dysgerminoma, yolk sac tumor, which are germ cell tumors. Demonstrates improved detection with liquid-based technique.

pmid-28471449.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるマイクロRNA発現を検討し、miR-514a-3pの喪失がPEG3を介したNF-κB経路の活性化を調節することを明らかにした。胚細胞をアポトーシスから保護する新規機構であり、腫瘍増殖にも寄与する。多くのTGCT検体でPEG3および核内p50の強い発現が報告されている。
pmid-28471449.summary_en: Study of microRNA expression in testicular germ cell tumors revealing miR-514a-3p loss regulates PEG3-mediated NF-κB pathway activation. Identifies novel mechanism protecting germ cells from apoptosis and promotes tumor growth. Reports strong PEG3 and nuclear p50 expression in majority of TGCT samples.

pmid-28473205.summary_ja: 初回治療に失敗した高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍68例を対象とした後方視的研究。絨毛癌、侵入奇胎、PSTT、中間型トロホブラスト腫瘍を含み、EMACO、MAC、BEP、ICEおよび白金系を含む各種レジメンの有効性を評価した。無増悪生存期間および全生存期間の転帰を報告している。
pmid-28473205.summary_en: Retrospective study of salvage chemotherapy outcomes in 68 GTN patients who failed initial treatment, including choriocarcinoma, invasive mole, PSTT, and intermediate trophoblastic tumor. Evaluates efficacy of various regimens (EMACO, MAC, BEP, ICE, platinum-based). Documents progression-free and overall survival outcomes.

pmid-28477749.summary_ja: 妊娠性滋養膜疾患と各種悪性腫瘍、特に乳癌との関連性を検討する総説。GTDの世界的疫学と分子病因を論じる。GTD疾患スペクトラムと非絨毛癌悪性腫瘍間の未検討の関連性を探索する重要な論文。
pmid-28477749.summary_en: Review examining possible correlations between gestational trophoblastic diseases and various cancers, particularly breast cancer. Discusses global epidemiology, molecular etiopathology, and risk factors for GTD. Explores understudied connections between GTD spectrum and non-choriocarcinoma malignancies.

pmid-28483254.summary_ja: 14例の新生児頭頸部奇形腫を41年間にわたり後方視的に検討した症例集積である。出生前・出生後の診断、解剖学的部位(頸部、鼻咽頭、外鼻、顔面)、上気道閉塞に対するEXIT手技を含む治療、外科的切除の転帰を記載している。完全切除例では再発はまれであった。
pmid-28483254.summary_en: Retrospective 41-year series of 14 neonatal patients with head and neck teratomas. Documents prenatal and postnatal diagnosis, anatomic sites (neck, nasopharynx, external nose, face), management including EXIT procedure for airway obstruction, and surgical resection outcomes. Complete resection associated with rare recurrence rate.

pmid-28484539.summary_ja: 副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫(SNTCS)の稀有な症例報告。原始神経上皮成分と悪性上皮・間葉成分を含む攻撃的悪性腫瘍。鼻腔、上咽頭、副鼻腔を広範に侵襲し両側眼窩と頭蓋内浸潤を伴う。手術、放射線療法、化学療法による治療経過を記述。
pmid-28484539.summary_en: Rare case report of sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma, an aggressive malignant neoplasm containing primitive neuroepithelial elements with epithelial and mesenchymal components. Describes extensive involvement of nasal cavity, nasopharynx, paranasal sinuses with bilateral orbital and intracranial extension. Treated with surgery, radiotherapy, and chemotherapy.

pmid-28490684.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対するシスプラチンベース化学療法に伴う脳静脈洞血栓症の稀有な合併症。診断画像所見と臨床管理を詳述。脱水とシスプラチン誘発性凝固異常を主因として発症するこの治療可能な重篤な合併症への認識の重要性を強調。
pmid-28490684.summary_en: Case report of cerebral venous sinus thrombosis as rare complication of cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumor. Documents diagnosis, imaging findings (MRI/MRV), and clinical management. Emphasizes awareness of this treatable but serious complication in testicular cancer patients receiving BEP regimen.

pmid-28491173.summary_ja: 妊娠性滋養膜新生物の放射線学的に検出困難な肺転移の症例報告。胸部X線の限界を指摘し、肺結節の発見にはCT画像検査の必要性を強調する。妊娠性滋養膜疾患患者における転移性疾患を見落とさないための臨床的指針を提供している重要な報告。
pmid-28491173.summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia with radiographically occult pulmonary metastases. Emphasizes limitations of chest X-ray and necessity of CT imaging for detecting smaller lung lesions in GTN patients. Provides clinical guidance for post-molar pregnancy surveillance to prevent missing occult metastatic disease.

pmid-28491175.summary_ja: 原発性卵管絨毛癌症例報告。39歳女性、不正出血と腹部腫瘤。β-hCG著明上昇。MRI嚢胞性腫瘤で固形部は蜂窩状。病理で卵管絨毛癌確定。特異的画像所見と著明なhCG上昇が付属器腫瘤の鑑別診断に有用。
pmid-28491175.summary_en: Case report of primary fallopian tube choriocarcinoma in 39-year-old woman presenting with irregular vaginal bleeding and palpable abdominal mass. Serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin significantly elevated. MRI demonstrated well-defined cystic-solid mass with characteristic 'honeycomb appearance' in solid component; ovaries appeared normal. Pathology confirmed fallopian tube choriocarcinoma. Authors emphasize distinctive MRI features combined with elevated hCG.

pmid-28491817.summary_ja: 性腺異形成を伴う45,X/46,XY男性の症例である。尿道下裂と停留精巣に対して手術を受け、陰嚢触診による経過観察が行われた。24歳時に右セミノーマ(pT1)を発症し、高位精巣摘除術を要した。停留精巣と悪性腫瘍リスクの管理上の課題を論じている。
pmid-28491817.summary_en: Case report of 45,X/46,XY male with gonadal dysgenesis presenting with hypospadias and undescended testis. Underwent hypospadias repair, right orchidopexy, and bilateral testicular biopsy showing no malignant findings. Annual follow-up by scrotal palpation continued. At age 24, patient developed right seminoma (pT1) requiring high orchiectomy. Discusses management challenges of cryptorchidism and malignancy risk.

pmid-28492758.summary_ja: 新生児巨大口腔咽頭奇形腫症例報告。9cm有茎性腫瘤で皮膚と毛髪。AFP著明上昇(316,000 ng/ml)。手術摘出で成熟奇形腫病理診断。化学療法で完全奏効とAFP正常化。5歳時口蓋裂修復。7年経過で無再発。
pmid-28492758.summary_en: Case report of giant epignathus teratoma in newborn boy, presenting as 9-cm polypoid mass with skin and hair exteriorizing through mouth. AFP markedly elevated at 316,000 ng/ml. Surgical resection confirmed mature teratoma histology. Chemotherapy administered due to residual tumor and persistent AFP elevation, achieving complete regression and AFP normalization. Cleft palate repair performed at five years.

pmid-28506050.summary_ja: 組織学的純粋セミノーマながらAFP陽性の6例臨床病理研究。治療前AFP平均1,372 ng/ml、AFPL3%異常上昇。BEP化学療法後、VIP化学療法を3例に追加。3例で増悪し救済治療施行。5年無増悪生存率50%で非セミノーマより不良。
pmid-28506050.summary_en: Clinicopathologic analysis of six metastatic AFP-positive seminoma cases. Mean pretreatment AFP 1,372 ng/ml; AFPL3% abnormally increased in all examined patients. Treatment included bleomycin/etoposide/cisplatin followed by etoposide/ifosfamide/cisplatin in three cases. Three patients experienced disease progression requiring salvage chemotherapy and surgery. Five-year progression-free survival 50%, inferior to non-seminoma prognosis.

pmid-28506950.summary_ja: 若年女性未分化奇形腫の生殖温存治療レビュー。初期段階診断が多く予後良好。両側性10%で5年生存率80%。78%が補助化学療法施行。手術単独観察法は50%再発率だが化学療法反応性良好。高い妊娠成功率。
pmid-28506950.summary_en: Narrative review of fertility-sparing management in young women with immature teratomas. Most cases diagnosed at early stage with good prognosis. Bilateral involvement occurs in 10% with 80% five-year survival. Adjuvant chemotherapy administered in 78% of cases. Watch-and-wait observation alone resulted in 50% recurrence rate but excellent chemotherapy responsiveness. Good fertility outcomes achieved with high conception success rates.

pmid-28507579.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍患者85例(嚢胞腺腫35例、奇形腫15例、嚢胞腺癌35例)のsTRAIL関連マーカー研究。全マーカー濃度は正常対照より腫瘍患者で上昇。奇形腫で最高sTRAIL-R1値。卵巣腫瘍の鑑別診断における有用性示唆。
pmid-28507579.summary_en: Study assessing serum soluble TRAIL and its receptors (sTRAIL-R1, sTRAIL-R2) in 85 women with ovarian tumors: 35 cystadenomas, 15 teratomas, 35 cystadenocarcinomas, compared with 30 healthy controls. All marker concentrations elevated in tumor patients versus controls with distinct patterns by diagnosis. Highest sTRAIL-R1 observed in teratoma group. Results suggest potential utility in ovarian tumor differential diagnostics.

pmid-28507813.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫学的プロファイリング研究。セミノーマはCD3+ T細胞浸潤とPD-L1発現が増加、制御T細胞は減少。進行期でT細胞シグネチャ低下、好中球・マクロファージシグネチャ増加。がん/精巣抗原とCD8+/制御T細胞比が無増悪生存と相関。
pmid-28507813.summary_en: Comprehensive immune profiling of testicular germ cell tumors using multiplexed immunohistochemistry and gene expression analysis. Seminomas showed increased CD3+ T-cell infiltration, decreased regulatory T-cells, increased PD-L1 expression compared with non-seminomas. Advanced tumor stage associated with decreased T-cell signatures but increased neutrophil and macrophage signatures. Cancer/testis antigens and CD8+/regulatory T-cell ratio correlated with recurrence-free survival.

pmid-28510616.summary_ja: 欧州骨髄移植学会(EBMT)に登録された女性の胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)患者60例を後方視的に解析した研究。原発部位は卵巣が67%、縦隔が13%、後腹膜が12%であった。カルボプラチンを用いたサルベージ大量化学療法は二次から六次治療として使用された。評価可能な51例のうち33%が完全奏効、16%が腫瘍マーカー陰性部分寛解に至り、中央値87か月のフォローアップで42%が無増悪であった。
pmid-28510616.summary_en: Retrospective EBMT analysis of 60 female germ cell tumor patients (median age 27) receiving salvage high-dose chemotherapy (HDC). Primary sites: ovarian (67%), mediastinal (13%), retroperitoneal (12%). Carboplatin-based HDC used as second-line to sixth-line therapy. Among 51 assessable patients, 33% achieved complete response, 16% marker-negative partial remission. Forty-two percent achieved progression-free status at median 87-month follow-up.

pmid-28511670.summary_ja: 両側精巣セミノーマ患者2例を報告した症例報告。両側高位精巣摘除術と同時に腫瘍精巣精子採取術(onco-TESE)を施行した。1例では精子を採取して凍結保存できたが、もう1例は無精子症のため採取できなかった。生殖年齢の精巣がん患者が父親となることを望む場合、化学療法や両側精巣摘除術の前に精子を保存することの重要性が示された。
pmid-28511670.summary_en: Two case reports of bilateral testicular seminoma patients undergoing simultaneous bilateral higher orchiectomy with testicular sperm extraction (onco-TESE). One patient successfully had sperm harvested and cryopreserved; second patient had azoospermia precluding extraction. Demonstrates importance of sperm preservation before chemotherapy or bilateral orchiectomy for reproductive-age testicular cancer patients wishing to father children.

pmid-28512062.summary_ja: 精巣胎児癌細胞におけるhsa-miR-513b-5p調節研究。精子形成停止患者で高発現。過剰発現により細胞増殖抑制とアポトーシス誘導。P53発現促進。異常なhsa-miR-513b-5p発現が精巣成熟停止に寄与する可能性示唆。
pmid-28512062.summary_en: Study investigating hsa-miR-513b-5p regulation in testicular embryonal carcinoma (NT2) cells. Highly expressed in infertile males with maturation arrest. Overexpression suppressed cell proliferation and induced apoptosis by targeting interferon regulatory factor 2 (IRF2). Promoted P53 expression independent of p53 status. Results suggest abnormal miR-513b-5p expression may contribute to testicular maturation arrest.

pmid-28514776.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者153例を後方視的に解析し、シスプラチン併用化学療法中の静脈血栓イベント(VTT)の予測因子を検討した研究。化学療法中または化学療法後にVTTを発症したのは17%であった。Lugano病期≥IIcはVTT発症と有意に関連した。Khorana risk scoreは精巣がんにおけるVTT予測に正確ではなく、高い腫瘍量はシスプラチン併用化学療法に伴う血栓症の独立したリスク因子とされた。
pmid-28514776.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 153 testicular cancer patients undergoing cisplatin-based chemotherapy to identify predictive factors for venous thrombotic events (VTT). Seventeen percent developed VTT during or after chemotherapy. Lugano stage ≥IIc was significantly associated with increased VTT risk. Khorana risk score model proved inaccurate for testicular cancer. High tumor volume represents independent risk factor for chemotherapy-associated thrombosis.

pmid-28520571.summary_ja: 早期(病期I・II)の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍223例を後方視的に解析し、初回手術時の大網切除の必要性を検討した研究。対象には卵黄嚢腫瘍、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、未熟奇形腫が含まれた。大網切除は74%で施行され、26%では省略された。10年全生存期間(全生存率)は大網切除あり90.5%、なし98.1%であり、早期病変では大網切除が生存率を改善しない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-28520571.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 223 early-stage (I-II) malignant ovarian germ cell tumors examining necessity of omentectomy during initial surgery. Cases included yolk sac tumors, dysgerminomas, and immature teratomas. Omentectomy performed in 74%, omitted in 26%. Ten-year overall survival rates were 90.5% with omentectomy versus 98.1% without. Results suggest omentectomy may not improve survival in early-stage disease.

pmid-28521629.summary_ja: 眼内未分化奇形腫の4症例目、仙尾部奇形腫との関連症例としては2例目。両腫瘍の関連性機序は不明だが、先天性仙尾部奇形腫を有する乳幼児への眼科的フォローアップと早期スクリーニングの重要性を示唆。
pmid-28521629.summary_en: Fourth reported case of intraocular immature teratoma and second associated with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Intraocular teratomas represent extremely rare neoplasms with only four cases documented. While the association between intraocular and sacrococcygeal teratomas remains unclear, findings suggest potential common embryologic origin. Authors recommend careful ophthalmologic screening and long-term follow-up for all infants diagnosed with congenital sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-28521633.summary_ja: 小児腫瘍585例のCD30発現研究。胎児癌と成熟奇形腫を含める。胎児癌では強い膜表面発現、成熟奇形腫では神経節細胞における陽性所見。CD30の小児腫瘍における発現が予想より広く認められることを示唆。
pmid-28521633.summary_en: Immunohistochemical study of CD30 expression in 585 pediatric neoplasms including embryonal carcinoma and mature teratoma. Strong CD30 membranous staining observed in embryonal carcinoma as expected. One mature teratoma showed CD30 positivity specifically in ganglion cells. Results suggest CD30 expression is more broadly distributed in pediatric tumors than previously recognized.

pmid-28523263.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞状奇形腫を伴う自動切断卵巣の稀有症例。34歳女性に5cm嚢胞性腫瘤を認め、腹腔鏡下に摘出。病理診断は成熟奇形腫。腫瘍マーカー正常範囲。術後7ヶ月以内に自然妊娠を達成し、帝王切開で健康な児を出産。良好な妊娠転帰を示す。
pmid-28523263.summary_en: Rare case of autoamputated ovary containing mature cystic teratoma (MCT) in 34-year-old woman. Imaging showed 5-cm cystic lesion with calcifications and fat component. Tumor markers (CA125, CA19-9) were normal. Laparoscopic removal was performed; pathology confirmed MCT. Patient achieved spontaneous pregnancy and delivered healthy baby by cesarean section within seven months post-operatively.

pmid-28528058.summary_ja: 縦隔の異時性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法後にgrowing teratoma syndromeを発症し、外科的切除が必要となった。腫瘍マーカー(AFP、hCG)とともに画像によるサーベイランスが、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の管理において重要であることが示された。3回の手術後、54か月の無病生存が得られた。
pmid-28528058.summary_en: Case report of metachronous mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Patient developed growing teratoma syndrome after bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin chemotherapy, requiring surgical resection. Demonstrates importance of monitoring tumor markers (AFP, hCG) and imaging surveillance in mediastinal GCT management, with 54-month disease-free survival achieved after three operations.

pmid-28533651.summary_ja: 精巣の原発胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。生検により確定診断された症例で、(18-)F-FDG PET/CTにより、リンパ節および脾臓の広範な転移がリンパ腫に類似した所見として認められた。転移性胚細胞腫瘍の画像所見と、診断上の検討事項を示した報告である。
pmid-28533651.summary_en: Case report of testicular germ cell tumor with extensive lymph nodal and splenic metastases mimicking lymphoma on 18F-FDG PET/CT. Demonstrates imaging findings and diagnostic considerations for metastatic GCT presentation.

pmid-28534963.summary_ja: 絨毛膜性疾患としての絨毛癌における糖転移酵素GnT-IVaの役割を研究。GnT-IVa過剰発現はintegrin β1とLAMP-2の糖鎖修飾を変化させ、浸潤性を増強。
pmid-28534963.summary_en: Study of N-acetylglucosaminyltransferase IVa (GnT-IVa) role in choriocarcinoma invasion within gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. GnT-IVa overexpression increased cell migration, invasion, and tumor formation through altered glycosylation of integrin β1 and LAMP-2.

pmid-28536927.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)におけるシスプラチン感受性とDNAミスマッチ修復(MMR)系の関係を検討した研究。未分化セミノーマはMMRおよびOCT4の発現が高くシスプラチン感受性が高い一方、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌などの分化した成分はMMR発現が低く、耐性を示した。
pmid-28536927.summary_en: Study of DNA mismatch repair (MMR) system role in cisplatin sensitivity of testicular GCT. Found that undifferentiated seminomas with high MMR/OCT4 expression show greater cisplatin sensitivity, while differentiated components (teratoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma) with reduced MMR expression show resistance.

pmid-28539868.summary_ja: 焼き尽くし精巣絨毛癌の症例。自然退縮後に転移のみで呈現し、診断的課題を示す。
pmid-28539868.summary_en: Case report of burned-out testicular choriocarcinoma presenting with hemoptysis, weight loss, and metastases without palpable testicular lesion. Demonstrates diagnostic challenge of GCT that regresses spontaneously leaving only metastatic disease.

pmid-28540054.summary_ja: 51歳男性の後腹膜原発成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。高齢男性での原発性後腹膜奇形腫は極めて稀で、成熟成分のみを含む。
pmid-28540054.summary_en: Case report of primary retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma in 51-year-old male with historical literature review. Extremely rare presentation in older males; imaging showed cystic mass with fat and calcifications, histology confirmed mature teratoma without immature components.

pmid-28542371.summary_ja: 精母細胞腫瘍(SpT)5例の全ゲノムシーケンス解析である。変異負荷は極めて低く(約0.2/Mb)、生殖系列のde novo変異と類似した変異シグネチャーを示した。染色体全体にわたる広範な異数性が、発がんの初期事象である可能性が示唆された。男性胚細胞腫瘍の病因と細胞起源の理解に寄与する知見である。
pmid-28542371.summary_en: Whole-genome sequencing analysis of five spermatocytic tumors revealing extremely low mutation load (~0.2 per Mb), extensive aneuploidy as likely initiating event, and mutational signature similar to germline de novo mutations, providing insights into male germ cell tumor etiology.

pmid-28544305.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)患者における性腺胚細胞腫瘍(GCT)のリスクを評価するための臨床実践ガイド。分子病因に基づくリスクの層別化を示し、予防的性腺摘出術、妊孕性温存、ホルモン補充療法を含む管理上の検討事項を論じている。
pmid-28544305.summary_en: Clinical practice guide for assessing gonadal germ cell tumor risk in patients with differences of sex development (DSD). Provides risk stratification by molecular etiology and discusses management considerations including prophylactic gonadectomy, fertility preservation, and hormone replacement.

pmid-28544640.summary_ja: セミノーマ由来TCam-2細胞とPBMCの培養モデルで腫瘍免疫相互作用を検討。IL-6やその他サイトカイン産生パターンを明らかにし、早期診断・治療標的の可能性を示唆。
pmid-28544640.summary_en: Co-culture model using seminoma-derived TCam-2 cells and peripheral blood mononuclear cells to investigate tumor-immune interactions. Demonstrated IL-6 and other cytokine production patterns in testicular GCT microenvironment, identifying IL-6 as potential target for TGCT diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-28546713.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ型)におけるエピジェネティックな変化を包括的にレビューした論文。DNAメチル化パターン、ヒストン修飾、マイクロRNA(miRNA)の発現を、精巣GCTの診断および治療層別化のための潜在的な診断・予後マーカーとして検討している。
pmid-28546713.summary_en: Comprehensive review of epigenetic alterations in testicular germ cell tumors (seminomas and non-seminomatous types). Discusses DNA methylation patterns, histone modifications, and microRNA expression as potential diagnostic and prognostic markers for testicular GCT diagnosis and treatment stratification.

pmid-28546716.summary_ja: 閉経後出血で診断された55歳の完全奇胎の症例報告。閉経後女性における胞状奇胎は極めて稀であり、このまれな臨床シナリオの報告例を追加するもの。
pmid-28546716.summary_en: Case report of complete hydatidiform mole in a 55-year-old postmenopausal woman presenting with postmenopausal bleeding. Extremely rare presentation of gestational trophoblastic disease in postmenopausal age group, adding to sparse literature on this unusual clinical scenario.

pmid-28552560.summary_ja: 胚胎癌細胞と正常ヒト胚性幹細胞のミトコンドリア生物エネルギー特性を比較。胚胎癌細胞ではアデニル酸キナーゼ活性上昇、酸素消費低下、有酸素解糖増加が認められ、異なるエネルギー代謝プロフィールを示した。
pmid-28552560.summary_en: Comparative study of mitochondrial bioenergetic profiles between embryonal carcinoma cells (2102Ep) and human embryonic stem cells. EC cells showed increased adenylate kinase activity, reduced oxygen consumption, and increased aerobic glycolysis, revealing distinct bioenergetic signatures that distinguish them from normal pluripotent stem cells.

pmid-28554176.summary_ja: 精巣および卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍に由来する転移性中枢型原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(PNET)の穿刺吸引細胞診に関する研究。異型の円形細胞とシナプトフィジン陽性を示す特徴的な細胞形態を有する5症例を検討し、転移性PNETの診断においてFNAが信頼性の高い手法であることを示した。
pmid-28554176.summary_en: Study of fine-needle aspiration cytology of metastatic central primitive neuroectodermal tumors (PNET) arising from testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors. Five cases showed characteristic cytomorphology with atypical round cells and synaptophysin positivity, demonstrating diagnostic reliability of FNA for metastatic PNET.

pmid-28555346.summary_ja: 気管支ブラッシング(BB)検査による肺外悪性腫瘍の気管支内転移(EBM)診断の有用性を検討。56例の患者でEBMを診断。リンパ腫21例、乳腺腺がん11例、結腸腺がん7例、黒色腫6例、腎細胞がん5例、胚胎がん2例を含む。BB感度は総合85%、非血液悪性腫瘍では94%。
pmid-28555346.summary_en: Study evaluating bronchial brushing (BB) sensitivity for diagnosing endobronchial metastases (EBM) from extrapulmonary malignancies. 56 patients identified with EBM. Diagnoses included lymphoma (21), breast adenocarcinoma (11), colonic adenocarcinoma (7), melanoma (6), renal cell carcinoma (5), and embryonal carcinoma (2). BB sensitivity was 85% overall and 94% for non-hematologic malignancies including germ cell tumors.

pmid-28555838.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)患者における癌精子抗原(CTAg)特異的CD4+CD8+ T細胞応答を検討。44%の患者でMAGE特異的T細胞陽性。術除後にMAGE特異的T細胞が89%減少。腫瘍抗原が持続されることでCTAg特異的免疫が維持される。CTAg特異的T細胞免疫は精巣がんの優れた臨床転帰に寄与。
pmid-28555838.summary_en: Study of spontaneous CD4+ and CD8+ T-cell responses against cancer testis antigens (CTAg) in testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) patients. MAGE-specific T cells present in 44% of patient samples. Longitudinal analysis showed 89% decrease in MAGE-specific T cells following orchiectomy, suggesting tumor antigen persistence sustains CTAg-specific immunity. CTAg-specific T-cell immunity may contribute to excellent clinical outcomes.

pmid-28567059.summary_ja: 不完全流産と双胎妊娠での胎盤内絨毛性疾患2症例。稀な悪性腫瘍であり流産、子宮外妊娠、正期産、早産または奇胎診断後に診断される。多くの患者は無症状で病変は梗塞と誤認される。両症例は母体血清hCG監視下で経過観察され、現在まで無病生存。
pmid-28567059.summary_en: Two cases of intraplacental choriocarcinoma diagnosed after incomplete miscarriage and preterm spontaneous vaginal delivery. Intraplacental choriocarcinoma is rare malignancy typically identified following abortion, ectopic pregnancy, term or preterm delivery, or after hydatidiform mole diagnosis. Most patients are asymptomatic; lesions often mistaken for placental infarcts. Both cases underwent maternal surveillance with serum hCG and remained disease-free.

pmid-28567335.summary_ja: 化学療法未治療患者に発生した転移性嚢胞性栄養膜細胞腫瘍(CTT)の稀な症例。原発精巣奇形腫で後腹膜リンパ節転移に奇形腫、胚胎がん、CTT含有。CTT通常は治療後に発生。β-hCG陽性、SALL4陰性。SALL4でhCG産生腫瘍との鑑別可能。
pmid-28567335.summary_en: Rare case of metastatic cystic trophoblastic tumor (CTT) in treatment-naïve patient with primary testicular teratoma. Retroperitoneal lymph node metastases contained teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and CTT positive for β-hCG and negative for SALL4. CTT typically occurs post-chemotherapy; this case demonstrates de novo occurrence in untreated metastatic testicular GCT. SALL4 immunohistochemistry helps differentiate from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-28571142.summary_ja: 25年間に治療された卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(MCT)223例の後方視的解析。MCTは卵巣腫瘍の20.2%、胚細胞腫瘍の78.5%を占め、最も多い合併症は捻転であった。悪性転化は3.5%に認められ、妊孕性温存のための早期診断と治療の重要性が示された。
pmid-28571142.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 223 ovarian mature cystic teratoma (MCT) cases over 25 years. MCT constituted 20.2% of ovarian neoplasms and 78.5% of germ cell tumors. Mean patient age 32.5 years; mean tumor size 8.6cm. Torsion was most common complication; malignant transformation occurred in 3.5% of cases. 8.9% were bilateral. Early diagnosis and treatment important for fertility preservation.

pmid-28572843.summary_ja: 30歳未産女性のストルマオバリイ(卵巣の半分以上が甲状腺組織からなる単層性胚細胞腫瘍)が乳頭状甲状腺がんに悪性転化した症例。腹腔鏡下右卵管卵巣摘出で摘出。病理で乳頭状甲状腺がん確認。全甲状腺切除後も同様所見。積極的手術と放射線ヨウ素療法を推奨。
pmid-28572843.summary_en: 30-year-old nulliparous woman with malignant struma ovarii (rare monodermal germ cell tumor where thyroid tissue comprises >50% of ovary) developing papillary thyroid carcinoma. Laparoscopic right salpingo-oophorectomy performed; histology showed struma-derived papillary thyroid carcinoma. Subsequent total thyroidectomy confirmed papillary thyroid carcinoma. Aggressive surgical management followed by radioiodine therapy recommended.

pmid-28573637.summary_ja: 男性がん患者、特に精巣がん生存者におけるテストステロン欠乏の臨床的意義をレビュー。がんと治療は下垂体-精巣軸の障害を引き起こす。精巣がん生存者はテストステロン欠乏を含む晩期合併症に直面。男性ホルモン代謝の異常は代謝症候群と死亡率増加につながる。
pmid-28573637.summary_en: Review of testosterone deficiency in male cancer patients with emphasis on testicular cancer survivors. Cancer and treatment can impair pituitary-gonadal axis, causing testosterone deficiency with somatic and psychological symptoms. Testicular cancer survivors have increasing late complications including testosterone deficiency. Androgen deficiency contributes to metabolic syndrome and increased mortality in this population.

pmid-28574809.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの放射線学的レビュー。最も一般的な精巣悪性腫瘍であり、無痛腫瘤として発症。超音波検査では均等な低エコー。MRI検査で精巣内病変を確認、CT検査で後腹膜リンパ節含む病期分類。良性・悪性鑑別診断疾患を詳述。
pmid-28574809.summary_en: Comprehensive radiologic review of testicular seminoma, the most common malignant testis tumor. Seminomas present as painless masses and are hypoechoic on ultrasound. MR imaging confirms intratesticular location; CT provides staging information including retroperitoneal lymph nodes. Benign mimics (infarction, hematoma, infection, epidermoid cyst) and malignant mimics (nonseminomatous GCTs, lymphoma) are reviewed with distinguishing features.

pmid-28576544.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫は三層の胚葉構造を持つ稀な先天腫瘍。通常は充実性または混合充実嚢胞性病変として発症。純粋嚢胞性奇形腫はリンパ管奇形と臨床的・画像的に類似し診断困難。硬化療法が手術切除の代替治療として提供される場合があり、管理方針決定が複雑。
pmid-28576544.summary_en: Cervical teratomas are rare congenital tumors containing three germ cell layers. They typically present as solid or mixed solid-cystic lesions. Purely cystic teratomas present diagnostic challenge due to clinical and radiologic similarity to lymphatic vascular malformations. Sclerotherapy may be offered as alternative to operative excision, making management decisions clinically complex.

pmid-28578457.summary_ja: 前縦隔胚細胞腫瘍(MGCT)と急性巨核球性白血病(M7)の合併26症例をレビュー。全例MGCT第III期の非セミノーマ。46%でMGCT先行、31%で同時診断。MGCT診断からM7発症までの中央値5ヶ月、全生存期間中央値6ヶ月。患者は血液悪性腫瘍発症のハイリスク。
pmid-28578457.summary_en: Literature review of 26 English-language cases reporting mediastinal germ cell tumors (MGCT) and acute megakaryoblastic leukemia (M7). All MGCT cases were stage III non-seminomatous type. MGCT preceded M7 leukemia in 46% of cases and occurred concurrently in 31%. Median time from MGCT diagnosis to M7 leukemia development was 5 months; overall median survival was 6 months. Prognosis remains poor despite treatment.

pmid-28579584.summary_ja: 腹部膨満で紹介された40歳男性。腹部CTで脂肪と石灰化を含む大型腫瘤が発見された。腫瘤は2週間で30cmから40cmへ急速増大。病理検査で後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断。40cmの成熟腸管様嚢胞、骨髄、脂肪を含有。嚢胞内分泌増加による急速増大と推測。
pmid-28579584.summary_en: 40-year-old male with abdominal distention found to have large retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma on computed tomography. Tumor size rapidly increased from 30cm to 40cm within 2 weeks. Surgical resection confirmed 40-cm mature teratoma containing intestinal tract-like cyst structures, bone marrow, and fat. Rapid growth likely related to increased cyst secretion within the lesion.

pmid-28581124.summary_ja: 32例転移性および4例精巣外卵黄嚢腫瘍(YST)と51例体細胞悪性腫瘍をZBTB16免疫組織化学で検討。ZBTB16はYSTで91.6%の感度と高特異性を示した。非YST要素と体細胞がんは陰性。AFPおよびグリプカン-3より診断精度に優れていた。
pmid-28581124.summary_en: ZBTB16 immunohistochemical expression was evaluated as diagnostic marker for metastatic and extragonadal yolk sac tumors (YST). Study included 32 metastatic and 4 extragonadal primary YSTs and 51 somatic malignancies. ZBTB16 demonstrated 91.6% sensitivity for YST detection with high specificity; all somatic cancers were negative. ZBTB16 proved superior to AFP and glypican-3 for YST diagnosis in metastatic and extragonadal settings.

pmid-28584680.summary_ja: カリニロ症を伴う36歳女性が成人期に仙骨前髄膜瘤、仙骨奇形腫、仙骨欠損の症状を呈した。多診療科による単一段階手術アプローチで髄膜瘤を閉鎖し硬膜欠損を修復。術後1年で髄膜瘤は完全に消失し、統合的手術治療の有効性が示された。
pmid-28584680.summary_en: 36-year-old female with Currarino syndrome presenting with late-onset symptoms including presacral mass, anterior sacral meningocele, and sacral agenesis. Multidisciplinary single-stage surgical approach successfully treated the anterior sacral meningocele through obliteration and dural defect closure. Complete meningocele resolution occurred 1 year post-operatively, demonstrating efficacy of coordinated surgical management.

pmid-28585395.summary_ja: 42例の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍でEMT関連マーカー(E-カドヘリン、N-カドヘリン、P-カドヘリン、Zeb1、HMGA2、ビメンチン)を免疫組織化学で分析。E-カドヘリンとHMGA2は未熟奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍で有意に高発現。ビメンチンとZeb1も未熟奇形腫で高値。臨床パラメータとの関連なし。
pmid-28585395.summary_en: Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) markers (E-cadherin, N-cadherin, P-cadherin, Zeb1, HMGA2, vimentin) were analyzed in 42 malignant ovarian germ cell tumors. E-cadherin and HMGA2 expression were significantly higher in immature teratomas and yolk sac tumors compared with dysgerminomas. EMT-associated markers were differentially expressed among GCT subtypes but not associated with clinical parameters.

pmid-28586780.summary_ja: 312例の精巣疾患患者血清中のマイクロRNA371a-3p値を測定した。臨床経過が予想外だったセミノーマ患者5例を検討。miR371a-3p高値は画像診断が不確実でも原発性精巣GCTおよび転移を同定。正常値は転移の不在を正確に予測。古典的マーカーと異なり原発性胚細胞腫瘍も識別可能。
pmid-28586780.summary_en: MicroRNA371a-3p serum levels were evaluated in 312 patients with various testicular diseases. Five seminoma cases with unexpected clinical courses were reviewed. Elevated miR371a-3p identified primary testicular GCT and metastases despite inconclusive imaging in two cases; normal levels correctly predicted absence of metastases in one case. Knowledge of miR371a-3p status would have altered clinical management in all reviewed cases.

pmid-28591197.summary_ja: シスプラチン感受性および耐性精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株でmTOR、EGFR、HER2、VEGFR、IGF-1R阻害薬を検討。単剤としての細胞増殖抑制効果は認められたが、シスプラチン併用では相加作用または拮抗作用となり、シスプラチン耐性克服には有効でなかった。
pmid-28591197.summary_en: Kinase inhibitors targeting mTOR, EGFR, HER2, VEGFR, and IGF-1R were tested in both cisplatin-sensitive and resistant testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. All kinase inhibitors demonstrated significant growth inhibition as single agents in both cell line types. However, combinations with cisplatin showed only additive or antagonistic effects without overcoming cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-28591464.summary_ja: 精巣がん生存者は対照群と比較して低い骨塩密度を示し、特に未治療の性機能低下患者で顕著である。股関節での骨塩密度は6-8%低下。脊椎では未治療性機能低下患者で有意な低下。治療による骨塩密度への直接的な影響は認められず。性機能低下患者の骨粗鬆症予防が重要。
pmid-28591464.summary_en: Testicular cancer survivors (mean 9.3-year follow-up) demonstrated significantly decreased bone mineral density compared to age-matched controls. Hip bone mineral density was 6-8% lower in hypogonadal patients; spine density reduction was significant only in untreated hypogonadism. Treatment modalities showed no independent association with BMD reduction. Hypogonadal survivors are at increased risk for osteoporosis requiring preventive intervention.

pmid-28595223.summary_ja: 進行した縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍および両側肺転移を有する69歳の女性の症例報告である。放射線療法(12 Gy/4分割)、EP化学療法(部分奏効を得た)、残存腫瘍の完全切除からなる多職種治療を受けた。術後5年間のフォローアップ中、再発なく無病の状態が持続した。
pmid-28595223.summary_en: A 69-year-old woman with advanced mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor and bilateral pulmonary metastases received multimodal treatment including radiotherapy (12 Gy/4 fractions), combination chemotherapy (EP regimen achieving partial response), and complete surgical resection of residual masses. The patient achieved sustained disease-free remission without recurrence throughout 5 years of post-operative follow-up.

pmid-28596199.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマの症例。上大静脈症候群で発症。化学療法により良好な結果を得て、72ヶ月無再発経過。外生殖腺性生殖細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-28596199.summary_en: 31-year-old male with large anterior mediastinal seminoma presenting with superior vena cava syndrome. History of childhood radioactive exposure. Treated with chemotherapy; achieved disease-free status at 72 months without surgical intervention.

pmid-28597671.summary_ja: 子宮体部の成熟奇形腫の症例。神経組織、軟骨、腺組織を含む。月経過多で発症。診断後15ヶ月で再発なし。非常に稀な部位である。
pmid-28597671.summary_en: 37-year-old woman with mature teratoma of uterine corpus presenting with metrorrhagia. Histology showed disorganized neural tissue, cartilage, seromucinous glands, and respiratory epithelium. No tumor relapse 15 months post-diagnosis. Rare location with ~20 cases reported.

pmid-28603942.summary_ja: 83歳女性の肝原発性絨毛癌の症例。胃および肝転移を伴う。組織所見は絨毛癌の特徴を示し、hCG陽性、AFP陰性であった。
pmid-28603942.summary_en: Rare case of primary hepatic choriocarcinoma in 83-year-old woman with gastric, lymph node, and splenic vein involvement. Histology showed syncytiotrophoblastic and cytotrophoblastic cells with hCG expression. Immunohistochemistry negative for AFP, glypican-3.

pmid-28604478.summary_ja: アンドロゲン不応症患者に生じた両側セミノーマの症例。FDG PET/CTで左骨盤側壁に集積を認めた。両側とも病理学的にセミノーマと確認された。
pmid-28604478.summary_en: 21-year-old woman with androgen insensitivity syndrome diagnosed with bilateral seminomas. FDG PET/CT showed focal uptake in left pelvic sidewall with calcifications; smaller lesion on right with faint uptake. Both confirmed as seminomas on pathology.

pmid-28604728.summary_ja: GWASとメタ解析(症例7,319例、対照23,082例)により、19の新規TGCTリスク遺伝子座を同定し、既知の遺伝子座を合計44へと約2倍に増加させた。Hi-C解析により、リスクSNP間の物理的相互作用が明らかになった。原始胚細胞の分化不全がTGCT感受性に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-28604728.summary_en: GWAS and meta-analysis (7,319 cases, 23,082 controls) identifies 19 new TGCT risk loci, doubling known loci to 44 total. Hi-C analysis reveals physical interactions among risk SNPs. Implicates failed primordial germ cell differentiation in TGCT susceptibility.

pmid-28604732.summary_ja: 5件のGWAS(症例3,558例、対照13,970例)のメタ解析により、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の新規感受性遺伝子座8か所と既報関連の精緻化を同定した。同定された39の独立マーカーは父から息子への家族性リスクの37%を説明する。
pmid-28604732.summary_en: Meta-analysis of five GWAS studies (3,558 cases, 13,970 controls) identifies eight new testicular GCT susceptibility loci plus refined previous associations. 39 independent markers identified explain 37% of father-to-son familial risk.

pmid-28607781.summary_ja: 10年間未治療だった6cm成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫がイレウスで発症。腫瘤は21cmに増大し、壁在結節を認めた。組織診で奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌と診断。
pmid-28607781.summary_en: 67-year-old woman with known 6cm mature cystic ovarian teratoma (untreated for 10 years) presented with ileus. Imaging revealed tumor growth to 21cm with mural nodules. Pathology confirmed squamous cell carcinoma arising from teratoma.

pmid-28607811.summary_ja: 核妊娠と誤診された妊娠絨毛癌5症例。腹腔鏡で発見・切除後、化学療法により100%の完全奏効を達成。追跡調査中に再発なし。
pmid-28607811.summary_en: Five cases of gestational choriocarcinoma misdiagnosed as cornual pregnancy, discovered incidentally during laparoscopy. Laparoscopic resection followed by prompt chemotherapy achieved 100% complete remission with no relapse during follow-up.

pmid-28612337.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップに向けた血清マイクロRNA(miR-371a-3p、miR-373-3p、miR-367-3p)バイオマーカーを評価した研究である。残存病変や再発の検出において、従来のマーカー(AFP、hCG、LDH)よりもマイクロRNA検査の感度が高かったが、成熟奇形腫には有効ではなかった。
pmid-28612337.summary_en: Study evaluating serum microRNA biomarkers (miR-371a-3p, miR-373-3p, miR-367-3p) for testicular GCT follow-up. microRNA test more sensitive than conventional markers (AFP, hCG, LDH) for detecting residual disease and relapse, but ineffective for mature teratoma.

pmid-28614211.summary_ja: 24歳の表現型女性(46,XX核型)に発生した、精母細胞性腫瘍様成分と性腺芽腫由来のジャーミノーマからなる混合型性腺胚細胞腫瘍の症例。外科的治療のみで化学放射線療法を行わず、10年以上無病状態が続いている。
pmid-28614211.summary_en: Unique mixed gonadal germ cell tumor with predominantly spermatocytic tumor-like component and germinoma arising in gonadoblastoma in 24-year-old phenotypic woman with 46,XX karyotype. Managed surgically; disease-free 10+ years without chemoradiation.

pmid-28615984.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫内に発生した乳頭状甲状腺微小癌の症例。奇形腫内の悪性転化は稀で、追加治療の有益性について明確なコンセンサスがない。
pmid-28615984.summary_en: Case of papillary thyroid microcarcinoma arising within mature cystic ovarian teratoma in 34-year-old woman. Rare malignant transformation; third reported case without struma ovarii. Conservative management pursued; unclear benefit of further thyroidectomy and radioiodine ablation.

pmid-28619116.summary_ja: シスプラチン併用化学療法を受ける精巣がん患者を対象とした身体活動介入の実現可能性研究。適格患者18例中12例が参加した。ウォーキングなどの低強度活動が好まれ、悪心と体調不良が主な障壁であった。
pmid-28619116.summary_en: Feasibility study of physical activity intervention during cisplatin-based chemotherapy for testicular cancer. Twelve of 18 eligible patients participated. Walking and low-intensity activities were preferred; nausea and general malaise were primary barriers.

pmid-28619976.summary_ja: 18歳女性の膀胱に発生した成熟奇形腫（皮様嚢胞）の症例。超音波で2.5×2cm大の腫瘤として検出され、腹腔鏡下膀胱部分切除術で治療。組織診で成熟奇形腫が確認された。
pmid-28619976.summary_en: Case of mature dermoid cyst in urinary bladder presenting with suprapubic pain and dysuria in an 18-year-old woman. Imaging revealed a 2.5×2 cm heterogeneously enhancing mass. Treated with laparoscopic partial cystectomy; histology confirmed dermoid cyst.

pmid-28624163.summary_ja: Blandin-Nühn腺の先天性粘液嚢胞と舌の奇形腫が同時に認められた新生児例の初めての文献報告である。出生前診断に基づき分娩時の気道確保を行い、遅延切除により完全な切除と診断を確定した。巨舌や下顎への影響などの合併症を監視するため、長期フォローアップを実施した。
pmid-28624163.summary_en: First documented case of simultaneous congenital mucocoele of Blandin-Nühn glands and lingual teratoma in newborn. Prenatal diagnosis guided delivery airway management. Delayed surgical excision ensured complete resection and diagnosis. Long-term follow-up monitoring for complications including macroglossia and mandibular effects.

pmid-28624968.summary_ja: 胚細胞がん細胞株NTera2における癌幹細胞フェノタイプの可塑性を検討。マーカー陰性細胞が拡大中にマーカー陽性へ変化。幹細胞フェノタイプは可塑的。
pmid-28624968.summary_en: Study of cancer stem cell phenotype plasticity in embryonal carcinoma cell line NTera2. Cells sorted by CD133/SSEA4 expression showed different properties. Single-cell sorting revealed cancer stem cell phenotypes are not fixed: marker-negative cells acquired marker expression upon expansion, demonstrating dynamic plasticity.

pmid-28630245.summary_ja: シスプラチン化学療法後の転移性非セミノーマGCT患者の急性脳梗塞。内頸動脈閉塞を呈した。シスプラチン関連の稀で重篤な血管合併症。
pmid-28630245.summary_en: Case of 22-year-old male with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor who developed acute stroke with right internal carotid artery occlusion 3 days after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Presented with dysarthria, hemiplegia, and hemisensory loss, highlighting rare but severe vascular complication of cisplatin therapy.

pmid-28633916.summary_ja: 胚細胞がん細胞（NT2）で新規OCT4B4変異体を同定。分化誘導時に発現低下。OCT4B4抑制でG0/G1蓄積増加。多能性制御における役割を示唆。
pmid-28633916.summary_en: Identification of novel OCT4B4 transcript variant in embryonic carcinoma (NT2) cells. Expression down-regulated upon differentiation induction. OCT4B4 knockdown increased G0/G1 phase accumulation. Suggests role in maintaining stemness properties of pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-28634489.summary_ja: 一次縦隔GCT 6例（セミノーマ3、卵黄嚢腫瘍2、絨毛癌1）の多モダリティ治療。全例完全寛解、再発なし。確定診断と迅速な多モダリティ治療が重要。
pmid-28634489.summary_en: Study of 6 patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors (3 seminomas, 2 yolk sac tumors, 1 choriocarcinoma) treated with multimodal therapy. Median age 25 years, median follow-up 32.5 months. Combination surgery and BEP/EP chemotherapy with residual tumor resection achieved complete remission in all patients without recurrence.

pmid-28634622.summary_ja: 睾丸セミノーマの燃焼尽くされた現象で肋骨転移が初発。原発巣は自然消退し転移巣のみ増殖。化学療法と切除後、3年無再発。
pmid-28634622.summary_en: Case of burned-out seminoma manifesting as solitary rib bone metastasis. Primary testicular tumor showed hyalinization (spontaneous regression) while metastatic disease progressed. Treated with inguinal orchiectomy, BEP chemotherapy, and rib resection, achieving 3-year recurrence-free survival.

pmid-28637513.summary_ja: 鼻副鼻腔teratocarcinosarcomaの稀な悪性腫瘍症例。奇形腫と肉腫の特徴を合わせ持つ。外科切除後の放射線療法で2年無再発。
pmid-28637513.summary_en: Case report of sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma, rare aggressive malignancy with histological features of both carcinosarcoma and teratoma. 83-year-old female treated with surgical debulking and radiotherapy (60 Gy). No recurrence at 2-year follow-up, suggesting radiotherapy effective for residual disease.

pmid-28643027.summary_ja: 卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した原発性黒色腫41例のシステマティックレビューである。平均年齢は51.5歳で、24%が診断時に転移していた。56.7%が疾患で死亡し、65%に再発が認められた。治療の主体は外科的切除であり、補助化学療法や免疫療法の有益性は不明である。
pmid-28643027.summary_en: Systematic review of 41 primary melanomas arising in ovarian cystic teratomas. Average age 51.5 years, 24% metastatic at presentation, 56.7% died of disease (mean 9.3 months), 65% experienced recurrence. Surgical resection is mainstay; benefits of adjuvant chemotherapy and immunotherapy remain unclear.

pmid-28647396.summary_ja: 高位精巣摘除術標本221例の原報告と中央病理再評価を比較。組織亜型31%、脈管侵襲22%、精索浸潤9%、病期23%の不一致。GCT病理診断の陥穽を強調。
pmid-28647396.summary_en: Study comparing original pathology reports with central review in 221 testicular cancer orchiectomy specimens. Found significant discrepancies: 31% in histologic subtype, 22% in lymphovascular invasion, 9% in spermatic cord invasion, and 23% in pathologic stage, highlighting diagnostic pitfalls in GCT classification.

pmid-28648654.summary_ja: 縦隔の再発非セミノーマ性胚細胞癌に上大静脈症候群とSVC腫瘍栓を伴った症例報告である。改変したEXCLUDER腹部大動脈瘤用イリアック肢人工血管をGianturco Zステントで固定し、SVCの開存性を改善して治療に成功した。
pmid-28648654.summary_en: Case of recurrent nonseminomatous germ cell carcinoma of mediastinum with superior vena cava syndrome and SVC tumor thrombus. Successfully managed with modified EXCLUDER abdominal aortic aneurysm iliac limb endoprosthesis fixed with Gianturco Z-stent for improved SVC patency.

pmid-28653284.summary_ja: 再発GCTに対する標準用量と大量化学療法の有効性を比較した60研究のシステマティックレビュー。生存期間に有意差なし。両治療法の有効性は同等。
pmid-28653284.summary_en: Systematic review of 60 studies (29 standard-dose, 31 high-dose) comparing salvage chemotherapy efficacy in relapsed germ cell tumors. Meta-analysis showed no significant survival difference in median OS or 1-5 year survival rates, indicating comparable efficacy for both approaches as second-line or beyond.

pmid-28656118.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化奇形腫後にGrowing Teratoma Syndromeを発症した12歳女性。化学療法中の成熟奇形腫増殖。小児GTSの診断と治療選択肢をレビュー。
pmid-28656118.summary_en: Case of 12-year-old female with ovarian immature teratoma who developed growing teratoma syndrome - growth of mature teratoma with normal tumor markers after chemotherapy. Reviews pathophysiology, diagnostic algorithm, and treatment options for pediatric GTS, emphasizing surgical resection.

pmid-28657230.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌への悪性転化52例の多施設研究。全MCTの0.2%。進行年齢、腫瘍サイズ≥15cm、solid成分が危険因子。早期発見と完全切除が予後に必須。
pmid-28657230.summary_en: Taiwanese multicenter study analyzing 52 cases of malignant transformation of ovarian mature cystic teratoma to squamous cell carcinoma. Transformation incidence 0.2%. Advanced age, large tumor size (≥15 cm), and solid components are risk indicators. Early detection and complete resection essential for long-term survival.

pmid-28658171.summary_ja: 14歳未満の小児性腺胚細胞腫瘍127例(精巣53例、卵巣74例)の後方視的レビューである。臨床的特徴、画像所見、悪性GCTでのαフェトプロテイン(AFP)上昇、病理型を記載した。悪性腫瘍では卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、良性では成熟奇形腫が最も多かった。
pmid-28658171.summary_en: Retrospective review of 127 pediatric gonadal germ cell tumors (53 testicular, 74 ovarian) under 14 years old. Documents clinical features, imaging findings, AFP elevation in malignant GCTs, and pathologic types. Yolk sac tumor most common malignancy; mature teratoma most common benign type.

pmid-28658855.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した卵巣原発扁平上皮癌の稀な悪性転化症例。統一された治療プロトコルがない点を指摘。攻撃的な細胞減量手術と化学療法で治療。
pmid-28658855.summary_en: Rare case of pure primary squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Discusses malignant transformation and lack of standardized treatment protocols. Patient managed with aggressive cytoreductive surgery followed by chemotherapy.

pmid-28660470.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎による精神病症状を呈した17歳女性の卵巣奇形腫症例。卵巣嚢腫摘出術及び免疫療法で完全寛解。若年精神病患者の重要な鑑別診断。
pmid-28660470.summary_en: Case of 17-year-old girl with acute psychosis, catatonia, and autonomic instability found to have 6 cm ovarian teratoma associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. Fully recovered after ovarian cystectomy and immunotherapy, highlighting importance of teratoma-associated encephalitis in psychiatric differential diagnosis.

pmid-28662725.summary_ja: Rhazya stricta植物抽出物がNT2胚細胞がん細胞の神経分化を誘導することを示した。Oct4およびSox2などの多能性マーカー発現が低下。神経変性疾患への治療応用の可能性を示唆。
pmid-28662725.summary_en: Study demonstrating that chloroform stem extract of Rhazya stricta induces differentiation of NT2 pluripotent embryonal carcinoma cells into neurite-forming cells at 5 μg/ml. Down-regulates pluripotency markers Oct4, Sox2, and TRA-1-60, suggesting potential therapeutic applications for neurodegenerative diseases.

pmid-28662988.summary_ja: 大網に発生した稀な腹膜外成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。腹膜外奇形腫の位置に関する3つの胚学的仮説を解説。腹腔鏡手術により安全に管理された。
pmid-28662988.summary_en: Case report of rare extragonadal mature cystic teratoma located in the omentum, typically presenting in reproductive-age women. Discusses three main embryologic theories explaining extragonadal teratoma location. Successfully managed by laparoscopic resection.

pmid-28664181.summary_ja: hCG産生による異所性妊娠を模倣する卵巣GCT症例。hCG上昇と急性骨盤痛を呈する患者の鑑別診断の重要性を強調。生殖年齢女性における診断確定の必要性を示す。
pmid-28664181.summary_en: Case report of ovarian germ cell tumor mimicking ectopic pregnancy due to hCG production and pelvic pain. Emphasizes importance of differential diagnosis between ovarian GCT and ectopic pregnancy in reproductive-age patients presenting with hCG elevation and acute pelvic symptoms.

pmid-28664453.summary_ja: 小児頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍9例を対象に、(18)F-FDG PET/CTと診断用CTを比較した後方視的研究である。PET/CTは悪性が疑われる病変をより多く同定し、患者の33%で治療方針の変更をもたらした。病期分類と治療計画における臨床的有用性が示された。
pmid-28664453.summary_en: Retrospective study of 9 pediatric patients with extracranial germ cell tumors comparing 18F-FDG PET/CT to diagnostic CT. PET/CT identified more lesions concerning for malignancy and resulted in management changes in 33% of patients, demonstrating significant clinical impact in GCT staging and treatment planning.

pmid-28664933.summary_ja: 短鎖反復配列による遺伝的接合性解析を行った卵巣胚細胞腫瘍28例の研究である。ホモ接合性は成熟奇形腫63%、未熟奇形腫86%で高く、共通の細胞起源が示唆された。純粋な未熟奇形腫では再発がなく、混合型胚細胞腫瘍では再発が80%に認められた。
pmid-28664933.summary_en: Genetic zygosity study of 28 ovarian germ cell tumors using short tandem repeat genotyping: 10 mature teratomas, 11 immature teratomas, and 7 mixed GCTs. High homozygosity rates (mature 63%, immature 86%) suggest common cellular origin. Pure immature teratomas had excellent prognosis with no recurrences; mixed GCTs showed higher recurrence (80%).

pmid-28668957.summary_ja: 254例のセミノーマ患者のAFP値の後方視的分析。1.97%（5例）で非特異的AFP上昇。対照群（2.04%）と同等。病理で純セミノーマ確認。不必要な治療を回避する重要性強調。
pmid-28668957.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 254 seminoma patients examining alpha fetoprotein (AFP) levels. Non-specific AFP elevation found in 5 patients (1.97%), comparable to controls (2.04%). Elevations were modest and persistent; pure seminoma confirmed histologically in all cases. Highlights importance of recognizing this subgroup to avoid unnecessary treatment intensification.

pmid-28673447.summary_ja: 妊娠性トロホブラスト疾患（絨毛癌27例、侵襲性胞状奇胎14例）の大量膣出血に対する選択的動脈塞栓療法の有効性研究。92.7%で出血制御成功。89.5%で寛解達成。
pmid-28673447.summary_en: Retrospective study of 41 gestational trophoblastic neoplasia patients (27 choriocarcinomas, 14 invasive moles) with massive vaginal hemorrhage treated with selective arterial embolization (SAE). SAE successfully controlled bleeding in 92.7%; all patients received chemotherapy without recurrent massive bleeding; 89.5% achieved complete remission.

pmid-28673797.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞性精巣腫瘍の485例を対象とした25年間の単施設研究である。積極的監視群(301例、再発17.3%)と補助化学療法群(184例、再発1.1%)を比較した。全生存率は両群で同程度(99.1%)であったが、監視群で再発率が有意に高かったため、積極的監視は低リスク患者にのみ推奨された。
pmid-28673797.summary_en: 25-year single-center study of 485 clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumor patients comparing active surveillance (301 patients, 17.3% relapse) versus adjuvant chemotherapy (184 patients, 1.1% relapse). Overall survival similar (99.1%), but active surveillance recommended only for low-risk patients based on significantly higher relapse rates in surveillance group.

pmid-28673838.summary_ja: ベンゾ(a)ピレンのヒト絨毛癌細胞に対する効果研究。p21/p27発現増加による細胞周期停止とROS媒介性小胞体ストレスによるアポトーシス誘導。妊娠性トロホブラスト病の治療薬候補として期待。
pmid-28673838.summary_en: Study of benzo(a)pyrene (major cigarette smoke component) effects on human choriocarcinoma cell lines (JEG-3 and BeWo). B(a)P induced cell cycle arrest via p21/p27 upregulation and apoptosis through ROS-mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress. Results suggest potential therapeutic application for gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treatment.

pmid-28673874.summary_ja: 325例の単孔式腹腔鏡下卵巣付属器腫瘤切除の研究。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が9.2%（30例）。低い合併症率。最小侵襲手術で安全に管理可能。良好な短期成績。
pmid-28673874.summary_en: Retrospective study of 325 single-port laparoscopic surgeries for adnexal masses including 30 mature teratomas (9.2%). Low surgical complication rates: 1.5% intraoperative injury, 4.0% hernia rate, no reoperations. Benign disease predominated (87.4%); mature teratomas successfully managed with minimally invasive approach and favorable outcomes.

pmid-28676534.summary_ja: 正常精子形成、不妊症のサブタイプ、精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるHENMT1およびPIWIタンパク質の発現を検討した。piRNA経路の構成因子は、胚細胞特異的な様式でトランスポゾン発現を制御する。TGCT検体では正常組織と比べHENMT1およびPIWIL1の発現が有意に低かった。
pmid-28676534.summary_en: Study of HENMT1 and PIWI protein expression in human testis across normal spermatogenesis, infertility subtypes, and testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs). piRNA pathway components regulate transposon expression in a germ-cell-specific manner. TGCT samples showed significantly lower HENMT1 and PIWIL1 expression compared to normal tissue.

pmid-28679192.summary_ja: 50歳男性の精巣未分化型セミノーマの症例。菌状肉芽腫様陰嚢病変として提示し、全身転移を伴う。広範囲外科切除にもかかわらず術後死亡。この稀な亜型の不良な予後を示す。
pmid-28679192.summary_en: Case report of highly aggressive anaplastic seminoma in a 50-year-old homeless male presenting as fungating scrotal lesion with systemic metastases. Despite wide surgical excision, the patient deteriorated rapidly and died postoperatively, illustrating the poor prognosis of this rare variant comprising 5-15% of seminoma cases.

pmid-28680880.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍モデルかつ癌幹細胞株であるNTERA-2細胞に対するゲデュニンの抗増殖作用とアポトーシス誘導作用を検討した。ゲデュニンはHSP90を抑制し、ROS介在性の小胞体ストレスを介してアポトーシスを誘導した。化学療法抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍に対する治療の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-28680880.summary_en: Study evaluating gedunin's antiproliferative and pro-apoptotic effects on NTERA-2 human embryonal carcinoma cells, a germ cell tumor model and cancer stem cell line. Gedunin inhibited HSP90 and induced apoptosis through ROS-mediated endoplasmic reticulum stress, suggesting potential as treatment for chemotherapy-resistant germ cell tumors.

pmid-28684142.summary_ja: 妊娠中の抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の症例。卵巣奇形腫が疑われ、帝王切開時に右卵巣摘出術を施行。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を確認。神経軸麻酔の管理について報告。
pmid-28684142.summary_en: Case of a 28-year-old pregnant woman with severe anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis requiring cesarean delivery at 28 weeks gestation for suspected ovarian teratoma. Right oophorectomy revealed a mature cystic teratoma. Combined spinal-epidural anesthesia was successfully used for this complex neuraxial anesthetic management.

pmid-28685300.summary_ja: 在胎期間満期で体重3.7 kgの新生児に出生時から巨大な肝腫瘤が認められ、後に肝十二指腸間膜由来の未熟奇形腫と判明した症例報告である。小児胚細胞腫瘍は小児悪性腫瘍の1～3%を占める。性腺外発生はきわめてまれな提示例であり、文献は限られている。
pmid-28685300.summary_en: Case report of a term neonate (3.7 kg) with a giant liver mass at birth later identified as an immature teratoma arising from the hepatoduodenal ligament. Pediatric germ cell tumors comprise 1-3% of malignant pediatric tumors; this extragonadal location represents a very rare presentation with limited literature documentation.

pmid-28690899.summary_ja: 55歳女性が腹水と血清CA-125高値(258 U/mL)を呈し、悪性卵巣癌が疑われた。左卵管卵巣摘出術と迅速凍結切片検査により、稀な単一胚葉性奇形腫である卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。術後に血清CA-125値は正常化し、6か月時点で再発は認められなかった。卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断においてこの病態を認識することの重要性が示された。
pmid-28690899.summary_en: A 55-year-old woman presented with abdominal ascites and elevated CA-125 (258 U/mL) suggesting malignant ovarian carcinoma. Left salpingo-oophorectomy with frozen section confirmed struma ovarii, a rare monodermal teratoma. Serum CA-125 normalized postoperatively with no recurrence at six months, highlighting the importance of recognizing this entity in differential diagnosis.

pmid-28693262.summary_ja: 精巣GCT(胚性癌)細胞NTera2でのAXIN1研究。AXIN1過剰発現は細胞生存低下、PI3K/AKT/mTOR経路抑制。遺伝子治療の標的候補。
pmid-28693262.summary_en: Study of AXIN1 tumor suppressor in testicular GCT using embryonal carcinoma cell line NTera2. AXIN1 overexpression decreased cell viability and inhibited PI3K/AKT/mTOR signaling; potential gene therapy target.

pmid-28694004.summary_ja: 無症状の16歳女児で心エコー検査により偶然発見された、稀な心膜内奇形腫の症例である。心臓MRIでは複雑な心膜嚢胞が示された。悪性転化の危険性を考慮して手術が行われ、組織学的に奇形腫と確定した。術後の経過は良好であった。
pmid-28694004.summary_en: Rare case of intrapericardial teratoma incidentally discovered in asymptomatic 16-year-old girl on echocardiography. Cardiac MRI showed complex pericardial cyst. Surgery performed for malignant transformation risk; histology confirmed teratoma.

pmid-28695637.summary_ja: 心膜内奇形腫の出生前管理シスマティック・レビュー(59論文、67症例)。出生前介入26例中75%が良好転帰。非介入群では63.4%が水腫発症し30.8%のみ良好。
pmid-28695637.summary_en: Systematic review of 59 studies (67 fetuses) with pericardial teratoma. Prenatal intervention attempted in 26 cases; 75% had favorable outcome. Non-intervention group: 63.4% developed hydrops, 30.8% favorable outcome.

pmid-28695872.summary_ja: 新生児眼窩悪性奇形腫の症例。著しいex ophtalmosで眼球視認不能。眼窩摘出施行。病理学的に悪性奇形腫。
pmid-28695872.summary_en: Case of malignant teratoma of orbit in neonate with massive proptosis obscuring eyeball. Orbital exenteration performed. Clinically suspected teratoma; pathology confirmed malignant teratoma.

pmid-28698426.summary_ja: 前縦隔嚢胞性腫瘤の症例。術前にはリンパ囊や奇形腫を予想したが病理学的にセミノーマ。8年無再発。
pmid-28698426.summary_en: Case of 25-year-old with cystic mass in anterior mediastinum. Preoperative imaging suggested thymic cyst or teratoma, but pathology confirmed seminoma. No recurrence at 8-year follow-up without adjuvant therapy.

pmid-28698791.summary_ja: 潜在精巣症を伴う精巣傍セミノーマの初報告症例。文献では4例目だが潜在精巣症合併例は初。潜在精巣症は癌リスク5-10倍。
pmid-28698791.summary_en: First reported case of paratesticular seminoma in postpubertal cryptorchid testis. Fourth reported case overall in published literature and first in cryptorchid setting. Cryptorchidism associated with 5-10 times increased cancer risk.

pmid-28699204.summary_ja: 思春期・青年期の環境曝露と精巣胚細胞がんリスクを調べた症例対照研究(症例255例、対照459例)である。競技スポーツ、ガーデニング、低体重は防御的に関連し、農業関連職業はリスク上昇と関連した。
pmid-28699204.summary_en: Case-control study (255 cases, 459 controls) investigating postnatal exposures during puberty/adolescence and testicular germ-cell cancer risk. Competitive sports, gardening, lower weight protective; agriculture occupations increased risk.

pmid-28700986.summary_ja: 妊娠中の化学療法患者13例(血液腫瘍、乳癌、咽頭癌、絨毛膜癌を含む)の報告。化学療法に暴露した9新生児すべて奇形なし。選択的薬剤は2・3月経以降に使用可。
pmid-28700986.summary_en: Report of 13 patients treated with chemotherapy during pregnancy (hematologic malignancies, breast cancer, nasopharyngeal cancer, choriocarcinoma). Among 9 exposed newborns, all were free of congenital anomalies, though 1 died neonatally.

pmid-28705066.summary_ja: 後腹膜嚢胞性病変28患者の研究。尾腸嚢胞52%、奇形腫29%、大腸由来13%、神経原性6%。悪性例5例(18%)。固有成分は悪性の予測因子。
pmid-28705066.summary_en: MRI study of 28 patients (31 lesions) with primary retrorectal cystic lesions including tailgut cysts (52%), teratomas (29%), colorectal lesions (13%), neurogenic lesions (6%). Five malignant cases (18%); solid component predictive of malignancy.

pmid-28709051.summary_ja: 84歳患者の胃絨毛膜癌と小細胞癌の衝突腫瘍。両者とも胃癌の0.1%未満と極めて稀。嚥下困難と貧血で呈示。総胃切除施行。
pmid-28709051.summary_en: Case of 84-year-old with collision tumor of gastric choriocarcinoma and small cell carcinoma. Both histologies rare (<0.1% of gastric cancers). Presented with dysphagia and anemia; total gastrectomy performed.

pmid-28712791.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ患者16,463例の全国規模研究。放射線療法は二次悪性腫瘍リスク増加だがstage IB/IIAで全生存改善。15年全生存率は96%以上。
pmid-28712791.summary_en: National study of 16,463 men with stage I/II testicular seminoma (1988-2013). Radiotherapy increased secondary malignancy risk but improved cancer-specific survival for stages IB/IIA. 15-year CSS excellent across stages (≥96%).

pmid-28712904.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛膜癌の脳転移2症例と文献15症例のレビュー。平均年齢25.5歳。67%が予後不良。出血関連合併症が一般的。
pmid-28712904.summary_en: Report of 2 cases of testicular choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastasis and review of 15 literature cases. Mean age 25.5 years; 67% had poor outcomes; hemorrhage-related complications common.

pmid-28714114.summary_ja: 肝芽腫と疑われた後腹膜未分化奇形腫の乳児症例。化学療法抵抗性で肝移植施行。病理学的にNorris grade 3未分化奇形腫と確認された。
pmid-28714114.summary_en: Case of 3-month-old with retroperitoneal immature teratoma initially misdiagnosed as hepatoblastoma. Chemotherapy-resistant tumor underwent split liver transplantation with pathology confirming Norris grade 3 immature teratoma.

pmid-28719463.summary_ja: 精索内脈管侵襲を伴う非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を、pT3腫瘍と比較した多施設共同研究である。この所見がpT3として病期分類されるべきかを検討し、再発および生存率の差を解析した。
pmid-28719463.summary_en: Multi-institutional study comparing nonseminomatous germ cell tumors with spermatic cord lymphovascular invasion to pT3 tumors, examining whether this finding warrants pT3 staging and analyzing disease recurrence and survival differences.

pmid-28719895.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症候群の女性における悪性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発症機序およびリスク因子を総説した論文である。腫瘍発生の機序と臨床的なスクリーニング戦略について論じている。
pmid-28719895.summary_en: Review of pathophysiology and risk factors for malignant testicular germ cell tumor development in women with complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS), discussing tumor development mechanisms and clinical screening strategies.

pmid-28720343.summary_ja: カリフォルニア州の小児がん13,636例を対象とした疫学研究である。出生地近傍の産業由来ジクロロメタン曝露により、胚細胞腫瘍(OR 1.52)、特に奇形腫(OR 2.08)のリスク上昇が認められた。
pmid-28720343.summary_en: Epidemiological study of 13,636 California childhood cancers finding elevated risk for germ cell tumors (OR 1.52) and particularly teratomas (OR 2.08) with industrial dichloromethane exposure near birth residence.

pmid-28724848.summary_ja: 38歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の腹腔鏡手術の症例報告で、組織病理学的確認と良好な術後経過を報告。
pmid-28724848.summary_en: Case report of laparoscopic excision of ovarian mature cystic teratoma with coexisting uterine adenomatoid tumor in a 38-year-old woman, with histopathologic confirmation and 6-month follow-up showing no recurrence.

pmid-28728581.summary_ja: DNA多型分析により卵巣の胎児性絨毛癌と診断された症例で、胎児性絨毛癌（GTD）は本サイトの対象範囲に含まれ、治療方針決定に重要。
pmid-28728581.summary_en: Case report of primary ovarian gestational choriocarcinoma diagnosed using DNA polymorphic analysis to confirm fetal origin, showing excellent chemotherapy response and demonstrating importance of distinguishing tumor types for treatment planning.

pmid-28730668.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫と反復三倍体妊娠の両方で減数第二分裂の失敗という同じメカニズムを示し、卵母細胞減数分裂異常に対する遺伝的素因の家系研究。
pmid-28730668.summary_en: Genetic analysis of mature ovarian teratomas and recurrent triploidy in miscarriages, identifying shared meiosis II failure mechanism in affected family members suggesting inherited genetic susceptibility to oocyte meiotic defects.

pmid-28750644.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質腫瘍の患者41例を対象とした後方視的研究である。妊孕性温存手術と化学療法後の生殖機能転帰を検討した。自然妊娠は83%に認められ、転帰は良好であった。
pmid-28750644.summary_en: Retrospective study of 32 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (6 dysgerminomas, 6 yolk sac tumors, 17 immature teratomas, 3 mixed) treated with fertility-sparing surgery and chemotherapy, showing good reproductive outcomes with 83% natural conception.

pmid-28751996.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における平滑筋肉腫と扁平上皮がんの同時発生という稀な悪性転化の症例報告で、この文脈での平滑筋肉腫の報告例は4例のみと極めて稀である。
pmid-28751996.summary_en: Case report of rare malignant transformation in mature cystic ovarian teratoma with simultaneous leiomyosarcoma and squamous cell carcinoma, representing one of only four previously reported leiomyosarcoma cases in this context.

pmid-28753801.summary_ja: 1095人のGCT患者を対象にした病院ベースの大規模研究で、40歳以上の患者が転移性GCTで化学療法後により高い再発リスクと死亡リスクを示すことを報告した。
pmid-28753801.summary_en: Large hospital-based study of 1,095 germ cell tumor patients examining how age ≥40 years affects outcomes in metastatic disease despite receiving intended chemotherapy, finding significantly worse prognosis and higher relapse rates in older patients.

pmid-28753846.summary_ja: TCGAデータを用いて、精巣腫瘍を含む複数の泌尿器科悪性腫瘍における体細胞変異数とコピー数変異パターンを分析し、遺伝子変異と腫瘍の段階、悪性度、生存転帰との相関を検証した。
pmid-28753846.summary_en: Analyzes somatic mutation count and copy number variation across multiple genitourinary cancers including testicular germ cell tumors using TCGA data, correlating genomic alterations with tumor grade, stage, and survival outcomes.

pmid-28758930.summary_ja: タバコ煙成分（ホルムアルデヒドとベンゼン）がヒト絨毛癌細胞JEG-3の増殖・遊走・EMTに与える影響を研究。GTD関連の腫瘍生物学。
pmid-28758930.summary_en: Studies effects of cigarette smoke components (formaldehyde and benzene) on human choriocarcinoma cells (JEG-3 line), demonstrating increased proliferation, migration, epithelial-mesenchymal transition, and antioxidant activation relevant to gestational trophoblastic neoplasia biology.

pmid-28759528.summary_ja: 29歳女性の完全胞状奇胎排出後3か月の症例報告。18F-FDG PET/CTにより妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のうち侵入奇胎(絨毛腺腫破壊性)が診断され、転移が否定された。PET/CTがGTNの患者管理に有用であった可能性を示す。
pmid-28759528.summary_en: Case report of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (invasive mole/chorioadenoma destruens) diagnosed by 18F-FDG PET/CT imaging 3 months after evacuation of complete hydatidiform mole in 29-year-old woman.

pmid-28764226.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者のBEP化学療法中に発症した冠動脈正常の急性心筋梗塞の症例。GCT化学療法の心毒性を強調。
pmid-28764226.summary_en: Case report of acute myocardial infarction with normal coronary arteries in seminoma patient receiving BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin), highlighting cardiotoxicity risks in germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-28765489.summary_ja: 24歳男性の症例報告。超音波検査で孤立性石灰化を示した精巣の純粋な胎児性癌を報告する。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な画像所見であり、3か月での増大を経て根治的精巣摘除術が行われた。
