pmid-22987628.summary_ja: 本研究では、新鮮凍結された48例のGCT検体と4種のGCT細胞株でEPCAM発現を測定した。EPCAMは良性ではなく悪性のGCTで発現しており、奇形腫では未熟度とともに発現が増加した。発現は血清AFPおよびhCGと相関し、卵黄嚢腫瘍および絨毛癌で最も高かった。免疫組織化学およびインビトロの解析でも、これらの結果が裏付けられた。著者らは、これらの非セミノーマ性GCTがEPCAM免疫療法の候補標的となる可能性があり、さらなる評価が必要であると述べている。
pmid-22987628.summary_en: This study measured EPCAM expression in 48 fresh-frozen germ cell tumors and four GCT cell lines. EPCAM was expressed in malignant but not benign GCTs and increased with immaturity in teratomas. Expression correlated with serum AFP and hCG levels and was highest in yolk sac tumors and choriocarcinomas, as confirmed by immunohistochemistry and in vitro work. The authors suggest these nonseminomatous GCTs may be candidate targets for EPCAM-directed immunotherapy, which warrants further evaluation.

pmid-22987789.summary_ja: 27歳男性が喘鳴で受診し、喉頭・気管を閉塞する腫瘤が認められた。部分的輪状気管切除後の7cm欠損を、骨皮膚橈骨前腕皮弁で一期的に再建した。術後に気管カニューレを抜去でき、発声と嚥下も良好であった。成人の喉頭に発生した悪性未熟奇形腫の初報告であり、新規の再建手技として報告している。
pmid-22987789.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with stridor due to a laryngeal and tracheal mass, diagnosed as a malignant immature teratoma. He underwent noncircumferential partial cricotracheal resection creating a 7-cm defect, reconstructed with an osteocutaneous radial forearm flap without prefabrication. He was decannulated and had good speech and swallowing postoperatively. The authors report this as the first malignant immature teratoma involving the larynx in an adult and describe a novel single-stage reconstructive technique.

pmid-23001941.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を中心とする高心拍出量病変の胎児35例を後方視的に検討した研究である。体重で補正した心拍出量と心血管プロファイルスコア(CVPS)の間に有意な負の相関が認められた。子宮内死亡や介入を要した例の80%ではCVPSが8未満であり、CVPSはリスク層別化に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-23001941.summary_en: This retrospective echocardiographic study of 35 fetuses with high cardiac output lesions, mostly sacrococcygeal teratoma, examined the relationship between estimated combined cardiac output indexed to fetal weight and the cardiovascular profile score. Higher cardiac output correlated with lower CVPS. Most fetuses that experienced in-utero demise or required intervention had a CVPS below 8, suggesting CVPS may help stratify risk and select fetuses for intervention.

pmid-23007804.summary_ja: HIV感染歴のある成人男性で、反復する頻脈を契機に心膜内腫瘤が見つかった症例報告である。外科的切除後に病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が有用な画像検査であり、リンパ腫や感染症が鑑別に挙がった。奇形腫は化学療法や放射線療法に抵抗性のため、手術が主な治療となる。
pmid-23007804.summary_en: This case report describes an HIV-positive adult man who presented with recurrent tachycardia and was found to have an intrapericardial mass. After surgical excision, histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors review imaging, with CT and MRI being most useful, and differential diagnoses including lymphoma and infection. They note that surgery is the main treatment because cardiac teratomas are relatively resistant to chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

pmid-23016566.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法後に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を同時施行した42例を後方視的に解析した。後腹膜リンパ節では壊死が多かったが、リンパ節に腫瘍が残らない症例でも精巣には生存腫瘍が認められることが多かった。組織学的不一致率は38.1%であり、進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍における完全精巣摘除術の意義を支持する結果となった。
pmid-23016566.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 42 patients who underwent simultaneous orchidectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. Necrosis predominated in most lymph node specimens, yet viable tumor often persisted in the orchiectomy despite tumor-free nodes, and histological discordance occurred in 38.1% of cases. The findings support completion orchidectomy as part of treatment for advanced testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-23017517.summary_ja: 1980年から2007年に化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた精巣がん患者1,790例を後方視的に解析した。腎摘除術は14.8%で施行され、近年は減少傾向であった。後腹膜腫瘤が10cmを超えることが最も強い予測因子であった(OR 9.30)。がん組織、救援化学療法、左側原発、腫瘍マーカー上昇も腎摘除術の増加と関連した。
pmid-23017517.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1,790 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND for testicular cancer from 1980 to 2007 found nephrectomy in 14.8%, with incidence declining over time. A retroperitoneal mass larger than 10 cm was the strongest predictor, with an odds ratio of 9.30. Higher rates were also associated with cancer histology, salvage chemotherapy, a left primary tumor, and elevated markers at surgery.

pmid-23021090.summary_ja: 1993年から2010年に化学療法後腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた、病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初回100例を後方視的に検討した。手術は実施可能で合併症も少なかった。平均74か月の観察期間中に再発は1例のみで、手術野内の再発はなかった。両側神経温存術後の患者の95.2%で順行性射精が保たれた。
pmid-23021090.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review covered the first 100 patients with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent postchemotherapy laparoscopic RPLND between 1993 and 2010. Surgery was feasible with low morbidity. Only one patient recurred during a mean follow-up of 74 months, with no recurrence inside the surgical field. Of patients who underwent bilateral nerve-sparing surgery, 95.2% reported antegrade ejaculation.

pmid-23046175.summary_ja: 新生児の女児に生じたエピグナサス奇形腫の症例報告である。下顎骨と舌が重複しており、出生時に開口障害と上気道閉塞を生じた。救命のため気管切開を行い、その後、腫瘍減量と解剖学的異常の矯正を段階的に実施した。気道リスクの軽減と外観・生活の質の改善が得られた。
pmid-23046175.summary_en: This report describes a female infant with an epignathus teratoma, a congenital teratoma of the oropharyngeal region, with duplication of both the mandible and tongue. The mass caused trismus and upper airway obstruction at birth, requiring life-saving tracheostomy. Staged operations, including debulking and correction of the anatomical anomaly, were then performed, reducing airway risk and improving facial appearance and quality of life.

pmid-23052753.summary_ja: 24歳女性の後腹膜腫瘤を報告。術前は未熟成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断されたが、切除標本で奇形腫内に潜在する原発性カルチノイド腫瘍が確認された。術後24か月間再発は認められていない。術前画像で良性と思われても、成人の後腹膜奇形腫では悪性転化が起こり得ることを強調している。
pmid-23052753.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman presented with an abdominal mass that was preoperatively diagnosed as a retroperitoneal mature teratoma with an immature component. Histology revealed mature fat, soft tissue and bone with prostate-like tissue, and an incidental latent primary carcinoid tumor within the teratoma, establishing a diagnosis of carcinoid arising in a mature teratoma. The patient remained free of recurrence for 24 months after surgery. The authors highlight that malignant transformation can occur in adult retroperitoneal teratoma even when preoperative imaging suggests a benign lesion.

pmid-23059385.summary_ja: 高齢男性の精巣および精巣付属器腫瘍を概説。通常型のセミノーマや非セミノーマは20〜45歳に多いが、60歳以上では精子細胞性セミノーマ、悪性ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍、精巣のリンパ腫、精巣周囲の肉腫が多くみられる。高齢者の非典型的な精巣腫瘤を認識する際の参考となる。
pmid-23059385.summary_en: This review discusses testicular and paratesticular neoplasms in elderly men, which differ markedly from those in younger patients. Conventional seminoma and nonseminoma typically occur between ages 20 and 45, whereas spermatocytic seminoma, malignant Leydig cell tumors, testicular lymphomas and paratesticular sarcomas are more common after age 60. The authors describe the entities most often diagnosed in older men, providing context for recognizing atypical testicular masses in this population.

pmid-23062817.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、パクリタキセルを含む大量化学療法(TECTIC)と自家幹細胞救済を行った48例の成績とQOLを報告。無増悪生存期間の中央値は11.8か月、全生存期間は21.7か月であった。長期生存者は全般的健康スコアが高い一方、身体機能は低く、持続的寛解と許容できるQOLが示された。
pmid-23062817.summary_en: The authors report the clinical course and quality of life of patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors treated with the TECTIC regimen (high-dose paclitaxel, etoposide, carboplatin, ifosfamide) with autologous stem cell rescue. Of 48 enrolled patients, median PFS was 11.8 months and median OS 21.7 months. Among interviewed survivors, global health scores exceeded historical cohorts while physical functioning was lower. HDCT with TECTIC produced durable remissions with acceptable quality of life in long-term survivors.

pmid-23065465.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分・完全胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、および絨毛癌の免疫組織化学的検討。p16は栄養膜細胞で妊娠週数とともに増加し、侵入奇胎の絨毛間質での強い発現が侵襲性に関与する可能性がある。絨毛癌ではBcl-2とp16がともに弱く、速い細胞周期回転が進行の鍵と考えられた。
pmid-23065465.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p16 and Bcl-2 expression across normal placenta, partial, complete and invasive hydatidiform moles, and post-molar choriocarcinomas. p16 expression in cytotrophoblast rose with gestational age, and strong p16 in the villous mesenchyme of invasive moles may contribute to their invasiveness. Bcl-2 was syncytiotrophoblast-specific. In choriocarcinoma, weak Bcl-2 with weak p16 suggested high apoptotic and proliferative potential, with rapid cell-cycle turnover proposed as the driver of progression.

pmid-23072289.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後にシスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・エトポシドによる補助化学療法を受けた病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。22か月後、奇形腫成分の悪性転化により生じた後頭部転移が横紋筋肉腫のみで構成されていた。悪性転化を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の補助化学療法の課題を示す。
pmid-23072289.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage I testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who received two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Twenty-two months later, an occipital metastasis composed solely of rhabdomyosarcoma developed, arising from malignant transformation of a teratoma component. The case highlights the challenges of adjuvant chemotherapy for germ cell tumors with malignant transformation.

pmid-23073996.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ61例と正常精巣23例を対象に、GP5+/GP6+コンセンサスプライマーを用いたリアルタイムPCRでHPV DNAを検索した。いずれの検体からもHPV DNAは検出されなかった。セミノーマとHPVの関連は支持されないと結論づけ、精巣腫瘍発生におけるHPVの役割については今後の検討が必要としている。
pmid-23073996.summary_en: This study used real-time PCR with GP5+/GP6+ consensus primers to test for human papillomavirus DNA in 61 seminoma specimens and 23 normal testicular samples. No HPV DNA was detected in any specimen. The authors conclude that the data do not support an association between HPV and seminoma, while noting that further studies are needed to definitively clarify any role of HPV in testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-23078915.summary_ja: Tgkdトランスジェニックマウスを用いて、卵巣奇形腫の発生におけるInpp4bの役割を検討した研究。Tgkdの挿入によりInpp4bの発現が低下し、顆粒膜細胞でPI3K/AKTシグナルが亢進していた。奇形腫は減数分裂Iを終えた成熟卵子に由来しており、PI3K/AKT経路の過剰活性化が卵巣奇形腫の形成を促進すると示唆している。
pmid-23078915.summary_en: This study examines the role of inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type II (Inpp4b) in ovarian teratoma formation using Tgkd transgenic mice, which are highly susceptible to teratomas. Tgkd insertion near Inpp4b reduced its expression and increased PI3K/AKT signaling in granulosa cells, creating a folliculogenesis defect. Tgkd teratomas were found to originate from trapped mature oocytes that had completed meiosis I. The findings suggest PI3K/AKT hyperactivation promotes teratoma formation.

pmid-23098692.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株において、1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD3がシスプラチン感受性を高めるかを、インビトロおよびインビボで検討した研究である。胎児性癌由来のNTera2細胞では、多能性遺伝子の抑制と細胞周期調節因子の上昇により、ビタミンDがシスプラチンの細胞傷害性を増強した。セミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞や2102Ep細胞では有意な効果はなかった。ヌードマウスの異種移植モデルでは、併用によりOCT4は低下したが、シスプラチン単独を超える腫瘍増殖抑制は得られなかった。
pmid-23098692.summary_en: In vitro and in vivo study of whether 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 enhances cisplatin sensitivity in testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Vitamin D augmented cisplatin cytotoxicity in the NTera2 embryonal carcinoma line by downregulating pluripotency genes and upregulating cell-cycle regulators, with no significant effect in seminoma (TCam-2) or 2102Ep lines. In NTera2 xenografts in nude mice, the combination reduced OCT4 expression but did not significantly enhance tumor growth inhibition beyond cisplatin alone, and dietary cholecalciferol did not increase cisplatin sensitivity.

pmid-23103591.summary_ja: 生後9か月の女児に生じた膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。不正性器出血で発症し、内視鏡・腹腔鏡下生検で診断された。PEB療法後に残存病変を外科的切除し、腫瘍は縮小した。2年後も無病生存中であり、生殖機能の温存を考慮した治療の重要性を述べている。
pmid-23103591.summary_en: Case report of a 9-month-old girl with an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the vagina presenting with metrorrhagia. Diagnosis was established using endoscopic and laparoscopic examination with biopsy. After platinum-based PEB chemotherapy, a residual lesion was removed during follow-up, and the tumor regressed. At two-year follow-up the patient was alive and disease-free. The authors stress that the vagina is a critical site where reproductive and sexual function should be preserved when possible.

pmid-23104458.summary_ja: 57歳女性の後縦隔に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。下行大動脈に接着した石灰化と液体成分を伴う腫瘍を、胸腔鏡手術で根治的に切除した。後縦隔の良性奇形腫は周囲構造と癒着しやすく、術前所見からこれを想定することの重要性を述べている。
pmid-23104458.summary_en: Case report of a 57-year-old woman with a posterior mediastinal mature teratoma adhering to the descending aorta. Preoperative work-up showed a calcified tumor with fluid components. The tumor was radically resected by video-assisted thoracic surgery, and histology confirmed a mature teratoma with cystic change. The authors note that benign posterior mediastinal teratomas often adhere to major surrounding structures such as the aorta, chest wall, and esophagus, and that this should be anticipated when typical features are present preoperatively.

pmid-23104726.summary_ja: 2つの第III相試験に登録された、再発・進行性の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を解析した研究。化学療法6週後のAFPおよびhCGの低下の程度(腫瘍マーカー減少度)が、無増悪生存期間と全生存期間の独立した予測因子であった。Lorch予後スコアとは独立した因子で、救済療法における予後評価に有用と結論している。
pmid-23104726.summary_en: Secondary analysis of 400 patients with progressive or relapsed disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumors from two prospectively accrued phase III trials. Serum AFP and hCG were measured at baseline and after six weeks of salvage chemotherapy. An unfavorable marker decline was an independent predictor of poorer progression-free and overall survival in both training and validation sets, beyond the Lorch prognostic score, supporting its use in the salvage setting.

pmid-23104768.summary_ja: 12週齢のSwiss albinoマウスに自然発生した精巣腫瘍の病理組織学的・免疫組織化学的解析の報告。左精巣に絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌が、右精巣に奇形腫が認められ、転移は見られなかった。マウスで自然発生した非転移性の複合的胚細胞腫瘍の初報告としている。
pmid-23104768.summary_en: Histopathological and immunohistochemical characterization of spontaneous testicular tumors in a 12-week-old Swiss albino mouse. The left testis contained choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonal carcinoma, and the right testis contained a teratoma. The neoplasms were nonmetastatic. The authors report this as the first description of spontaneously arising, nonmetastasizing choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, and teratoma together in the testes of a mouse.

pmid-23110807.summary_ja: 欧州12地域の癌登録と米国SEERデータを用い、1993〜97年と2003〜07年に診断された精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの相対生存率を比較した研究。50歳未満のセミノーマは98%以上の生存率を示した。高齢の非セミノーマ患者では改善が見られたものの依然として低く、欧州の患者は米国に比べ死亡リスクが高かった。
pmid-23110807.summary_en: Population-based analysis of 12 European cancer registries and the US SEER 9 database, comparing relative survival of testicular seminoma and nonseminoma patients diagnosed in 1993-1997 and 2003-2007. Five-year relative survival for seminoma was at least 98% in patients under 50. Nonseminoma survival remained lower, and older nonseminoma patients improved substantially but still lagged behind older seminoma patients. After adjustment, European patients had higher relative excess risk of death than US patients.

pmid-23114647.summary_ja: 症例報告である。48歳女性に発生した侵襲性の高い両側性の肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍を報告している。腫瘍は原始生殖細胞マーカーに陽性で、第3染色体多倍体を示した。肺の原発性胚細胞腫瘍で初めて報告された染色体異常とされている。著者らは、Oct3/4とSox2の相互作用が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の発生に寄与している可能性を論じている。
pmid-23114647.summary_en: Case report of a 48-year-old woman with an aggressive bilateral primary yolk sac tumor of the lung. The tumor stained positive for primordial germ cell markers and showed chromosome 3 polysomy, described as the first chromosomal aberration in a primary lung germ cell tumor. The study frames the findings around the interaction between Oct3/4 and Sox2 as a possible contributor to the pathogenesis of extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-23117007.summary_ja: 18歳女性の後腹膜に生じた大型の成熟奇形腫の症例報告。他院で包虫嚢胞と誤診されて手術を受け、切除不能として紹介された。下大静脈や右腎静脈を含む血管合併切除と再建により完全切除が可能であり、術後経過は順調だった。術前画像検査と手術計画の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23117007.summary_en: Case report of an 18-year-old woman with a large retroperitoneal benign cystic teratoma that had been misdiagnosed as a hydatid cyst at another hospital. CT angiography showed a 14 cm cystic mass invading the retrohepatic suprarenal inferior vena cava, the right renal vein, and the liver. The tumor was completely resected with vascular reconstruction using a Dacron graft and renal vein reimplantation, with an uneventful recovery. The authors emphasize the importance of preoperative imaging and planning.

pmid-23117572.summary_ja: 本研究は精巣腫瘍107例でナトリウム/ヨウ素シンポーター(NIS)発現を検討し、セミノーマの大部分と胎児性癌の多くでNISが陽性であることを示した。NIS陽性はリンパ管侵襲と関連した。ヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害薬はNTERA細胞でNIS発現と放射性ヨウ素取り込みを増強し、侵襲性の高い精巣腫瘍への標的治療の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23117572.summary_en: This study examined sodium/iodide symporter (NIS) expression in 107 testicular tumors, mostly seminomas, and found it in 90 of 98 seminomas and 5 of 7 embryonal carcinomas, but not in Leydig cell tumors. NIS positivity correlated with lymphovascular invasion. In the embryonal carcinoma line NTERA, histone deacetylase inhibitors markedly increased NIS expression and radioiodine uptake, suggesting NIS-targeted radioiodine could be a therapeutic option for aggressive testicular tumors.

pmid-23129837.summary_ja: 26歳女性の右付属器腫瘤に対し部分卵巣摘出術が施行された。腫瘤は嚢胞成分と充実成分から成っていた。病理では卵巣奇形腫に由来する結合組織形成型髄芽腫と診断され、卵巣髄芽腫としては4例目の報告である。卵巣原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の一亜型として位置づけられ、文献的な稀少性も検討されている。
pmid-23129837.summary_en: The authors report a 26-year-old woman with a right adnexal mass containing cystic and solid components, treated with partial oophorectomy. Pathology showed a desmoplastic medulloblastoma arising from an ovarian teratoma, the fourth such case of ovarian medulloblastoma reported. The tumor belongs to the primitive neuroectodermal tumor spectrum of the ovary. The paper also reviews the rarity and classification of ovarian primitive neuroectodermal tumors.

pmid-23136239.summary_ja: 病期II精巣腫瘍の治療後21か月目に血清hCGが徐々に上昇した22歳男性例。画像検査では精巣微小石灰化以外に病変は指摘されなかった。左精巣摘除術で微小な悪性胚細胞腫瘍と、hCG陽性の精細管内トロホブラストが確認された。術後hCGは正常化し、6か月後も再発はなかった。
pmid-23136239.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a previously treated stage II right testicular tumor had a gradual rise in serum hCG 21 months later, while imaging showed no lesion apart from testicular microlithiasis. Left testis biopsy showed intratubular germ cell neoplasia, and orchiectomy revealed a small malignant germ cell tumor plus hCG-positive intratubular trophoblasts. hCG normalized immediately after surgery and no recurrence was seen at 6 months, illustrating an isolated tumor marker elevation.

pmid-23137282.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株5種と胚性幹細胞株6種のエクソンレベル解析を比較し、28の差次的発現遺伝子を同定した。NR5A2の過剰発現は、WNTを介した多能性の破綻と悪性化の関連を示唆した。DNMT3Bなどで選択的スプライシングが確認され、原発性胎児性癌および正常精巣のデータと照合された。
pmid-23137282.summary_en: Exon-level transcriptomic profiles of five embryonal carcinoma cell lines, a germ cell tumor subtype, were compared with six human embryonic stem cell lines, using only purified undifferentiated cells. Of 28 differentially expressed genes, many had cancer and stemness roles, and NR5A2 overexpression in malignant cells suggested WNT-mediated pluripotency dysregulation. Alternative splicing in DNMT3B and other genes was validated, and the findings were checked against primary EC tumors and normal testis.

pmid-23148694.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の33歳未経妊女性が、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法中に全身性血栓塞栓症を発症した症例報告である。脳梗塞、両側肺動脈および骨盤静脈の多発塞栓、右上肢の広範な深部静脈血栓症を認めた。化学療法中に血栓症を認めた場合は、全身性か局所性かを検討する必要があると著者らは強調している。
pmid-23148694.summary_en: Case report of a 33-year-old nulligravida Japanese woman with ovarian germ cell tumor who developed systemic thromboembolism during cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy. She had brain infarction, bilateral pulmonary artery and pelvic vein emboli, and extensive deep vein thromboses in the right limb. Given the high cure rate of cisplatin-based regimens, the authors emphasize that thrombosis detected during chemotherapy should be evaluated for systemic versus local origin.

pmid-23150218.summary_ja: 北京協和医院で1990〜2012年に妊娠に合併した卵巣悪性腫瘍41例を後方視的に解析した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍10例と卵巣絨毛癌1例を含む。死亡率は24.4%で、新生児の多くは健康に生存した。外科的治療が主体で、根治的手術の遅延は予後不良と関連していた。
pmid-23150218.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 41 ovarian malignancies complicating pregnancy at a single center (1990-2012). Included were epithelial cancers, borderline tumors, malignant germ cell tumors (10 cases), sex cord-stromal tumors, metastatic tumors, and one primary choriocarcinoma. Median overall survival was 30 months, with 24.4% mortality. Most neonates survived healthy. Surgery was the main treatment, and delayed radical surgery was associated with poor prognosis.

pmid-23159816.summary_ja: フランスの絨毛性疾患基準施設で2000〜2011年に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）または類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍（ETT）と診断された22例を後方視的に解析した。患者の約3分の1は子宮外妊娠と誤診されていた。初回の病理診断の39%が誤りであり、専門家による病理再評価の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-23159816.summary_en: Retrospective review of 22 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) or epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) at the French reference center (2000-2011). Because these two gestational trophoblastic neoplasia subtypes share diagnostic, therapeutic, and prognostic features, they were analyzed together. Presentations were irregular bleeding or amenorrhea, and about a third were initially misdiagnosed as ectopic pregnancy. The initial histological diagnosis was wrong in 39% of evaluable patients, highlighting the need for expert pathology review.

pmid-23160138.summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫5例を、Currarino症候群や総排泄腔奇形などの非典型的特徴とともに報告し、文献を併せてレビューした。1例は術後に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴って再発し、AFP上昇が先行していた。補助化学療法と再切除で治癒した。著者らは完全切除、AFPの経過観察、長期の監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23160138.summary_en: Five children with sacrococcygeal teratomas showing atypical features, including Currarino syndrome and cloacal anomalies in some patients, are reported and reviewed with the literature. Four were managed in the neonatal period, and two had prenatal diagnosis. One girl with Currarino syndrome died after surgery. One patient relapsed two years later with a yolk sac tumor component, anticipated by elevated AFP, and remained disease-free after adjuvant chemotherapy and re-excision. The authors emphasize complete excision, AFP monitoring, and long-term surveillance.

pmid-23164315.summary_ja: スペインの単一施設における20例の小児抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例シリーズで、患者の年齢中央値は13歳、70%が女性であった。ステロイド、免疫グロブリン、血漿交換などの治療により、多くの患者が十分に回復した。2例で卵巣奇形腫が確認され、そのうち1例は発症時に認められた。著者らは特徴的な脳波パターンを記述し、単純ヘルペス脳炎後の舞踏アテトーゼと抗NMDAR脳炎との新たな関連を指摘している。
pmid-23164315.summary_en: This single-center Spanish series reviews 20 pediatric patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, with a median age of 13 years and 70% female. Most recovered substantially after steroids, intravenous immunoglobulin or plasma exchange, with rituximab or cyclophosphamide in some. Ovarian teratoma was identified in two patients, one at onset. The authors describe a characteristic EEG pattern and a novel link between post-herpes simplex encephalitis choreoathetosis and anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

pmid-23165333.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍127例を用い、SF-1の免疫組織化学的発現を組織マイクロアレイで評価した研究である。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫などでは核内発現が認められなかった。一方、対照の非胚細胞腫瘍組織23例はいずれも強陽性であった。SF-1は性索間質性病変に特異的であり、生検での鑑別に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-23165333.summary_en: This tissue microarray study examined SF-1 immunohistochemistry in 127 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma and choriocarcinoma. No nuclear SF-1 expression was seen in any germ cell tumor, whereas all 23 non-germ cell control tissues, including Sertoli and Leydig cells, were strongly positive. The authors conclude that SF-1 is specific for sex-cord stromal lesions and is useful for distinguishing them from germ cell tumors on biopsy.

pmid-23171623.summary_ja: 新生児の希少な気道病変2例を報告する研究である。上咽頭奇形腫と先天性喉頭嚢胞がそれぞれ外科的に治療された。診断の難しさや手術・麻酔上の課題を考察し、新生児喘鳴に関する文献も概説した。奇形腫などの希少病変を見逃さないことと、施設内での多職種による管理の重要性が結論づけられている。
pmid-23171623.summary_en: This report describes two rare neonatal airway lesions managed surgically: a nasopharyngeal teratoma and a congenital laryngeal saccular cyst. The authors discuss diagnostic difficulty and the surgical and anaesthetic challenges, and review the literature on neonatal stridor. They conclude that rare lesions such as teratomas must not be overlooked in neonatal airway distress, and that management should be multidisciplinary within an institutional setting.

pmid-23186076.summary_ja: 1981年から2010年に転移性精巣がんに対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた96例を対象に、推算糸球体濾過量で腎機能を評価した研究である。化学療法の1年後に23%が慢性腎臓病を呈した。治療前の軽度腎障害と血圧高値がリスク因子であった。化学療法後少なくとも1年間は腎機能を慎重にモニタリングすることが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-23186076.summary_en: This retrospective study followed 96 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer between 1981 and 2010, assessing renal function using estimated GFR. One year after chemotherapy, 23% had chronic kidney disease. Mild renal damage and elevated blood pressure before treatment were independent risk factors, with odds ratios of 2.63 and 4.22. The authors advise close renal monitoring for at least one year after chemotherapy, particularly in patients with these risk factors.

pmid-23199791.summary_ja: 新たに樹立された絨毛癌細胞株iC3-1の遺伝子発現を、既存の絨毛癌・栄養膜細胞株および正常胎盤と比較した研究。IGF1R、CHFR、HAS2、CD44、S100Pなどに発現差が示された。絨毛癌組織でも一部タンパクの免疫反応性が確認された。絨毛癌の発生機序を研究するための有用なモデルになると結論づけている。
pmid-23199791.summary_en: The authors established a new choriocarcinoma cell line, iC3-1, and compared its gene expression profile with existing trophoblast and choriocarcinoma lines (BeWo, JEG3, HTR8/SVneo) and normal third-trimester placenta. Several genes, including IGF1R and CHFR, were upregulated relative to BeWo and JEG3, while HAS2, CD44, and S100P were elevated relative to parental HTR8/SVneo cells and normal placenta. Choriocarcinoma tissue also showed HAS2, CD44, and S100 immunoreactivity. The authors propose iC3-1 as a useful model for studying choriocarcinoma tumorigenesis.

pmid-23202784.summary_ja: 満期産胎盤内に発生した原発性胎盤内妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。高度に多形性の栄養膜細胞が胎盤に浸潤し、腫瘍内に絨毛が孤立して残存する像を示した。腫瘍と胎盤のSTR解析で10座位すべての遺伝子型が一致した。よって現妊娠の胎盤由来であり、胚細胞由来の非妊娠性絨毛癌ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-23202784.summary_en: A case of primary intraplacental gestational choriocarcinoma in a full-term placenta is described. Histology showed sheets of highly pleomorphic trophoblasts invading the placenta, with isolated chorionic villi remaining within the tumor. Short tandem repeat analysis of tumor and placental DNA showed a complete genotype match at all 10 loci examined. This indicates the tumor arose from the current pregnancy's placenta rather than being a nongestational choriocarcinoma of germ cell origin.

pmid-23224120.summary_ja: 縦隔・後腹膜・中枢神経系の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍19例と非胚細胞腫瘍20例でSALL4免疫染色を評価した研究。胚細胞腫瘍の18例(95%)でSALL4が強発現し、特異度は100%だった。他の胚細胞マーカーは21〜69%の陽性率にとどまった。
pmid-23224120.summary_en: The authors evaluated SALL4 immunostaining in 19 extragonadal germ cell tumors (six mediastinal, five retroperitoneal, eight CNS) and 20 non-GCT controls. SALL4 was strongly expressed in 18 of 19 GCTs (95%) with 100% specificity, outperforming other GCT markers, which were expressed in 21-69% of cases. The authors recommend SALL4 in the first antibody panel for midline tumors in patients under 40 and in the workup of undifferentiated tumors of any location.

pmid-23224440.summary_ja: 小児の卵巣奇形腫9例に対する卵巣温存手術の後方視的検討。平均追跡期間は29.5か月。病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が中心で、未熟奇形腫も1例含まれた。術後経過は良好で、術前に奇形腫と診断されれば卵巣温存手術は安全に施行できると結論づけている。
pmid-23224440.summary_en: Nine children (mean age 11.2 years) who underwent ovary-sparing surgery for teratoma were retrospectively reviewed, with mean follow-up of 29.5 months. Most masses were mature cystic teratomas, with one immature teratoma included. Ultrasonography, MRI, and tumor markers supported the diagnosis, and ovarian tissue was preserved in 12 ovaries using a dissection plane between tumor and normal ovary. Outcomes were uneventful, supporting ovary-sparing surgery when the preoperative diagnosis is teratoma.

pmid-23225212.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍28例を対象に、SNPアレイCGHと腫瘍抑制遺伝子・インプリンティング遺伝子のメチル化を解析した。減数分裂エラーや発生段階の異なる起源を示唆する所見を報告した。卵黄嚢腫瘍では遺伝的・エピジェネティックな変化が蓄積しており、悪性転化への関与が示唆された。
pmid-23225212.summary_en: This study examined 28 pediatric germ cell tumors using SNP array comparative genomic hybridization and methylation analysis of tumor suppressor genes and imprinted loci (H19, SNRPN). Some tumors showed segmental or whole uniparental disomy, suggesting origins from meiosis I errors, endoreduplication, or premeiotic primordial germ cells. Recurrent gains at 3p and 20q and losses at 1p36-p35 were common, with RUNX3 promoter methylation in 16 tumors. Two yolk sac tumors with extensive UPD showed 20q gain, 1p loss, and multiple methylated tumor suppressor genes, suggesting these alterations may have driven malignant transformation.

pmid-23238629.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍148例を後方視的に解析した研究である。血管侵襲と精巣網・門部軟部組織への浸潤が、診断時の進行臨床病期と独立して関連した。転移性疾患の予測因子として、門部浸潤を日常の病理報告に含めるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-23238629.summary_en: This retrospective study of 148 consecutive nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis evaluated pathologic and clinical features against clinical stage at presentation. Vascular invasion, rete testis invasion, and hilar soft tissue invasion were significantly associated with advanced stage on univariate analysis. On multivariate analysis, vascular invasion and invasion into the rete testis and hilar soft tissues remained significant. The authors conclude that tumor invasion into the testicular hilum should be routinely reported by pathologists, alongside vascular invasion, as a predictor of metastatic disease at presentation.

pmid-23240671.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質性腫瘍の免疫組織化学的診断について、実践的なアプローチを総説したものである。SALL4、OCT4、AFP、glypican-3などの各腫瘍型マーカーを、感度・特異度を踏まえて解説する。卵巣カルチノイドの原発巣推定における免疫組織化学の限界にも触れている。
pmid-23240671.summary_en: This review presents a practical approach to using immunohistochemistry in diagnosing ovarian germ cell tumors and sex cord-stromal tumors. It covers markers for malignant germ cell differentiation (SALL4, PLAP), dysgerminoma (OCT4, CD117, D2-40), yolk sac tumor (AFP, glypican-3), embryonal carcinoma (OCT4, CD30, SOX2), sex cord-stromal differentiation (calretinin, inhibin, SF-1, FOXL2), and steroid cell tumors (melan-A). The authors emphasize understanding each marker's sensitivity and specificity for specific differential diagnoses. They also discuss the limited role of immunohistochemistry in determining the primary site of ovarian carcinoid tumors.

pmid-23249573.summary_ja: 精巣がんの術後CT監視を受ける患者について、マルコフモデルで生涯リスクと余命損失を比較した。病期Iのセミノーマを有する33歳男性では、生涯死亡リスクはがんの方がわずかに高かった。一方、余命損失はがんによる方が3倍以上大きかった。生涯リスク指標は短期的な健康リスクに比べ、放射線リスクを過大評価しうると結論づけている。
pmid-23249573.summary_en: This Markov model study projected outcomes for patients undergoing CT surveillance for testicular cancer in the decade after orchiectomy. It compared lifetime mortality risk and life expectancy loss from testicular cancer with those from radiation-induced cancers caused by CT. For 33-year-old men with stage I seminoma, lifetime mortality risk was slightly higher from testicular cancer, but life expectancy loss from testicular cancer was more than three times greater. The authors argue that lifetime risk estimates may overemphasize radiation-induced cancer risks relative to short-term health risks.

pmid-23251245.summary_ja: 本研究は、マイクロRNA(miRNA)-145が絨毛癌の病態に果たす役割を検討した。絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG-3にmiR-145発現ウイルスを導入するとSox2の発現が低下し、in vitroで細胞増殖が抑制された。異種移植モデルでも腫瘍増殖が抑制された。内因性miR-145がSox2を介して絨毛癌の発症に関与し、治療標的となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-23251245.summary_en: This study examined the role of microRNA-145 in human choriocarcinoma. Transfecting JAR and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells with a miR-145 expression virus reduced Sox2 mRNA and protein levels. miR-145 suppressed proliferation through cell cycle regulation in vitro, and xenograft experiments showed reduced tumor growth in vivo. The findings suggest that endogenous miR-145 may contribute to choriocarcinoma pathogenesis through epigenetic regulation of Sox2, indicating potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-23273044.summary_ja: 本報告は、出生時から眼窩腫瘤を認めた7歳女児の成熟眼窩奇形腫例である。右眼球は欠如しており、腫瘤内には異所性の歯を認めた。眼瞼温存眼窩内容除去術が施行された。病理組織学的検査で三胚葉由来の成分が確認された。1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-23273044.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-year-old girl with an orbital mass present since birth, with absence of the right eyeball and an ectopic tooth within the tumor. Lid-sparing exenteration was performed. Histopathology showed elements of all three germ layers, consistent with mature orbital teratoma. No normal ocular structures were identified, and there was no recurrence at one year of follow-up.

pmid-23274560.summary_ja: 1996年から2011年に単施設で治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の17例を後方視的に解析した研究です。全生存期間の中央値は86か月で、FIGO病期IVは生存の悪化と有意に関連しました。前妊娠からの期間、hCG値、年齢は予後と関連せず、病期が最も重要な予後因子とされています。
pmid-23274560.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study of 17 patients with placental-site trophoblastic tumor (1996 to 2011) evaluated presentation, treatment, and prognostic factors. Median overall survival was 86 months. Higher FIGO stage, particularly stage IV, was the only factor significantly associated with worse survival (p=0.009), while antecedent pregnancy interval, outcome, hCG level, and age were not. The authors conclude that FIGO stage is the most important predictor of survival.

pmid-23274926.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する5日間のシスプラチン併用化学療法を受ける初回治療患者50例を対象とした第II相単群試験です。5-HT3受容体拮抗薬とデキサメタゾンに7日間のアプレピタントを追加し、1サイクル目の1〜7日目に嘔吐がなかった割合は82%でした。以降の各サイクルでも効果は維持され、重篤な予期せぬ有害事象は報告されませんでした。
pmid-23274926.summary_en: This phase 2 single-arm trial enrolled 50 chemo-naive patients receiving 5-day cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell tumors. A 7-day aprepitant schedule was added to a 5-HT3 antagonist and dexamethasone. The primary endpoint, no emesis on days 1 to 7 of cycle 1, was 82%. Efficacy was maintained across cycles with over 80% of patients free of emesis each day. No unexpected or serious adverse events were reported, and nausea was more common than vomiting.

pmid-23287532.summary_ja: TP53を有する胎児性癌細胞株PA-1をエトポシドで処理し、DNA損傷に対する応答を検討した研究です。TP53をノックダウンするとOCT4AやP21CIP1の上昇が抑えられ、有糸分裂異常や老化マーカーの増加が認められました。TP53が自己複製と老化の経路を連結し、ゲノムの安定性を保つ仕組みが示唆されています。
pmid-23287532.summary_en: This study examines PA-1 embryonal carcinoma cells, a TP53-competent line, after etoposide-induced DNA damage. OCT4A and P21CIP1 were upregulated after G2/M arrest, and cells with persistent damage senesced. TP53 knockdown blocked these increases, raised DNA damage, and caused mitotic abnormalities and senescence markers such as p16 and SA-β-galactosidase. The authors propose that TP53 links self-renewal and senescence to maintain genome integrity in EC cells.

pmid-23287591.summary_ja: 良性縦隔成熟奇形腫に対して胸腔鏡下手術(VATS)を受けた15例を検討した後方視的研究である。腫瘍の平均径は5.3 cmで、15例中12例で胸腔鏡下切除が完遂された。開胸へ移行した3例は、腫瘍径が大きく術前に強い胸痛を伴っていた。術後合併症は乳糜胸1例のみで、平均4.6年の追跡期間中に再発はなかった。著者らは、適切に選択された患者ではVATSが標準治療となりうる一方、大きな腫瘍や症状のある患者では開胸手術がより適切かもしれないと結論づけている。
pmid-23287591.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 15 patients with benign mediastinal mature teratoma who underwent video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS). Mean tumour diameter was 5.3 cm, and thoracoscopic resection was completed in 12 of 15 patients. The three conversions involved larger tumours with severe preoperative chest pain. Postoperative complications were limited to one chylothorax, and no recurrence occurred over a mean follow-up of 4.6 years. The authors conclude that VATS may be standard care for selected patients, while open surgery may suit large tumours or symptomatic patients.

pmid-23292912.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のErbBファミリー受容体の発現を解析し、全検体でErbB3が高発現していることを見いだした。絨毛癌型モデルのマウスでは、ErbB1阻害薬のセツキシマブとゲフィチニブは効果がなかった。ErbB1とErbB2の二重阻害薬ラパチニブは腫瘍増殖を約50%抑制し、ErbB3の活性化も阻害した。抗ErbB1薬ではなくラパチニブが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療に有効である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23292912.summary_en: This study examined ErbB receptor expression in human testicular germ cell tumours, finding ErbB3 expressed in all tumours tested. In orthotopic nude mouse models of a choriocarcinoma-type tumour, the pure ErbB1 inhibitors cetuximab and gefitinib had no effect, because ErbB2 remained activated through an ErbB1-independent route. Lapatinib, a dual ErbB1/ErbB2 inhibitor, reduced tumour growth by about 50% and blocked ErbB3 activation. The authors suggest lapatinib, rather than anti-ErbB1 agents, may be effective for testicular GCT patients.

pmid-23293116.summary_ja: ドイツ精巣がん研究グループによるこの調査では、胚細胞腫瘍の対側に生じた精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)を有する228例の治療を評価した。局所精巣放射線療法(18~20 Gy)が最良の成績を示し、悪性事象率は2.5%、無イベント生存期間の中央値は11.08年であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法2サイクルでは悪性事象率が50%、カルボプラチンは最も成績が悪かった。照射を受けた患者の約3分の1に性腺機能低下症が生じた。著者らは、TINの標準的治療として20 Gyの放射線療法が引き続き適切であると結論づけている。
pmid-23293116.summary_en: This German Testicular Cancer Study Group survey assessed treatments for testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) contralateral to a germ cell tumour in 228 patients. Local testicular radiotherapy (18-20 Gy) gave the best outcome, with a malignant event rate of 2.5% and a median event-free survival of 11.08 years. Two cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy had a 50% malignant event rate, and carboplatin performed worst. Hypogonadism occurred in about one-third of irradiated patients. The authors conclude that 20 Gy radiotherapy remains the standard management of TIN.

pmid-23302226.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍がシスプラチンに高感受性を示す機序を検討した研究である。Oct-4を除去すると感受性は低下したが、p53の活性には影響しなかった。Bcl-2ファミリーの中でNoxaのみがOct-4の状態と相関し、Oct-4陽性の胎児性癌細胞や患者検体では基礎Noxa量が高かった。Oct-4のノックダウンはNoxa除去と同程度に感受性を低下させ、Noxaがシスプラチン高感受性の中心的な決定因子であることが示された。
pmid-23302226.summary_en: This study investigated why testicular germ cell tumour cells are hypersensitive to cisplatin. Oct-4 depletion reduced cisplatin sensitivity without altering p53 transactivation or localisation, suggesting Oct-4 provides a permissive context for p53-mediated apoptosis. Among Bcl-2 family proteins, only Noxa correlated with Oct-4 status. Oct-4-positive embryonal carcinoma cells and patient samples had high constitutive Noxa levels, and Oct-4 knockdown reduced Noxa and cisplatin sensitivity to a similar extent as Noxa depletion. Noxa is thus a central determinant of cisplatin hypersensitivity.

pmid-23303528.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌（CIS）から浸潤性の胚細胞腫瘍への進展に、減数分裂の調節異常が関与するかを検討した。CIS細胞では減数分裂マーカーと抑制因子が同時に発現していた。有糸分裂と減数分裂の切り替えを司るDMRT1は、思春期前の精巣で成人より高頻度にCIS細胞で発現していた。DMRT1は浸潤性腫瘍では低下しており、CISの浸潤性変化に伴う発現低下が示唆された。
pmid-23303528.summary_en: This study examined whether dysregulated meiosis contributes to testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS) and its progression to invasive germ cell tumour. Meiosis markers and inhibitors were co-expressed in CIS cells in both pre- and post-pubertal testes. DMRT1, a key mitosis-meiosis switch regulator, was found in a subset of CIS cells, more often in prepubertal (27%) than adult (2.6%) testes, and was downregulated in invasive tumours except spermatocytic seminoma. The authors conclude that meiosis signalling is dysregulated in CIS and that DMRT1 loss accompanies invasive transformation.

pmid-23305547.summary_ja: 病期IIBの精巣がんで、シスプラチン併用化学療法後に残存後腹膜腫瘍を認めた6例に対し、神経温存腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を実施した報告です。全例で開腹移行なく完遂し、合併症率は33.3%で、主にリンパ漏で保存的に管理されました。全例で射精機能は温存されました。病理では成熟奇形腫2例、壊死組織4例でした。中央値30か月の観察期間で再発はなく、実施可能性が示されました。ただし症例数が少なく、今後の検証が必要です。
pmid-23305547.summary_en: This report describes six patients with clinical stage IIB non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor who underwent extraperitoneal nerve-sparing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for residual masses after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All procedures were completed without conversion to open surgery. The complication rate was 33.3%, mostly prolonged lymphatic leakage managed conservatively, and antegrade ejaculation was preserved in all patients. Pathology showed mature teratoma in two patients and necrosis in four. With a median follow-up of 30 months, no recurrence occurred, suggesting feasibility, though larger and longer studies are needed.

pmid-23313819.summary_ja: 卵巣癌、線維腫、皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)におけるPTCH1遺伝子の変化を比較した研究です。ヘテロ接合性の消失は皮様嚢腫で55.56%と最も高率でした。c.3944Tアレルは対照群で卵巣癌より多く、保護的役割が示唆されました。点変異は認められませんでした。皮様嚢腫は胚細胞腫瘍の一型で、本研究の対象の一つです。
pmid-23313819.summary_en: This study examined PTCH1 in ovarian carcinomas, fibromas, and dermoid cysts. Loss of heterozygosity was found in 27.3% of carcinomas, 18.18% of fibromas, and 55.56% of dermoids, with no point mutations detected. The SNP c.3944C>T was less frequent in carcinomas than in controls, suggesting a possible protective role for the T allele. A novel polymorphism, c.-1184G>A, was found only in tumor samples. Dermoid cysts, which are mature teratomas and a type of germ cell tumor, were one of the three tumor groups studied.

pmid-23318909.summary_ja: 1989年から2010年に腹腔鏡手術を受けた悪性非上皮性卵巣腫瘍28例の後方視的研究である。うち8例は悪性胚細胞腫瘍であった。全例が病期Iで、術中合併症や開腹移行はなかった。補助化学療法を受けた5例のうち再発は1例のみで、化学療法により治療された。腹腔鏡手術は早期例において生存を損なわず安全と示された。
pmid-23318909.summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 patients with malignant nonepithelial ovarian tumors evaluates laparoscopic management, including 8 malignant germ cell tumors (4 dysgerminomas, 2 immature teratomas, 1 choriocarcinoma, 1 yolk sac tumor) and 20 sex cord-stromal tumors. All patients had stage I disease. Laparoscopic surgery was feasible without intraoperative complications or conversion to laparotomy. Five patients received adjuvant chemotherapy, and one recurrence occurred, treated with chemotherapy. No patient died of disease over a median follow-up of 34.5 months. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe for early-stage MNEOTs without compromising survival.

pmid-23320455.summary_ja: 33歳女性に生じた純粋非妊娠性卵巣絨毛癌の症例報告である。極めてまれで、生殖年齢での診断は困難である。術後にエトポシド、メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンDからなるEMA化学療法レジメンを複数コース投与し、有効であった。まれな悪性疾患における診断の難しさと、化学療法の有効性を示す。
pmid-23320455.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman diagnosed with pure nongestational ovarian choriocarcinoma, a very rare entity that is difficult to diagnose during the reproductive years. Pure ovarian choriocarcinoma can be gestational or nongestational in origin, and nongestational cases are extremely uncommon. After surgery, the patient received multiple courses of the EMA regimen, comprising etoposide, methotrexate, and actinomycin-D, which proved effective. The report highlights the diagnostic challenge and the efficacy of EMA chemotherapy in this rare malignancy.

pmid-23321493.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者90例の横断画像を解析し、転移リンパ節の局在を血管と骨の解剖に対して評価した。転移リンパ節の84%は傍大動脈領域に存在した。従来の照射野に含まれないリンパ節は3%に過ぎなかった。血管解剖に基づく縮小した修正照射野は、正常組織への照射と毒性を減らす可能性がある。
pmid-23321493.summary_en: This study analyzed cross-sectional scans of 90 seminoma patients with infradiaphragmatic adenopathy to map metastatic nodes relative to vascular and bony anatomy. Of 145 radiographically positive nodes, 84% were para-aortic, 9% common iliac, and 7% pelvic. Nodes clustered within a narrow zone around the aorta inferior to T12/L1, and none were superior to L1 in left-sided or superior to L2 in right-sided tumors. Only 3% of nodes would fall outside conventional radiation fields. The authors propose smaller vascular-based modified fields that may reduce normal tissue irradiation and toxicity.

pmid-23327670.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoとJEG-3において miR-34a の機能を解析した。miR-34a の強制発現は増殖と浸潤を抑制した。miR-34a の阻害はSCIDマウスの異種移植腫瘍を増大させた。miR-34a は Notch リガンドDLL1を標的として発現を抑制し、絨毛癌の腫瘍抑制因子として作用することが示された。
pmid-23327670.summary_en: This study investigates miR-34a in choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JEG-3. Transient miR-34a overexpression suppressed proliferation and invasion, while inhibition enlarged xenografts in SCID mice. The authors identified the Notch ligand Delta-like 1 (DLL1) as a target through in silico prediction, luciferase assays, and Western blotting. MiR-34a reduced MMP9 and uPA expression via DLL1 suppression, and the invasion effect was partly reversed by Notch activation. The findings identify miR-34a as a tumor suppressor in choriocarcinoma acting through the DLL1-Notch axis.

pmid-23329179.summary_ja: 抗真菌薬であるグリセオフルビンの、ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞に対する作用を検討した。グリセオフルビンはカスパーゼ9およびカスパーゼ3を介したアポトーシスを誘導し、増殖を抑制した。腫瘍抑制因子であるコネキシン43の発現を上昇させ、その核への移行を促進した。コネキシン43のsiRNAによるノックダウンは効果を消失させ、本分子が必要であることが示された。
pmid-23329179.summary_en: This study examines griseofulvin, an antifungal antimitotic drug, in human germ cell tumor cells. Griseofulvin inhibited tumor cell growth by activating the mitochondrial caspase pathway (caspase 9 and 3), inducing apoptosis rather than altering proliferation. It upregulated connexin 43, a tumor suppressor, and disrupted its association with tubulin while promoting nuclear translocation of connexin 43 or its fragment. siRNA knockdown of connexin 43 blocked griseofulvin-induced apoptosis, establishing its requirement. The findings reveal a connexin 43-dependent mechanism by which griseofulvin may be repurposed as a candidate anti-germ cell tumor agent.

pmid-23331834.summary_ja: 本報告は、膵頭部に原発した混合型胚細胞腫瘍を有する12か月の女児を記述しており、卵黄嚢(卵黄嚢腫瘍)と成熟奇形腫から構成されていた。膵臓の原発性胚細胞腫瘍はきわめてまれであり、著者らはこれを初めての症例として報告している。本腫瘍は、脳から仙尾部に至る原始生殖細胞由来腫瘍の広範な性腺外分布を示すものである。乳児の膵腫瘤の鑑別診断において考慮すべき報告である。
pmid-23331834.summary_en: This report describes a 12-month-old girl with a primary mixed germ cell tumor of the pancreatic head, consisting of endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor and mature teratoma. Primary germ cell tumors of the pancreas are extremely rare, and the authors present this as the first such case. The tumor reflects the broad extragonadal distribution of primordial germ cell-derived neoplasms, from the brain to the sacrococcygeal region. The report is significant for pediatric surgeons because it expands the recognized sites of extragonadal germ cell tumors and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of infant pancreatic masses.

pmid-23332198.summary_ja: 巨大卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が完全寛解した後、縦隔腫瘤が出現した若年女性の症例報告である。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)および陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/CTの所見から、化学療法後の反跳現象である生理的胸腺過形成と診断され、侵襲的検査は不要であった。34か月後も再発はみられなかった。治療関連の胸腺過形成を認識することが、不必要な侵襲的検査の回避に重要である。
pmid-23332198.summary_en: This case report describes a young woman with bulky ovarian dysgerminoma who achieved complete remission after chemotherapy but later developed a mediastinal mass initially suspected to be relapse. CT and PET/CT findings, including close thymic location, homogeneous density, and an inverted V morphology, supported physiologic thymic hyperplasia, a rebound phenomenon after chemotherapy. No invasive procedures were needed, and at 34 months the patient remained relapse-free. The case highlights the importance of recognizing treatment-related thymic hyperplasia to avoid unnecessary invasive diagnostic procedures in young women with dysgerminoma.

pmid-23338927.summary_ja: 30歳女性の卵巣ストルマカルチノイド腫瘍(ステージ1A)の症例報告です。主訴は重度の便秘で、多毛症と陰核肥大を伴っていました。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とβ-hCGは正常でしたが、CEAが上昇していました。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で11.4cmの充実性・嚢胞性の右卵巣腫瘤を認め、開腹右卵巣嚢腫摘出術が行われました。
pmid-23338927.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old woman with a stage IA strumal carcinoid tumour of the ovary, a monodermal teratoma subtype. She presented with severe constipation, an abdominal mass, hirsutism, and clitoromegaly. AFP and beta-hCG were normal, although CEA was elevated. MRI revealed an 11.4 cm solid and cystic right ovarian mass, which was treated by open right cystectomy. The authors suggest that strumal carcinoid may present with longstanding constipation and be associated with hirsutism.

pmid-23339101.summary_ja: 53歳女性の献体で偶然発見された、非骨盤部後腹膜の良性奇形腫(腸腰筋に接着)の症例報告です。献体提供者は転移性膀胱癌を死因としていました。奇形腫は通常小児または骨盤内に多いため、腎下極の深部という位置は稀です。転移性癌と骨盤外奇形腫の増殖との関連可能性について文献をもとに考察されています。
pmid-23339101.summary_en: This case report describes a benign teratoma located in the non-pelvic retroperitoneal space, adherent to the psoas muscle, found incidentally in a 53-year-old female cadaver whose cause of death was metastatic bladder cancer. The lesion lay deep to the inferior pole of the kidney, an unusual location, since teratomas are typically seen in children or the lower pelvis. The authors discuss a possible association between metastatic cancer and extrapelvic teratoma growth and review the literature.

pmid-23343953.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学的マーカーとしてGlut3とCyclinA2を評価したものです。組織マイクロアレイを用いて、セミノーマの97%と胎児性癌のすべてでCyclinA2が陽性でした。Glut3は胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍に対して感度96%、特異度92%を示し、SALL4に匹敵しました。CyclinA2は感度が高いものの、非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性例により特異度は低めでした。
pmid-23343953.summary_en: This study evaluates Glut3 and CyclinA2 as immunohistochemical markers for testicular germ cell tumors. Using tissue microarrays, CyclinA2 stained 97% of seminomas and all embryonal carcinomas, while Glut3 showed strong membranous staining in all embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors. Glut3 was sensitive (96%) and specific (92%) for embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor, comparable to SALL4. CyclinA2 was sensitive but less specific due to focal staining in nongerm cell tumors.

pmid-23344410.summary_ja: 33歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の症例報告です。不妊症の評価中に偶然診断されました。病変が持続したため子宮全摘術が施行されました。病理所見は術前画像と子宮鏡検査の所見と大きく乖離していました。術前画像が腫瘍部位と一致しない場合、妊孕性温存を目的とした楔状切除は無効となりうると結論づけています。
pmid-23344410.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman, gravida 3 para 1111, incidentally diagnosed with placental site trophoblastic tumor during an infertility evaluation. Persistent pathologic evidence of disease led to hysterectomy. The pathology showed a disease site widely discordant from preoperative imaging and hysteroscopic findings. The authors conclude that wedge resection, proposed as a fertility-sparing alternative, may be ineffective because preoperative imaging may not correlate with the tumor site.

pmid-23347651.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍と肝細胞癌の鑑別におけるSALL4の免疫組織化学的評価。肝細胞癌69例と卵黄嚢腫瘍10例を組織マイクロアレイで検討した。肝細胞癌の46%でSALL4陽性だが点状・塊状の染色パターンを示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍はびまん性の顆粒状染色だった。25%のカットオフ値では感度100%、特異度92.8%であり、Hep Par1の併用で特異度は99%に向上した。
pmid-23347651.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study evaluated SALL4 expression to distinguish yolk sac tumor from hepatocellular carcinoma. Sixty-nine HCC samples and ten yolk sac tumors were assessed on tissue microarrays. Nuclear SALL4 was detected in 46% of HCC, but HCC showed a punctate pattern while all yolk sac tumors displayed diffuse granular staining. A 25% extent cutoff gave 100% sensitivity and 92.8% specificity, rising to 99% specificity with Hep Par1 added. The authors report SALL4 expression in HCC for the first time.

pmid-23348213.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍のまれな多小嚢性卵黄嚢型変異の3症例を報告。23歳から43歳の患者で、いずれも卵巣に限局した片側性付属器腫瘤を呈し、嚢胞性と充実性の成分を併せ持っていた。腫瘍細胞はαフェトプロテインとグリピカン3に陽性であった。2例は20年および26年の無病生存が確認されており、従来型より緩徐な経過をたどる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23348213.summary_en: This report describes three cases of the rare polyvesicular vitelline variant of ovarian yolk sac tumor in patients aged 23 to 43. All presented with unilateral adnexal masses confined to the ovary, combining cystic and solid components. Tumor cells were positive for alpha-fetoprotein and glypican-3. Two patients remained disease free for 20 and 26 years, suggesting this variant may follow a more indolent course than conventional yolk sac tumor.

pmid-23348357.summary_ja: 生後1日の新生児に生じた、口蓋から咽頭・舌へ進展する巨大なエピグナトス奇形腫の症例報告。稀な先天性成熟奇形腫で、哺乳障害はあったが直ちの気道閉塞はなかった。生後5日目に気管挿管下の全身麻酔で完全切除された。奇形腫が三胚葉由来の組織から成ることにも触れ、その生物学的特徴を概説している。
pmid-23348357.summary_en: This case report describes a 1-day-old infant with a giant epignathus teratoma arising from the palate and extending to the oropharynx and tongue. Epignathus is a rare congenital mature teratoma. The tumor caused feeding difficulty but no immediate respiratory obstruction. It was completely excised under general anesthesia via endotracheal intubation on day five of life. The authors review teratoma biology, noting that these neoplasms contain tissues from all three germ cell layers.

pmid-23351423.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、13歳時に片側の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された女性を記述している。彼女は妊孕性温存手術と術後補助化学療法を受けた。長期フォローアップ中は疾患のない状態を保ち、31歳で自然に妊娠した。著者らは、卵黄嚢腫瘍は治癒可能であり、妊孕性温存手術と速やかな併用化学療法が治療の選択肢であると結論づけている。
pmid-23351423.summary_en: This case report describes a woman diagnosed with unilateral ovarian yolk sac tumor at age 13. She underwent fertility-sparing surgery followed by postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy. During long-term follow-up she remained disease free and conceived naturally at age 31. The authors conclude that yolk sac tumor is curable and that fertility-preserving surgery with immediate combination chemotherapy is the treatment of choice.

pmid-23356395.summary_ja: 36歳男性に生じた大腸原発絨毛癌の症例報告。性腺外発生は極めてまれで、大腸原発例はこれまで文献上12例のみ報告されている。過去の症例の多くは腺癌を合併していた。絨毛癌は通常、子宮や性腺に発生するため、この稀な発生部位の理解に寄与する。文献レビューも併せて行われている。
pmid-23356395.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma of the colon, an extragenital presentation that is exceedingly rare. The authors review the clinical characteristics of the 12 previously reported colonic cases. Most of those prior cases were associated with adenocarcinoma. The report contributes to understanding this unusual site of choriocarcinoma, which typically arises in the uterus and gonads.

pmid-23359388.summary_ja: 本総説は、若年男性で最も一般的な悪性腫瘍である精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の分子異常をまとめ、セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を区別している。OCT3/4、SOX2、SOX17、HMGA1/2、PATZ1などの組織学的亜群を区別するバイオマーカーを取り上げている。また、ヒト化抗体やキナーゼ阻害剤などの標的治療戦略もレビューし、化学療法抵抗性の腫瘍の治療を目的としている。
pmid-23359388.summary_en: This mini-review summarizes molecular alterations in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs), the most common malignancy in young men, and distinguishes seminoma from nonseminomatous GCTs. It highlights biomarkers such as OCT3/4, SOX2, SOX17, HMGA1/2 and PATZ1 that discriminate histological subgroups. It also reviews targeted therapeutic strategies, including humanized antibodies and kinase inhibitors, aimed at treating chemotherapy-resistant tumors.

pmid-23360792.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの既往がある24歳男性が、発熱と白血球増多を伴う右腰筋腫瘤を膿瘍と診断された。AFPとhCGは正常範囲であった。外科的探索と生検でセミノーマの転移と判明し、腰筋膿瘍に類似した再発胚細胞腫瘍の稀な例である。後腹膜腫瘍減量術前の診断遅延を避けるため、精巣腫瘍の転移を鑑別に含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-23360792.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with a history of right testicular seminoma presented with a right psoas mass, initially diagnosed as an abscess because of fever and leukocytosis. Serum AFP and hCG were normal. Surgical exploration and biopsy revealed seminoma metastasis, an unusual presentation of recurrent germ cell tumor that mimicked a psoas abscess. The authors emphasize considering metastatic testicular neoplasm in the differential diagnosis to avoid delay before retroperitoneal tumor debulking.

pmid-23362440.summary_ja: 若年男性に最も多いがんである精巣胚細胞腫瘍の現在の管理をレビューしている。純粋セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(NSGCT)に大別され、セミノーマは放射線療法とプラチナ系化学療法に感受性が高い。NSGCTは転移巣に奇形腫成分を伴うことが多く、化学療法と奇形腫成分の外科的切除を要する。高い治癒率には、病期分類、早期の適切な治療、厳格なフォローアップ、救済療法が重要とされる。
pmid-23362440.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of testicular germ cell tumors, the most common cancer in young men. Tumors are divided into pure seminoma and nonseminomatous GCTs (NSGCTs). Seminomas are highly sensitive to radiation and platinum chemotherapy, while NSGCTs often contain teratoma at metastatic sites and usually require chemotherapy plus surgical removal of residual teratomatous components. The authors stress careful staging, adequate early treatment, strict follow-up, and salvage therapy as keys to high cure rates.

pmid-23374785.summary_ja: 2施設で1999〜2010年に根治的精巣摘除術を受けた83例の後方視的研究。がん性標本の62%で精子形成が認められ、腫瘍マーカー値との関連はなかったが、腫瘍径が小さいほど精子形成が保たれやすかった。摘除精巣は腫瘍学的精巣精子採取術による凍結保存精子の供給源になりうると結論づけている。
pmid-23374785.summary_en: This retrospective study of 83 men who underwent radical orchiectomy for testicular cancer at two institutions assessed spermatogenesis in the removed testes. Spermatogenesis was detected in 62% of cancerous specimens, with similar rates in pure seminomas and nonseminomatous/mixed germ cell tumors. Tumor marker levels were not associated with spermatogenesis, but smaller tumor size was an independent positive predictor. The authors conclude that most cancerous testes contain active spermatogenesis and may serve as a source for sperm cryopreservation via oncologic testicular sperm extraction.

pmid-23374840.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマ患者から樹立された新規細胞株SEM-1の特性を、精巣由来のTCam-2およびJKT-1と比較した。SALL4やAP-2γなどを発現し、12p増加を伴う低三倍体核型を示したが、イソクロモソーム12pやBRAF V600Eは認めなかった。セミノーマと非セミノーマの中間的特徴を持ち、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の分子病態研究のモデルになると述べている。
pmid-23374840.summary_en: The authors established SEM-1, a new cell line from a patient with mediastinal seminoma, and characterized it against the testis-derived seminoma lines TCam-2 and JKT-1. SEM-1 expressed SALL4, AP-2γ, and several stem cell markers, and showed a hypotriploid karyotype with 12p gain but no isochromosome 12p or BRAF V600E mutation. Its profile was closer to TCam-2 than to JKT-1, and it displayed features intermediate between seminoma and nonseminoma. The authors propose SEM-1 as a model for studying the molecular pathogenesis of extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-23374946.summary_ja: 左胸部に副乳を有する53歳男性で、47歳時に病期IIAの精巣セミノーマが見つかった症例を報告する。あわせて、多乳症と泌尿生殖器やその他の悪性腫瘍を合併した既報例を文献的に検討した。副乳は泌尿生殖器がんや内臓がんのリスク上昇と関連しうるため、悪性腫瘍の潜在的リスクを持つ遺伝性皮膚疾患として注意すべきだと提唱している。
pmid-23374946.summary_en: A 53-year-old man with a left-chest accessory nipple (polythelia) was diagnosed with stage IIA testicular seminoma at age 47. The authors review published reports of patients with polythelia and genitourinary or other malignancies. They highlight an association between supernumerary nipples and increased risk of genitourinary cancers and visceral neoplasms. They suggest polythelia should be considered a genodermatosis with malignant potential that warrants attention beyond cosmetic concern, prompting consideration of cancer surveillance in affected patients.

pmid-23375412.summary_ja: 化学療法のみで治癒しうる絨毛癌や精巣腫瘍では、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値が甲状腺機能に影響すると仮説を立てた論文である。化学療法に伴うホルモン低下が細胞周期停止と化学療法抵抗性を招くと論じ、ホルモンを化学療法と併用する「ネオ内分泌化学療法」を提唱している。臨床的検証はなく、あくまで仮説である。
pmid-23375412.summary_en: This hypothesis article proposes that some choriocarcinomas and testicular tumors, which are curable with chemotherapy alone, have high human chorionic gonadotropin levels that may influence thyroid function. The author argues that chemotherapy-induced hormone decline causes G0/G1 arrest and chemoresistance. Accordingly, the author proposes neo-endocrinochemotherapy (choriocarcinoma-mimic chemotherapy), which co-administers endocrine hormones with chemotherapy to restore cell-cycle activity and enhance chemosensitivity. The concept is untested clinically and remains speculative.

pmid-23379293.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の23歳患者の脳脊髄液を、ラット大脳皮質培養神経ネットワークに作用させて解析した。発症初期の脳脊髄液はスパイク・バースト発火を抑制したが、回復後は抑制されなかった。同期性は変化せず、自己免疫性脳炎に伴う脳脊髄液変化の機能的影響を評価する手法として有用な可能性を示している。
pmid-23379293.summary_en: In this study, cerebrospinal fluid from a 23-year-old patient with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, obtained during early disease and after recovery, was applied to dissociated rat cortical cultures on microelectrode arrays. Early patient CSF suppressed global spike and burst rates, whereas post-recovery CSF did not. Network synchrony was unaffected throughout. The patient had an ovarian teratoma that was removed alongside immunomodulatory therapy. The authors suggest in vitro network activity assays may help evaluate functional effects of autoimmune encephalitis-related CSF changes.

pmid-23391779.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する悪性卵巣甲状腺腫で、骨盤骨転移をきたした2症例の報告です。1例目は22歳女性で、卵巣甲状腺腫内の甲状腺乳頭癌に対する手術後、全摘と放射性ヨウ素治療により骨盤転移が消失しました。2例目は49歳女性で、骨盤内再発と股関節転移を認め、切除と複数回のI-131治療で改善しました。全甲状腺摘出の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-23391779.summary_en: Two cases of malignant struma ovarii with metastases to the pelvic bone are reported. In the first, a 22-year-old woman had papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in struma ovarii after salpingo-oophorectomy. Following total thyroidectomy, radioactive iodine therapy resolved pelvic metastasis. The second case, a 49-year-old woman, had pelvic recurrence and hip metastasis treated with resection, thyroidectomy and multiple I-131 ablations. The authors emphasize total thyroidectomy to enable detection and treatment of bone metastasis.

pmid-23396295.summary_ja: 混合性性腺異形成の患者の異形成性性腺で、OCT3/4、β-カテニン、TSPYを免疫組織化学と免疫蛍光法で検討した研究です。性腺芽細胞腫の発生はOCT3/4とTSPYの相互作用によるもので、β-カテニンは関与しないと結論しています。これらのマーカーは悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高い性腺の同定に有用と示唆されました。
pmid-23396295.summary_en: This study examined OCT3/4, beta-catenin and TSPY expression by immunohistochemistry and immunofluorescence in dysgenetic gonads from patients with mixed gonadal dysgenesis, compared with gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma/seminoma. The authors propose that gonadoblastoma development results from an interaction between OCT3/4 and TSPY, while beta-catenin is not involved. They suggest these markers may help identify gonads at high risk of malignant germ cell tumor development. The sample size is not stated in the abstract, and the findings are preliminary.

pmid-23400963.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の89例を中央値82か月追跡した研究です。再発は9例で、そのうち8例は積極的監視群でした。5年無増悪生存率は監視群74.1%、化学療法群92.3%、後腹膜リンパ節郭清群100%でした。多変量解析でリンパ管・血管侵襲、13歳超、停留精巣の既往が監視中の再発と関連し、リスクに応じた管理への応用が示唆されています。
pmid-23400963.summary_en: This study of 89 patients with clinical stage I testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, followed for a median of 82 months, assessed relapse predictors after orchidectomy. Nine patients relapsed, eight of them under surveillance. Five-year PFS was 74.1% in the surveillance group, 92.3% in the chemotherapy group and 100% in the RPLND group. Lymphatic/vascular invasion, age over 13 years and a history of cryptorchidism predicted relapse during surveillance on multivariate analysis. The authors suggest these factors may guide risk-adapted management.

pmid-23401282.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から得た奇形腫膜の超微細構造とコラーゲン組成を、羊膜と比較した研究です。奇形腫膜は3層構造を示し、層の配列とコラーゲンの分布は羊膜とほぼ逆でした。奇形腫膜のコラーゲン線維は羊膜より細いことも示されています。卵巣奇形腫の発生機序を理解する手がかりとなる可能性があります。
pmid-23401282.summary_en: The ultrastructure and collagen composition of the teratoma membrane from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary were compared with human amniotic membrane. The teratoma membrane had three layers with distinct fiber arrangements, and its layer organization and collagen patterns were roughly reversed relative to amnion. The outer teratoma layer was rich in type III collagen, the inner layer contained types III and IV, and its collagen fibrils were thinner. The authors suggest these differences reflect different functional roles, providing insight into ovarian teratoma pathogenesis.

pmid-23402579.summary_ja: 33歳男性の左精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍(病期III)に対し、プラチナ系化学療法を施行。4年後に後腹膜再発し、切除された腫瘤と腎臓の病理では主に成熟奇形腫で、その内部に乳頭状腎細胞癌が認められた。原発性腎癌は否定された。標準的な胚細胞腫瘍レジメンへの反応は乏しいため、再発時には腎細胞癌由来の可能性を除外すべきと報告している。
pmid-23402579.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with a left testicular mixed germ cell tumor (stage III) received cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin chemotherapy. Four years later he relapsed with a retroperitoneal mass. Resection of the mass and left kidney showed a mature teratoma with somatic malignant transformation into papillary renal cell carcinoma, confirmed by immunohistochemistry, and no primary renal tumor was found. The authors report this as a first description of such transformation in a testicular GCT metastasis after platinum chemotherapy. They advise excluding a renal origin at recurrence, because renal cell carcinoma responds poorly to standard GCT regimens.

pmid-23406948.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍23例について、術中の捺印細胞診と凍結切片診断を最終病理診断と比較した。6例で不一致があり、未熟奇形腫の正診率は54.5%にとどまったが、他の胚細胞腫瘍では91.7%であった。凍結切片で誤診された2例では細胞診が正診に寄与した。両者を組み合わせることで術中診断の精度向上が期待できると結論している。
pmid-23406948.summary_en: Intraoperative diagnosis of ovarian germ cell tumors relies on frozen sections and imprint cytology. In 23 cases, the authors compared intraoperative assessments with final histology. Discrepancies occurred in 6 cases. Accuracy was only 54.5% for immature teratoma, versus 91.7% for other GCT subtypes. Cytology was helpful in two cases where frozen sections were inaccurate. The authors conclude that imprint cytology has lower sensitivity for immature teratoma but acceptable sensitivity for other GCTs, and recommend combining it with frozen sections.

pmid-23411938.summary_ja: 肺扁平上皮癌の既往がある67歳男性の頸部リンパ節生検で、CD10陽性の大型異型細胞がみられ、当初はリンパ腫が疑われた。OCT3/4、SALL4、CLDN6陽性により胚細胞性の性格が示され、転移性セミノーマと確定した。セミノーマ16例中14例でCD10が強陽性であり、リンパ腫との鑑別で誤りを招きうると警告している。
pmid-23411938.summary_en: A 67-year-old man with prior lung squamous cell carcinoma had cervical and para-aortic lymphadenopathy. Cervical node biopsy showed large atypical cells that were CD10-positive, initially suggesting lymphoma. Further staining for OCT3/4, SALL4 and CLDN6 revealed germ cell features, confirming metastatic seminoma. In a series of 16 seminomas, CD10 was strongly positive in 14 and weakly or partially positive in 2. The authors conclude that CD10 expression can mislead toward lymphoma and should be considered in the differential diagnosis of seminoma.

pmid-23412127.summary_ja: 33歳男性が無痛性の左陰嚢腫脹で受診した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGは正常であったが、CTでは左陰嚢の不均一な腫瘤と傍大動脈リンパ節腫大が認められた。病期II A期の精巣がんと診断され、左高位精巣摘除術を受けた。病理検査では悪性胚細胞腫瘍成分を伴わない成熟奇形腫であった。1か月後に傍大動脈リンパ節が著明に縮小したため補助化学療法は見送られ、転移の可能性があるため慎重な経過観察が勧められた。
pmid-23412127.summary_en: A 33-year-old man presented with painless left scrotal swelling. Serum AFP and β-hCG were normal, while CT showed a heterogeneous left scrotal mass and para-aortic lymphadenopathy. He was diagnosed with stage IIA testicular cancer and underwent left high orchiectomy. Pathology showed mature teratoma without a malignant germ cell tumor component. The para-aortic nodes shrank markedly one month later, so adjuvant chemotherapy was withheld, and careful follow-up was advised because metastasis remained possible.

pmid-23412128.summary_ja: 経済的・社会的な障壁を抱える、I期の巨大セミノーマの男性2例を報告している。39歳の1例目は、β-hCGの上昇と440 gの精巣腫瘍を認め、経過観察を選択したが通院が途絶えた。21か月後に傍大動脈リンパ節の腫瘤が出現し、エトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法で完全奏効を得た後、経済的困難から再び通院が途絶えた。36歳の2例目は、1,926 gの腫瘍と、LDHおよびβ-hCGの上昇を認めた。不安定な生活習慣のため精巣摘除術が遅れた。その後経過観察を選択し、19か月間再発はない。社会経済的状況が両患者の治療の継続を妨げた。
pmid-23412128.summary_en: Two men with stage I giant seminomas faced socioeconomic barriers. The first, aged 39 with elevated β-hCG and a 440 g testicular tumor, chose surveillance but stopped follow-up. At 21 months he had a para-aortic mass, achieved complete response after etoposide-cisplatin chemotherapy, then again discontinued visits due to financial difficulties. The second, aged 36 with a 1,926 g tumor and raised LDH and β-hCG, delayed orchiectomy because of an unstable lifestyle. He then chose surveillance and has remained recurrence-free for 19 months. Socioeconomic circumstances disrupted both patients' care.

pmid-23412916.summary_ja: 77歳女性の卵巣腫瘍で、現在報告されている最高齢の卵巣甲状腺腫例である。凍結切片では索状の性索様成分が見られ、セルトリ細胞腫瘍などの性索間質性腫瘍が疑われた。最終診断は甲状腺濾胞の存在と免疫組織化学の結果に基づき卵巣甲状腺腫であった。卵巣奇形腫の3%未満という稀な腫瘍が、術中診断を誤らせうることを示し、文献的考察を加えている。
pmid-23412916.summary_en: A 77-year-old woman with an ovarian mass was diagnosed with struma ovarii, reported as the oldest known case of this disease. Frozen section showed sex cord-like elements, raising suspicion of a sex cord-stromal tumor, possibly Sertoli cell tumor. The final diagnosis rested on typical thyroid follicles and immunohistochemistry. Struma ovarii, a monodermal variant of ovarian teratoma that makes up under 3% of such tumors, can mimic other ovarian neoplasms on frozen section and mislead intraoperative assessment. The authors also review the literature.

pmid-23420531.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の367例と対照537例を用い、アリール炭化水素受容体(AHR)およびそのリプレッサーAHRRの遺伝子多型を解析した研究である。AHRRの4つの一塩基多型が転移と有意に関連した。AHR経路が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の浸潤進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23420531.summary_en: This case-control study of 367 patients with testicular germ cell cancer and 537 controls examined whether polymorphisms in the aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AHR) and its repressor AHRR are linked to disease risk, histology, and metastasis. Four AHRR single-nucleotide polymorphisms showed significant allele associations with metastatic disease. The authors suggest that AHR-activating compounds may contribute to the invasive progression of testicular germ cell cancer, directly or by modifying reproductive hormone action.

pmid-23427184.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞を用い、内在性TIMP-2の過剰発現が増殖を促進することを示した。その作用はMAPK経路のERK1/2およびJNK1/2を介しており、阻害で抑制された。TIMP-2は絨毛癌の新たな腫瘍マーカーとなり得ると提案されている。
pmid-23427184.summary_en: This study investigated the role of endogenous TIMP-2 in proliferation of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. Transient overexpression of TIMP-2 increased proliferation and activated ERK1/2 and JNK1/2 of the MAPK pathway. Inhibiting these kinases suppressed the proliferative effect. The authors propose BeWo cells as a model for fast-growing choriocarcinoma and suggest TIMP-2 may serve as a novel tumor marker for this malignancy.

pmid-23429169.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫の胎児を後方視的に検討し、MRIで測定した胎児肺容積が致死的な肺低形成を予測できるかを評価した。在胎週数の中央値より1標準偏差低い肺容積は陽性的中率100%を示した。少数例ながら、MRIによる肺容積評価が有用と結論されている。
pmid-23429169.summary_en: This retrospective cohort of fetuses with cervical teratomas evaluated whether MRI-measured total lung volumes could predict lethal pulmonary hypoplasia. Lung volumes one standard deviation below the median for gestational age had a 100% positive predictive value for neonatal death from pulmonary hypoplasia, while larger volumes were uniformly associated with survival. Percent predicted lung volume at or below 75.7% and observed-to-expected volume at or below 68.3% were also associated with lethality.

pmid-23429488.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞を用い、Eph-ephrin Aシステムの悪性妊娠性絨毛性疾患における浸潤への関与を検討した。組換えEph A1およびephrin A4は増殖に影響せず浸潤を促進し、インテグリンα5の発現を増加させた。Eph-ephrin相互作用が絨毛癌の浸潤をインテグリンと協調して制御することが示唆された。
pmid-23429488.summary_en: Using the choriocarcinoma-derived JEG-3 cell line, this study examined whether the Eph-ephrin A system affects invasion in malignant gestational trophoblastic disease. Recombinant Eph A1 and ephrin A4 promoted invasion without changing proliferation, increased integrin α5 expression, and reduced focal adhesion kinase phosphorylation. The authors conclude that Eph-ephrin interaction regulates choriocarcinoma invasion in cooperation with integrins.

pmid-23429489.summary_ja: 南アフリカ・リンポポ州で生検診断された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍119例を前方視的に収集し、臨床病理学的特徴を検討した。良性は70.6%、悪性は29.4%であった。卵管原発の奇胎と絨毛癌はまれであり、悪性例の11.4%がHIV感染者であった。
pmid-23429489.summary_en: This study prospectively collected 119 biopsy-diagnosed gestational trophoblastic neoplasia cases in South Africa's Limpopo Province to characterize benign and malignant disease. Of these, 70.6% were benign and 29.4% malignant. Tubal GTN was rare: two hydatid moles and two choriocarcinomas arose in the fallopian tubes, accounting for 0.5% of tubal ectopic pregnancies. Among 35 malignant cases, 11.4% were HIV-infected, and mean age did not differ between benign and malignant groups.

pmid-23432104.summary_ja: 1987〜2008年のフィンランド全国登録に基づき、仙尾部奇形腫の有病率を検討した研究である。総有病率は1:10,700と従来報告より高く、胎児期診断は55%であった。周産期死亡は28%で、約30%に合併奇形が認められ、カウンセリングや分娩計画への活用が示唆されている。
pmid-23432104.summary_en: This nationwide Finnish registry study over 1987 to 2008 identified 124 sacrococcygeal teratomas among 1.33 million pregnancies, a total prevalence of 1:10,700, substantially higher than prior estimates. Most cases were live births, with 55% detected prenatally and 18% ending in termination. Perinatal mortality was 28% of SCT births, and about 30% had associated anomalies, mainly urinary tract. The authors suggest the difference may partly reflect accurate registration, and that high perinatal mortality should inform family counselling and delivery planning.

pmid-23432495.summary_ja: オーストラリアとニュージーランドの重症患者9例の抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例集積である。卵巣奇形腫を伴う傍腫瘍性症候群として知られ、長期集中治療や気管切開合併症、致死的高体温が多くみられた。初期検査が正常でも卵巣奇形腫が見つかる例があった。
pmid-23432495.summary_en: This Australian and New Zealand case series describes nine critically ill patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a paraneoplastic syndrome often associated with ovarian teratoma. One patient died and one had poor neurological recovery, while others recovered substantially or completely. Patients frequently required prolonged intensive care, developed tracheostomy complications from hypersalivation and life-threatening hyperthermia, and had difficult-to-control abnormal movements. Ovarian teratomas were present even when initial investigations were normal.

pmid-23438793.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の鑑別を目的に、p27とp57の免疫染色と組織学的指標を検討した研究である。部分奇胎と妊娠産物の鑑別には絨毛最大径1.5mmが、部分奇胎と完全奇胎の鑑別にはp27の7.5%カットオフが有用であった。絨毛癌では両者の共発現が認められなかった。
pmid-23438793.summary_en: This study evaluated p27 and p57 immunostaining, along with histopathologic parameters, to distinguish gestational trophoblastic diseases including product of conception, partial mole, complete mole, and choriocarcinoma. Maximal villous diameter at 1.5 mm best separated partial mole from product of conception, and p27 at 7.5% helped distinguish partial from complete mole. Co-expression of p27 and p57 was seen in non-molar and partial molar gestations but not in choriocarcinoma. The authors suggest these markers may reflect suppressive roles in trophoblast proliferation and invasion.

pmid-23440800.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する初回併用化学療法について、コクランレビューの最新版。対象となった無作為化試験は1件(42例)のみで、MAC療法と改変CHAMOCAレジメンを比較した。有効性に有意差はなかったものの、CHAMOCAは毒性が強く死亡例も多かったため試験は早期中止された。現在はEMA/COが最も広く用いられているが、MAC等との比較試験はなく、多施設共同の大規模試験が必要とされる。
pmid-23440800.summary_en: This Cochrane review updates the evidence on first-line combination chemotherapy for high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Only one randomized trial (42 women) was identified, comparing MAC with the modified CHAMOCA regimen. Efficacy did not differ significantly, but CHAMOCA caused more toxicity and more deaths, and the trial was stopped early. The authors do not recommend CHAMOCA. EMA/CO remains the most widely used regimen, but no randomized trial has compared it with MAC or FAV, so larger multicentre trials with long-term surveillance are needed.

pmid-23445130.summary_ja: 卵管に発生した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビュー。卵管奇形腫は極めてまれで、報告例は73例である。多くは良性で、半数が嚢胞性であった。患者年齢は17～67歳で、術前診断された例はなかった。本症例はトルコからの初報告である。
pmid-23445130.summary_en: This report describes a case of mature cystic teratoma of the fallopian tube, a very rare location. The authors reviewed the literature to update data on tubal teratomas, identifying 73 reported cases. Most tumours were benign, and about half were cystic. Patients were 17 to 67 years old, and none was diagnosed preoperatively. The present case is the first tubal cystic teratoma reported from Turkey.

pmid-23448565.summary_ja: 成人の眼窩内で、完全に円錐内に位置した類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。眼窩類皮嚢腫の多くは骨縫合部近傍の円錐外に生じ、小児に多く認められるため、本例は極めてまれな部位と考えられる。評価はCTとMRIにより行われた。成人の深部眼窩腫瘤の鑑別において、この非典型的な病変を認識することの重要性が示された。
pmid-23448565.summary_en: This case report describes an intraconal orbital dermoid cyst in an adult, a very rare location. Most orbital dermoids are extraconal and occur in children, so an entirely intraconal lesion is exceptional. The patient was evaluated with CT and MRI. The authors highlight the importance of recognizing this uncommon presentation when an adult presents with a deep orbital mass.

pmid-23455529.summary_ja: 化学療法後の原発性縦隔絨毛癌の22歳男性例。血清β-hCGは正常化していたが、FDG PET/CTで前縦隔と肺病変に集積を認め残存腫瘍が疑われた。切除標本では壊死と線維組織球性反応のみで生存腫瘍はなく、PET/CTの偽陽性と判明した。化学療法後の残存腫瘤評価において、FDG PET/CTは誤解を招く可能性があり注意が必要である。
pmid-23455529.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old man with primary mediastinal choriocarcinoma and bilateral lung metastases. After chemotherapy, serum β-hCG had normalized, but FDG PET/CT showed uptake in the anterior mediastinal and lung lesions, suspicious for residual disease. Resection showed necrosis and fibrohistiocytic reaction without viable tumour, so the PET/CT findings were false positive. The authors caution that FDG PET/CT may be misleading when assessing residual masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-23462292.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)の感受性座位として、染色体1q23のUCK2遺伝子周辺を検討した。大規模な症例対照研究とメタ解析により、UCK2のSNP、特にrs3790665が全ゲノム有意水準で関連した。家族研究でも過剰伝達が確認され、UCK2の遺伝的多様性がTGCTリスクに寄与することが示唆された。
pmid-23462292.summary_en: This genome-wide association meta-analysis of 940 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 1559 controls, followed by replication in 2202 additional cases and 2386 controls, examined 122 SNPs on chromosome 1q23 near the UCK2 gene. Genome-wide significant associations were found for several UCK2 markers, with rs3790665 most significant (PCombined = 6.0 × 10^-9). A familial study also showed over-transmission of rs3790665 to affected individuals, supporting UCK2 variation as a TGCT risk factor.

pmid-23463367.summary_ja: 神経筋外来の5例に加え、文献から45例を集計した放射線照射後下位運動ニューロン症候群の報告である。多くは精巣がんに対する放射線療法後の男性で、潜伏期間は3か月から27年と幅が大きい。MRIでは画像検査を受けた患者の約半数で馬尾の造影増強が認められた。本症候群は従来考えられているより頻度が高い可能性があり、見逃さないことが重要と結論づけられている。
pmid-23463367.summary_en: This report describes five patients with postradiation lower motor neuron syndrome treated at a neuromuscular clinic, three of whom had received radiotherapy for seminoma. A systematic review of the literature identified 45 additional cases, mostly men with testicular cancer irradiated at a mean age of 33 years, with latency ranging from 3 months to 27 years. Gadolinium-enhanced MRI of the cauda equina was positive in about half of imaged patients. The authors argue this syndrome may be more common than recognized.

pmid-23465476.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍144例の施設データを解析し、治療前後の腎機能を比較した。全体の推定GFR中央値は有意に低下し、化学療法を受けた患者の9.9%が新規にCKDステージ3を発症したが、非化学療法群では発症例はなかった。化学療法が長期的な腎機能リスクとなることを示し、生存者への説明に役立つと結論づけられている。
pmid-23465476.summary_en: This institutional review of 144 patients with testicular germ cell tumor compared renal function before and after treatment. Median estimated GFR declined significantly, from 104 to 95.5 mL/min/1.73m². Among patients receiving systemic chemotherapy, 9.9% developed new CKD stage 3, compared with none of those treated without chemotherapy (P=0.01). The authors conclude chemotherapy carries a long-term renal risk relevant to survivorship counseling.

pmid-23465478.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍12検体のゲノム解析で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清によりリンパ節転移の有無で分けて比較した。転移例と非転移例の間でY染色体のコピー数に差が認められ、Y染色体の欠失が進行を予測するマーカーとなる可能性が示された。同定された変化は他の精巣腫瘍でも報告されたものと類似していた。症例数が少ないため、結果は予備的なものである。
pmid-23465478.summary_en: This commentary on a genomic study of clinical stage I non-seminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT) summarizes an analysis of 12 mixed germ cell tumors, 8 without and 4 with nodal metastasis at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Array comparative genomic analysis revealed copy-number differences between groups. The most notable finding was a statistically suggestive difference in Y chromosome copy number, suggesting Y chromosome deletion as a potential marker for predicting progression. The sample size is small, so the finding is preliminary.

pmid-23465479.summary_ja: ASCOおよびEAUの会員969名への調査により、病期Iの精巣セミノーマに対する精巣摘除術後の治療方針を検討した。過半数は単一の戦略のみを提供し、サーベイランス、放射線療法、化学療法がそれぞれ約2割ずつであった。診療方針は専門領域や国によって大きく異なり、同一国内でも標準化されていなかった。標準化には長期の再発率と有害事象のデータが必要とされる。
pmid-23465479.summary_en: This commentary on a European practice-pattern survey of 969 clinicians (ASCO and EAU members) examines post-orchiectomy management of clinical stage I seminoma. Most respondents offered only one strategy: 18% surveillance only, 19% radiotherapy only, and 21% chemotherapy only. Practice varied substantially between specialties and countries, and even within countries. The authors call for long-term relapse and adverse-effect data to standardize care.

pmid-23465480.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ52例(転移12例、非転移40例)の原発腫瘍のRNAを用いて、94の候補遺伝子を定量PCRで解析した。DRD1とFAM71F2の2遺伝子の組み合わせで転移の有無を87.7%の一致率で識別でき、腫瘍サイズ単独(61%)を上回った。症例数は限られるが、補助療法とサーベイランスの選択を支援する可能性がある。
pmid-23465480.summary_en: Using RNA from primary seminoma tumors of 12 metastatic and 40 non-metastatic patients, the authors screened 94 candidate genes by qPCR. Expression of DRD1 and FAM71F2 discriminated metastatic status, with 87.7% concordance when combined, exceeding tumor size alone (61%). The study is limited by small sample size and single-cohort validation, but suggests gene expression could guide decisions between early adjuvant therapy and surveillance.

pmid-23466003.summary_ja: 成人男性の腹腔内停留精巣に由来する後腹膜成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の手術確認例を報告した。原発性後腹膜奇形腫は後腹膜腫瘍の1〜11%を占め、多くは新生児や若年成人に生じる。診断はマルチスライスCTとMRIで行われた。成人男性でこの経路から生じた症例は極めて稀であることが強調されている。
pmid-23466003.summary_en: The authors describe an adult man with a surgically confirmed retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma arising from an intra-abdominal undescended testis. Teratomas are germ cell tumors usually arising in gonads, and primary retroperitoneal teratomas make up 1–11% of retroperitoneal neoplasms, most often in neonates and young adults. Multislice helical CT and MRI were used for diagnosis. The authors note that this origin in an adult male has been very rarely reported.

pmid-23466004.summary_ja: 37歳男性に生じた精巣セミノーマの晩期再発例で、後縦隔の大きな腫瘤として出現した。腫瘍は下行大動脈を取り囲み、左心房と左主気管支を圧迫していた。セミノーマは治療後5年間無病であれば通常治癒とみなされるが、大きな縦隔腫瘤としての再発は極めて稀であると指摘されている。
pmid-23466004.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with late relapse of testicular seminoma presenting as a large posterior mediastinal mass. The tumor encased the descending thoracic aorta and compressed the left atrium and left main bronchus on CT and PET. The authors note that patients with seminoma are usually considered cured after 5 disease-free years, and that relapse as a large mediastinal mass is extremely rare.

pmid-23469623.summary_ja: 病期I純粋精巣セミノーマ47例で、根治的精巣摘除術後の検体を用いてROR2やWnt5aなどの免疫染色を検討しました。ROR2/Wnt5aはリンパ管浸潤や病理学的T分類と有意な関連を示さず、予後マーカーとしての有用性は支持されませんでした。
