It notes that cisplatin chemotherapy and the high radiosensitivity of seminoma have produced excellent cure rates. The authors describe ongoing research into the molecular basis of germ cell tumours and why some tumours resist treatment. The article aims to clarify areas of confusion in testicular pathology and oncology and highlight current topics of interest for clinicians and pathologists. It is an overview rather than primary data.

pmid-21938584.summary_ja: グローニンゲン大学の29例で、播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘍を腹腔鏡下に切除した成績である。成功率は86%で、成熟奇形腫が55%を占めた。在院日数は短く、早期再発は1例のみであった。適切に選択された患者では有用な選択肢となり得るが、長期的な腫瘍学的効果の検証が必要と結論している。
pmid-21938584.summary_en: This single-centre series from Groningen reports laparoscopic resection of residual retroperitoneal tumour masses in 29 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Laparoscopy succeeded in 86% of cases, with three conversions. Histology showed mature teratoma in 55% and viable tumour in one patient. Hospital stay was short, with one early relapse during median follow-up of 47 months. The authors conclude that laparoscopic resection is a feasible option in selected patients, pending long-term oncologic data.

pmid-21948117.summary_ja: セネガルの胞状奇胎後妊娠性絨毛癌患者43例でNLRP7の全エクソンを解析した遺伝学的研究である。患者のみに認められた新規変異3種を同定した。G487Eの頻度は集団間で大きく異なり、アフリカ由来の対立遺伝子が祖先型と考えられた。NLRP7変異の頻度が高い集団は、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の多発地域と一致する。
pmid-21948117.summary_en: This genetic study sequences NLRP7 in 43 Senegalese women with post-molar gestational choriocarcinoma to assess susceptibility to malignant transformation of hydatidiform moles. Three novel variants were found only in patients, not in controls from Senegal, Tunisia, or Canada. Allele frequencies of the G487E variant differed markedly across populations, with the African allele likely ancestral. The authors suggest higher NLRP7 variant frequencies in Senegal and Tunisia may relate to the greater prevalence of moles and choriocarcinoma there.

pmid-21983876.summary_ja: 64歳男性に発生した膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。膵奇形腫は極めて稀な先天性腫瘍で、術前診断が難しいとされる。本症例は画像検査により術前に診断された。文献上26例目の報告であり、嚢胞性膵腫瘤を認めた際の画像評価の重要性と、適切な手術計画の立案につながる点が示されている。
pmid-21983876.summary_en: Case report of a 64-year-old man with a mature cystic teratoma of the pancreas, the 26th reported case. The diagnosis was made preoperatively on imaging. The authors note that the preoperative diagnosis of this congenital tumor arising from totipotent cells is challenging. This is an extragonadal teratoma, relevant to the site's scope.

pmid-21989172.summary_ja: 精子形成におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)による遺伝子発現制御をまとめた総説。翻訳後の制御の乱れが精巣胚細胞腫瘍や精母細胞腫瘍の発生に関与しうるとされる。miRNAの操作は抗腫瘍薬や新たな避妊法への応用が期待される。PubMedを用いた文献検索に基づき、精子形成の分子機構、腫瘍発生との関連、治療・避妊への応用可能性について論じている。
pmid-21989172.summary_en: Review of microRNA regulation of gene expression in mammalian spermatogenesis and its involvement in testicular germ cell tumor development. Disruption of miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional control may contribute to neoplasia. The authors also discuss miRNA-based anticancer reagents and contraceptive applications.

pmid-22026641.summary_ja: 本研究は、276例の思春期前精巣検体を対象に未分類型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)の有無を検討した。6例に異型胚細胞が認められた。間性の3例はIGCNUの基準を満たしたが、ダウン症候群の1例は胚細胞成熟遅延と分類された。間性疾患を除くと、真のIGCNUは見出されなかった。
pmid-22026641.summary_en: This study examined 276 prepubertal testicular specimens for intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified type (IGCNU). Six specimens contained atypical germ cells. Three intersex patients met the IGCNU criteria. One Down syndrome case showed centrally located germ cells with fetal markers (Oct3/4, PLAP, CD117) and was classified as delayed germ cell maturation. The remaining cases proved to involve undiagnosed intersex disorders. The authors found no bona fide IGCNU in prepubertal testes apart from intersex conditions, which informs the pathogenesis and classification of testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-22040835.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の幹細胞様細胞(SC-OYST)について、腹膜中皮細胞との共培養が及ぼす影響を検討した。共培養によりCD133陽性NOY1細胞は高いCD133発現、コロニー形成、遊走・浸潤能を示した。CXCR4阻害薬AMD3100は、これらの機能と生体内での腫瘍形成能を抑制した。腹膜中皮細胞が腹膜播種におけるニッチを提供し、治療標的となりうると示唆された。
pmid-22040835.summary_en: This study examined how peritoneal mesothelial cells interact with stem-like cells of ovarian yolk sac tumor (SC-OYST), using the NOY1 cell line sorted by CD133 status. Co-culture with mesothelial cells increased CD133 expression and colony formation, and CD133-positive cells showed greater migration and invasion. The CXCR4 inhibitor AMD3100 suppressed colony formation, migration, invasion, and in vivo tumorigenicity of CD133-positive cells. The authors suggest peritoneal mesothelium provides a niche supporting these cells in peritoneal dissemination, highlighting potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-22052450.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫26例のMRI所見を後方視的に検討し、13例ではコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見も比較した。全例が境界明瞭な囊胞性腫瘤で充実成分を伴い、多くは多房性であった。T1高信号点やT2低信号の小腔、CTでの高吸収域と充実成分内の曲線状石灰化が特徴的であった。画像所見が診断に有用であると結論づけられている。
pmid-22052450.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed MR images of 26 struma ovarii cases, with CT images available in 13. All tumors were well-defined cystic masses with solid components, mostly multicystic. Solid components appeared as thickened septa or walls, and T1 high-intensity foci and T2 low-intensity loculi were common. On CT, high attenuation areas and curvilinear calcifications within solid components were frequent. The authors conclude that struma ovarii typically appears as a lobulated multicystic lesion with solid components, and that imaging features aid diagnosis.

pmid-22068256.summary_ja: 64歳の女性が、卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する乳頭状甲状腺癌と判明するまで3年以上、卵巣腺癌として誤って治療されていた症例を報告する。両側卵管卵巣摘出術の既往があっても、卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別診断に含めることの重要性を強調している。病理医、腫瘍医、外科医の連携も指摘されている。
pmid-22068256.summary_en: A 64-year-old woman was treated for ovarian adenocarcinoma for over three years before papillary thyroid carcinoma arising from struma ovarii was identified. This is reported as the first case of such thyroid carcinoma in a patient with prior bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Possible etiologies include residual ovarian tissue, ectopic thyroid, or metastatic thyroid cancer. The authors stress including struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis even after oophorectomy, and the importance of coordination among pathologists, oncologists, and surgeons.

pmid-22068818.summary_ja: セミノーマ43例、非セミノーマ14例、正常精巣組織23例を対象に、15遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化を解析した。MGMTなど4遺伝子は非セミノーマでメチル化が多く、APCとhMLH1は両組織型で正常精巣より高頻度であった。4遺伝子の組み合わせで非セミノーマの86%を同定できた。組織型と相関するため、今後の大規模検証を経てバイオマーカー開発に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-22068818.summary_en: This study analyzed promoter methylation of 15 cancer-related genes in 43 seminomas, 14 non-seminomas, and 23 normal testis tissues using quantitative methylation-specific PCR. MGMT, VGF, ER-β, and FKBP4 were more often methylated in non-seminomas than in seminomas. APC and hMLH1 were more methylated in both histologies than in normal testis. A combined panel of APC, hMLH1, ER-β, and FKBP4 identified 86% of non-seminomas and 7% of seminomas. The authors suggest the methylation profiles correlate with histology and may aid biomarker development, pending larger validation.

pmid-22072226.summary_ja: 全身型若年性特発性関節炎の19歳患者が、インフリキシマブ治療中に縦隔ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を発症した症例報告である。インフリキシマブの発がんリスクには議論があるが、本剤がジャーミノーマの増大を促した可能性が指摘されている。TNF阻害薬の適応は厳格に判断すべきであり、全国規模のコホート研究が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-22072226.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old patient with systemic-onset juvenile idiopathic arthritis who developed a mediastinal germinoma during infliximab treatment. The authors note that the cancer risk of infliximab is controversial, but that this agent may have accelerated germinoma growth. They conclude that indications for TNF inhibitors should be strictly decided and that a nationwide cohort study is needed to assess cancer risk in patients with JIA receiving biologics.

pmid-22072546.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムワイド解析で同定された4遺伝子（KITLG、SPRY4、BAK1、DMRT1）のバリアントを、小児胚細胞腫瘍52例と新生児141例で比較した。BAK1のrs210138は小児胚細胞腫瘍全体と有意に関連した。KITLGとSPRY4のバリアントは思春期群（10〜21歳）でのみ関連を認めた。これらの遺伝子座が小児・思春期の感受性に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22072546.summary_en: This study evaluated variants in KITLG, SPRY4, BAK1, and DMRT1, loci identified in adult testicular GCT genome-wide studies, in 52 pediatric germ cell tumors compared with 141 newborn controls. The BAK1 variant rs210138 was significantly associated with pediatric GCT overall. KITLG and SPRY4 variants were associated only in the adolescent group aged 10 to 21 years. Associations were largely similar across sexes. The authors conclude these loci may contribute to GCT susceptibility in adolescents and children, notably through BAK1.

pmid-22075622.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の細胞株BeWo、JAR、JEG-3を、PlGF依存性の腫瘍血管新生モデルとして評価した。in vitroと免疫不全マウスの異種移植で解析し、PlGFを中和する融合蛋白sFLT01の効果も検討した。腫瘍血管新生におけるPlGFの役割の解明や、抗血管新生療法の評価に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-22075622.summary_en: This study characterized three human choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo, JAR, and JEG-3, as preclinical models for placental growth factor (PlGF)-dependent tumor angiogenesis. The cells were examined in vitro and in immunodeficient mouse xenografts using ELISA, immunohistochemistry, and double immunofluorescence. The PlGF-neutralizing fusion protein sFLT01 was tested in cell culture and xenograft studies. The authors conclude these models are valuable for exploring PlGF's role in tumor angiogenesis and for evaluating PlGF-targeted anti-angiogenic therapies.

pmid-22075658.summary_ja: 58歳の女性がHartmann手術でS状結腸腫瘍の切除を受け、病理検査で大腸原発の絨毛癌と確定した症例報告である。根治的手術と化学療法の併用が長期生存の最良の機会になると述べている。大腸原発の絨毛癌はきわめて稀であり、病理学的診断の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-22075658.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old woman whose sigmoid colon tumor, removed by Hartmann's procedure, was pathologically confirmed as primary choriocarcinoma of the colon. The authors note that radical surgery combined with chemotherapy offers the best chance of long-term survival for this rare malignancy. The case underscores the rarity of primary colonic choriocarcinoma and the role of pathological examination in establishing its diagnosis, since the tumor was identified only after surgical resection.

pmid-22078334.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の残存腫瘍切除を受けた402例（414回）の多施設後方視的解析。残存腫瘍5cm以上が下大静脈介入の独立した予測因子で、IGCCCG中間/不良リスクも関連した。大きな残存腫瘍と不良リスクの患者は血管手術が可能な専門施設へ紹介すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22078334.summary_en: This multicenter German Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis of 402 patients (414 residual tumor resections) identified predictors of additional vascular procedures during residual tumor resection in advanced germ cell tumors. Of the evaluable cases, 40 underwent major vascular procedures, mostly inferior vena cava resection. In multivariate analysis, residual tumor size of 5 cm or more was the strongest predictor (OR 4.61), and intermediate or poor IGCCCG risk was also associated in univariate analysis. The authors recommend referring patients with large residual masses and unfavorable risk to specialized centers.

pmid-22080441.summary_ja: NR5A1変異を持つ46,XY思春期患者2例の解析。1例では精巣上皮内腫瘍の前駆病変が認められ、胚細胞腫瘍リスクの上昇が示された。出生時の表現型は思春期の男性化を予測しにくく、早期の精巣固定術と腫瘍スクリーニングが勧められるとする。
pmid-22080441.summary_en: Two 46,XY adolescents with NR5A1 (SF-1) mutations and a predominantly female phenotype at birth were studied for pubertal course and gonadal histology. Both had LH and testosterone in the normal male range, with virilization disproportionate to the neonatal phenotype. The girl, gonadectomized at 13 years, had incomplete spermatogenesis and bilateral precursor lesions of testicular carcinoma in situ. The boy's bilateral biopsies at 12 years showed germ cells without malignancy. The authors conclude that these patients are at increased risk for malignant germ cell tumors, warranting early orchidopexy and screening.

pmid-22081041.summary_ja: 30代の健康な男性が転落し、剖検で肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍と心内転移が確認された症例。腫瘍はAFP陽性だった。心腔内腫瘍による流出障害が失神を招き転落につながった可能性が論じられている。死因に関与する潜在疾患を見出すため、詳細な剖検の重要性を強調している。
pmid-22081041.summary_en: A healthy man in his 30s fell down stairs and died after pulmonary contusion and cardiopulmonary arrest. Echocardiography had shown a floating left ventricular mass and severe mitral regurgitation. Autopsy revealed a primary lung yolk sac tumor with a metastatic intracardiac yolk sac tumor, which was positive for alpha-fetoprotein. The authors propose that the cardiac tumor obstructed outflow and caused syncope, which led to the fall. They emphasize that a thorough autopsy can identify latent disease contributing to death.

pmid-22084429.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが28年後に再発し、低分化神経内分泌癌成分を伴う未分化胚細胞腫瘍として出現した症例。当初は腸管原発腫瘍の転移と誤診された。晩期再発は多様な形態をとり、臨床医・病理医双方にとって診断が困難になりうると指摘する。
pmid-22084429.summary_en: A testicular seminoma recurred 28 years after surgery as an undifferentiated germ cell tumor with a heterologous poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma component. The neuroendocrine component initially led to misdiagnosis as a metastasis from a primary intestinal tumor. The authors note that late recurrences of testicular germ cell tumors have increased since cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved survival. These recurrences can take variable forms and occur years after the primary tumor, making diagnosis challenging for both clinicians and pathologists.

pmid-22085657.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎と持続性絨毛性腫瘍）の多モダリティ画像診断の総説。超音波検査が初期検査として中心で、完全胞状奇胎は「ぶどうの房」像を示す。骨盤MRIは子宮筋層浸潤の評価に、胸部X線・頭部MRI・CTは絨毛癌の転移評価に用いられ、転移巣は高血管性で出血しやすいと述べる。
pmid-22085657.summary_en: This review describes multimodality imaging of gestational trophoblastic disease, spanning hydatidiform moles and persistent trophoblastic neoplasia. Ultrasound is the initial test of choice, showing a cluster-of-grapes appearance in complete moles and a hypervascular myometrial mass in persistent disease. Pelvic MRI helps assess myometrial invasion in equivocal cases. Chest radiography, brain MRI and CT evaluate metastases, which usually arise in choriocarcinoma and are hypervascular and prone to bleeding. The authors stress the role of imaging in staging and management.

pmid-22089368.summary_ja: 2000〜2010年に単施設で治療された小児卵巣腫瘍60例を解析した。大半は良性で、悪性例は卵黄嚢腫瘍やディスジャーミノーマを含み、術後化学療法で予後は良好であった。肺転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例は再発後に死亡した。年長児の良性例には卵巣温存手術を第一選択として推奨している。
pmid-22089368.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 60 children treated for ovarian tumors between 2000 and 2010. Most lesions were benign. Malignant cases, including yolk sac tumors and a dysgerminoma, received postoperative chemotherapy and had good prognoses; one yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis died after recurrence. Neonatal cystic lesions were managed with aspiration or umbilical-crease salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors recommend ovary-sparing resection through a modified Rocky Davis incision as first-line treatment for older children with non-malignant preoperative diagnoses.

pmid-22105889.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫(皮様嚢腫)の壁内に存在した下垂体腺腫が、極めて高度な高プロラクチン血症の原因となった症例を報告した。皮様嚢腫内の下垂体組織による同様の報告はこれまでにない。卵巣腫瘍による異所性プロラクチン産生を文献的に概説し、血清値が高く脳画像に異常がない場合は異所性産生を考慮すべきとしている。根治には機能組織の外科的切除が必要である。
pmid-22105889.summary_en: A patient had extreme hyperprolactinemia caused by a pituitary adenoma located in the wall of an ovarian dermoid cyst, a mature teratoma. Such marked prolactin elevation from pituitary tissue within a dermoid had not been reported before. The authors review ectopic prolactin production in ovarian tumors and emphasize that ectopic prolactin should be considered when serum levels are elevated but brain imaging is normal. Definitive treatment requires surgical removal of the functioning tissue.

pmid-22114766.summary_ja: 亜麻の根と葉の抽出物が、絨毛癌細胞株Jeg 3およびBeWoのプロゲステロン・エストラジオール産生と、エストロゲン受容体・プロゲステロン受容体の発現に与える影響を検討した。両抽出物はERβ発現を低下させ、プロゲステロン産生も細胞株により抑制された。ホルモン産生を修飾しうる可能性が示され、動物実験や後方視的疫学研究などの追加研究が必要とされている。
pmid-22114766.summary_en: This study examined how crude extracts from flax (Linum usitatissimum) roots and leaves affect progesterone and estradiol production and estrogen and progesterone receptor expression in two choriocarcinoma cell lines, Jeg 3 and BeWo. Root and leaf extracts downregulated progesterone production in a cell-dependent manner, and both extracts reduced ERβ expression in both lines. Leaf extract increased ERα in BeWo cells. The authors conclude that flax extracts can modify progesterone and possibly estradiol production and alter ERβ expression, and call for animal and epidemiological studies.

pmid-22127018.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における社会経済的地位（SEP）の影響を、発症リスクから生存者ケアまでの段階ごとに総説した。高SEPで発症リスクが高い一方、低SEPでは進行病期での診断や生存率の低下が報告されている。格差是正に向けた研究の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-22127018.summary_en: This narrative review of 63 English-language papers examines how socioeconomic position (SEP) relates to testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) across risk, diagnosis, treatment, survival, and survivorship. Higher SEP was linked to increased incidence in most studies, while lower SEP was associated with later-stage diagnosis and poorer survival. Lower education was associated with less radiation therapy use in stage I seminoma. The authors call for more research on disparities.

pmid-22127348.summary_ja: 進行した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の23歳女性にBEP化学療法を行った症例である。初回投与後に腫瘍崩壊症候群を来たし、血液透析を要した。完全寛解に至ったが、ブレオマイシンによるとみられるグレード4の肺線維症を併発した。腫瘍崩壊後のブレオマイシン毒性に注意を促している。
pmid-22127348.summary_en: The authors describe a 23-year-old woman with stage IIIc pure ovarian yolk sac tumor who received BEP chemotherapy after salpingo-oophorectomy. Tumor lysis syndrome developed after the first infusion and required hemodiafiltration and hemodialysis. She achieved complete remission after three additional cycles but developed grade 4 pulmonary fibrosis, attributed to bleomycin. The report highlights bleomycin toxicity after tumor lysis in rapidly progressing disease.

pmid-22131554.summary_ja: 自動車工場労働者を対象とした症例対照研究で、金属加工液（MWF）への曝露と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した。全体およびセミノーマのリスク上昇は認められなかった。一方、油性MWFへの長期皮膚曝露は非セミノーマ性腫瘍のリスク上昇と関連し、工学的対策と保護具の使用が推奨されている。
pmid-22131554.summary_en: This case-control study of automobile workers examined whether metal-working fluid (MWF) exposure explains an elevated testicular cancer risk linked to metal-cutting tasks. Overall germ cell tumor and seminoma risks were not increased. However, long-term dermal exposure to oil-based MWF was associated with increased risk of non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, with particularly high odds for exposure exceeding 5000 hours. The authors recommend engineering controls and personal protective equipment.

pmid-22137539.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学により、正常、胎児、腫瘍の精巣組織においてパルボウイルスB19のカプシドタンパク質VP1およびVP2が検出された。正常精巣では約86%、腫瘍組織では約74%で陽性であった。正常精巣DNAからもB19 DNAが検出された。B19が精巣腫瘍を含む組織に持続しており、がんなどへの関与が示唆されると結論づけられた。
pmid-22137539.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to detect parvovirus B19 capsid proteins VP1 and VP2 in normal, fetal, and tumor testicular tissues, and PCR was used to detect B19 DNA in normal testicular tissue. VP1/VP2 were found in 85.7% of normal adult samples and 73.9% of tumor samples. B19 DNA was detected in normal testicular DNA. The authors conclude that B19 persists in testicular tissues, including tumors, and may play a role in chronic disease and cancer. Further molecular mechanism studies are needed.

pmid-22138413.summary_ja: セミノーマ様細胞株TCam-2を用いて、エストロゲンによる増殖促進機構を検討した。エストラジオールはGPER-cAMP/PKA経路を活性化してERα36の発現を誘導し、EGFRの発現と細胞増殖を促進した。ERα36は将来の予後マーカーとなる可能性があり、in vivoでの検証が必要とされた。
pmid-22138413.summary_en: This study examined how estrogens affect proliferation of the seminoma-like TCam-2 cell line, which lacks ERα. Estradiol and testosterone both stimulated proliferation. Estradiol activated the GPER-cAMP/PKA pathway, inducing ERα36 expression. ERα36 knockdown reduced EGFR expression and cell proliferation, and ERα36 colocalized with cytoskeletal microfilaments, suggesting a role in motility. The authors propose ERα36 as a potential future prognostic marker for seminoma that should be tested in vivo.

pmid-22142638.summary_ja: 乳癌の病期分類のための画像検査中に偶然発見された胃腫瘍の症例である。胃の外科的切除標本では、表層の腺癌と深部粘膜下層の未熟奇形腫の2成分からなる衝突腫瘍であった。リンパ節転移を認めたが、術後18か月無病で経過している。胃原発の性腺外未熟奇形腫と腺癌が併存する稀な症例として報告された。
pmid-22142638.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman had an asymptomatic gastric tumor found during staging for breast carcinoma. Endoscopic biopsy showed poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. Gastrectomy revealed two components: a superficial lymphoepithelioma-like adenocarcinoma and a deeper submucosal immature teratoma. Lymph node metastasis was present. The patient was disease-free 18 months after surgery. The report describes an unusual collision tumor combining adenocarcinoma with an extragonadal immature teratoma of the stomach.

pmid-22146529.summary_ja: 生後2か月の日本人女児に発生した右後腹膜の未熟奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍の約15%が腎芽腫様成分で、未熟奇形腫の成分内に存在していました。奇形腫は器官様配列の有無により奇形様Wilms腫瘍と鑑別されると述べています。予後は確立しておらず、症例の蓄積が必要だと結論づけています。
pmid-22146529.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old girl with a right retroperitoneal immature teratoma containing nephroblastic components, which made up roughly 15% of the tumor. Such combinations are exceptionally rare. The authors emphasize that organoid arrangement distinguishes teratoma from teratoid Wilms tumor, which shows heterologous elements in over half the tumor. Because the prognosis of retroperitoneal teratomas with nephroblastic components is not established, the authors call for more case studies to guide clinical management.

pmid-22162396.summary_ja: 幹細胞特異的RNA結合タンパク質L1TD1が、ヒト胚性幹細胞の自己複製に必要であることを示しています。L1TD1を欠失させるとOCT4とNANOGが速やかに減少しました。L1TD1はセミノーマで高発現しており、その欠失はセミノーマ細胞の自己複製と増殖を阻害しました。L1TD1はRNAを介してLIN28と、またRNAヘリカーゼAと相互作用し、OCT4量を調節する複合体の一部と考えられています。
pmid-22162396.summary_en: This study identifies L1TD1, a stem cell-specific RNA-binding protein, as required for human embryonic stem cell self-renewal. L1TD1 depletion rapidly reduces OCT4 and NANOG, and OCT4, SOX2 and NANOG bind its promoter. L1TD1 is highly expressed in seminomas, and its depletion impairs self-renewal and proliferation of seminoma cells. The authors show that L1TD1 interacts with LIN28 via RNA and with RNA helicase A, proposing a complex that regulates OCT4 levels.

pmid-22167448.summary_ja: 2005～2010年に某施設で病理診断された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)50例を後方視的に解析した。左右の卵巣にほぼ同数認められ、両側例は5例であった。平均年齢は35.4歳で、腫瘍マーカー上昇が2例、捻転が1例で見られた。悪性転化率は低いと結論づけている。
pmid-22167448.summary_en: This retrospective review of 50 pathology-confirmed mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) at one Turkish centre from 2005 to 2010 describes their anatomical and clinical features. Tumours were distributed almost equally between the right and left ovaries, with 5 bilateral cases. Mean age was 35.4 years, with a range of 14 to 58. Tumour markers were elevated in two patients, one presented with torsion, and one was found incidentally during delivery. The authors conclude that these benign tumours have a low malignant transformation rate.

pmid-22167657.summary_ja: 32歳女性で骨盤内類皮嚢腫に伴う多中心性キャッスルマン病が報告された。両者の併発は初報である。類皮嚢腫に浸潤したCD68陽性マクロファージがIL-6を産生していることが免疫組織化学で示された。嚢腫摘出で症状と血清IL-6は部分的に改善し、抗IL-6受容体抗体投与後に完全に改善した。
pmid-22167657.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with multicentric Castleman disease (MCD) associated with a pelvic dermoid cyst, a combination not previously reported. Immunohistochemistry showed IL-6 produced by CD68-positive macrophages infiltrating the dermoid cyst. Cyst resection partially improved systemic symptoms and lowered serum IL-6. Complete improvement followed anti-IL-6 receptor antibody treatment after resection. The authors propose the dermoid cyst as a source of IL-6 contributing to MCD.

pmid-22168173.summary_ja: 子宮の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と考えられた5例に、妊孕性温存術式である改良Strassman法を施行した。1例は寛解を維持し妊孕性を保持した。残り4例は切除不完全のため完全子宮摘出術を要し、うち2例の子宮では残存病変は認められなかった。十分な説明の上で実施すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22168173.summary_en: This report describes five women with presumed solitary uterine placental site trophoblastic tumours (PSTT) treated with a modified Strassman procedure, a fertility-sparing alternative to radical hysterectomy. One patient remained in remission with intact fertility. Four required completion hysterectomy because of incomplete excision, and no residual disease was found in two of those uteri. The authors advise offering this only after extensive counselling and plan to study intraoperative frozen section with cold-knife dissection.

pmid-22173179.summary_ja: 巨大な後腹膜growing teratoma syndromeに対し、血管合併切除を伴う根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した12例を後方視的に検討した。完全切除率は100%で、手術死亡はなかった。追跡期間中央値59か月で10例が無病生存し、1例は転移性悪性黒色腫で死亡、1例は傍大動脈領域に再発した。血管外科手術の併用は正当化されると結論づけている。
pmid-22173179.summary_en: This retrospective series of 12 patients treated with radical RPLND for bulky growing teratoma syndrome (retroperitoneal mass 10 cm or more) evaluated aggressive vascular resection. Procedures included aortic resection and grafting, inferior vena cava resection, and left nephrectomy. All resections were complete, with no operative deaths and acceptable morbidity. With median follow-up of 59 months, 10 patients were disease-free, one died of melanoma, and one had a para-aortic recurrence. The authors consider combined vascular surgery with RPLND justified.

pmid-22175254.summary_ja: SWENOTECA IVの集団ベース研究で、転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がん882例中55例(6.2%)が大量化学療法を受けた。適応は腫瘍マーカー低下不良、手術時の生存腫瘍、選択的再発であった。中央値7.5年の追跡で、全生存率は適応別に72%、100%、58%であった。治療中に3例が死亡し、最も多いグレード4の非血液毒性は腎毒性であった。
pmid-22175254.summary_en: This SWENOTECA population-based study reports 55 men with metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer (6.2% of 882 patients) treated with high-dose chemotherapy. Indications were poor tumour marker response, residual vital cancer at surgery, or selected relapses. Median follow-up was 7.5 years. Overall survival was 72%, 100%, and 58% by indication, and failure-free survival was 64%, 71%, and 42%. Three patients died during treatment, and nephrotoxicity was the most common grade 4 non-haematological toxicity.

pmid-22176344.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の16歳女児に発生した両側ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。骨盤内腫瘤で受診し、病期IBと診断された。補助化学療法としてBEP療法を3コース施行。純粋型性腺異形成症では家族内の核型検査が性腺悪性腫瘍の予防に重要と強調している。
pmid-22176344.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with Swyer syndrome and primary amenorrhea was diagnosed with bilateral dysgerminoma at laparotomy, four years after she presented with a pelvic mass. The tumor was stage IB without capsular invasion. She received adjuvant BEP chemotherapy with three cycles. The authors emphasize that karyotype screening of family members in pure gonadal dysgenesis can help prevent gonadal malignancy.

pmid-22177144.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍男性119例を後方視的に解析し、診断用放射線被ばく量を推定した研究。セミノーマと非セミノーマで差はなかった。5年以上のフォローアップを受けた患者の78%が年間20mSvの基準を超え、生涯の致死的がんリスクは約2.1%と推定された。画像検査の慎重な運用を提言している。
pmid-22177144.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 119 men with testicular germ cell tumors estimated cumulative diagnostic radiation exposure. Lifetime and annual doses did not differ between seminoma and nonseminoma groups. Of patients with more than 5 years of follow-up, 78% exceeded the annual 20 mSv guideline. The estimated lifetime excess risk of fatal cancer was 2.1%. The authors recommend judicious use of imaging in this population.

pmid-22177913.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた91例を解析。術中合併症は4.3%、平均在院日数は2.1日であった。pN0・pN1症例では後腹膜再発を認めなかった。安全で有効、腫瘍学的にも妥当なアプローチと結論づけている。
pmid-22177913.summary_en: This review of 91 patients undergoing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors reports favorable perioperative outcomes, with a 4.3% intraoperative complication rate and a mean hospital stay of 2.1 days. No patient with pN0 or pN1 disease developed retroperitoneal recurrence. Among pN0 patients, five had systemic relapse. The authors conclude that the approach is safe, effective, and oncologically sound.

pmid-22180527.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し病期分類目的の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた85例を解析。31.8%の患者で転移を認めた。転移陽性リンパ節は平均1.05cm、陰性は0.55cmであった。1cmをカットオフとすると転移の60%を見逃すため、0.7～0.8cmへの引き下げを提案している。
pmid-22180527.summary_en: Analysis of 85 patients who underwent staging laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Metastases were found in 31.8% of patients. Metastatic nodes averaged 1.05 cm versus 0.55 cm for benign nodes. A 1 cm cutoff would miss 60% of metastatic nodes, so the authors suggest lowering the threshold to 0.7–0.8 cm, which yields 70% sensitivity and specificity.

pmid-22180529.summary_ja: 28歳男性の右肺全体を占めた肺原発悪性奇形腫の剖検例と文献的考察。腫瘍は軟骨肉腫様、骨肉腫様、脂肪肉腫様などの悪性間葉系成分と、悪性上皮成分が混在していた。極めて稀な疾患であり、文献をレビューしている。
pmid-22180529.summary_en: A case report of a 28-year-old man with a primary malignant teratoma involving the entire right lung, diagnosed at autopsy. The tumor combined malignant mesenchymal components resembling chondrosarcoma, osteosarcoma, liposarcoma and pleomorphic sarcoma with malignant epithelial elements. The authors review the literature on this rare entity.

pmid-22181336.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の高分化甲状腺癌4例の報告と文献53例のレビュー。全例が中央値9年のフォローアップで無病生存であった。卵巣内限局例の25年累積再発率は7.5%と低値であった。卵巣外進展や遠隔転移がなければ、広範な骨盤内手術は必要ない可能性を示している。
pmid-22181336.summary_en: This report of four patients with well-differentiated thyroid cancer arising in struma ovarii, together with a review of 53 literature cases, found all four alive without disease at a median follow-up of 9 years. The pooled 25-year cumulative recurrence rate for ovary-confined disease was 7.5%. The authors suggest that extensive pelvic surgery and prophylactic total thyroidectomy may be reserved for extra-ovarian spread or distant metastasis.

pmid-22194441.summary_ja: 426例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例と614例の対照を用いた関連解析で、KITLGの2つの変異（rs995030、rs4471514）を検討した。いずれもTGCTのリスク増加と関連し、リスクアレルのホモ接合体では約7倍のリスクであった。関連は特にセミノーマで強かった。これらのマーカーは精子産生とは関連せず、KITLGは精子形成機能とは独立してTGCTの発生に影響することが示唆された。
pmid-22194441.summary_en: This association study of 426 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 614 controls examined KITLG variants rs995030 and rs4471514. Both variants were associated with increased TGCT risk, with homozygous risk-allele carriers showing about sevenfold higher risk, and the association was strongest for seminoma. The markers were not related to sperm production, suggesting that KITLG influences TGCT risk independently of spermatogenic function.

pmid-22198244.summary_ja: 低増殖性で化学療法抵抗性を示す絨毛癌または持続性胞状奇胎に対する治療戦略を追跡した。低い過糖鎖修飾ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG、40%未満)またはhCG倍加時間が2週間を超えることで対象を同定し、hCGが3000mIU/mlを超えるまで化学療法を延期した。新規19例中16例が治療に成功し、既報を合わせると計24例で有効性が示された。
pmid-22198244.summary_en: This study extends a treatment strategy for minimally aggressive gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, in which choriocarcinoma or persistent hydatidiform mole is slow-growing and chemorefractory. Patients were identified by low hyperglycosylated hCG (below 40%) or an hCG doubling time over two weeks, and chemotherapy was deferred until hCG exceeded 3000 mIU/ml. Of 19 newly identified patients, 16 were successfully treated, bringing the total to 24 women successfully treated with this protocol.

pmid-22202548.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がんで化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた532例のうち、130例(24%)は後腹膜外の残存腫瘤も切除されました。その約3分の1で奇形腫または活性のある非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が確認され、後腹膜外の組織学的所見は独立した進行予測因子でした。5年無増悪生存率は74%でした。
pmid-22202548.summary_en: This institutional review of 532 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection assessed the 130 patients (24%) who also had resection of extraretroperitoneal residual masses. Teratoma or viable NSGCT was found in about one-third of these resected extraretroperitoneal lesions. Histology at the extraretroperitoneal site independently predicted progression, with 5-year freedom from progression of 74%. Concordance with retroperitoneal histology was low for teratoma and viable tumor, so extraretroperitoneal residual disease should be assessed separately.

pmid-22211141.summary_ja: 85歳女性の子宮体部腫瘍で、類内膜腺癌と絨毛癌成分、腹膜播種を伴う漿液性乳頭状腺癌が併存していた症例報告です。手術と保存的治療後20週で、ダグラス窩に再発が出現しました。再発腫瘍は原発巣と異なる低分化癌で、腫瘍細胞の多方向分化と高悪性度転化を示しています。
pmid-22211141.summary_en: This case report describes an 85-year-old woman with a mixed uterine carcinoma. The tumor combined endometrioid adenocarcinoma with squamous differentiation, choriocarcinoma, and a disseminated papillary serous peritoneal nodule. After surgery and conservative treatment, a recurrence in the Douglas pouch appeared 20 weeks later, showing poorly differentiated carcinoma unlike the primary. The case shows high-grade transformation and divergent differentiation of tumor cells.

pmid-22213325.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発腫瘍と細胞株でビタミンD受容体(VDR)のmRNAとタンパク質発現を初めて示した研究です。ビタミンDはGADD45の発現増加を介して細胞株の増殖を抑制する可能性があります。ビタミンD受容体シグナルが発症や抗腫瘍療法に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-22213325.summary_en: This study shows that primary testicular germ cell tumors and TGCT cell lines express the vitamin D receptor (VDR) at mRNA and protein levels. Vitamin D inhibited proliferation of TGCT cell lines, possibly via increased GADD45 expression. Expression of several other vitamin D-regulated genes was also examined as potential contributors to pathogenesis. The findings suggest vitamin D signaling may play a role in TGCT biology and could be explored as part of antitumor therapy.

pmid-22225777.summary_ja: Aicardi症候群の4歳女児に、口腔原発の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍が生じた症例を報告する。非常に稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。臨床経過と診断の過程を示し、組織発生の推定と口腔内腫瘤の鑑別診断を考察する。口腔原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告は極めて少ない。
pmid-22225777.summary_en: A 4-year-old girl with Aicardi syndrome presented with a primary oral extragonadal yolk sac tumor, a rare germ cell tumor. The authors describe the clinical presentation and diagnostic workup, discuss the putative histogenesis, and review the differential diagnosis for oral masses in this setting. This is among the first reports of a primary oral yolk sac tumor.

pmid-22227541.summary_ja: 1990年から1998年の間に治療を受けた病期Iの精巣セミノーマ137例を対象とした後方視的研究である。96例は傍大動脈および骨盤リンパ節への予防的放射線療法を受け、41例は経過観察のみであった。5年時の無病生存率は、経過観察群で73.5%、放射線療法群で91%であった（p=0.004）。疾患特異的生存率は両群で類似していた。観察群の再発は主に後腹膜であり、BEP化学療法で治療された。著者らは、予防的放射線療法の方が良好な転帰をもたらしたと結論づけている。
pmid-22227541.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 137 patients with Stage I testicular seminoma treated between 1990 and 1998. Ninety-six patients received prophylactic radiotherapy to para-aortic and pelvic nodes, while 41 were managed by observation. Five-year disease-free survival was 73.5% in the observation group versus 91% in the radiotherapy group (p=0.004), with similar disease-specific survival. Observation-group relapses were mainly retroperitoneal and were treated with BEP chemotherapy. The authors conclude that prophylactic radiation gave better outcomes.

pmid-22228386.summary_ja: 生後5か月の女児に生じた膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告です。膣出血を主訴に受診し、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で膣の大部分を占める分葉状腫瘤が認められ、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇していました。生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、化学療法6サイクルのみで治療し、フォローアップ中も無病です。生殖機能温存の観点から、化学療法単独を考慮すべきと提案しています。
pmid-22228386.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-month-old female infant with a primary vaginal yolk sac tumor presenting with vaginal bleeding. MRI revealed a lobulated mass occupying most of the vagina, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated. Biopsy confirmed yolk sac tumor. The infant received six cycles of chemotherapy as the sole modality and remained disease-free on follow-up. The authors suggest that chemotherapy alone may be considered to preserve sexual and reproductive function in such a rare tumor.

pmid-22228428.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌に対する精製ビテキシン化合物1(VB1)の抗腫瘍効果を検討した前臨床研究です。JEG-3細胞を用いたマウス移植モデルで腫瘍増殖が有意に抑制され、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)も低下しました。in vitroでは細胞増殖を抑え、アポトーシスを誘導し、mTORシグナル伝達を阻害しました。治療候補としての可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-22228428.summary_en: This preclinical study evaluated purified vitexin compound 1 (VB1), a lignan from Vitex negundo, against human choriocarcinoma. In severe combined immunodeficient mice bearing choriocarcinoma xenografts, VB1 significantly inhibited tumor growth and reduced serum beta-hCG levels. In JEG-3 cells, it suppressed proliferation, induced apoptosis, and inhibited the mTOR signaling pathway. The authors conclude that VB1 inhibits choriocarcinoma through apoptosis induction and mTOR pathway suppression, suggesting therapeutic potential.

pmid-22229956.summary_ja: 出生前に巨大な腹部腫瘤と羊水過多として見つかった、先天性未熟胃奇形腫の症例報告です。当初は胎便性腹膜炎が疑われました。妊娠36週で帝王切開が行われ、新生児は腹部腫瘤による重症呼吸窮迫を呈しましたが、緊急手術で腫瘍を摘出し良好に回復しました。胎児腹部腫瘤の出生前鑑別では奇形腫も考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-22229956.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital immature gastric teratoma detected prenatally as a large fetal abdominal mass with polyhydramnios, initially suspected to be meconium peritonitis. After cesarean section at 36 weeks, the neonate developed severe respiratory distress due to the abdominal mass. Emergency surgery successfully removed the tumor, and the infant recovered well without other anomalies. The case highlights the importance of including teratoma in the prenatal differential diagnosis of fetal abdominal masses.

pmid-22230011.summary_ja: 閉経前女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた、消化管型粘液性境界悪性様腫瘍の症例報告です。腫瘍と奇形腫内の消化管上皮との組織学的移行像から、起源は奇形腫の消化管上皮と考えられました。免疫組織化学でサイトケラチン20やMUC5ACなどの発現が確認され、悪性転化が示唆されています。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫からの腺癌はとりわけまれです。
pmid-22230011.summary_en: This report describes a premenopausal woman with a mucinous borderline-like tumor arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Histological transition between the tumor and gastrointestinal elements of the teratoma suggested origin from teratomatous gastrointestinal epithelium. Immunohistochemistry showed diffuse cytokeratin 20 and partial cytokeratin 7 positivity, with partial MUC5AC and focal MUC2 and MUC6 expression. The authors interpret these findings as consistent with malignant transformation of the teratomatous gastrointestinal epithelium. Adenocarcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma is especially rare.

pmid-22233950.summary_ja: 61歳男性の膵鉤状突起に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告と文献レビューです。画像検査で偶発的に発見されました。膵嚢胞性病変の中でも極めてまれで、術前の病理組織学的診断は困難とされています。膵嚢胞性病変の評価では成熟嚢胞性奇形腫も鑑別に含めることが重要と述べています。
pmid-22233950.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes a 61-year-old man with a mature cystic teratoma of the pancreatic uncinate process, discovered incidentally on diagnostic imaging. The authors note that mature cystic teratomas are extremely rare among pancreatic cystic lesions and that preoperative histological diagnosis is difficult because of inadequate biopsy material. The case underscores the need for greater awareness of mature cystic teratoma when evaluating pancreatic cystic masses, so that this entity is considered in the differential diagnosis.

pmid-22243760.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマにおいて、遺伝子発現解析が潜在性転移を予測できるかを検討した。94の候補遺伝子をリアルタイムPCRで評価し、転移例12例と非転移例40例を比較した。DRD1とFAM71F2の組み合わせは一致率87.7%で、腫瘍径（61%）を上回った。早期補助療法と監視強化の判断への応用が示唆されている。
pmid-22243760.summary_en: This study evaluated whether gene expression profiling of primary testicular seminoma can predict occult metastasis better than standard clinical and pathological parameters. Using 94 candidate genes, the authors compared 12 metastatic tumors, 40 non-metastatic stage I tumors, and normal testis tissue. Expression of DRD1 and FAM71F2 discriminated metastatic status, with combined concordance of 87.7%, exceeding tumor size (61%). The authors suggest these markers could guide decisions between early adjuvant therapy and increased surveillance.

pmid-22244391.summary_ja: 巨大頸部腫瘤の胎児における出生時の気道閉塞を予測するため、新規指標である気管食道変位指数（TEDI）を検討した。24例中10例は奇形腫であった。羊水過多、奇形腫の診断、TEDI 12超が気道合併と関連し、TEDIのAUCは0.80であった。これらの所見がない胎児は、EXIT手技を要しない可能性がある。
pmid-22244391.summary_en: This study introduces the tracheoesophageal displacement index (TEDI) to predict airway complications in fetuses with giant neck masses. Of 24 fetuses, 10 had teratomas. Polyhydramnios, teratoma diagnosis, and TEDI above 12 were associated with a complicated airway at birth, with TEDI showing an AUC of 0.80. Fetuses without these findings had uncomplicated airways and might be delivered safely without an ex utero intrapartum treatment approach. The findings aid selection for such procedures.

pmid-22244665.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の現在の管理をまとめたレビューである。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌は化学療法への感受性が高く、治癒率は90%を超え、妊孕性温存も可能である。一方、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍は化学療法抵抗性が比較的高く、外科的切除が主な治療となり、化学療法は転移性疾患に限られる。
pmid-22244665.summary_en: This review covers current management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, which includes invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental-site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Invasive mole and choriocarcinoma respond highly to chemotherapy, with cure rates above 90% and preservation of fertility. PSTT and ETT are relatively chemoresistant, so surgery is the primary treatment, with chemotherapy reserved for metastatic disease. The article summarizes treatment strategies for each subtype.

pmid-22245602.summary_ja: 367例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者と214例の対照で、ESR1、ESR2、LHCGRの多型を解析した。ESR2とLHCGRの多型は発症リスクと関連した。ESR1の多型はセミノーマ、LHCGRの別の多型は転移と関連した。これらのホルモン受容体多型は、リスク、組織学的亜型、転移リスクに寄与すると結論づけられている。
pmid-22245602.summary_en: This study genotyped 367 testicular germ cell tumor patients and 214 controls to identify polymorphisms in ESR1, ESR2, and LHCGR. ESR2 and LHCGR variants were associated with overall risk. An ESR1 variant was linked to seminoma, and an LHCGR variant to metastasis. Some variants also predicted hormone levels in healthy men. The authors conclude these hormone-receptor polymorphisms contribute to risk, histological subtype, and metastatic potential.

pmid-22248255.summary_ja: 12歳女児の卵巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告である。横紋筋肉腫成分を伴い、胚細胞腫瘍と横紋筋肉腫の両方に対する化学療法で治療された。治療終盤に出現した後腹膜腫瘤は、血清マーカーが正常であったが、完全切除により成熟奇形腫と判明した。治療後約3年の時点で完全寛解を維持している。
pmid-22248255.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-year-old girl with an ovarian mixed germ cell tumor containing a rhabdomyosarcomatous component. She received germ cell tumor and rhabdomyosarcoma-directed chemotherapy. Near the end of treatment, a growing retroperitoneal mass emerged despite normal serum markers; complete resection revealed a mature teratoma consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. She remained in complete remission about three years after presentation. The authors recommend combined chemotherapy for sarcomatous components and surgical management of growing masses even with normal markers.

pmid-22248970.summary_ja: 胎児期から思春期にかけて、頸部から仙尾部までの非性腺部位に生じる小児胚細胞腫瘍の管理をまとめたレビューである。外科的切除が中心で、正確な外科的病期分類がリスクに基づく治療選択に不可欠である。成熟奇形腫・未熟奇形腫や完全切除可能な一部の悪性腫瘍は手術単独で治療される。切除不能・転移性疾患には現代の化学療法が高い生存率をもたらし、術前化学療法は臓器温存を可能にする。
pmid-22248970.summary_en: This review describes the management of pediatric germ cell tumors, which arise from in utero through adolescence at nongonadal sites from the neck to the sacrococcygeal region. Surgical resection is central, and accurate surgical staging determines risk-based therapy. Benign mature and immature teratomas, and selected completely resectable malignancies, are treated with surgery alone. Modern chemotherapy yields high survival in unresectable or metastatic disease, and neoadjuvant chemotherapy allows organ preservation.

pmid-22251944.summary_ja: 53歳男性の精巣腫瘍は印環細胞のみからなり、転移性癌との鑑別が問題となった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清で奇形腫および卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の転移が確認された。全成分でi(12p)が認められ、共通の胚細胞起源が示唆された。精巣の印環細胞癌が胚細胞腫瘍由来となりうることを示した初の報告である。
pmid-22251944.summary_en: A 53-year-old man presented with a testicular tumor composed entirely of signet ring cells that mimicked metastatic carcinoma. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection showed metastatic teratoma and yolk sac tumor components alongside signet ring cell carcinoma. Fluorescence in situ hybridization showed i(12p) in all components, supporting a common germ cell origin. The authors conclude that testicular signet ring cell carcinoma can be a primary germ cell tumor rather than necessarily metastatic adenocarcinoma. This is the first such report.

pmid-22252431.summary_ja: 1979年から2003年にイングランドで登録された悪性およびCNSの胚細胞腫瘍33,364例を対象とした集団ベースの研究である。大部分は精巣腫瘍（92.5%）であり、卵巣（3.9%）と性腺外（3.2%）は少なかった。発生率のピークは部位により異なり、複数の部位でジャーミノーマおよび非ジャーミノーマの発生率が時間とともに増加していた。著者らは、全部位のGCTは胎生期・胎児期に共通の起源を持つが、部位特異的に進行すると考え、今後は全部位を対象とした遺伝学的研究を勧めている。
pmid-22252431.summary_en: This population-based study analyzed 33,364 malignant and selected CNS germ cell tumors registered in England from 1979 to 2003. Most cases were testicular (92.5%), with ovarian (3.9%) and extragonadal (3.2%) tumors less common. Incidence peaks varied by site, and germinomas and nongerminomas showed increasing incidence over time at several sites. The authors suggest that GCTs at all sites share an embryonic or fetal origin with site-specific progression, and recommend future genetic studies across all sites.

pmid-22252920.summary_ja: 頸部に転移した胚細胞腫瘍34例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の頸部手術の意義を評価した。37回の頸部手術のうち22回で転移陽性リンパ節が認められた。頸部に残存する生存腫瘍が疾患特異的生存を予測し、5年および10年生存率は82.3%であった。頸部再発や永続的神経障害は認めなかった。
pmid-22252920.summary_en: This retrospective review of 34 patients with germ cell tumor metastatic to the neck evaluates the role of head and neck surgery after chemotherapy. Most patients had a neck mass at diagnosis, and 22 of 37 neck procedures found positive nodes. Preoperative tumor markers did not correlate with neck pathology. No patients had neck recurrence or permanent nerve injury. Viable tumor in the neck predicted disease-specific survival, with 5- and 10-year survival of 82.3%.

pmid-22253721.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌11検体と絨毛癌細胞株3種（BeWo、JAR、JEG）を高解像度aCGHで解析した。原発性腫瘍は単純な染色体再編成または正常プロファイルを示し、細胞株は複雑な異常を示した。候補遺伝子を含む23の最小限重要領域を同定し、マイクロRNA(miRNA)クラスターと刷り込み遺伝子が多く見られた。
pmid-22253721.summary_en: Eleven gestational choriocarcinoma samples and three choriocarcinoma cell lines (BeWo, JAR, JEG) were analyzed by high-resolution array CGH. De novo tumors showed simple rearrangements or normal profiles, whereas cell lines had complex aberrations. Twenty-three minimal critical regions were identified, containing candidate genes, with unusually many microRNA clusters and imprinted genes. The study characterizes the genomic landscape of gestational choriocarcinoma and suggests candidate genes for further study.

pmid-22261704.summary_ja: 精巣、精巣転移および縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍52例で、充実型卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を検討した。多くは他の卵黄嚢腫瘍パターンを伴い、基底膜様沈着や核多形性が特徴であった。セミノーマとの鑑別にはAE1/AE3、グリピカン3、OCT3/4の免疫染色が有用とされた。α-フェトプロテインは陰性例が多かった。
pmid-22261704.summary_en: This study reviewed 52 germ cell tumors with solid-pattern yolk sac tumor components, including testicular, testicular metastatic, and mediastinal sites. Solid yolk sac tumor was usually associated with other yolk sac patterns and showed basement membrane deposits, nuclear pleomorphism, and hyaline globules, with few lymphocytes. AE1/AE3, glypican 3, and OCT3/4 provided a useful panel to distinguish it from seminoma. Alpha-fetoprotein was often negative, and CD117 was frequently positive, so neither can reliably distinguish it from seminoma.

pmid-22269740.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔腫瘍が自然破裂し、両側性大量血胸と出血性ショックを呈した症例。緊急開胸止血術で破裂した縦隔腫瘍が確認された。病理学的に絨毛癌と未熟奇形腫の混合型で、肺転移を伴う絨毛癌成分を認めた。救援化学療法を受けた後、診断から2年時点で寛解を維持している。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍のまれで致死的になりうる提示例である。
pmid-22269740.summary_en: A patient presented with bilateral massive hemothorax and hemorrhagic shock due to spontaneous rupture of a primary mediastinal tumor. Urgent thoracotomy controlled bleeding and revealed a ruptured mediastinal mass. Pathology showed a mixed choriocarcinoma and immature teratoma with lung metastases of choriocarcinoma. The patient received salvage chemotherapy and remained in remission two years after diagnosis. The report highlights a rare, life-threatening presentation of mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-22270429.summary_ja: 25歳女性が、小腸と大腸の両方に穿通した10cmの類皮嚢腫による小腸閉塞で受診した。大腸の一次縫合、小腸切除、左卵管卵巣摘出術の一塊切除、小腸端々吻合が行われた。卵巣類皮嚢腫と腸管の間に生じたまれな瘻孔の症例であり、卵巣奇形腫の重篤な合併症として臨床・画像所見の認識が重要である。
pmid-22270429.summary_en: A 25-year-old woman presented with small bowel obstruction caused by a 10-cm dermoid cyst that had perforated into both the small and large bowel. She underwent primary large bowel repair, small bowel resection, and en bloc left salpingo-oophorectomy with small bowel reanastomosis. The case illustrates a rare fistula between an ovarian dermoid cyst and bowel, a serious complication of a common benign neoplasm. Clinical and radiologic features are important for recognition and prevention of further complications.

pmid-22270441.summary_ja: AFP高値を契機に出生前診断された胎児エピグナトゥス（口咽頭奇形腫）の症例報告。27週で切迫早産となり、気道確保のためEXIT手技で分娩した。病理学的には未熟奇形腫であった。出生前診断の重要性と、子宮切開法や胎児サイズが転帰に影響することを指摘している。
pmid-22270441.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old woman whose elevated alpha-fetoprotein prompted prenatal imaging, which revealed a fetal epignathus, an oropharyngeal teratoma, without intracranial extension. Because of preterm labor at 27 5/7 weeks, the team performed an EXIT procedure to secure the neonate's airway, requiring complete exteriorization given the small size and short cord. Pathology confirmed an immature teratoma. The authors emphasize prenatal diagnosis for counseling and note that uterine incision choice and fetal size critically influence outcome.

pmid-22273650.summary_ja: 1995～2010年にジッダの病理部に提出された卵巣検体618例を後方視的に解析した。腫瘍は382例で、良性が多かった。胚細胞腫瘍は28%を占め、20歳未満では表層上皮性腫瘍に次いで多かった。悪性腫瘍は高齢ほど増加し、最多の悪性は漿液性嚢胞腺癌であった。
pmid-22273650.summary_en: This retrospective pathology series reviewed 618 ovarian specimens submitted to King Abdulaziz University, Jeddah, between 1995 and 2010. Of these, 382 were neoplasms, mostly benign. Surface epithelial tumors predominated, followed by germ cell tumors (28%). Germ cell tumors were the second most common neoplasm under age 20, after surface epithelial tumors. Malignant tumors became more frequent with increasing age, and serous cystadenocarcinoma was the most common malignancy.

pmid-22279357.summary_ja: 2000年から2010年の間に性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた小児15例を対象とした後方視的レビューで、非典型的な所見に焦点を当てている。腫瘍は縦隔、後腹膜、仙尾部などに発生し、3例は出生前に診断された。5例は未熟な成分を含み、2例は悪性で、切除後に補助化学療法を受けた。追跡期間中央値4.5年で15例中14例が無イベント生存であり、1例は7.5年後に未熟な縦隔奇形腫の局所再発を生じた。
pmid-22279357.summary_en: This retrospective review of 15 children treated for extragonadal germ cell tumors between 2000 and 2010 highlights atypical presentations. Tumors arose in the mediastinum, retroperitoneum, sacrococcygeal region, and other sites, and three were diagnosed antenatally. Five contained immature elements and two were malignant; these received adjuvant chemotherapy after excision. With a median follow-up of 4.5 years, 14 of 15 remained event-free, and one immature mediastinal teratoma recurred locally at 7.5 years.

pmid-22279365.summary_ja: 7歳男児が左精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍、空腸転移、急性腸閉塞で受診した症例報告。高位鼠径精巣摘除と空腸腫瘤切除を行い、その後化学療法を実施した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍が転移により腹部症状で発症しうることを示している。手術と化学療法の併用が必要であった。
pmid-22279365.summary_en: A 7-year-old boy presented with a left testicular endodermal sinus tumor complicated by jejunal metastasis and acute intestinal obstruction. He underwent high inguinal orchidectomy and resection of the jejunal mass, followed by chemotherapy. The case report emphasizes that testicular germ cell tumors can present with abdominal symptoms due to metastatic spread, and that treatment required both surgery and systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-22285526.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性の妊孕性を総説した。胞状奇胎は通常良性で、排出後に化学療法を要することは少ない。持続性病変には化学療法を行うが、生児出産率は70%超と報告されている。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の妊孕性温存治療の成功率は約67%である。心理・性的問題への支援と多職種連携が重要とされる。
pmid-22285526.summary_en: This review addresses fertility in women with gestational trophoblastic disease. Hydatidiform mole is generally benign and often needs no chemotherapy after evacuation, and subsequent pregnancy outcomes approach population norms. Persistent disease requires single or combined chemotherapy, yet term live birth rates above 70% have been reported. Successful pregnancies also follow choriocarcinoma, and fertility-sparing treatment for placental-site trophoblastic tumour succeeds in about 67% of cases. Psychological support and multidisciplinary care are emphasized.

pmid-22288043.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、症候性の縦隔腫瘤を有する26歳のエホバの証人の女性を記述する。CTでは隣接構造への浸潤が疑われ切除不能と判断されたが、手術では被膜に包まれ完全に切除可能な成熟奇形腫であり、問題なく切除された。18か月の経過観察で再発はみられなかった。著者らは、原発性縦隔腫瘍では切除可能性は手術時に判断すべきであり、画像所見のみを理由に手術を見送るべきではないと主張している。
pmid-22288043.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old Jehovah's Witness woman with a symptomatic mediastinal mass that CT suggested was unresectable because of presumed invasion of adjacent structures. At surgery, the mass was an encapsulated, completely resectable mature teratoma, which was excised without difficulty. At 18 months follow-up she remained free of recurrence. The authors argue that resectability should be judged at operation and that surgery should not be withheld solely on imaging findings in primary mediastinal tumors.

pmid-22288964.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫86例を盲検下で検討し、甲状腺組織の19の組織学的特徴と臨床経過との関連を調べた研究です。線維化の欠如と巨大濾胞パターンは悪性例に多く、索状パターンは良性経過と関連していました。しかし多くの特徴は良性・悪性で差がなく、実用性は不確かです。組織所見から予後を予測することはできず、これらの腫瘍の挙動は予測困難だと結論づけられています。
pmid-22288964.summary_en: This blinded study of 86 struma ovarii cases (60 clinically benign and 26 clinically malignant, with long-term follow-up) evaluated 19 histologic features of thyroid tissue. Only lack of fibrosis, macrofollicular pattern (more common in malignant tumors), and trabecular pattern (linked to benign behavior) showed associations, and their practical value was judged uncertain. Most features were similar in benign and malignant tumors. The authors conclude that clinical outcome cannot be predicted from microscopic features.

pmid-22290426.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞株を用いた培養実験で、カルシウム/カルモジュリン依存性キナーゼ阻害薬KN-93の作用を検討しました。KN-93により細胞増殖が抑制され、S期の細胞が減少しG0/G1期の細胞が増加しました。アポトーシスも誘導され、増殖、悪性形質、アポトーシスに関連する遺伝子の発現も変化しています。著者らは、絨毛癌の治療薬としての可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-22290426.summary_en: This in vitro study examined the effects of KN-93, a calcium/calmodulin-dependent kinase inhibitor, on the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. KN-93 suppressed growth, shifted the cell cycle with fewer cells in S phase and more in G0/G1, and induced apoptosis, as shown by phosphatidylserine externalization, loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, and DNA fragmentation. Expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype, and apoptosis was altered. The authors suggest KN-93 may serve as a therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-22290909.summary_ja: 1983年から2010年に、白金系化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが高値であった原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21例に対し、残存腫瘍切除を行った後方視的研究です。術後に11例でマーカーが正常化し、5年生存率は36%でした。術後のマーカー上昇や不完全切除を示す残存生存腫瘍は予後不良と関連していました。完全切除が可能な場合には手術が妥当だと結論づけられています。
pmid-22290909.summary_en: This retrospective series of 21 patients with primary mediastinal NSGCT and elevated serum tumor markers after platinum-based chemotherapy underwent residual tumor excision between 1983 and 2010. After surgery, markers normalized in 11 patients, and 8 patients were alive at a median follow-up of 98 months, with 5-year survival of 36%. Postoperative marker elevation and residual viable tumor, indicating incomplete resection, were associated with worse survival. The authors conclude that surgery is warranted when complete resection is feasible.

pmid-22291076.summary_ja: 再発または難治性胚細胞腫瘍の211例を、VIP療法に続いてCE療法を行う群（A群）とCEC療法を行う群（B群）に無作為に割り付けた試験の長期成績です。大量化学療法に伴う治療関連死亡はB群で14%、A群で4%と多く、試験は早期に中止されました。5年無増悪生存率は両群で同程度（47%、45%）でした。全生存率はA群で高い傾向（49%、39%）にありましたが、有意差はありません。
pmid-22291076.summary_en: This randomized trial compared two high-dose chemotherapy regimens in 211 patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors: arm A (VIP plus three cycles of CE) and arm B (VIP plus one cycle of CEC with autologous stem-cell reinfusion). The study stopped early because treatment-related mortality was higher in arm B (14% vs 4%). Five-year PFS was similar (47% vs 45%), while OS trended higher in arm A (49% vs 39%, not significant). The authors conclude that patients achieved durable long-term survival with single or sequential high-dose chemotherapy.

pmid-22294087.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のBeWo細胞とJEG-3細胞を用いて、インターロイキン1β（IL-1β）による細胞死に対するプロゲステロンの影響を調べた培養実験です。IL-1βはJEG-3細胞でより強く細胞死を誘導しました。プロゲステロンはこれを抑制し、高濃度ではほぼ消失させました。その作用はMAPK阻害薬で打ち消されたことから、両者のクロストークにMAPK経路が関与すると考えられています。
pmid-22294087.summary_en: This in vitro study used two choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo and JEG-3, to examine how interleukin-1β affects cell death with and without progesterone. IL-1β induced more cell death in JEG-3 cells (about 40%) than in BeWo cells (about 15%). Progesterone significantly reduced this IL-1β-induced death in JEG-3 cells, abolishing it at 1000 nM, and induced ERK1/2 phosphorylation. A MAPK inhibitor (UO126) blocked progesterone's protective effect, suggesting cross-talk involving the MAPK pathway.

pmid-22305424.summary_ja: 原発性精巣腫瘍で治療を受けた小児87例（うち胚細胞腫瘍78例）を後方視的に解析しました。卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多く、多くの症例で血清AFPが上昇していました。病期I卵黄嚢腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の有無で生存率に有意差がなく、必要ない可能性が示されました。
pmid-22305424.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 87 children treated for primary testicular tumors, 78 of them germ cell tumors, found yolk sac tumor was most common (40 cases). Most patients had elevated AFP, and 50 underwent surveillance. Over a median follow-up of 50 months, six relapsed and four died. For stage I yolk sac tumor, RPLND did not significantly change survival, suggesting it may not be necessary.

pmid-22310344.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21歳男性が、化学療法と手術後に完全寛解に至りました。4か月後に骨痛と汎血球減少、腫瘍マーカーの上昇が生じ、骨髄穿刺で孤立性骨髄再発と確認されました。救援化学療法で腫瘍マーカーは低下しましたが、患者は敗血症で死亡しました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の孤立性骨髄再発の初報告です。
pmid-22310344.summary_en: The authors report a 21-year-old man with primary mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who achieved complete remission after chemotherapy and surgery. Four months later he developed bone pain and pancytopenia with rising tumor markers, and bone marrow aspiration confirmed isolated bone marrow relapse. Salvage chemotherapy lowered the markers, but he died of sepsis three weeks later. This is the first reported isolated bone marrow relapse of this tumor type.

pmid-22313835.summary_ja: 縦隔に生じる代表的な胚細胞腫瘍の一つであるセミノーマの発生頻度と特徴をまとめた総説です。胚細胞腫瘍は特定部位だけでなく広く分布して生じると考えられるようになりました。組織像が類似するため、病歴、身体所見、画像所見による慎重な評価が必要とされています。
pmid-22313835.summary_en: This review focuses on seminoma, one of the most common germ cell tumors arising in the mediastinum. It notes that germ cell tumors, once thought to arise only from specific anatomic sites, now appear in a ubiquitous distribution. Because histology is similar across sites, careful clinical history, physical examination, and radiologic evaluation are required. The authors state that a detailed review of all mediastinal germ cell tumors is beyond its scope.

pmid-22314417.summary_ja: 1973〜1979年にスウェーデンで生まれた男性35万人超を対象とした全国コホート研究です。極端な早産（22〜29週）は調整後に精巣がんリスクの上昇と関連しましたが、該当例はわずか5例でした。極端ではない早産や過期産、胎児発育との関連は認められませんでした。
pmid-22314417.summary_en: This Swedish national cohort of 354,860 men born in 1973–1979 examined gestational age at birth and testicular cancer risk over 11.2 million person-years. Extremely preterm birth (22–29 weeks) was associated with a nearly fourfold hazard after adjustment, though only five cases occurred in that group. Other preterm births, post-term birth, and fetal growth were not associated. The authors suggest extreme preterm birth may independently raise risk, pending confirmation.

pmid-22315593.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍の男性3例を報告。うち2例は同一性腺内の上皮内癌と性腺芽腫を根拠に後方視的に性分化疾患（DSD）と判明した。尿道下裂や停留精巣の既往もDSDに合致した。3例目は浸潤前の前駆病変で発見された。臨床的指標に基づく早期認識により転移性癌を防げた可能性があり、精巣発生不全症候群との重なりも示された。
pmid-22315593.summary_en: Three male patients with malignant germ cell tumors were described; two were retrospectively recognized as having disorders of sex development (DSD), based on carcinoma in situ and gonadoblastoma found in a single gonad. Hypospadias and cryptorchidism in their histories were consistent with DSD. The third patient's precursor lesion was detected before invasion. All had normal 46,XY karyotypes. The authors argue that early recognition using these clinical features could prevent metastatic cancer and identify individuals at increased risk, highlighting overlap with testicular dysgenesis syndrome.

pmid-22316366.summary_ja: 早期精巣がんの治療に伴う毒性と、その最小化戦略をまとめた総説。10年生存率は95%超だが、化学療法と放射線療法による二次性悪性腫瘍や心血管疾患が長期的問題となっている。病期I高リスク非セミノーマでは化学療法を1サイクルに減らす、病期Iセミノーマではカルボプラチンを放射線療法の代わりに用いる、といった方策が検討されている。
pmid-22316366.summary_en: The review examines toxicity in early-stage testicular cancer, a highly curable malignancy with 10-year survival above 95%. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy yields large survival gains but causes long-term second malignancies and cardiovascular disease, increasing surveillance uptake. Strategies to reduce treatment burden include one cycle of bleomycin, cisplatin and etoposide instead of two for stage I high-risk nonseminomas, and carboplatin instead of radiotherapy for stage I seminomas. The article details toxicities of diagnosis and treatment and approaches to minimize them while preserving cure rates.

pmid-22321834.summary_ja: フタル酸エステル代謝物MEHPは、精巣胎児性癌細胞NT2/D1においてMMP2の発現と活性化を誘導し、浸潤と遊走を促進した。MMP2阻害剤SB-3CTはこの作用を抑制し、MMP2の関与が示された。マイクロアレイ解析では細胞接着と転写に関わる遺伝子が主に変化した。フタル酸曝露が精巣がんの進行に影響しうることを示唆する。
pmid-22321834.summary_en: In testicular embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells, mono-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate (MEHP), a plasticizer metabolite, induced MMP2 expression and enhanced invasion and migration. The MMP2-specific inhibitor SB-3CT blocked these effects, showing MMP2 mediates progression. Microarray analysis revealed MEHP mainly altered genes involved in cell adhesion and transcription, with decreased gap junction protein-alpha 1, vinculin and ID1, and increased claudin-6 and beta 1-catenin. The findings suggest phthalate exposure may modulate testicular cancer progression.

pmid-22322942.summary_ja: ダウン症候群の28歳日本人男性で、再生不良性貧血に対する骨髄移植の予定中に前縦隔腫瘍が偶発的に見つかった。切除標本は典型的なセミノーマの組織像を示した。ダウン症候群では精巣セミノーマの増加が知られるが、原発性縦隔セミノーマの報告は初めてである。ダウン症候群ではセミノーマが精巣に加え縦隔にも発生しうることを示す症例。
pmid-22322942.summary_en: A 28-year-old Japanese man with Down syndrome, scheduled for bone marrow transplantation for aplastic anemia, was incidentally found to have an anterior mediastinal tumor. Histopathology was typical of seminoma. Testicular seminoma is known to be more common in Down syndrome, but primary mediastinal seminoma in this population had not been reported before. The case indicates seminoma can arise in the mediastinum as well as the testis in Down syndrome.

pmid-22325393.summary_ja: スコットランドで過去30年間に診断された仙尾部奇形腫53例（女児41例）の解析。女児の12%（5例）で、初回手術時には認識されなかった尿生殖器奇形が後に判明した。排尿困難や失禁で発見され、診断は生後6週から13歳に及んだ。女児の仙尾部奇形腫では尿生殖器奇形を疑い、排尿障害があれば積極的に除外すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22325393.summary_en: Scottish cohort of 53 sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) patients over 30 years, including 41 girls. Five girls (12%) were later diagnosed with urogenital anomalies not apparent at initial surgery, presenting with retention or incontinence and diagnosed between 6 weeks and 13 years of age. The authors conclude urogenital anomalies are surprisingly common in girls with SCT, should be suspected, and should be actively excluded in girls with voiding difficulties. The mechanism of the association remains unclear.

pmid-22327130.summary_ja: 1999年から2010年に、予後不良または選択された中等度予後の胚細胞腫瘍44例を対象に、複数サイクルの自己末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法と二次切除を行った後方視的単施設解析である。CR率は73%、3年生存率は79.5%で、疾患関連死は16%、移植関連死はなかった。著者らは、ランダム化試験で否定的な結果が出ているにもかかわらず、予後不良の転移性胚細胞がんに対しこの治療は安全かつ有効であり、さらなる検討に値すると結論づけている。
pmid-22327130.summary_en: Retrospective single-center analysis of 44 patients with poor or selected intermediate prognosis germ cell tumors treated with multiple cycles of high-dose chemotherapy with autologous PBSC transplantation (1999 to 2010) plus secondary resection. The complete response rate was 73%, 3-year survival 79.5%, with disease-related death in 16% and no transplant-related deaths. The authors conclude this approach is safe and effective for poor-prognosis metastatic germ cell cancer despite negative randomized trials, and that it warrants further study.

pmid-22343384.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の過去1年間の重要な進展をまとめたものである。ゲノム研究では再発や化学療法抵抗性のマーカーとなる遺伝子発現が検討されている。早期セミノーマの治療は放射線療法からサーベイランスや化学療法へと移行しつつあり、完全寛解した播種性非セミノーマでの後腹膜リンパ節郭清の役割は不確かになりつつある。
pmid-22343384.summary_en: This annual review summarizes recent advances in testicular germ cell tumors. Genomic studies are exploring gene expression as potential markers of relapse and chemotherapy resistance. For early-stage seminoma, management is shifting from radiotherapy toward surveillance or chemotherapy. The role of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in disseminated nonseminomatous tumors in complete remission is becoming less certain. Treatment and surveillance strategies for both early and advanced disease continue to be refined as large studies mature.

pmid-22343745.summary_ja: 25歳男性が左精巣の硬い腫瘤で受診した。核型は45,X/46,X,del(Y)で、Y染色体長腕の大部分が欠失していた。高位精巣摘除術で混合型精巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、予防的化学療法が行われた。遺伝学的高リスク患者に対する治療選択肢について考察している。
pmid-22343745.summary_en: A 25-year-old man with a 45,X/46,X,del(Y) karyotype presented with a left testicular mass after prior hypospadias surgeries. High orchiectomy revealed a mixed-type testicular germ cell tumor. Chromosomal analysis showed loss of most of the Y-chromosome long arm. Prophylactic chemotherapy was administered. The report discusses management options for patients with testicular malignancy who are genetically at high risk.

pmid-22345374.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の女性患者10例を検討した。多くは卵巣奇形腫に関連する傍腫瘍症候群である。不適切洞性頻脈や洞停止を伴う徐脈などの洞結節機能異常が高頻度に認められた。3例で一時的ペーシングを要したが、永久ペーシングは不要であった。免疫療法や奇形腫切除により全例で不整脈は消失し、フォローアップ中の再発はなかった。
pmid-22345374.summary_en: This study reviewed 10 female patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a paraneoplastic autoimmune encephalitis often linked to ovarian teratoma. Sinus node dysfunction was common, including inappropriate sinus tachycardia and bradycardia with sinus arrest. Temporary pacing was needed in three patients, while permanent pacing was unnecessary. All dysrhythmias resolved after immunotherapy and/or teratoma resection, with no recurrence at follow-up.

pmid-22348147.summary_ja: 本研究は、遺伝的に感受性のある129.MOLF-L1コンジェニックマウスにおいて、出生前の環境因子曝露が精巣胚細胞腫瘍を誘発するかどうかを検討した。妊娠10.5日および11.5日に、DES、フルタミド、または放射線に曝露させた。DESとフルタミドは腫瘍発生率を増加させなかったが、0.8Gyの放射線照射により発生率は45%から100%に上昇し、両側性腫瘍や奇形腫型の腫瘍が増加した。腫瘍のない精巣の精子形成は正常であった。著者らは、胎児期の放射線照射が精巣がんを誘発しうること、および妊娠初期に放射線に曝露した男性胎児にリスクがある可能性を示唆し、病態研究のためのモデルを提供すると結論づけている。
pmid-22348147.summary_en: This study examined whether prenatal exposure to environmental agents induces testicular germ cell tumors in genetically susceptible 129.MOLF-L1 congenic mice. Pregnant mice were exposed to diethylstilbestrol, flutamide, or radiation on days 10.5 and 11.5 of gestation. Neither DES nor flutamide increased tumor incidence, whereas 0.8-Gy radiation raised incidence from 45% to 100%, with more bilateral and teratoma-type tumors. Spermatogenesis in tumor-free testes remained normal. The authors conclude that fetal irradiation can induce testicular cancer, suggesting a risk for male fetuses exposed to radiation in early pregnancy, and providing a model for studying pathogenesis.

pmid-22349043.summary_ja: 米国の放射線腫瘍医を対象に、精巣セミノーマ病期I術後の治療推奨を調査した。回答者の62%が術後放射線療法を推奨し、サーベイランスは21%であった。放射線療法を推奨する医師ほど、再発時の救済困難を懸念し、放射線に伴う二次性悪性腫瘍への認識が低かった。等価の有効性と低い侵襲性を踏まえ、サーベイランスの適切な実施に向けた教育の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-22349043.summary_en: This survey study assessed how American radiation oncologists recommend management for stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy. Of 261 respondents (53% response rate), 62% usually recommended adjuvant radiotherapy, 21% surveillance, and 3% chemotherapy. Physicians recommending radiotherapy were more likely to believe relapsed patients could not be salvaged and were less aware of radiation-associated second malignancies. Most physicians underestimated the magnitude of this risk. The authors conclude that because surveillance offers equivalent efficacy with less morbidity, ongoing physician education is needed to promote appropriate implementation of surveillance.

pmid-22350540.summary_ja: 2つの第II相試験で一次大量化学療法を受けた予後不良の胚細胞がん434例を対象とした後方視的解析である。40例(9%)が一次骨転移を呈し、縦隔原発、卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織型、同時性の肝転移と関連していた。大量化学療法の全体奏効率は85%で、無増悪生存率は63%、サルベージを含む全生存率は75%であった。骨単独の再発はまれであったが予後は不良であった。著者らは、診断時の骨転移が特定の臨床的特徴と骨再発に伴う予後不良を示すサブグループを同定すると結論づけている。
pmid-22350540.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 434 patients with poor-prognosis germ cell cancer treated with primary high-dose chemotherapy in two phase II trials. Forty patients (9%) presented with primary bone metastases, more often in patients with mediastinal primaries, yolk sac tumor histology, and synchronous liver metastases. Overall response to high-dose chemotherapy was 85%. Progression-free survival was 63%, and long-term overall survival with salvage was 75%. Isolated skeletal relapses were rare but had a dismal outcome. The authors conclude that bone metastasis at diagnosis identifies a subgroup with specific clinical features and poor prognosis for skeletal relapse.

pmid-22353601.summary_ja: 腹腔内に播種した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の女性例で、血清AFPは441,611ng/mlに達した。妊孕性の温存と臓器障害の回避のため最適な腫瘍減量術は行わなかった。残存腫瘍は補助化学療法に反応し、AFPは急速に低下した。連続したFDG-PET/CTで寛解が確認された。切除不能な残存病変を有する進行卵黄嚢腫瘍では、AFPとPETを組み合わせて治療効果を評価すると有用だと提案している。
pmid-22353601.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with a primary extragonadal yolk sac tumor disseminated throughout the abdomen with a serum AFP of 441,611 ng/ml. Optimal cytoreduction was not performed to preserve fertility and avoid organ injury. Residual disease responded to adjuvant chemotherapy, with a sharp decline in AFP. Serial FDG-PET/CT confirmed remission. The authors suggest that for advanced yolk sac tumors with unresectable residual disease, combining AFP levels with FDG-PET/CT may help monitor response and guide treatment planning in young women who wish to preserve fertility.

pmid-22357549.summary_ja: マウス精巣細胞をin vitroで形質転換させ、胚細胞腫瘍の形成過程を解析する新たなモデルを確立した。CD9陽性の精巣細胞に、ドミナントネガティブ型Trp53、Myc、活性化Hras1を導入すると腫瘍形成性の変化が生じた。移植すると、奇形腫、セミノーマ、胎児性癌からなる混合胚細胞腫瘍を形成した。胚細胞腫瘍の形成と初期化の類似性を示唆する。
pmid-22357549.summary_en: This study established an in vitro model of germ cell tumor formation by transforming mouse testis cells. Lentiviral transfection of dominant-negative Trp53, Myc, and activated Hras1 into CD9-expressing testis cells caused tumorigenic conversion. The cells resembled embryonic stem cells but were aneuploid and lacked Nanog. Yamanaka factors produced euploid ES-like cells. Both cell types formed mixed germ cell tumors containing teratomas, seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas on transplantation, and showed similar imprinting methylation changes. The authors suggest close similarity between GCT formation and reprogramming.

pmid-22361719.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例です。右心房へ転移した病変が奇形腫へ分化し、右室流入路閉塞を来しました。右心系の心臓転移は無症状のこともあれば、うっ血性心不全、肺塞栓、死亡に至ることもあります。画像診断と治療の進歩により、危険であるが治療可能な疾患として扱うべきだと述べています。
pmid-22361719.summary_en: This report describes a 24-year-old man with a testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor whose metastasis to the right atrium differentiated into a teratoma. The intracardiac lesion caused inflow obstruction of the right ventricle. The authors note that right-sided heart metastases from germ cell tumors can be asymptomatic or cause congestive heart failure, pulmonary embolism, or death. Improved imaging and treatment strategies mean such metastases should be regarded as dangerous but treatable.

pmid-22364997.summary_ja: 鈍的外傷後に胸膜腔へ破裂した縦隔成熟奇形腫の15歳男児の症例です。突然の左胸痛と呼吸困難で受診し、CTで前縦隔腫瘤と左胸水を認めました。5か月後に腫瘍は増大し摘出されました。病理組織学的に成人型組織からなる成熟奇形腫と確認されました。外傷が縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の破裂を明らかにし、または誘発しうることを示す症例です。
pmid-22364997.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old boy with a mediastinal mature teratoma that ruptured into the pleural cavity after blunt chest trauma. He presented with sudden left chest pain and dyspnea, and CT showed an anterior mediastinal mass with left pleural effusion. Five months later the lesion had enlarged and was resected. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma composed of adult-type tissues. The case suggests that trauma may reveal or precipitate rupture of a mediastinal germ cell tumor.

pmid-22369392.summary_ja: 60歳女性で成熟奇形腫に生じた乳頭状甲状腺癌の症例を報告し、多職種アプローチで治療した。著者らは発表済みの悪性卵巣甲状腺腫59例をレビューした。転移と再発の頻度は従来の報告より高かった。卵巣摘出術、甲状腺全摘術、I-131によるアブレーションを受けた患者では再発はなかった。著者らは、多モダリティによる治療が生存を改善し再発リスクを下げる可能性があると示唆している。
pmid-22369392.summary_en: This paper reports a 60-year-old woman with papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in a mature teratoma, managed with a multidisciplinary approach. The authors reviewed 59 published cases of malignant struma ovarii. They found higher rates of metastasis and recurrence than traditionally reported. No recurrences occurred in patients treated with oophorectomy, thyroidectomy, and I-131 radioablation. The authors suggest a multimodal approach may improve survival and reduce recurrence risk.

pmid-22371952.summary_ja: 35歳女性の前縦隔腫瘤で、CTでは奇形腫が疑われた。詳細な病理組織学的検査により、成熟奇形腫内に典型的カルチノイド(神経内分泌腫瘍)が発見された。奇形腫の悪性転化は画像では診断困難で、病理組織学的検査が不可欠であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-22371952.summary_en: A 35-year-old woman presented with an anterior mediastinal mass that CT suggested was a teratoma. Careful histopathological examination revealed a typical carcinoid, a neuroendocrine neoplasm, within the mature teratoma. The authors note that teratoma is the second most common mediastinal neoplasm and that malignant transformation in mature teratomas is uncommon at both gonadal and extragonadal sites. They emphasize that such transformation cannot be reliably diagnosed on imaging and requires histopathology.

pmid-22374422.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者65例と正常精巣20例を免疫組織化学で解析した。EMMPRINは53例のセミノーマで陽性で、陽性例はTNM病期の進行や腫瘍特異的生存の低下と関連した。Cox回帰分析で独立した予後因子であり、予後不良の指標となりうる。
pmid-22374422.summary_en: The authors examined EMMPRIN expression by immunohistochemistry in 65 seminoma patients and 20 normal testes. EMMPRIN was detected in 53 seminoma specimens but not in normal testes. Positive staining correlated with higher TNM stage and histological differentiation and with reduced tumour-specific survival. In Cox regression, EMMPRIN expression was an independent prognostic factor. The authors conclude that EMMPRIN expression predicts unfavourable prognosis in human seminoma and may contribute to tumour progression.

pmid-22381109.summary_ja: 27週の超音波検査で眼窩に固形・嚢胞性の血管に富む腫瘤が見つかり、先天性眼窩奇形腫と診断された。32週で子宮内胎児死亡となり、腫瘤の破裂が確認された。奇形腫は破裂の危険があり、子宮内MRIは病変範囲の評価に有用であると述べている。
pmid-22381109.summary_en: The authors report a fetus with a congenital orbital teratoma diagnosed antenatally by ultrasound at 27 weeks, showing a complex solid and cystic orbital mass with extensive vascularity. MRI supported the diagnosis and defined the tumor's location. At 32 weeks the fetus died in utero, and the mass was found to have ruptured. The authors note that fetal orbital teratomas, like sacrococcygeal teratomas, carry a rupture risk and that in utero MRI helps assess disease extent.

pmid-22382110.summary_ja: 6か月齢男児に偶然発見された心窩部腫瘤で、組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された症例報告です。胃奇形腫は極めてまれで、未熟型は悪性転化の可能性があります。推奨治療は外科的切除であり、画像診断、治療、術後のフォローアップについて考察しています。
pmid-22382110.summary_en: A 6-month-old boy presented with an incidentally detected epigastric mass, diagnosed histologically as a mature gastric teratoma. Gastric teratomas are very rare, accounting for about 2.6% of perinatally diagnosed germ cell tumours. Most are mature, while about 15% are immature with potential for malignant transformation. The recommended treatment is surgical excision. The authors discuss diagnostic imaging, therapy and postoperative follow-up.

pmid-22383152.summary_ja: 単一施設における124例の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者の後方視的解析で、化学療法後に胸腔内残存腫瘍切除を受けた。完全切除率は97.6%で、罹患率12.7%、死亡率0.5%であった。縦隔では成熟奇形腫が主要な組織型であり、両側手術を受けた患者の20.3%で部位間の組織像が不一致であった。生存腫瘍、不完全切除、34歳以上、大きな肺切除は予後不良因子であった。5年生存率は87%、10年生存率は85%であった。
pmid-22383152.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 124 patients with testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors underwent intrathoracic residual tumor resection after chemotherapy. Complete resection was achieved in 97.6%, with morbidity of 12.7% and mortality of 0.5%. Mature teratoma predominated in mediastinal masses, and histology was discordant between sites in 20.3% of patients undergoing bilateral procedures. Viable cancer, incomplete resection, age 34 years or older, and major pulmonary resection were associated with worse survival. Five- and ten-year survival were 87% and 85%.

pmid-22390222.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の女性3例の報告です。せん妄、けいれん、自律神経不安定が出現し、血清または脳脊髄液中に抗体が検出されました。腫瘍摘出と免疫療法により神経症状は回復しており、早期診断が重要とされています。
pmid-22390222.summary_en: This report describes three women with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian neoplasms, presenting with delirium, seizures and autonomic instability. Antibodies were detected in serum or cerebrospinal fluid. Ovarian masses were excised in two patients, and a microscopic neoplasm was found after empirical salpingo-oophorectomy in the third. All patients slowly recovered neurologically after surgery and immunotherapy. The authors emphasize that prompt recognition followed by tumor removal and immunotherapy usually leads to recovery.

pmid-22391053.summary_ja: 従来の光子線による傍大動脈照射を受けた病期Iのセミノーマ患者10例について、陽子線治療計画を作成して比較しました。陽子線では胃と大腸の線量が大幅に低下し、二次がんは1万人あたり300例少ないと推定されました。急性毒性の軽減が期待され、前向き研究が必要とされています。
pmid-22391053.summary_en: Ten patients with stage I seminoma previously treated with para-aortic photon radiation to 25.5 Gy were replanned with proton beam therapy. Proton plans reduced dose to the stomach by 46% and the large bowel by 64%. Modeling estimated that proton therapy would avert 300 excess second cancers per 10,000 men treated at a median age of 39 and surviving to 75. The authors suggest reduced acute toxicity and second cancer risk, and call for prospective studies.

pmid-22392906.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ35例の組織マイクロアレイと細胞株を用いて、ERβとHMGA1の相互作用を検討しました。正常胚細胞ではERβとHMGA1が結合していましたが、セミノーマではERβが減少し、HMGA1が過剰発現して細胞質に局在していました。エストラジオール処理でも同様の変化が見られ、エストロゲンがERβによる増殖抑制を弱める可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-22392906.summary_en: This study examined ERβ and HMGA1 interaction in normal germ cells and in human testicular seminomas, using GC1 and TCam-2 cell lines and a tissue microarray of 35 seminoma cases. ERβ interacted with HMGA1 in normal germ cells. In seminomas, ERβ was downregulated while HMGA1 was overexpressed and cytoplasmic. Estradiol induced similar changes in TCam-2 cells. The authors propose that estrogen exposure weakens ERβ-mediated growth restraint in seminoma, possibly through cytoplasmic relocalization of HMGA1.

pmid-22394039.summary_ja: 2006〜2007年に卵巣類皮嚢腫で手術を受けた160例を後方視的研究として検討した。血清腫瘍マーカーではCA19-9が37.6%の患者で高値を示した。CA19-9、CA125、CEAは腫瘍径が大きいほど有意に上昇した。著者らは、類皮嚢腫ではCA19-9が最も有用な腫瘍マーカーである可能性を指摘している。
pmid-22394039.summary_en: This retrospective study of 160 women operated on for ovarian dermoid cysts in 2006-2007 examined serum tumor markers (CA19-9, CA125, CEA, CA15-3, AFP) in relation to tumor size. CA19-9 was elevated in 37.6% of patients, CA125 in 19.3%, CEA in 9.4%, CA15-3 in 4%, and AFP in only one patient. Levels of CA19-9, CA125 and CEA rose significantly as tumor size increased. The authors suggest that serum CA19-9 may be the most useful marker in ovarian dermoid cysts, with tumor size as its main determinant.

pmid-22394436.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ88例でDNMT3Bの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した研究。巣状の発現は病期Iで35.7%に認められた。病期Iにおいて発現例の再発率は24%で、非発現例の6.7%より高く、無再発生存率も有意に低かった。著者らは、DNMT3B陽性の病期Iセミノーマは再発リスクが高く、注意深いフォローアップが必要と結論づけている。
pmid-22394436.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study of 88 testicular seminomas examined DNA methyltransferase 3B (DNMT3B) expression. Focal DNMT3B staining was seen in 39.8% of tumors and was more frequent in stage III than in stage I or II. Among stage I seminomas, DNMT3B expression was associated with a relapse rate of 24%, compared with 6.7% without expression, and with significantly poorer relapse-free survival. The authors conclude that DNMT3B-positive stage I seminomas carry a higher relapse risk and need careful follow-up, suggesting DNMT3B as a possible predictive marker.

pmid-22394608.summary_ja: 1989〜2006年に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性1246例を解析し、年齢の影響を検討した研究。50歳以上の患者は全体の約2〜3%であった。術前CTのリンパ節径を除き、臨床病理学的特徴は年齢群間で類似していた。多変量解析で年齢は再発の有意な予測因子ではなく、50歳以上でも安全に施行可能と結論づけられている。
pmid-22394608.summary_en: This database-based cohort study of 1,246 men with nonseminomatous germ cell tumour (NSGCT) who underwent primary or post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (1989-2006) examined whether age affects outcomes. Only about 2-3% of patients were aged 50 or older. Apart from pre-operative CT nodal size, clinicopathological and perioperative characteristics were similar in older and younger men. Age was not a significant predictor of recurrence on multivariable analysis. The authors conclude that RPLND can be safely performed in men aged 50 and over.

pmid-22395993.summary_ja: 2004年から2010年に単一の術者が行った、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた精巣がん85例のシリーズである。33%の患者が補助的手術を必要とし、最も多かったのは血管切除であった。腎摘除術は14%に行われた。早期合併症は28%に発生したが周術期死亡はなかった。後腹膜病理では成熟奇形腫39%、線維化28%、生存胚細胞腫瘍32%であった。平均18か月の経過観察で、各組織群の大半は再発を認めず、経験豊富な術者による積極的な外科治療を支持するとしている。
pmid-22395993.summary_en: This single-surgeon series of 85 testicular cancer patients undergoing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (2004-2010) reviewed patients who needed additional procedures. Adjuvant surgery was required in 33%, most often vascular resection, and nephrectomy was performed in 14%. Early complications occurred in 28%, with no perioperative deaths. Retroperitoneal pathology showed mature teratoma in 39%, fibrosis in 28% and viable GCT in 32%. With a mean follow-up of 18 months, most patients in each histology group had no recurrence, supporting aggressive surgery by experienced surgeons.
