Because the patient and family requested preservation of the hymen for cultural reasons, the team omitted the routine intravaginal preparation normally used for laparoscopy. A left salpingo-oophorectomy was performed laparoscopically, and the specimen was extracted in a large endobag. The authors describe useful technical adaptations, including manipulating the uterus transrectally with gauze attached to ovum forceps, and review the literature on this approach.

pmid-22677786.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、精巣腫瘍107例の超音波画像と診療記録を検討し、セミノーマ55例と非セミノーマ52例の超音波所見を比較した。セミノーマは低エコー性で均一、分葉状であることが多く、非セミノーマは不均一で嚢胞性であることが多かった。精巣微小石灰化はセミノーマでより多くみられた。著者らは、慎重な超音波解析により確定手術前に基礎となる病理組織像を推定でき、良性と悪性の精巣病変の鑑別研究の基盤になると結論づけている。
pmid-22677786.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed ultrasound images and records of 107 patients with testicular tumors, comparing sonographic features of 55 seminomas with 52 non-seminomas. Seminomas were more often hypoechoic, homogeneous, and lobulated, while non-seminomas were more often heterogeneous and cystic. Testicular microlithiasis was more common in seminomas. The authors conclude that careful ultrasound analysis can help predict underlying histopathology before definitive surgery, and lay groundwork for distinguishing benign from malignant testicular lesions.

pmid-22682753.summary_ja: 妊娠中に両側卵巣嚢腫が見つかった35歳女性で、左卵巣の成熟奇形腫内の卵巣甲状腺腫に濾胞亜型の乳頭状甲状腺癌が認められました。KRAS遺伝子のコドン12変異が検出され、BRAFやRET/PTCの異常は認められませんでした。分子検査は卵巣甲状腺腫の良性と悪性の鑑別に有用である可能性を述べています。
pmid-22682753.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with bilateral ovarian cysts found during pregnancy, diagnosed as mature teratoma with struma ovarii. The left ovarian cyst contained a focus of follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma. Molecular testing showed a KRAS codon 12 mutation without other common papillary thyroid carcinoma alterations, and no BRAF or RET/PTC changes. The authors suggest molecular testing may help differentiate benign from malignant struma ovarii, and that rare PTC-specific mutations can occur in these tumors.

pmid-22682983.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、化学療法の前後を問わず、腫大した後腹膜リンパ節のみを切除された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者94例を検討した。腫瘤の約半数で成熟奇形腫、約5人に1人で生存癌腫、残りで壊死または線維化が認められた。追跡期間中央値60か月で、5.4%が後腹膜再発し、6.4%が疾患により死亡した。ほとんどの患者で順行性射精が保たれていた。著者らは、適切に選択された患者において、腫大リンパ節の切除のみが妥当な選択肢であると結論づけている。
pmid-22682983.summary_en: This retrospective series reviewed 94 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent resection of enlarged retroperitoneal lymph nodes alone, with or without prior chemotherapy. Pathology showed mature teratoma in about half of masses, viable carcinoma in about one in five, and necrosis or fibrosis in the rest. Over a median follow-up of 60 months, 5.4% had retroperitoneal relapse and 6.4% died of disease, with antegrade ejaculation preserved in most men. The authors conclude that enlarged lymph node resection alone is a reasonable option in selected patients.

pmid-22684226.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫32例を対象に、染色体12p異常をFISH法で解析した。全体の72%に12p異常を認め、線維性間質の53%でイソクロモソーム12pがみられた。線維性間質は上皮成分と同様の遺伝学的異常を共有しており、奇形腫の間質が腫瘍性であり、上皮と間質は共通の前駆細胞に由来することが示唆された。
pmid-22684226.summary_en: Chromosome 12p abnormalities were examined by FISH in pure testicular teratomas from 32 patients. Such abnormalities were found in 72% of cases, including isochromosome 12p in the fibrous stroma in 53%. The fibrous stroma shared 12p alterations with epithelial components such as gastrointestinal-, respiratory-, and squamous-type epithelium and cartilage. The findings suggest that the fibrous stroma is neoplastic and that both epithelial and stromal components of teratoma arise from a common progenitor.

pmid-22687803.summary_ja: 25歳男性が1か月の上大静脈症候群と1週間の胸骨後部痛で受診した。CTで前縦隔に石灰化を伴う軟部腫瘤を認め、経胸壁生検で原発性縦隔セミノーマと診断された。化学放射線療法を施行し、部分奏効が得られた。上大静脈症候群は本疾患では極めてまれな初発症状である。
pmid-22687803.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with one month of superior vena cava syndrome and a week of retrosternal chest pain. CT showed an anterior mediastinal soft-tissue mass with stippled calcifications compressing the superior vena cava. Transthoracic biopsy confirmed primary mediastinal seminoma. He was treated with combined chemoradiotherapy and achieved a partial response. The authors note that superior vena cava syndrome is an extremely uncommon presentation of this rare tumor, which usually causes nonspecific symptoms.

pmid-22689918.summary_ja: 35歳男性の精巣胎児性癌(pT1)で、精巣摘除後もAFPが持続的に高値であった。母親にも同様の高値があり、遺伝性AFP持続症と診断された。LCA反応性AFP分画は低く、残存腫瘍の可能性は低いと判断された。国内3例目で、AFP分画を評価した初の症例である。
pmid-22689918.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with pT1 testicular embryonal carcinoma had persistently elevated α-fetoprotein after orchiectomy, without clinical or radiographic abnormality. His mother also had elevated AFP, confirming hereditary persistence of α-fetoprotein. The lens culinaris agglutinin-reactive AFP fraction was low while non-reactive AFP was high, suggesting a low probability of residual tumor. This is the third Japanese case and the first to evaluate AFP subfractions.

pmid-22691605.summary_ja: 27歳男性が鼻中隔から発生した腫瘤による鼻閉で受診した。内視鏡的に完全摘除され、組織学的に良性奇形腫と診断された。頭頸部奇形腫はまれで、成人例は悪性の傾向があるため、本例は珍しい。鼻中隔の良性奇形腫も見逃すべきではないと報告している。
pmid-22691605.summary_en: A 27-year-old man presented with nasal obstruction due to a mass arising from the nasal septum. Endoscopic removal was performed, and histology showed a benign teratoma. The authors note that head and neck teratomas are rare, usually presenting in neonates, and that adult teratomas tend to be malignant, making this adult benign case unusual. They emphasize that benign teratoma of the nasal septum should not be overlooked, and review the related literature.

pmid-22696812.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の免疫組織化学的発現を比較した。PSTTではVEGF、アンジオポエチン-1、-2が絨毛癌より高く、絨毛癌ではVEGFR-3が強く発現していた。VEGFやその受容体を標的とする薬剤が妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の治療に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22696812.summary_en: Immunohistochemical expression of VEGFs, PLGF, their receptors, IL-6 and CD147 was compared among normal first-trimester placentas, partial and complete moles, choriocarcinomas and PSTTs. VEGF and angiopoietins were higher in PSTT than in choriocarcinoma, while VEGFR-3 was stronger in choriocarcinoma. Choriocarcinoma also showed more CD147 than moles. VEGF and VEGFR-2 were measured in choriocarcinoma cell lines. The authors suggest that anti-VEGF agents may be useful in treating gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-22696813.summary_ja: イタリアの39施設で2005〜2009年の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を集計した。1,297例のうち部分胞状奇胎951例、完全胞状奇胎329例、絨毛癌17例であった。完全胞状奇胎は1,000妊娠あたり0.5、絨毛癌は0.013、GTD全体は15〜49歳女性1万人あたり2.3であった。データ抽出はコーディングや妊娠数の不備で困難であった。
pmid-22696813.summary_en: A multicenter survey of 39 Italian hospitals retrieved pathology database records of GTD cases from 2005 to 2009. Among 1,297 cases, 951 were partial moles, 329 complete moles, and 17 choriocarcinomas. The complete mole rate was 0.5 per 1,000 pregnancies, the choriocarcinoma rate 0.013 per 1,000 pregnancies, and the overall GTD rate 2.3 per 10,000 women aged 15-49. Coding errors and incomplete pregnancy denominators complicated data retrieval.

pmid-22696821.summary_ja: シェフィールド妊娠性絨毛性疾患センターのデータと既報をもとに、非妊娠健康女性における持続性hCG高値を検討した。悪性腫瘍化のリスクは11〜19%、死亡率は1〜3%と推定された。hCG持続高値があっても妊娠は安全に可能と思われた。将来的な症例報告と国際的な連携が必要と述べている。
pmid-22696821.summary_en: A retrospective case series from the Sheffield Trophoblastic Disease Centre database, combined with published reports, examined healthy nonpregnant women with persistently elevated hCG. The estimated malignancy risk was 11-19% and mortality 1-3%. Pregnancy appeared viable and safe despite persistent hCG elevation. The authors call for reporting future cases and liaison between national and international trophoblastic disease centers, since the condition may be premalignant.

pmid-22703795.summary_ja: 1995～2010年にEXIT手技を受けた87例のうち、巨大頸部奇形腫の17例を後方視的に検討した研究です。胎盤循環下での気道確保は全例で成功し、同条件下での死亡はありませんでした。新生児死亡率は23%で、主因は気道圧迫による重度の肺低形成でした。気道閉塞が予想される症例にはEXITが最適であり、出生前画像の詳細な評価と多職種チームの重要性が強調されています。
pmid-22703795.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 87 ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedures performed between 1995 and 2010, including 17 fetuses with giant cervical teratomas. Airway access under placental support was achieved in all cases, with zero mortality under placental support. Seven tumors were resected immediately after EXIT and six later, while four patients died before resection. Neonatal mortality was 23%, mainly from severe pulmonary hypoplasia caused by airway compression. The authors conclude that EXIT remains the optimal strategy when airway obstruction is anticipated, emphasizing careful prenatal imaging review and a multidisciplinary team.

pmid-22705360.summary_ja: 高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍12例に対し、週1回の高用量メトトレキサート・エトポシド療法の有効性と毒性を後方視的に検討しました。EP-EMAから耳毒性のため変更した7例中6例が再発なく完全寛解に至りました。非血液毒性は軽度で、主に貧血と好中球減少が認められました。有望な治療選択肢と考えられ、さらなる検討が必要とされています。
pmid-22705360.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of twelve patients with high-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia evaluates weekly high-dose methotrexate-etoposide (HD MTX-ETO). Seven patients switched from EP-EMA because of ototoxicity, and six of them achieved complete remission without recurrence. Among five patients treated primarily with HD MTX-ETO, four achieved complete remission. One placental site trophoblastic tumor patient died of progressive disease, and one choriocarcinoma patient with brain and liver metastases died under EP-EMA. Toxicity was low apart from hematologic effects, and the authors suggest HD MTX-ETO may be a treatment option warranting further study.

pmid-22706746.summary_ja: セミノーマで経過観察中に肝転移が疑われた患者の症例報告です。多発性の肝結節病変は、最終的に常染色体劣性の銅蓄積症であるウィルソン病と診断されました。ウィルソン病は画像上転移と類似し、悪性腫瘍との併存時に誤診を招くことがあります。セミノーマとの併存報告は過去になく、肝病変の鑑別では良性疾患も考慮すべきことが示されています。
pmid-22706746.summary_en: This case report describes a patient initially followed for seminoma with suspected liver metastases, whose multiple hepatic nodular lesions were ultimately diagnosed as Wilson disease. Wilson disease, an autosomal recessive copper accumulation disorder, can mimic metastatic disease on imaging and may lead to misdiagnosis when it coexists with malignancy. The authors note that coexistence of Wilson disease with seminoma has not been previously reported. About 40% of testicular cancers are pure seminoma, and liver metastases are rare in this histology. The report highlights the importance of considering benign mimics before attributing liver lesions to malignancy.

pmid-22707696.summary_ja: 縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性に急性巨核芽球性白血病が発症した症例報告です。染色体解析から、白血病は胚細胞腫瘍から直接生じたと示唆されました。同種骨髄移植後も、横紋筋肉腫成分を含む未分化肉腫と転移を伴う奇形腫で再発しました。悪性転化の治療は悪性組織に応じて選択し、予後不良例では長期のフォローアップが必要と結論づけています。
pmid-22707696.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with a mediastinal germ cell tumour that was complicated by acute megakaryoblastic leukaemia. Cytogenetic analysis suggested the leukaemia arose directly from the germ cell tumour. Despite allogeneic bone marrow transplantation, the patient relapsed with an undifferentiated sarcoma containing rhabdomyosarcoma components and a residual teratoma with metastasis. The authors conclude that treatment of malignant transformation depends on the malignant tissue counterpart, that unresectable or metastatic disease generally requires multimodal therapy, and that long-term follow-up is needed in patients with poor prognostic features.

pmid-22712465.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織と細胞株で、MMP-2、MMP-9とその阻害因子TIMP-1、TIMP-2の発現を比較した研究です。腫瘍組織では正常精巣より両MMPが高値でした。非セミノーマ性の細胞株は浸潤能が高く、MMP発現も多い傾向がみられました。MMPとTIMPの不均衡は悪性度を反映し、精巣腫瘍の新たなバイオマーカー候補と考えられています。
pmid-22712465.summary_en: This study compared matrix metalloproteinases MMP-2 and MMP-9 with their inhibitors TIMP-1 and TIMP-2 in human testicular germ cell tumours. Tumour tissues showed higher MMP-2 and MMP-9 levels than normal testis, with active forms detected only in tumours. Among three cell lines, the non-seminomatous NCCIT and NTERA2/D1 cells were more invasive and expressed more MMPs than seminoma-derived JKT-1 cells. Invasiveness inversely correlated with TIMP expression, and marimastat suppressed invasion, most strongly in the most invasive lines. The authors propose the MMP/TIMP balance as a potential biomarker of testicular malignancy.

pmid-22713299.summary_ja: 原発縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者5例で、化学療法中に増大した奇形腫が心肺機能を悪化させた経過を検討した研究です。全例で成熟奇形腫が認められ、一部では未熟成分や悪性転化、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が混在していました。growing teratoma syndromeは、腫瘍マーカー低下下の増大と心肺機能悪化で定義すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-22713299.summary_en: This study reviewed 188 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy surgery for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumours and identified five men with growing teratoma syndrome. These patients had large symptomatic mediastinal masses that caused cardiopulmonary deterioration and prevented completion of cisplatin-based chemotherapy, despite falling tumour markers. Resected specimens showed mature teratoma, with immature foci, sarcomatous transformation and nonseminomatous germ cell tumour in some cases. The authors define the syndrome by growth with cardiopulmonary decline, and report that prompt surgery can achieve cure.

pmid-22718761.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌細胞で、シスプラチン誘導性アポトーシスに関わるNOXAの転写制御機構を解析した研究です。転写因子p73、Sp1、KLF6がNOXAの発現を調節していました。耐性細胞ではNOXAの誘導が認められませんでした。組織解析ではNOXA発現が胎児性癌患者の良好な予後と相関し、治療反応の予測因子として有望とされています。
pmid-22718761.summary_en: This study examined how the proapoptotic protein NOXA is transcriptionally regulated in testicular embryonal carcinoma cells exposed to cisplatin. NOXA was induced in cisplatin-sensitive NTERA2 cells but not in resistant 1411HP cells, and its blockade reduced apoptosis. p73, Sp1 and KLF6 were found to control the NOXA promoter. Tissue microarray analysis showed NOXA expression correlated with better prognosis in embryonal carcinoma patients, leading the authors to propose NOXA as a predictive factor for cisplatin-based chemotherapy response.

pmid-22719055.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の増殖におけるBDNF/TrkBシグナルの役割を検討した研究です。奇胎組織ではBDNFとその受容体TrkBが発現していました。阻害薬K252aにより、栄養膜細胞の増殖が抑制され、アポトーシスが増加しました。マウス異種移植モデルでも奇胎の増殖と浸潤が抑えられ、新たな治療法になりうると結論づけています。
pmid-22719055.summary_en: This study investigated whether the BDNF/TrkB signalling pathway regulates hydatidiform mole growth. BDNF and its receptor TrkB were found in molar trophoblasts. In molar explant cultures, the Trk inhibitor K252a and soluble TrkB decreased trophoblast proliferation and viability and increased apoptosis. In a SCID mouse xenograft model, K252a suppressed molar growth and reduced chorionic gonadotropin-β levels. The authors suggest BDNF/TrkB inhibition could be a novel medical treatment for hydatidiform mole.

pmid-22730277.summary_ja: 猫眼症候群の特徴を有する9か月女児で、正中頸部腫瘤が性腺外成熟奇形腫と診断された症例です。aCGHとFISHで染色体22由来の過剰マーカー染色体を確認し、奇形腫組織は46,XYを示しました。異性双生児由来の胎児内胎児が示唆され、表現型の拡大と用量感受性遺伝子を論じています。
pmid-22730277.summary_en: A case report of a 9-month-old girl with Cat-Eye syndrome features and a palpable midline neck mass diagnosed as an extragonadal mature teratoma. Array CGH and FISH confirmed a supernumerary marker chromosome derived from chromosome 22, and the teratoma tissue showed a 46,XY karyotype, suggesting a fetus-in-fetu from a dizygotic twin of opposite sex. The authors extend the phenotypic spectrum of Cat-Eye syndrome and discuss dosage-sensitive genes.

pmid-22730711.summary_ja: 2000〜2010年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性疾患104例の後方視的研究です。転移は11例（10.6%）で、大半は肺転移でした。侵入奇胎は絨毛癌より多く、転移例の多くはWHO基準で高リスクでした。全例が化学療法で完全寛解し、個別化された併用化学療法により予後は良好と結論づけています。
pmid-22730711.summary_en: A retrospective study of 104 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease treated over 2000–2010, of whom 11 had metastases, mostly pulmonary. Invasive mole was more frequent than choriocarcinoma, and most metastatic patients were high-risk by WHO scoring. All patients received chemotherapy, achieving complete remission. The authors conclude that individualized, timely combined chemotherapy yields good prognosis, even with cerebral metastases.

pmid-22734844.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、卵巣の卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う胚細胞-性索間質混合腫瘍が原因で思春期早発症を呈した4歳女児を記述している。インヒビンおよびαフェトプロテインの著明な上昇が診断を支持した。卵管卵巣摘除術の後、化学療法を受け、8か月の追跡で再発や転移は認められなかった。著者らは、腹部腫瘤と思春期早発症を呈する思春期前の女児の鑑別診断として、本腫瘍を考慮すべきであると強調している。
pmid-22734844.summary_en: A case report of a four-year-old girl with precocious puberty caused by an ovarian mixed germ cell-sex cord-stromal tumor with a yolk sac tumor component. Markedly elevated inhibin and alpha-fetoprotein levels supported the diagnosis. After salpingo-oophorectomy, she received chemotherapy and remained free of recurrence or metastasis over eight months of follow-up. The authors highlight this tumor in the differential diagnosis of prepubertal girls with abdominal mass and precocious puberty.

pmid-22738859.summary_ja: 経口避妊薬を服用中に尿妊娠反応が陽性となった女性の原発性肺絨毛癌の症例報告です。腫瘍は完全切除され、現在まで再発はみられていません。既報31例の検討では、完全切除後に化学療法または綿密なフォローアップを行う方針で生存率が良好な傾向がありましたが、5年生存率は5%未満と予後は依然不良です。
pmid-22738859.summary_en: This case report describes a woman who presented with a positive urine pregnancy test despite oral contraceptive use and was diagnosed with primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma. The tumor was completely resected, and no recurrence was seen at follow-up. The authors reviewed the 31 previously reported cases and found a trend toward better survival with complete resection followed by chemotherapy or close surveillance. Overall prognosis remains poor, with 5-year survival below 5%.

pmid-22740852.summary_ja: 成熟卵巣奇形腫の組織と対応する正常組織を比較し、マイクロRNA(miRNA)の発現をマイクロアレイとqRT-PCRで解析した研究です。miRNA-520a-5pなどは1.3～2.6倍に増加し、let-7aやmiRNA-34aなどは55～87%低下していました。成熟奇形腫で示されたmiRNAプロファイルは初めてであり、病態形成への関与が今後の検証課題とされています。
pmid-22740852.summary_en: Using microarray profiling with qRT-PCR validation, the authors compared microRNA expression between mature ovarian teratoma tissues and matched normal tissue. Several miRNAs were upregulated by 1.3- to 2.6-fold, including miRNA-520a-5p and miRNA-26b*, while others such as let-7a and miRNA-34a were reduced by 55-87%. This is the first reported miRNA profile of mature ovarian teratomas. The authors suggest these differentially expressed miRNAs may contribute to pathogenesis if validated in future studies.

pmid-22741151.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマを有する41歳男性が、根治的精巣摘除術の6か月後に右鼡径部の触知可能な腫瘤を呈した。胸腹部CTでは後腹膜や遠隔転移は認められなかったが、陰嚢シンチグラフィーで鼡径部の充血性病変が描出された。切除によりセミノーマが浸潤した鼡径リンパ節が確認され、センチネルリンパ節と考えられた。術後補助放射線療法により完全奏効が得られ、2年間のフォローアップで無病生存を続けている。
pmid-22741151.summary_en: A 41-year-old man with stage I testicular seminoma developed a palpable right inguinal mass six months after radical orchiectomy. Thoracoabdominal CT showed no retroperitoneal or distant disease, but scrotal scintigraphy revealed a hyperemic inguinal lesion. Excision confirmed a seminoma-infiltrated inguinal lymph node, likely the sentinel node. Adjuvant radiotherapy achieved a complete response, and the patient remained disease-free at 2-year follow-up.

pmid-22743256.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、同時性両側精巣腫瘤を呈した思春期前の男児を記述する。この年齢層の精巣腫瘤は一般に良性で、多くは成熟奇形腫、類表皮嚢胞、間質性腫瘍である。腫瘤は精巣温存の部分精巣摘除術で治療された。6か月のフォローアップで残存腫瘍、正常な精巣の輪郭、萎縮は認められなかった。著者らは、良性と判断された腫瘤に対して部分精巣摘除術が第一選択であることを強調している。
pmid-22743256.summary_en: This case report describes a prepubescent boy with synchronous bilateral testicular masses, which in this age group are typically benign and most often mature teratomas, epidermoid cysts, or stromal tumors. The masses were managed with testis-sparing partial orchiectomy. At six-month follow-up there was no residual tumor, normal testicular contour, and no atrophy. The authors highlight partial orchiectomy as the preferred approach for masses deemed benign.

pmid-22744174.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の病理診断と臨床管理に関する最新の知見をまとめた総説です。稀少な亜型の診断の難しさや、再発に関わる組織学的因子の重要度の違いが検討されています。肉眼的・顕微鏡的な検索への示唆、新たな臨床的に重要な疾患単位、診断上の落とし穴についても解説されています。
pmid-22744174.summary_en: This review summarizes recent developments in testicular tumor pathology and clinical management. It highlights the diagnostic challenges posed by the rarity and complexity of testicular tumor variants. Recent trials and retrospective analyses suggest that some histopathological features linked to recurrence matter more than others, with implications for macroscopic and microscopic examination. The review also describes newly recognized clinically important entities and common diagnostic pitfalls.

pmid-22752087.summary_ja: 妊娠8週で急性精神病症状と緊張病、自律神経症状を呈した32歳初産婦の症例報告である。血清抗NMDA受容体抗体が検出され、血漿交換療法が奏効した。帝王切開で健康な男児が出生し、同時に左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が摘出された。妊娠中の緊張病では抗NMDA受容体脳炎を考慮し、早期治療が重要と結論している。
pmid-22752087.summary_en: A 32-year-old primigravida developed acute psychosis with catatonia and autonomic disturbance at eight weeks of pregnancy. Serum anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were detected, and she responded to plasma exchange. Caesarean section delivered a healthy boy, and a benign mature cystic teratoma was removed from the left ovary. The authors conclude that anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis should be considered for catatonia in pregnancy, and prompt treatment leads to good outcomes.

pmid-22754236.summary_ja: ステージIAの卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の生存者である女性と、その兄が精巣悪性腫瘍を発症した家族例である。兄は腫瘍マーカーの著明な上昇と僧帽弁の疣贅を伴い、治療にもかかわらず死亡した。異性の同胞に胚細胞由来の悪性腫瘍が生じたことは遺伝的感受性を示唆すると考察している。文献検索で類似例は6例のみであった。
pmid-22754236.summary_en: This report describes a family in which a woman with stage IA ovarian dysgerminoma survived, while her older brother developed disseminated testicular malignancy with markedly elevated tumour markers and mitral valve vegetations, and died despite treatment. The authors suggest that germ cell malignancies in siblings of different sex point to genetic susceptibility. A literature review identified only six similar families.

pmid-22768090.summary_ja: 血清で可溶化したクルクミノイドが胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1に結合し、増殖抑制、老化、カスパーゼ依存性アポトーシスを濃度依存的に誘導することを示しています。細胞への結合は主に膜画分に認められ、還元代謝経路で代謝されました。作用機序の解明に寄与する研究です。
pmid-22768090.summary_en: This study examines how serum-solubilized curcuminoids bind to and act on NT2/D1 embryonal carcinoma cells. Concentration-dependent effects included reduced proliferation, senescence, and caspase-mediated apoptosis. Cellular binding was mainly membrane-associated and curcuminoids were metabolized by a previously unidentified reduction pathway. Binding affinities and metabolic patterns varied across other cell lines. The findings suggest that curcuminoids activate distinct signaling pathways depending on their affinity for cellular binding sites. The work provides a basis for investigating signal transduction using defined curcuminoid preparations.

pmid-22770971.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の20歳女性で、左卵巣に13 mmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が見つかりました。正常な卵巣内で広範な凝固壊死を伴っていた点は従来報告がありません。壊死により神経抗原が放出され、自己免疫応答を誘導した可能性を考察し、病理組織学的特徴を文献的に検討しています。
pmid-22770971.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor autoimmune encephalitis was found to have a 13 mm mature ovarian teratoma. The tumor showed massive coagulative necrosis within an otherwise normal ovary, a previously unreported feature. The authors propose that necrosis may release neuronal antigens and trigger the autoimmune response. They review the histopathological features of ovarian teratomas associated with this encephalitis and discuss why certain tumor types are more frequently linked to it. The case highlights ovarian teratoma as the most common tumor associated with anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

pmid-22771412.summary_ja: 28歳男性が喘鳴と呼吸困難で受診し、声門下狭窄を伴う気管腫瘍が見つかりました。病理組織学的に非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、VIP化学療法後に肺結節の大部分が消失しました。残存病変は胸腔鏡下に切除され、現在は再発の監視下で無病生存しています。
pmid-22771412.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with stridor and dyspnea due to a tracheal mass causing subglottic narrowing. Histopathology showed a non-seminomatous germ cell tumor. After cricotracheal resection and reconstruction, PET revealed new pulmonary nodules. He received four cycles of VIP chemotherapy (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin), after which nodules largely resolved on CT. Thoracoscopic wedge resections removed residual disease. He remains disease-free under surveillance for recurrence. The case documents an extremely rare extragonadal germ cell tumor of the trachea.

pmid-22773216.summary_ja: スワイヤー症候群（46,XY核型）の16歳女性が、腹部腫瘤と陰核肥大で受診しました。切除した性腺の病理組織学的検査で、右卵巣に混合型胚細胞腫瘍が認められ、左側は性腺線条で性腺芽腫は認められませんでした。性腺腫瘍のリスクが高いため、早期の予防的性腺摘出が推奨されています。
pmid-22773216.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with Swyer syndrome (46,XY karyotype, primary amenorrhea, female external genitalia) presented with an abdominal mass and clitoromegaly. Histopathology of excised gonads revealed a mixed germ cell tumor in the right ovary and a streak gonad on the left without gonadoblastoma. The authors emphasize that individuals with Swyer syndrome carry a high risk of gonadal neoplasia, supporting early prophylactic gonadectomy to improve survival. The case illustrates the link between gonadal dysgenesis and germ cell tumor development.

pmid-22776340.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫は最も頻度の高い卵巣腫瘍の一つですが、併存例や寄生性の例はまれです。従来の報告の多くは大網と卵巣の併存でしたが、本症例はダグラス窩と卵巣に併存していました。両病変を腹腔鏡下に切除したことを報告しています。
pmid-22776340.summary_en: Dermoid cysts of the ovary are among the most common ovarian neoplasms, but coexisting or parasitic dermoid cysts are unusual. Most prior reports involved the omentum and ovary, whereas this case involved the pouch of Douglas and the ovary. The authors describe laparoscopic resection of both lesions. The report documents an uncommon distribution of ovarian mature cystic teratomas outside the typical omental location. It adds to the clinical knowledge of atypical dermoid cyst presentations treated by minimally invasive surgery.

pmid-22779019.summary_ja: 胎児の頸部後方に分葉状腫瘤として出現した胎盤奇形腫の症例報告です。超音波検査で胎盤から生じた2つの高エコー性腫瘤が確認され、病理組織学的検査で奇形腫と診断されました。38週で選択的帝王切開が行われ、胎児は正常で母子ともに良好な経過でした。
pmid-22779019.summary_en: This case report describes a placental teratoma presenting as a lobulated mass behind the fetal neck. Ultrasound identified two echogenic masses arising from the placenta, and gross examination confirmed two lobulated lesions. Histopathological examination supported the diagnosis of placental teratoma, which is a rare, nontrophoblastic benign tumor thought to arise from germ cells. Elective cesarean section was performed at 38 weeks for breech presentation. The fetus was normal, and maternal and fetal outcomes were good.

pmid-22782964.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴う転移性精巣腫瘍に対して化学療法を受けた56例を対象に、リンパ節転移による尿管閉塞を検討した。化学療法前に尿管ステント留置を要したのは12例で、非セミノーマよりセミノーマで有意に多かった。閉塞は化学療法または後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に解消した。ステント留置により化学療法前の腎機能は改善したが、11例中6例で化学療法後に糸球体濾過量が60 ml/min未満に低下した。著者らは、治療中および治療後の腎機能の綿密なモニタリングの必要性を指摘している。
pmid-22782964.summary_en: This retrospective study of 56 patients with metastatic testicular tumors treated with chemotherapy examined ureteral obstruction from retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Twelve patients required ureteral stenting before chemotherapy, and this was significantly more frequent in seminoma than non-seminoma. Obstruction resolved after chemotherapy or retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Stenting improved renal function before chemotherapy, but glomerular filtration rate declined below 60 ml/min in 6 of 11 patients afterward, warranting close renal monitoring during and after treatment.

pmid-22783384.summary_ja: 早産で生まれた新生児の仙尾部奇形腫の症例です。出生10日後に外科的切除が行われ、腫瘍内に未熟成分と網膜様構造が認められました。免疫組織化学染色で正常マウス網膜との類似が確認されました。幹細胞治療における奇形形成作用の理解に示唆を与える可能性があります。
pmid-22783384.summary_en: This case report describes a premature newborn with sacrococcygeal teratoma that was surgically resected 10 days after birth. The tumor contained immature components and a retina-like structure. Immunohistochemistry confirmed similarities between this structure and normal mouse retina, and its unique vascular arrangement and polarity were considered important for structural differentiation. The authors suggest these findings may inform understanding of teratogenic activity relevant to stem cell therapy.

pmid-22784265.summary_ja: 眼窩に生じた類皮嚢腫が頭蓋内へ進展した48歳女性の症例報告です。類皮嚢腫の頭蓋内進展は非常に稀で、骨を侵食しながら緩徐に進展しました。治療は外科的手術で、放射線療法や化学療法の適応はないとされています。
pmid-22784265.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with an orbital dermoid cyst that extended intracranially by invading neighboring bones over a slow growth period. Intracranial extension of a dermoid cyst is very rare. Treatment was surgical, and the authors noted that radiotherapy or chemotherapy is not indicated for this disease. The report highlights the unusual pattern of growth from the orbit into the cranium.

pmid-22785518.summary_ja: 腹部症状を訴えた女性2例で、超音波検査により卵巣奇形腫が疑われた報告です。CTで傍大動脈リンパ節腫大が見られ、悪性を疑いました。全身18F-FDG PET/CTにより良性と悪性の鑑別や病期分類に有用であった可能性が示されました。
pmid-22785518.summary_en: This report describes two women with abdominal complaints and suspected ovarian teratoma on ultrasonography. CT revealed enlarged para-aortic lymph nodes, raising suspicion of malignancy. Total-body 18F-FDG PET/CT helped distinguish benign from malignant ovarian teratoma and abdominal lymphadenopathy, with histopathology confirmation. The authors conclude that PET/CT may aid accurate diagnosis and staging when malignant teratoma is suspected, which may require a more aggressive multimodality approach.

pmid-22787184.summary_ja: 再発性腹痛と巨大な嚢胞性骨盤内腫瘤を呈した41歳女性の症例です。卵巣甲状腺腫から発生した乳頭状甲状腺型癌と診断されました。子宮摘出、両側卵管卵巣摘出、甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨウ素アブレーションが行われ、現在もフォローアップ中です。
pmid-22787184.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman with recurrent abdominal pain and a large cystic pelvic mass, in whom histopathology revealed papillary thyroid-type carcinoma arising from a struma ovarii. Treatment included hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, total thyroidectomy, and postoperative radioactive iodine ablation with levothyroxine suppression. The patient remains under follow-up for possible recurrence and metastasis. The case illustrates malignant transformation of a monodermal teratoma.

pmid-22795387.summary_ja: 55歳男性が、オンコニューラル抗体陰性の亜急性小脳失調を発症しました。PET-CTで胸腺結節と仙骨前腫瘤が見つかり、胸腺ジャーミノーマおよび成熟奇形腫と診断されました。ステロイド減量時には失調が悪化しました。抗体が陰性でも腫瘍検索が重要であることを示す症例です。
pmid-22795387.summary_en: A 55-year-old man developed subacute pancerebellar syndrome without onconeural antibodies. PET-CT identified a thymic nodule and a presacral mass. Pathology showed thymic germinoma, and the presacral mass was a mature teratoma after chemotherapy. Testicular ultrasound was suspicious, but orchiectomy showed no malignancy. Neurological symptoms improved after tumor identification, though ataxia worsened as steroids were tapered. The case stresses that paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration warrants tumor screening even when antibodies are negative.

pmid-22797776.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫（皮様嚢腫）の初代培養細胞で、ヘッジホッグ-Gliシグナル経路の活性化を確認しました。Sonic Hedgehogは細胞増殖を促進し、Patchedの細胞内移行を誘導しました。シクロパミンは増殖を抑制し、核内のGli1を減少させました。リガンド依存性の自己分泌機構が、腫瘍形成に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-22797776.summary_en: This study examined Hedgehog-Gli signaling in primary cultures of ovarian dermoids, classified as mature teratomas. Activation of the pathway was confirmed. Cyclopamine slowed proliferation, while Sonic Hedgehog stimulated proliferation and induced internalization of Patched, which accumulated in cytoplasmic granules with Shh. Cyclopamine reduced nuclear Gli1 localization. The authors propose a ligand-dependent autocrine mechanism that may also be activated by paracrine signals in ovarian dermoids.

pmid-22800561.summary_ja: 28歳男性が無痛性の両側陰嚢腫脹で受診しました。超音波検査とCTで両側精巣腫瘍が疑われましたが、MRIで右精巣の非造影と出血性梗塞が確認されました。両側精巣摘除術により、左精巣セミノーマと対側精巣捻転が判明しました。両側精巣腫瘤の鑑別には、MRIが有用とされています。
pmid-22800561.summary_en: A 28-year-old man presented with painless bilateral scrotal swelling. Ultrasonography and CT suggested bilateral testicular tumors, while MRI showed no enhancement in the right testis, consistent with hemorrhagic infarction from torsion. Bilateral orchiectomy revealed a left seminoma and contralateral testicular torsion with hemorrhagic infarction. The authors conclude that MRI can distinguish torsion from bilateral tumors and suggest MRI when bilateral testicular masses are found.

pmid-22801034.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の良性例、悪性転化例および絨毛癌組織でPCBP1発現をウェスタンブロットで解析し、69例で免疫組織化学染色も行いました。悪性転化例ではPCBP1が低下し、血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)値と負の相関を示しました。PCBP1高発現は妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍への進展リスクの低さと関連しました。フォローアップでの予測因子として期待されます。
pmid-22801034.summary_en: Researchers measured PCBP1 expression in complete hydatidiform moles that stayed benign, moles that underwent malignant transformation, and choriocarcinoma tissues by Western blot, and in 69 complete moles by immunohistochemistry. PCBP1 was lower in malignant-transformed moles and inversely associated with serum hCG. High PCBP1 expression was linked to a lower risk of progression to gestational trophoblastic tumors (OR 0.22). Low PCBP1 may be a strong predictor of malignant transformation during postmolar follow-up.

pmid-22803571.summary_ja: 860例の腫瘍組織マイクロアレイで、クローディン6は全ての胚細胞腫瘍（28例）に発現し、非胚細胞腫瘍では8%に限られた。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌ではびまん性の染色が認められ、未熟奇形腫では限局的であった。原始的胚細胞腫瘍の新規診断マーカーとしての有用性が示された。
pmid-22803571.summary_en: Using tissue microarrays of 860 tumors, the authors found claudin-6 expressed in all 28 germ cell tumors, versus 8% of non-germ cell tumors. Full-section staining showed diffuse expression in seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors and choriocarcinoma trophoblastic cells, with focal expression in immature teratomas. Claudin-6 was also expressed in AFP-producing gastric adenocarcinomas and pulmonary fetal adenocarcinomas. The authors propose claudin-6 as a novel diagnostic marker for primitive germ cell tumors.

pmid-22807905.summary_ja: 過去に胞状奇胎があり定期受診が不規則だった48歳女性に、左卵巣へ転移した絨毛癌を認めた。2次元カラードプラ超音波検査、3次元パワードプラ超音波検査、動的造影MRIにより卵巣腫瘤を評価した。3次元パワードプラは腫瘤と血管の関係をより明瞭に示し、造影MRIは隣接構造と腸骨血管を描出した。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の転移評価に有望な手法と考えられる。
pmid-22807905.summary_en: A 48-year-old woman with a prior molar pregnancy and irregular follow-up had metastatic choriocarcinoma involving the left ovary. The ovarian mass was evaluated with two-dimensional color Doppler ultrasound, three-dimensional power Doppler ultrasound, and dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI. Three-dimensional power Doppler better defined the vascular relationships of the mass, while contrast MRI showed adjacent structures and the iliac vessels. The authors suggest these modalities are promising for evaluating metastases from gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-22810004.summary_ja: セミノーマ細胞株TCAM2において、エストラジオールはERβを介してPTENプロモーターのSp1結合を促進し、PTEN発現を増加させた。ERβとPTENの協調により細胞生存率が低下し、オートファジーが誘導された。DNA断片化やカスパーゼ切断は認めず、LDHおよびRIP1の結果から壊死性細胞死（ネクロプトーシス）が示唆された。ERβリガンドの治療応用が提案された。
pmid-22810004.summary_en: In TCAM2 human seminoma cells, estradiol acting through estrogen receptor beta (ERβ) increased PTEN expression by promoting Sp1 binding at the PTEN promoter. ERβ and PTEN together reduced cell survival, suppressed AKT phosphorylation, and induced autophagy markers. The absence of DNA fragmentation and caspase cleavage, together with LDH and RIP1 findings, suggested necroptosis. The authors propose ERβ ligands as potential therapies for estrogen-dependent seminoma.

pmid-22813813.summary_ja: 11歳の小児が閉塞性黄疸で受診し、肝十二指腸間膜に発生した成熟奇形腫と診断された。まれな性腺外発生部位の臨床像、外科的管理、経過を報告している。性腺外奇形腫は仙尾部、後腹膜、縦隔に多いが、肝十二指腸間膜発生は極めてまれであるとの文献的考察を含む。
pmid-22813813.summary_en: An 11-year-old child presented with obstructive jaundice caused by a mature teratoma in the hepatoduodenal ligament. The authors describe the clinical presentation, surgical management and outcome of this rare extragonadal site. They review the literature, noting that sacrococcygeal, retroperitoneal and mediastinal locations are common for pediatric extragonadal teratomas, whereas hepatoduodenal ligament involvement is very rare. The report is a case-based review of an unusual presentation.

pmid-22814307.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍65例（再発37例、非再発28例）を対象とした後方視的研究である。初回化学療法2サイクル後のマーカー半減期（MHL）が再発を予測するかを検討した。初期マーカー値に群間差はなかったが、予後良好・中間・不良の各群でMHLに有意差が認められた（不良群のAFPを除く）。MHLが予想より長い症例は慎重なフォローアップが必要とした。
pmid-22814307.summary_en: This retrospective study examined whether the marker half-life (MHL) of AFP and beta-hCG after two cycles of first-line chemotherapy predicts relapse in 65 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors (37 relapsed, 28 nonrelapsed). Initial marker levels did not differ between groups. MHL differed significantly across good, intermediate and poor IGCCCG risk groups, except for the AFP half-life in poor-risk patients. The authors conclude that MHL predicts recurrence, and patients with a longer-than-expected MHL warrant closer investigation.

pmid-22814615.summary_ja: 生後2か月の女児が、出生時からの反復する嘔吐、発育不全、反復性の喘鳴とチアノーゼを呈した。口咽頭から起始する腫瘤を全身麻酔下にCO2レーザーで切除し、病理組織学的検査で口咽頭の奇形腫と確認された。極めてまれな先天性腫瘍で、新生児の気道閉塞の鑑別診断に挙げるべきだと論じている。
pmid-22814615.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old girl with an oropharyngeal mass causing recurrent stridor, cyanosis, vomiting and poor weight gain since birth. The mass was excised under general anaesthesia using a CO2 laser. Histopathological examination confirmed a teratoma of the oropharynx. The authors review the clinical presentation, diagnosis and treatment of this extremely rare congenital tumour, which should be considered in the differential diagnosis of neonatal airway obstruction.

pmid-22815844.summary_ja: 原発性無月経の22歳女性で、46,XY性腺異形成と診断された。腹腔鏡検査で線状卵巣を認め、病理学的に両側性の性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が確認された。SRYの新規変異に加え、後に腎不全を契機に見つかったWT1のスプライス部位変異も同定された。DSD患者の多遺伝子診断が早期治療と浸潤がん予防に重要だと論じている。
pmid-22815844.summary_en: A phenotypically female 22-year-old with primary amenorrhoea was diagnosed with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis. Laparoscopy showed streak ovaries, and pathology revealed bilateral gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, confirmed by immunohistochemistry. Genetic analysis identified a novel SRY missense mutation. Later, progressive kidney failure prompted WT1 analysis, which revealed a pathogenic splice-site mutation in intron 9 consistent with Frasier syndrome. The authors emphasise that multi-gene diagnosis in DSD patients enables early treatment and may prevent invasive cancer.

pmid-22819380.summary_ja: 精巣の精母細胞性セミノーマ36例を対象に、DNAメチル化、メチル基転移酵素、各種ヒストン修飾を免疫組織化学で評価した。推定起源である精原細胞に一致するパターンは認められず、隣接細胞間で修飾レベルが大きく異なる不均一な分布を示した。著者らは、この腫瘍がエピジェネティックな不安定性を示し、体細胞ニッチの欠如が一因と考察している。
pmid-22819380.summary_en: This study examined epigenetic modifications in 36 testicular spermatocytic seminoma samples using immunohistochemistry. The researchers assessed DNA methylation, DNA methyltransferases and several histone marks. No marker matched the presumed spermatogonial cell of origin, and no correlation with tumour cell size was found. Instead, staining showed a 'salt-and-pepper' heterogeneous pattern between neighbouring cells. The authors conclude that these tumour cells are epigenetically unstable, possibly due to the lack of regulatory signals from the absent somatic niche.

pmid-22820986.summary_ja: GPを伴う卵巣未熟奇形腫15例と、伴わない27例を比較した。GP群は腫瘍径が大きく、再発率が40%と高く（非GP群3.7%）、術前CA-125高値も多かった。再発は全例が2年以内に生じ、無再発生存期間は有意に短かった。ただしGP群のほぼ全例が生存しており、GPは主に再発の予後不良因子と結論づけられている。
pmid-22820986.summary_en: This study compared 15 ovarian immature teratomas (ITs) associated with gliomatosis peritonei (GP) with 27 ITs without GP. Patients with GP had larger tumours, more frequent recurrence (40% vs 3.7%) and more often elevated preoperative CA-125. All recurrences occurred within two years, and recurrence-free survival was significantly shorter. However, nearly all GP patients remained alive. The authors conclude that GP is an adverse prognostic factor for recurrence in ovarian IT.

pmid-22826728.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、生後2日目に来院した先天性未熟奇形腫の眼窩症例を有する女児について述べている。腫瘍は改良型眼窩内容除去術により良好に治療された。患児は24か月にわたり断続的にフォローアップを受けられず、その後は所在を確認できなかった。保護者への啓発努力にもかかわらずこの事態が生じた。著者らは、資源の限られた環境におけるこうした社会的要因が、予後および整容的転帰に影響しうることを論じている。
pmid-22826728.summary_en: This case report describes a female neonate with a congenital immature teratoma of the orbit, presenting on the second day of life. Modified exenteration successfully treated the tumour. The child was lost to follow-up intermittently over 24 months and could not be traced thereafter, despite efforts to educate the parents. The authors discuss how such social factors and limited resources may affect prognosis and cosmetic outcome in this setting.

pmid-22826993.summary_ja: 82歳女性が腹部腫瘤で来院し、試験開腹術で大網から茎捻転を伴う腫瘍を認めた。切除標本には歯と毛髪が含まれ、成熟奇形腫と判断された。切除により根治し、術後3日で退院した。大網奇形腫は極めてまれで、成人では特に少なく、患者は長年無症状で保有していた可能性があると述べている。
pmid-22826993.summary_en: This case report describes an 82-year-old woman who presented with an abdominal mass. Exploratory laparotomy revealed a tumour with torsion on its pedicle arising from the greater omentum. Removal showed teeth and hair, consistent with a mature teratoma. Excision was curative, and the patient was discharged after three days. The authors note that omental teratomas are extremely rare, particularly in adults, and that the patient likely carried the tumour asymptomatically for life.

pmid-22827762.summary_ja: 59歳の閉経後女性の右卵巣に生じた巨大腫瘍の症例報告。血管肉腫、明細胞腺癌、成熟奇形腫の成分が混在していた。免疫染色とHUMARAアッセイにより、3成分が同一のクローン起源を持つことが示され、成熟奇形腫からの悪性転化が示唆された。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、文献レビューも併せて報告されている。
pmid-22827762.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old postmenopausal woman with a large right ovarian tumor containing angiosarcoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and mature teratoma components. Immunohistochemistry (CD31, CD34, HNF-1β) characterized the malignant elements, while HUMARA X-chromosome inactivation assays showed identical clonal patterns across all three components. The findings suggest that the malignant tumor, with two distinct phenotypes, arose from a mature teratoma through malignant transformation. The authors also review the literature on this rare entity, which occurs in about 1-2% of mature ovarian teratomas.

pmid-22829014.summary_ja: ファンコニ貧血の遺伝子FANCD2の2種類の変異を有する家系を報告。発端者は軽症のFAを示し、兄弟はT細胞ALL、父親は精巣セミノーマを発症していた。両変異アレルは白血病細胞とセミノーマの双方に存在し、腫瘍におけるアレル欠失は認められなかった。特定のFANCD2変異が両疾患の感受性に関与する可能性が示唆されたが、症例数が少なく因果関係の確定には至らない。
pmid-22829014.summary_en: This family study describes FANCD2 mutations (c.458T>C and c.2715+1G>A) in a pedigree with mild Fanconi anaemia in the index case, T-cell ALL in a heterozygous brother, and testicular seminoma in a heterozygous father. Both mutant alleles were retained in the T-cell ALL and seminoma tissues, with no evidence of loss of heterozygosity in the tumors. The authors propose that these specific FANCD2 variants may contribute to susceptibility to both T-cell leukemia and seminoma, although the small number of cases limits firm conclusions about causality.

pmid-22833082.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎と卵巣奇形腫を有する5例の症例シリーズで、脳炎関連の奇形腫5例（成熟4例、未熟1例）を、神経グリア成分を含む対照奇形腫22例と比較した。脳炎関連腫瘍では、成熟神経グリア組織に局在する腫瘍内リンパ球浸潤がより顕著で、対照にはない反応性胚中心、リンパ形質細胞浸潤、神経細胞の変性変化が認められた。著者らは、これらの反応性リンパ成分を伴う奇形腫を検討する病理医は抗NMDAR脳炎を考慮すべきであり、放射線学的に検出困難な小さな奇形腫を見つけるため慎重な標本採取を行うよう勧めている。
pmid-22833082.summary_en: This series of five patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and ovarian teratoma compares 5 encephalitis-associated teratomas (4 mature, 1 immature) with 22 control teratomas containing neuroglial elements. Encephalitis-associated tumors showed more prominent intratumoral lymphoid infiltrates localized to mature neuroglial tissue, including reactive germinal centers, lymphoplasmacytic infiltrates, and degenerative neuronal changes that were absent in controls. The authors advise pathologists to consider anti-NMDAR encephalitis when reviewing teratomas with these reactive lymphoid features, and recommend careful sampling to detect small, radiologically occult teratomas.

pmid-22833084.summary_ja: 58歳女性の成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に、扁平上皮癌と多形肉腫が生じた症例報告。上皮成分は角化を伴う中等度分化型扁平上皮癌で、間質成分は多数の巨細胞と奇怪な核、高度な核分裂像を示した。成熟奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、大多数が閉経後に生じ、扁平上皮癌が主な組織型である。上皮性と肉腫様の双方の悪性成分を示す特異な症例として報告されている。
pmid-22833084.summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma and pleomorphic sarcoma (malignant fibrous histiocytoma) arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary in a 58-year-old woman. The tumor contained a moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma with keratinization and a stromal component with abundant giant cells, bizarre nuclei, and marked mitotic activity. Malignant transformation of mature ovarian teratoma is rare, mostly occurring after menopause, and squamous cell carcinoma accounts for most cases. The authors highlight this as a unique example showing both epithelial and sarcomatous malignant elements.

pmid-22837112.summary_ja: フランスの11施設で精子を凍結保存した精巣がん患者1158例を対象とした後方視的研究。セミノーマでは精巣摘除術前の精子濃度と総精子数が非セミノーマより有意に低かった。病期III、停留精巣の既往、20歳未満の症例で精液性状の障害が強かった。精子凍結保存は精巣摘除術の前に行うべきであり、重度の障害がある場合は同時に精巣内精子採取術を検討すべきと提言されている。
pmid-22837112.summary_en: This retrospective study of 1158 men with testicular cancer who banked sperm at 11 French CECOS centers evaluated semen parameters by tumor histology, stage, and clinical history. Pure seminomas accounted for 48% of cases. Sperm concentration and total sperm count were significantly lower before orchiectomy in seminoma patients than in nonseminoma patients, while nonseminoma parameters declined after surgery. Impairment was greater in stage III disease, prior cryptorchidism, and patients younger than 20. The authors recommend cryobanking before orchiectomy and considering concurrent testicular sperm extraction in severe impairment.

pmid-22838241.summary_ja: 1979年から2009年に低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍と診断された358例を後方視的に検討。メトトレキサート不成功の68例のうち64例にアクチノマイシンDを用い、完全奏効率は75%であった。逐次治療に不応の20例は多剤併用化学療法で寛解した。絨毛癌の診断と当初のFIGOスコア3以上が耐性と関連していた。二次治療としてのアクチノマイシンDは有効であり、多剤療法により最終的に全例が治癒したと結論づけられている。
pmid-22838241.summary_en: This retrospective review of 358 women treated for low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) from 1979 to 2009 evaluated secondary actinomycin D after methotrexate failure. Of 68 methotrexate failures, 64 received actinomycin D, achieving a complete response rate of 75%, with 71% in resistance and 88% in toxicity cases. All 20 patients who failed sequential chemotherapy achieved remission with multiagent regimens. Choriocarcinoma diagnosis and original FIGO score of 3 or higher were associated with resistance. The authors conclude that secondary actinomycin D is effective and that multiagent therapy yields eventual cure.

pmid-22838243.summary_ja: シェフィールドセンターで1975年から2010年に治療された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍905例のうち、死亡24例を後方視的に検討。死因は転移性腫瘍が13例、治療関連合併症が6例であった。不良な予後因子は胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、高リスクスコア、化学療法抵抗性であった。多剤耐性を示す転移性胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍が最大の死因であり、現在では敗血症などによる早期の治療関連死は回避可能であると結論づけられている。
pmid-22838243.summary_en: This single-centre review of 905 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia treated at Sheffield from 1975 to 2010 analyzed the 24 deaths. Eleven died during initial treatment, eight from relapse and progression, and 19 were analyzed with 13 from metastatic tumor and 6 from treatment-related complications, mostly sepsis and multiorgan failure. Poor prognostic features included placental site trophoblastic tumor, high-risk score, and chemotherapy resistance. The authors identify metastatic multidrug-resistant PSTT as the leading cause of death, and note that early treatment-related sepsis deaths are now avoidable.

pmid-22838244.summary_ja: 1997年から2010年にシェフィールドセンターに異所性妊娠性絨毛性疾患を疑われて紹介された症例の後方視的検討。組織学的再検討により12例が確認され、絨毛癌4例、部分胞状奇胎5例、全胞状奇胎3例であった。絨毛癌の3例は化学療法を要したが、全例が寛解した。異所性GTDは稀で過剰診断されやすく、中央病理診断の重要性と良好な予後が強調されている。
pmid-22838244.summary_en: This retrospective review of patients referred to the Sheffield Centre with suspected ectopic gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) from 1997 to 2010 found 42 possible cases. Histological review confirmed 12: four choriocarcinomas, five partial moles, and three complete moles, with no metastasis. Most patients presented with abdominal pain or vaginal bleeding, and ultrasound diagnosed 19% of ectopic pregnancies. Three ectopic choriocarcinomas required chemotherapy, all achieving remission. The authors emphasize that ectopic GTD is rare and overdiagnosed, that central pathology review is valuable, and that prognosis is excellent.

pmid-22838253.summary_ja: 複雑な経過をたどった妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の5例を集積し、胸部外科手術が診断や管理に大きく寄与したことを報告。肺転移は本疾患で比較的多いが予後不良因子とはされない。しかし、診断の確定や薬剤耐性病巣の根治的切除を目的として開胸術および転移巣切除術が必要となる場合がある。単施設の経験に基づき、この稀な患者群で胸部外科手術を検討すべき状況が提案されている。
pmid-22838253.summary_en: This case series describes five patients with complicated gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (GTN) in whom thoracic surgery contributed significantly to diagnosis or management. Lung metastases are common in GTN and not considered adverse prognostic features, but occasionally thoracotomy and metastatectomy are needed either to establish a diagnosis or to resect drug-resistant disease with curative intent. Based on this single-center experience, the authors suggest criteria for when thoracic surgery should be considered in this rare patient group.

pmid-22840865.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者144例を後方視的に解析し、治療前後の糸球体濾過量を比較した。化学療法を受けた群では糸球体濾過量の有意な低下がみられ、CKD病期3の新規発症率が9.9%と、化学療法を受けなかった群(0%)より有意に高かった。生存者の長期的な腎リスクを理解し、患者への説明に役立つ知見である。
pmid-22840865.summary_en: This retrospective institutional study of 144 patients with testicular germ cell tumor compared renal function before and after treatment. Patients receiving systemic chemotherapy had a significant decline in estimated glomerular filtration rate and a markedly higher risk of new-onset CKD stage 3 (9.9% versus 0%) than those treated without chemotherapy. The findings clarify long-term renal risks in testicular germ cell tumor survivors and can inform patient counseling.

pmid-22852029.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iおよび進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最新の標準治療をまとめた総説。積極的監視、PEB化学療法、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清、化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清の適応と再発率、順行性射精喪失などの合併症を解説し、複雑な手術は経験豊富な施設で行うべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22852029.summary_en: This review summarizes current best practice for clinical stage I and advanced testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumours. It covers active surveillance, primary chemotherapy with PEB, nerve-sparing RPLND, and the indications for postchemotherapy RPLND. Relapse rates across these strategies are discussed, along with complications such as loss of antegrade ejaculation. Salvage chemotherapy is recommended for rising markers, and the authors stress that complex retroperitoneal surgery should be performed only in experienced centres.

pmid-22854062.summary_ja: 乳房腫瘤と巨大腹部腫瘤を呈した女性で、化生性乳癌と卵巣奇形腫の同時発症を報告した症例報告。乳癌に対し改良根治乳房切除術、卵巣奇形腫に対し腹腔鏡下切除と化学療法6コースを実施した。術後10か月の時点で再発はなく、両疾患が同一患者に併存した例は初報告とされ、両者の関連を考察している。
pmid-22854062.summary_en: This case report describes a woman who presented with a breast mass and a giant abdominal mass. She was diagnosed with metaplastic breast carcinoma with sarcomatous components and a simultaneous ovarian teratoma. Treatment included modified radical mastectomy, laparoscopic excision of the teratoma, and six courses of chemotherapy. At ten months she remained under follow-up without recurrence. The authors state that this combination has not been reported before and discuss a possible link between metaplastic breast carcinoma and ovarian teratoma.

pmid-22856447.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の患者に両側同時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍が生じた症例を報告した論文。両側精巣腫瘍は稀で大半が異時性であること、停留精巣では発生率が高いことを踏まえ、両側停留精巣に伴う同時性両側腫瘍は極めて稀で既報がないと述べている。抄録のため治療の詳細は限られる。
pmid-22856447.summary_en: This report describes bilateral synchronous testicular germ cell tumours in a patient with bilateral cryptorchidism. The authors note that bilateral testicular tumours are rare, with most being metachronous, and that testicular tumour incidence is elevated in cryptorchidism. They state that synchronous bilateral tumours in bilateral cryptorchidism are extremely rare and probably not previously reported. As an abstract, it offers limited detail on diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-22859813.summary_ja: 前駆症状の後に恐怖、せん妄、自傷、認知障害などを呈した33歳女性で、症状発現から50日後に抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された症例報告。卵巣の類皮嚢腫を認めたため腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術を行い、24時間以内に認知機能と食欲の改善がみられた。卵巣奇形腫の早期摘出の重要性と、精神疾患と誤認しないことの必要性を強調している。
pmid-22859813.summary_en: A 33-year-old nulliparous woman developed psychiatric and behavioural symptoms, including terror, delirium, self-harm, and cognitive impairment, after a brief prodrome. Anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis was diagnosed 50 days after onset. Following detection of a dermoid cyst, laparoscopic oophorectomy was performed, and cognitive function and appetite improved within 24 hours. The report emphasizes that early removal of an ovarian teratoma may improve prognosis and that such presentations should not be dismissed as hysteria.

pmid-22863192.summary_ja: 本研究は、若年発症がんの116組の患者－両親トリオと罹患していない同胞からなる382ゲノムを解析し、新生の生殖系列コピー数多型(CNV)を調べた。固有の新生CNVは乳がんおよび大腸がんのトリオと対照では認められなかったが、精巣胚細胞腫瘍のトリオ43組の7%で認められ、これはバックグラウンドの率を超えていた。これらの知見は、一部のヒト悪性腫瘍、特に精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感受性に関わる、まれな新生遺伝機序を示唆している。
pmid-22863192.summary_en: This study analyzed 382 genomes from 116 early-onset cancer case-parent trios and unaffected siblings to look for de novo germline copy-number variations (CNVs). Unique de novo CNVs were absent in breast and colon cancer trios and controls but occurred in 7% of 43 testicular germ cell tumor trios, a rate exceeding background levels. The findings suggest a rare de novo genetic mechanism underlying susceptibility to some human malignancies, particularly testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-22866184.summary_ja: 出生前に診断されていなかった胎児仙尾部奇形腫が、腫瘤により経腟分娩を突然停止させた症例を報告した。現在の周産期管理ではこのような合併症は極めてまれである。予期せず遭遇した場合は、緊急開腹による腫瘤の縮小が遅延した分娩の完遂につながる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22866184.summary_en: This report describes a fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma that remained undiagnosed antenatally and caused sudden arrest of an otherwise uncomplicated vaginal delivery when the tumor mass obstructed the birth canal. Such complications are very rare in the current era of widespread antenatal care. The authors suggest that when this situation is unexpectedly encountered, urgent laparotomy followed by reduction of the tumor mass may allow completion of the delayed delivery. The case highlights the obstetric challenge posed by unrecognized large sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-22868508.summary_ja: 慢性腹膜透析中の21歳男性に生じた縦隔セミノーマの症例である。エトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法を血液透析と併用し、ペグフィルグラスチムで支持した。緑膿菌感染症を合併したが腫瘍反応は速やかで、診断後17か月時点まで寛解が続いている。
pmid-22868508.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man on chronic peritoneal dialysis with a mediastinal seminoma. He was treated with etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy combined with daily hemodialysis, using a dose-adjusted schedule with pegylated filgrastim support. His course was complicated by a Pseudomonas infection, but tumor response was prompt and remission persisted 17 months after diagnosis. The authors consider this the second report of chemotherapy in a hemodialysis patient with extragonadal GCT and suggest that the protocol is feasible and may yield favorable outcomes.

pmid-22868632.summary_ja: 本症例報告は外陰部卵黄嚢腫瘍を提示する。極めてまれで悪性度が高く、1年以内に再発することが多い腫瘍である。報告された外陰部YSTとしては13例目にあたる。患者の再発は、この腫瘍について文献で報告された中で最長のフォローアップ期間の後に生じた。本報告は、まれな婦人科の胚細胞腫瘍の長期的な臨床経過を記録し、このような患者に長期のサーベイランスが必要であることを示している。
pmid-22868632.summary_en: This case report presents a vulvar yolk sac tumor, an extremely rare and highly malignant tumor that frequently recurs within a year. It is the 13th reported case of vulvar YST. The patient's recurrence occurred after the longest follow-up period reported in the literature for this tumor. The report documents the long-term clinical course of a rare gynecologic germ cell tumor and underscores the need for extended surveillance in such patients.

pmid-22870019.summary_ja: 46,XYの核型を持つアンドロゲン不応症候群の成人女性例である。重度の腹痛で受診した腹部腫瘍から、ジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍が認められ、悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。成人期に初めて診断された場合は、フォローアップが適切な選択肢となり得る。
pmid-22870019.summary_en: This report describes a 46,XY adult woman with androgen insensitivity syndrome who presented with severe abdominal pain after 15 years of marriage. Microscopy of an abdominal tumor showed germinoma and yolk sac tumor with adjacent seminiferous tubules, leading to a final diagnosis of malignant mixed germ cell tumor. These patients have a 5 to 10 percent risk of germ cell tumors after secondary sexual development. The authors suggest that surveillance may be the most appropriate option when such conditions are first diagnosed in adulthood.

pmid-22870372.summary_ja: 本報告は、出生前に診断された巨大な仙尾部奇形腫の切除中に心停止を起こした早産児2例を記載している。1例は高カリウム血症が原因であったが、もう1例はそれ以外の原因によるものであった。早産児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫に対する麻酔管理上の注意点を考察し、電解質異常や大量出血に備えた周到な準備と監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-22870372.summary_en: This report describes two premature neonates who suffered cardiac arrest during excision of large, prenatally diagnosed sacrococcygeal teratomas. One arrest was attributed to hyperkalemia, while the other had a different cause. The authors discuss anesthetic considerations for premature infants with huge sacrococcygeal teratomas. They emphasize that resection in this population carries high perinatal mortality, largely from electrolyte imbalance and massive bleeding. The case series highlights the need for meticulous perioperative preparation, including careful monitoring of potassium and hemodynamic status, to reduce the risk of intraoperative cardiac arrest.

pmid-22877235.summary_ja: 1973年から2011年に治療された小児24例の後方視的レビューで、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の特徴を記述している。13例が成熟奇形腫、4例が卵黄嚢腫瘍、4例が未熟奇形腫、3例がその他の悪性組織型であった。成熟奇形腫は外科的切除のみで無病を維持した。卵黄嚢腫瘍と悪性奇形腫の患者は予後不良で、化学療法と放射線療法を受けても多くが死亡した。著者らは、成熟奇形腫には補助療法は不要、未熟奇形腫には慎重なサーベイランスが必要、悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍には集中的な化学療法と局所制御が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-22877235.summary_en: This retrospective review of 24 children treated between 1973 and 2011 characterizes mediastinal germ cell tumors. Thirteen were mature teratomas, four were endodermal sinus tumors, four were immature teratomas, and three had other malignant histologies. Mature teratomas required only surgical resection and remained disease-free. Patients with endodermal sinus tumors and malignant teratomas had poor outcomes, and many died despite chemotherapy and radiotherapy. The authors conclude that mature teratomas need no adjuvant therapy, immature teratomas need close surveillance, and malignant mediastinal GCTs require intensive chemotherapy and local control.

pmid-22882535.summary_ja: ノルウェーの651例の精巣がん症例と313例の対照を比較した症例対照研究である。LHR、SRD5A2、ARの遺伝子多型を解析し、LHR Asn312Serのヘテロ接合体で精巣がんのリスク低下（OR 0.66）が認められた。セミノーマと非セミノーマの間に有意差はなかった。LHR遺伝子の多様性が精巣がん感受性に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22882535.summary_en: This Norwegian case-control study of 651 testicular cancer cases and 313 controls examined polymorphisms in the luteinizing hormone receptor (LHR), 5-alpha-reductase II (SRD5A2), and androgen receptor (AR) genes. A heterozygous LHR Asn312Ser genotype was associated with lower odds of testicular cancer (OR 0.66). No significant difference was found between seminoma and non-seminoma subtypes. The authors suggest that genetic variation in the LHR gene may influence susceptibility to testicular cancer, consistent with the hypothesis that in utero sex hormone imbalance contributes to risk.

pmid-22883319.summary_ja: 本症例集積は、1980年から2002年の間に大学病院の顎顔面外科で治療を受けた口腔奇形腫の5例（女児4例、男児1例）を報告する。ほとんどの新生児には口蓋裂、二分舌、鼻類皮嚢腫などの先天奇形が合併していた。全例で全身麻酔下に腫瘍を基部で切除し、組織学的に奇形腫に典型的な複数の組織成分が確認された。平均8年のフォローアップでは再発は認められず、著者らは、完全な外科的切除により、これらのまれな小児病変で持続的な局所制御が得られることを示唆している。
pmid-22883319.summary_en: This case series reports five patients with oral teratomas, four girls and one boy, treated at a university maxillofacial surgery department between 1980 and 2002. Most affected newborns had associated congenital malformations, including cleft palate, bifid tongue, and nasal dermoid cyst. All tumors were excised at their base under general anesthesia, and histology showed mixed tissue components typical of teratomas. After a mean follow-up of eight years, no recurrence was detected, suggesting that complete surgical excision yields durable local control in these rare pediatric lesions.

pmid-22883659.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、甲状腺癌を含む卵巣奇形腫である悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の患者6例について、その臨床像と術後管理を記述している。患者は腹痛、圧迫感、月経異常などを呈し、初回の婦人科的切除の後、甲状腺全摘術と放射性ヨウ素療法を受けた。全例が中央値60か月のフォローアップ時点で寛解していた。著者らは、甲状腺全摘術、放射性ヨウ素、長期フォローアップを組み合わせた積極的な術後管理を支持している。
pmid-22883659.summary_en: This retrospective review of six patients with malignant struma ovarii, a rare ovarian teratoma containing malignant thyroid carcinoma, describes their presentation and postoperative management. Patients presented with abdominal pain, pressure, or menstrual problems and initially underwent gynecological resection with specialized pathology review. All six then received total thyroidectomy and radioactive iodine therapy, and all remained in remission at a median follow-up of 60 months. The authors favor aggressive postoperative management with total thyroidectomy, radioiodine, and long-term follow-up.

pmid-22884658.summary_ja: 本ランダム化比較試験は、類皮嚢腫を有する女性67例を対象に、卵巣の内側切開と反内側切開による腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術を比較した。内側アプローチは、嚢胞内容物の漏出と手術時間を有意に減少させ、化学性腹膜炎の発生例はなかった。術後のFSH値は低く、基底胞状卵胞数、卵巣径、最高収縮期血流速度は高く、卵巣予備能の温存が示唆された。著者らは、内側切開が腹腔鏡下類皮嚢腫摘出術において安全で組織温存的な術式であると結論づけている。
pmid-22884658.summary_en: This randomized controlled trial of 67 women with dermoid cysts compared laparoscopic cystectomy performed through a mesial ovarian incision with an antimesial incision. The mesial approach significantly reduced intracystic spillage and operative time, and no patient developed chemical peritonitis. Postoperative FSH was lower, and basal antral follicle count, ovarian diameter, and peak systolic velocity were higher, indicating better ovarian reserve preservation. The authors conclude that the mesial incision is a safe, tissue-sparing technique for laparoscopic dermoid cystectomy.

pmid-22892230.summary_ja: 若年男性の右上葉肺病変は悪性腫瘍に類似し、感染症として治療されることが多かった。切除により成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。完全切除で予後は良好である一方、未治療では喀血や悪性転化・転移性疾患を来しうる。肺病変の鑑別診断に奇形腫を含める重要性を示す症例報告である。
pmid-22892230.summary_en: A young man presented with a right upper lobe lung lesion that mimicked malignancy and was often treated as infection. Resection established a diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma, an extremely rare intrapulmonary germ cell-derived tumor. The authors emphasize that complete resection gives an excellent prognosis, while untreated benign cystic teratoma may cause hemoptysis or malignant transformation with metastatic disease. The report highlights including teratoma in the differential diagnosis of pulmonary lesions.

pmid-22893003.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往があり血清hCGが高値の26歳女性に、右上葉の孤立性肺結節が見つかった。FDG-PETの集積は弱く(SUVmax 2.0)、当初は血管奇形と考えられた。フォローアップCTで急速な増大が確認され部分切除が行われ、絨毛癌の肺転移と診断された。広範な壊死と出血が非典型的な画像所見の原因と考えられた。
pmid-22893003.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with a prior hydatidiform mole and high serum hCG had a solitary right upper lobe lung nodule that showed only weak FDG uptake (SUVmax 2.0) and was initially thought to be a vascular malformation. Rapid growth on follow-up CT prompted partial lobectomy. Pathology showed pulmonary metastasis from choriocarcinoma, with extensive necrosis and hemorrhage that likely explained the atypical PET and CT appearances. The case shows how choriocarcinoma metastasis can mislead imaging.

pmid-22895825.summary_ja: 精巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍52例の組織マイクロアレイで、CDX2の核発現を検討した。絨毛癌、奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍で陽性例を認めたが、古典的セミノーマでは3%にとどまった。精細管内胚細胞腫瘍と正常精細管は全例陰性であった。CDX2発現は原発不明癌の鑑別で誤りを招く可能性があり、消化管原発と誤認される臨床的潜在性精巣腫瘍に注意が必要と述べている。
pmid-22895825.summary_en: Tissue microarray analysis of 52 malignant testicular germ cell tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma and choriocarcinoma, found CDX2 nuclear positivity in choriocarcinoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor, but only 3% of classic seminomas. Intratubular germ cell neoplasia and normal tubules were negative. CDX2 expression could mislead the workup of metastases of unknown primary, which may be a clinically occult testicular tumor rather than a gastrointestinal primary.

pmid-22897071.summary_ja: 33歳男性が胸痛、動悸、体重減少を訴え、甲状腺機能亢進症と著明なhCG高値を示した。左精巣腫瘍と肺、肝、後腹膜の転移が判明した。抗甲状腺薬とβ遮断薬で治療し、緊急精巣摘除術を行い、類器官型の胎児性癌と診断された。術後24時間で予期せず死亡した。精巣腫瘍のまれな症状として甲状腺機能亢進症に留意すべきである。
pmid-22897071.summary_en: A 33-year-old man developed chest pain, palpitations and weight loss from hyperthyroidism, with very high hCG, and was found to have a left testicular tumor with lung, liver and retroperitoneal metastases. Antithyroid drugs and beta-blockers were started, and urgent orchiectomy showed organoid-type embryonal carcinoma. He died unexpectedly 24 hours later. The authors propose that hyperthyroidism, a rare manifestation of testicular tumors, should be considered alongside hCG levels.

pmid-22898258.summary_ja: 42歳男性が右陰嚢内の腫瘤で受診し、組織学的に原発性精巣傍セミノーマと診断された。根治的精巣摘除術後、精巣内にはセミノーマを認めなかった。精巣病変を伴わない原発性精巣傍セミノーマは極めてまれで、文献検索で本症例は2例目と報告されている。
pmid-22898258.summary_en: A 42-year-old man presented with a right scrotal mass, and histology confirmed a primary paratesticular seminoma. Radical orchidectomy revealed no testicular seminoma. The authors note that primary paratesticular seminoma without testicular involvement is extremely rare, and after a literature review they report only the second such case. This short case report shows that seminoma can arise outside the testis.

pmid-22901819.summary_ja: 42歳男性に発生した31cmの巨大な病期I純粋精巣セミノーマの症例を報告。組織学的に純粋セミノーマであったが、初診時に血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)がわずかに上昇していた。未認識の非セミノーマ成分などが原因として考察され、腫瘍マーカーの解釈の重要性を示している。
pmid-22901819.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with a very large 31 cm stage I pure testicular seminoma. Despite a pure seminoma histology, serum alpha-fetoprotein was mildly elevated at presentation, which the authors discuss as possibly reflecting unrecognized nonseminomatous elements or rare benign causes. The report reviews typical features of testicular germ cell tumors, including painless enlargement, retroperitoneal spread, and the limited value of AFP in pure seminoma. It highlights the importance of careful pathological assessment and marker interpretation.

pmid-22901920.summary_ja: 中国の単施設で1997～2008年に治療した思春期前の精巣・精巣傍腫瘍63例を後方視的に検討。成熟奇形腫が最多で、卵黄嚢腫瘍がこれに次いだ。精巣温存手術は15例に行われ、卵黄嚢腫瘍1例に再発・転移が生じたが、大半は無病生存であった。良性病変の多くには、より侵襲の少ない治療が適すると結論づけている。
pmid-22901920.summary_en: This 11-year single-center series from China reviewed 63 prepubertal boys with testicular and paratesticular tumors, with a median age of 11 months. Mature teratoma was the most common histology, followed by yolk sac tumor. Most presented with a painless scrotal mass, and testis-sparing surgery was performed in 15 patients. One yolk sac tumor recurred with metastasis, but most patients were disease free at a median follow-up of 50 months. The authors conclude that prepubertal lesions are mostly benign and that conservative surgery is appropriate for benign disease.

pmid-22901924.summary_ja: 新生児期に腸閉塞で発症した男児例を報告。肛門狭窄、仙骨前奇形腫、仙骨奇形を伴い、Currarino症候群と診断された。人工肛門造設後に奇形腫の後方矢状切開による切除と肛門直腸修復を行った。HLXB9遺伝子変異が家族にも認められ、遺伝的要因の重要性を示す。
pmid-22901924.summary_en: This case report describes a male neonate presenting with bowel obstruction due to Currarino syndrome, with anal stenosis, a presacral teratoma, and a sacral anomaly. Initial management was a defunctioning colostomy, followed by posterior sagittal excision of the teratoma and anorectal repair. The authors note that the proband's sister also had Currarino features diagnosed later and that the HLXB9 mutation was identified in the proband, sister, and mother. The case highlights that presacral teratoma can present in the neonatal period and be associated with hereditary anorectal and sacral anomalies.

pmid-22901929.summary_ja: 3歳男児の無症候性の陰嚢内精巣間腫瘤が類皮嚢腫と診断された症例報告。血清腫瘍マーカー(AFP、β-hCG)は陰性で、ドプラ超音波検査で血流は認めなかった。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)により右海綿体を経て後部尿道に達する進展範囲が明らかとなり、安全な切除に役立った。小児の無痛性陰嚢腫瘤の鑑別診断に含めるべきと述べている。
pmid-22901929.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-year-old boy with an asymptomatic intertesticular scrotal mass that was ultimately diagnosed as a dermoid cyst. Serum tumor markers AFP and beta-hCG were negative, and Doppler ultrasound showed no blood flow. MRI defined the lesion's extension through the right corpus cavernosum to the posterior urethra, which guided safe surgical excision. The authors emphasize that benign dermoid cysts should be considered in the differential diagnosis of painless pediatric scrotal masses, and that MRI is valuable for anatomic delineation.

pmid-22905472.summary_ja: 帝王切開時に胎盤外の子宮前壁に約3cmの有茎性病変を偶然認めた症例報告。組織学的に中間型栄養膜細胞の過剰増殖を示したが、Ki-67指数は低く核分裂像は認めなかった。中間型栄養膜細胞腫瘍との鑑別が重要で、後者は手術や化学療法を要しうるのに対し、過剰胎盤部反応には特別な治療やフォローアップは不要である。
pmid-22905472.summary_en: This case report describes an exaggerated placental site (EPS) reaction, a physiologic exuberant trophoblastic proliferation, found incidentally during cesarean delivery as a 3 cm polypoid lesion on the uterine wall separate from the placenta. Histology showed exuberant intermediate trophoblast proliferation with low Ki-67 index and no mitoses. The authors stress that EPS reaction must be distinguished from intermediate trophoblastic tumors, which may require surgery or chemotherapy, whereas EPS reaction needs no specific treatment or follow-up. Biopsy of suspicious placental-site lesions is recommended.

pmid-22906432.summary_ja: 完全性性腺形成不全とターナー症候群に伴う性腺芽腫の2症例を報告。1例ではディスジャーミノーマの増殖を認めた。FISHでは両成分にY染色体配列が検出され、12p等染色体(isochromosome 12p)はディスジャーミノーマにのみ認められた。ディスジャーミノーマの増殖は予後不良因子であり、追加治療が必要である。
pmid-22906432.summary_en: This report describes two cases of gonadoblastoma associated with gonadal dysgenesis: one with complete gonadal dysgenesis and one with Turner syndrome. In one case, dysgerminoma overgrowth was present. Cytophotometry showed diploid DNA in gonadoblastoma and aneuploid DNA in dysgerminoma. FISH detected Y chromosome sequences in both components, while isochromosome 12p was found only in the dysgerminoma. The authors conclude that dysgerminoma overgrowth arises from additional chromosomal aberrations such as i(12p), which carries an adverse prognosis.

pmid-22909019.summary_ja: スロバキア共和国の1968～2006年の精巣がんの動向を解析。罹患率は急増したが、死亡率は安定し、1990年以降は軽度の減少傾向を示した。1993～2002年のコホートでは5年相対生存率が約92～93%であった。診断時の平均年齢はセミノーマで30～41歳、非セミノーマで23～34歳であった。国際比較も行われている。
pmid-22909019.summary_en: This population-based study analyzes testicular cancer trends in the Slovak Republic from 1968 to 2006. Incidence rose sharply, while mortality stabilized and showed a mildly significant decline after 1990. Five-year relative survival reached about 92-93% in the 1993-2002 cohorts. The average age at diagnosis was about 30-41 years for seminomas and 23-34 years for nonseminomas. The results are presented alongside international comparisons.

pmid-22915425.summary_ja: 精巣上体炎を伴う患者14例、16か所の局所的な精巣病変を対象に、造影超音波検査の有用性を検討した研究である。無血管性の病変では、造影超音波により梗塞や膿瘍と腫瘍を区別する手がかりが得られた。組織学的検査では梗塞、膿瘍、セミノーマが確認され、他の病変は超音波による経過観察で消失が確認された。造影超音波は、カラードプラ超音波を補完して無血管性の精巣組織を性状診断するうえで有用であると結論づけられている。
pmid-22915425.summary_en: This study assessed contrast-enhanced ultrasound for focal testicular lesions found in patients with epididymitis. Among 16 lesions in 14 patients, CEUS helped distinguish avascular infarction and abscess from tumor. Histology confirmed infarction, abscess, and seminoma, while follow-up ultrasound confirmed resolution in others. CEUS was a useful adjunct to color Doppler for characterizing nonvascularized testicular tissue.

pmid-22923694.summary_ja: 本マウス研究は、感受性の高い129/Sv背景において、Apobec1の用量が単独で、またはDnd1と組み合わせて、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の感受性を修飾するかを検討したものである。父系のApobec1欠損は従来型の様式でTGCTリスクを上昇させた一方、母系の部分欠損は遺伝性のエピジェネティック変化を介して世代を超える様式でリスクを低下させた。これらの変化は複数世代にわたって持続し、交互の生殖細胞系列での交配により元に戻った。
pmid-22923694.summary_en: This mouse study tests whether Apobec1 dosage modifies susceptibility to testicular germ cell tumors on a susceptible 129/Sv background, alone or with Dnd1. Paternal Apobec1 deficiency increased TGCT risk conventionally, whereas maternal partial deficiency reduced TGCT risk transgenerationally via heritable epigenetic changes. These changes persisted for multiple generations and reversed with alternate germ-line crosses.

pmid-22924141.summary_ja: 妊娠23週で仙尾部奇形腫を二次元および三次元超音波検査により出生前診断した症例報告である。充実性・嚢胞性成分と石灰化を伴う腫瘤を認め、胎児は25週で死亡した。三次元超音波検査は病変の範囲評価と両親の理解に有用であった。予後不良因子についても言及している。
pmid-22924141.summary_en: This case report describes prenatal diagnosis of sacrococcygeal teratoma at 23 weeks using two- and three-dimensional ultrasonography. The mass had solid and cystic components, calcifications, and internal flow. The fetus died at 25 weeks, and postnatal findings confirmed the diagnosis. Three-dimensional ultrasonography helped characterize lesion extent and aided parental understanding of the condition.

pmid-22925191.summary_ja: オランダの登録記録に基づく後方視的コホート研究で、1971〜2011年にGTNで死亡した26例を解析した。死亡数は40年間で減少し、リスク分類導入後に顕著だった。早期死亡の一部は治療関連、後期死亡の多くは転移性腫瘍によるものだった。過期妊娠後の絨毛癌が死亡例の多くを占め、高リスク群として扱うべきと提案されている。
pmid-22925191.summary_en: This Dutch retrospective cohort study reviewed 26 women who died from gestational trophoblastic neoplasia between 1971 and 2011, using national registry records. Deaths declined markedly over four decades, mostly after risk classification was introduced. Early deaths were sometimes treatment-related, while later deaths mainly resulted from metastatic disease. Women with post-term choriocarcinoma formed a large share of fatalities, leading the authors to propose that they be managed as high-risk disease. The authors emphasize accurate risk stratification to guide initial therapy and prevent drug resistance.

pmid-22934149.summary_ja: 28歳女性で、縦隔と左卵巣に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が併存していたという症例報告である。健康診断で偶然発見された。奇形腫は全能性細胞の発生異常により生じる胚細胞腫瘍で、主に性腺に、まれに縦隔に発生する。異なる部位の奇形腫の同時併存が稀であることが報告の意義である。
pmid-22934149.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman had a mature cystic teratoma in the mediastinum and in the left ovary, found incidentally during a health check. The authors report this case because the simultaneous occurrence of two mature teratomas at different sites is rare. Teratomas are germ cell tumors arising from abnormal development of totipotential cells, most commonly in the gonads and occasionally in the mediastinum. The authors describe the case as unusual in its coexistence rather than in its management.

pmid-22937135.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)の性腺芽腫・ディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)16例と、DSDのない卵巣未分化胚細胞腫15例のc-KIT変異を解析した。DSDのない例では53%に活性型c-KIT変異を認めた。OCT3/4は全例で陽性で、TSPYの発現はDSD例の腫瘍のみに認められた。c-KITとTSPYの状態から、ディスジャーミノーマの発生には二つの並行経路があると提唱されている。
pmid-22937135.summary_en: This study analyzed c-KIT and PDGFRA mutations in 31 patients: 16 with disorders of sex development presenting with gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, and 15 with pure ovarian dysgerminomas without DSD. c-KIT codon 816 mutations were found in five cases, all in pure ovarian dysgerminomas, and activating c-KIT mutations overall occurred in 53% of non-DSD cases. DSD cases showed rare N505I and D820E variants in one tumor. No PDGFRA mutations were detected. OCT3/4 was expressed in all lesions, while TSPY expression was limited to DSD tumors. The authors propose two parallel pathways of dysgerminoma development.

pmid-22938171.summary_ja: 28歳男性が閉塞性黄疸で受診し、肝門部リンパ節転移と高度のβ-hCG上昇(11,000IU/ml)を認めた。精巣摘除術により純粋絨毛癌と診断された。肺転移もあり、化学療法を行ったが1か月後に死亡した。精巣がんが胆汁うっ滞様症状で発症した稀な症例を、文献レビューとともに報告している。
pmid-22938171.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man with obstructive jaundice caused by hepatic hilar lymph node metastases. Markedly elevated serum beta-hCG (11,000 IU/ml) and a testicular nodule led to the diagnosis of pure choriocarcinoma of the testis, confirmed by orchidectomy. Pulmonary metastasis was also present. Despite general chemotherapy, the patient died one month later. The authors review the literature and emphasize this unusual presentation of testicular cancer that mimicked cholestasis.

pmid-22938868.summary_ja: 化学療法後に残存する精巣がんの管理を、文献検索と専門家の合意に基づいて総説している。非セミノーマでは1cm以上の残存腫瘤に後腹膜リンパ節郭清が推奨され、奇形腫のみの場合は高い治癒率が得られる。セミノーマでは3cm未満の腫瘤は経過観察が可能とされる。救済療法における大量化学療法の有用性は議論が残るとしている。
pmid-22938868.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of testis cancer after first-line chemotherapy, based on a Medline search and expert consensus. Mature teratoma or viable GCT in residual nonseminomatous masses of at least 1 cm supports postchemotherapy RPLND, with cure rates above 90% when only teratoma is resected. In seminoma, masses under 3 cm may be observed, while larger PET-positive masses warrant selective surgery. Late relapse is rare, and resection remains central for chemoresistant disease. The benefit of high-dose chemotherapy in salvage therapy remains debated.

pmid-22940535.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍由来の2種の細胞株(野生型NTera-2、p53変異型NCCIT)を用い、ブレオマイシンによる酸化ストレスに対するNACの効果を検討した基礎研究である。ブレオマイシンと過酸化水素は脂質過酸化などを増加させ、グルタチオンを低下させた。NACの同時投与によりこれらの変化は抑制された。ブレオマイシン由来の酸化ストレスをNACが軽減すると結論づけている。
pmid-22940535.summary_en: This experimental study examined whether N-acetyl-L-cysteine (NAC) reduces oxidative stress induced by bleomycin in two testicular cancer cell lines, wild-type NTera-2 and p53-mutant NCCIT. Bleomycin and hydrogen peroxide increased lipid peroxidation and protein carbonyl markers while lowering glutathione and antioxidant capacity. Co-incubation with NAC reversed these changes and restored glutathione levels. The authors conclude that NAC mitigates bleomycin-induced oxidative damage in testicular germ cell tumor cells.

pmid-22941667.summary_ja: SEERデータ(1973〜2008年)を用い、15〜74歳の白人男性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の罹患率を年齢・期間・コホートモデルで解析した。セミノーマは非セミノーマより増加が速かった。暦年期間の偏差は全体およびセミノーマで有意であり、出生後の曝露が病因上重要であることを示唆している。
pmid-22941667.summary_en: This population-based analysis of SEER data from 1973 to 2008 examined age-period-cohort models of testicular germ cell tumor incidence in white men aged 15 to 74. Seminoma incidence rose faster than nonseminoma, and calendar period deviations were highly significant for all TGCT and seminoma models. Effects on nonseminoma were weaker. The authors conclude that period effects are significant, challenging the view that only in utero exposures drive TGCT development and suggesting that postnatal exposures are etiologically relevant.

pmid-22949908.summary_ja: 病期IIのセミノーマに対し、大動脈傍リンパ節への40Gyの放射線療法を受けた男性3例の報告である。治療4〜9か月後に両脚の筋力低下が出現した。腰仙部神経叢や脊髄の放射線障害が考えられ、2例は完全に回復した。治療は対症療法であり、病態は不明な点が多いと述べている。
pmid-22949908.summary_en: This report describes three men treated for stage II seminoma with para-aortic radiotherapy (40 Gy, hockey-stick fields) who developed bilateral leg weakness four to nine months later. Symptoms were attributed to lumbosacral plexus or spinal cord injury from radiation. Two patients fully recovered, while the remaining treatment was symptomatic. The authors discuss uncertain pathophysiology, including direct toxicity and microinfarction, and note that limited data make frequency and outcome hard to estimate.

pmid-22951007.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の正中傍腹膜外アプローチを記述し、12例を経腹膜アプローチの対照例と後方視的に比較した。手術時間と出血量は少なく、リンパ節回収数は多く、腸管機能の回復と在院期間の短縮が見られた。安全に施行可能で合併症を減らしうるとしている。ただし追跡期間は短く、結論の確定には更なる検討が必要である。
pmid-22951007.summary_en: This technical report describes a midline extraperitoneal approach to retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular germ cell tumor. Twelve consecutive patients, including seven after chemotherapy, were compared with matched transperitoneal controls. The extraperitoneal group had shorter operative time, less blood loss, higher lymph node yield, earlier return of bowel function, and shorter hospital stay. The authors conclude the approach is safe and may reduce morbidity, though follow-up was short and the design was retrospective.

pmid-22952821.summary_ja: 胚性幹細胞を免疫不全マウスに移植して奇形癌を誘導し、無血清培養で奇形癌幹細胞株を樹立した。次世代シーケンスにより悪性度の変化に関連する26遺伝子を同定し、Gata3、Arnt、Tdgf1、PHC1、Utyなどが含まれた。Wntシグナル経路が関与する可能性が示された。初期発癌に関わる候補遺伝子と経路を提案している。
pmid-22952821.summary_en: This study established a mouse teratocarcinoma stem cell line by injecting embryonic stem cells into immunodeficient mice and serially transplanting teratocarcinoma-derived stem cells. High-throughput sequencing identified 26 differentially expressed genes linked to increasing malignancy, including Gata3, Arnt, Tdgf1, PHC1 and Uty. Pathway analysis implicated Wnt signaling and immune-related pathways. The authors propose these candidates may drive early tumorigenesis, offering a model for studying the malignant progression of teratocarcinoma.

pmid-22953296.summary_ja: 7歳女児が感染した後腹膜奇形腫の破裂による急性腹症と腹膜炎で受診した症例報告である。後腹膜奇形腫は通常無症状だが、成人では稀に腹腔内膿瘍や腹膜炎で発症することが報告されている。小児でも後腹膜奇形腫が破裂して重篤な急性腹症を来しうるため、小児の急性腹症の鑑別に含めるべきことを示している。
pmid-22953296.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-year-old girl who presented with an acute abdomen caused by rupture of an infected retroperitoneal teratoma, leading to peritonitis. Retroperitoneal teratomas are usually asymptomatic, but in rare cases they present as intra-abdominal abscesses or peritonitis in adults. The report shows that pediatric retroperitoneal teratomas can rupture and cause serious acute abdominal emergencies. Clinicians should therefore consider them in the differential diagnosis of acute abdomen in children.

pmid-22962582.summary_ja: 卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍のバイオマーカーとしてカリオフェリン2(KPNA2)を検討した。KPNA2は卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマ、胎児性癌などで過剰発現しており、SALL4と正の相関を示した。KPNA2高発現は再発、化学療法抵抗性、5年全生存期間(全生存率)・無病生存期間の低下と関連し、独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-22962582.summary_en: This study investigated karyopherin 2 (KPNA2) as a biomarker in ovarian malignant germ cell tumors. KPNA2 was overexpressed in yolk sac tumors, immature teratomas, dysgerminomas, embryonal carcinomas and mature teratomas with malignant transformation, and it correlated with SALL4 expression. High KPNA2 was associated with recurrence, ascites, suboptimal cytoreductive surgery, chemotherapy resistance and higher hCG levels.
