Patients with high KPNA2 had significantly lower 5-year overall survival and disease-free survival. KPNA2 was an independent prognostic factor.

pmid-22963770.summary_ja: 幹細胞転写因子NANOGが、ヒト胎児性癌由来NCCIT細胞においてGDF3遺伝子発現を制御する機構を検討した。NANOGのノックダウンおよび過剰発現によりGDF3発現は変化し、レチノイン酸による分化誘導でも変動した。NANOGはGDF3の最小プロモーター領域に生体内で結合し、転写活性化ドメインを介して転写を活性化した。
pmid-22963770.summary_en: This study examined how the stem cell transcription factor NANOG regulates growth and differentiation factor 3 (GDF3) in NCCIT human embryonal carcinoma cells. GDF3 expression changed with NANOG knockdown and overexpression, and also during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. NANOG activated transcription through a minimal GDF3 promoter region, binding it in vivo through its transactivation domain. The findings provide the first evidence that NANOG transcriptionally activates the oncogenic growth factor GDF3 in embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-22965656.summary_ja: ロサンゼルス郡での集団ベースの症例対照研究で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者163例と、年齢などをマッチさせた対照292例の薬物使用歴を比較した。マリファナ使用は約2倍のリスク上昇と関連し、その関連は非セミノーマおよび混合型腫瘍に特異的であった。コカイン使用は低いリスクと関連した。内因性カンナビノイド系を介した影響についての機序研究が必要とされている。
pmid-22965656.summary_en: This population-based case-control study in Los Angeles County examined recreational drug use and testicular germ cell tumor risk among 163 patients and 292 matched controls. Marijuana use was associated with roughly a twofold increased risk, and this association was specific to nonseminoma and mixed histology tumors. Cocaine use was associated with lower risk. The authors suggest that cannabinoids may affect germ cell function through the endocannabinoid system and call for mechanistic studies, particularly in young men using cannabinoids therapeutically.

pmid-22978485.summary_ja: 38歳男性の精嚢原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告と文献レビューである。卵黄嚢腫瘍は性腺外に生じる稀な悪性胚細胞腫瘍である。血尿と血精液症で受診し、両側精嚢の切除で典型的な組織像が確認された。放射線療法、化学療法、追加手術に反応せず、全身転移をきたして約1年半後に死亡した。
pmid-22978485.summary_en: The authors report a 38-year-old man with a primary yolk sac tumour of the seminal vesicle, a rare extragonadal malignant germ cell tumour. Presenting with haematuria and haemospermia, he underwent resection of both seminal vesicles, which showed typical yolk sac tumour histology. Despite radiotherapy, chemotherapy, and further surgery, he developed multiple systemic metastases and died about 18 months after diagnosis. The paper also reviews the limited literature on this rare entity and its uncertain optimal treatment.

pmid-22986090.summary_ja: ノルウェーのがん登録から得たイヌの精巣セミノーマ45例を、形態学とPLAP・c-KITの免疫組織化学で検討した。2例はPLAP陽性かつc-KIT陽性で古典的セミノーマに近い染色性を示した。全例が形態学的には精母細胞性セミノーマに一致した。イヌのセミノーマをヒトモデルとする有用性は限定的である。
pmid-22986090.summary_en: The authors characterised 45 canine testicular seminomas from the Norwegian Canine Cancer Register using morphology and immunohistochemistry for PLAP and c-KIT. Two tumours showed a classical seminoma staining pattern (PLAP+/c-KIT+), but all 45 were morphologically consistent with spermatocytic seminoma. No tumours met criteria for classical seminoma, so canine seminoma appears to be a limited model for human seminoma. Regional, breed, or diagnostic criteria differences may explain discrepancies with previous studies.

pmid-22987375.summary_ja: 1991年から2010年にチュニジアで組織学的に確認された精巣がん41例を解析した。発生率は年間約2例と極めて低かった。多くが T2 または T3 で受診し、症状出現から受診まで平均16.5か月を要した。セミノーマと混合型胚細胞腫瘍が主な病理型であった。
pmid-22987375.summary_en: This study analysed 41 Tunisian men with histopathologically confirmed testicular cancer treated between 1991 and 2010, examining incidence, presentation, stage, histology, management, and survival. The incidence was very low, about two cases per year. Most patients presented at T2 or T3 after delays of over a year. Seminomas and mixed germ cell tumours were the most common types. Treatment combined radical orchidectomy with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy, and half the patients were lost to follow-up. Late presentation and limited follow-up were identified as major challenges.

pmid-22987989.summary_ja: 精巣の病期I胚細胞腫瘍は高い治癒率を示す。非セミノーマでは血管侵襲の有無で再発リスクを層別化し、陽性例にはBEP補助化学療法が推奨される。セミノーマには確立した再発リスク基準がなく、監視療法は頻回の画像検査や受診率の低さが課題となる。単回カルボプラチンは再発率を5%未満に抑える選択肢として論じられている。
pmid-22987989.summary_en: This review discusses management options for clinical stage 1 testicular germ cell tumours, which are highly curable. Orchidectomy alone cures most patients, and recurrence risk in nonseminomatous tumours is stratified by vascular invasion; adjuvant BEP chemotherapy is recommended for vascular invasion-positive cases. For seminoma, no validated recurrence risk criteria exist, and surveillance faces challenges including the need for frequent scans and poor compliance. Single-dose carboplatin reduces recurrence to under 5% and may lower second primary risk, though long-term toxicity concerns remain under study.

pmid-22988259.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫は新生児に最も多い先天性腫瘍である。本レビューは、その発生起源、画像所見、治療について、放射線技師に有用な情報を文献から整理したものである。画像診断に関わる医療従事者が患者のケアに携わる際に必要となる基礎知識を提供し、潜在的に致死的となりうる本疾患への理解を促すことを目的としている。
pmid-22988259.summary_en: This literature review summarizes the origin, imaging features, and treatment of sacrococcygeal teratoma, the most common congenital tumor in newborns. Written for radiologic technologists, it aims to give imaging professionals the fundamental knowledge needed when caring for affected patients. The review draws on peer-reviewed articles and contemporary imaging textbooks, extracting practical points for imaging workflow. The authors emphasize that this potentially fatal tumor warrants familiarity across imaging staff who may be involved in care.

pmid-22988355.summary_ja: 良性縦隔奇形腫が自然に肺および胸膜へ破裂した2症例を報告している。良性縦隔奇形腫は通常無症状で、胸膜への破裂は稀である。早期発見と適切な手術計画のためには断面画像検査が重要であると強調し、両症例の画像所見について考察している。この稀な合併症を認識することの重要性を示した報告である。
pmid-22988355.summary_en: This report describes two cases of spontaneous pulmonary and pleural rupture of benign mediastinal teratoma. Benign mediastinal teratomas are usually asymptomatic, and rupture into the pleura is rare. The authors stress that cross-sectional imaging is crucial for early detection and for planning an appropriate surgical approach. The paper discusses the imaging appearances observed in both patients, highlighting the importance of recognizing this uncommon complication.

pmid-22989902.summary_ja: 36歳男性が近時記憶障害と性格変化で発症し、抗Ma2・抗NMDA受容体・抗GluRε2抗体陽性の辺縁系脳炎と診断された。免疫療法後も記憶障害は残存した。発症11か月後に左精巣腫瘍が見つかり、病理はセミノーマであった。腫瘍随伴性脳炎が潜在性の胚細胞腫瘍の発見に先行しうることを示した症例である。
pmid-22989902.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 36-year-old man with paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis who presented with short-term memory disturbance and personality change. Brain MRI and PET showed bilateral hippocampal abnormalities, and antibodies against Ma2, NMDA receptor, and GluRε2 were detected. Immunotherapy was given, but recent memory deficits persisted. Eleven months after onset, a left testicular tumor was identified and resected, with pathology confirming seminoma. The case highlights that paraneoplastic encephalitis may precede discovery of an occult germ cell tumor.

pmid-22992236.summary_ja: 本総説は、胚細胞腫瘍に関連して発生する血液悪性腫瘍を検討したものであり、血液内科医や血液病理医にとって特有の課題となる。GCTの多くは性腺由来であるが、縦隔などの正中部の性腺外腫瘍では非セミノーマ組織型が多く、治療抵抗性や二次性血液腫瘍を生じやすい。発症機序にはKITシグナルの活性化と12p領域の過剰発現が関与する。長期生存には、ごく一部の症例で同種造血幹細胞移植または臍帯血移植が最良の選択肢であると述べている。
pmid-22992236.summary_en: This review examines hematologic malignancies arising in association with germ cell tumors, which pose a particular challenge to hematologists and hematopathologists. Most GCTs are gonadal, but extragonadal midline tumors, especially in the anterior mediastinum, are associated with nonseminomatous histology, poor response to treatment, and a tendency toward secondary hematologic neoplasia. Pathogenesis involves KIT pathway overactivity and 12p overexpression. Allogeneic stem cell or cord blood transplantation is the best option for long-term survival in a few cases.

pmid-22996776.summary_ja: 26歳男性が胸痛と血痰で受診し、経気管支肺生検で腺癌と診断された右中肺野の肺結節を切除した。病理学的に精巣原発の胎児性癌の肺転移と判明した。若年男性では、原発性肺癌と思われる肺腫瘍であっても精巣悪性腫瘍を念頭に置く必要があると指摘している。
pmid-22996776.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 26-year-old man with chest pain and bloody sputum whose right middle lung nodule was initially diagnosed as adenocarcinoma on transbronchial biopsy. Imaging showed no other lesions or lymphadenopathy. Bilobectomy with chest wall resection was performed, and pathology revealed metastasis of embryonal carcinoma from a testicular primary. The authors stress that in young men, testicular malignancy should be considered even when a lung tumor appears to be primary lung cancer.

pmid-23002208.summary_ja: 低酸素環境下で精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞が化学療法に耐性を示す機序を検討した基礎研究である。低酸素では胎児性癌細胞においてOCT4がSUMO1によるSUMO化を受けて不安定化し、シスプラチンとブレオマイシンへの感受性が低下する。SUMO脱離酵素SENP1はこの過程を抑制してOCT4を維持し、感受性を回復させた。SENP1は耐性腫瘍に対する治療標的となりうると述べている。
pmid-23002208.summary_en: This laboratory study examines why hypoxia makes testicular germ cell tumor cells resistant to chemotherapy. Under low oxygen, embryonal carcinoma cells lose OCT4, a transcription factor linked to poor prognosis, through SUMO1-mediated sumoylation at lysine 123. The SUMO peptidase SENP1 reverses this process, stabilizing OCT4 and restoring sensitivity to cisplatin and bleomycin. The authors identify SENP1 as a potential therapeutic target for drug-resistant testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-23006885.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに対する放射線療法から37年後に脊髄内の未分化星細胞腫を発症した54歳男性の症例報告である。左下肢の脱力と感覚障害が進行し、MRIでT9からT12の腫瘤と脊髄空洞症を認めた。亜全摘術と化学療法を行ったが神経症状は進行し、術後9か月で死亡した。放射線誘発性脊髄悪性星細胞腫では脊髄切除術が最適な治療となりうると著者らは考察している。
pmid-23006885.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old man who developed an intramedullary anaplastic astrocytoma of the spinal cord 37 years after radiotherapy for testicular seminoma. He presented with progressive left leg weakness and numbness, and MRI showed a T9 to T12 mass with syringomyelia. Subtotal resection and chemotherapy were given, but neurological decline led to death nine months after surgery. The authors suggest that cordectomy may be the optimal treatment for radiation-induced spinal malignant astrocytoma.

pmid-23009113.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍88例を対象に、細胞周期制御因子の発現を免疫組織化学的に解析した研究である。p27(Kip1)、Skp2、Cks1、サイクリンA・Eの異常は、IGCNU、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の順に高頻度となった。Ki-67標識率も同じ順に上昇した。細胞周期の調節異常が精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生と組織学的進展に関与する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-23009113.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined cell-cycle regulators in 88 adult patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including intratubular germ cell neoplasms, unclassified (IGCNU), seminomas, and embryonal carcinomas. Alterations in p27(Kip1), Skp2, Cks1, cyclin A, and cyclin E became progressively more frequent from IGCNU to seminoma to embryonal carcinoma. The Ki-67 labeling index also rose across these histologies. The findings suggest that cell-cycle dysregulation contributes to tumor development and histological progression in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-23009771.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の一般的な形態である奇形腫について、画像所見を含めて総説したものである。外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉の三胚葉由来組織を含むと定義され、脂肪成分が画像上の特徴となる。成熟奇形腫と未熟奇形腫は分化度により区別され、成人では未熟型が悪性の経過をとりやすい。小児では仙尾部腫瘍が多いことも述べている。
pmid-23009771.summary_en: This multimodality review covers teratomas, a common form of germ cell tumor. It outlines the histologic spectrum of GCTs in children and adults, including seminoma, choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonal carcinoma. Teratomas are defined by tissues from all three germ layers, and fat is a key imaging hallmark. Mature and immature subtypes are distinguished by degree of differentiation, with immature tumors more likely to behave malignantly in adults. The article emphasizes imaging features and clinical behavior.

pmid-23011538.summary_ja: 1969年から2008年までのフィンランドがん登録データを用いた人口ベースの研究であり、両性における悪性胚細胞腫瘍の年齢調整発生率を算出した。男性では、特に15～44歳で性腺GCTの発生率が大きく上昇し、すべての組織学的亜型で増加した。女性では、卵巣の非ディスジャーミノーマのみ増加が認められた。性腺外GCTの発生率は両性で安定して低かった。著者らは、性別によりリスク因子が異なる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-23011538.summary_en: This population-based study used Finnish Cancer Registry data from 1969 to 2008 to calculate age-adjusted incidence of malignant germ cell tumors in both sexes. Gonadal GCT incidence in males rose markedly, particularly among those aged 15 to 44, with all histologic subtypes increasing. In females, only non-dysgerminoma ovarian tumors increased. Extragonadal GCT incidence remained stable and low in both sexes. The authors suggest that risk factors differ between males and females.

pmid-23021209.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた32例を後方視的研究で解析し、残存腫瘤の壊死を予測する因子を検討した。リンパ節径の相対変化、精巣摘除標本における奇形腫の不在、絨毛癌の存在が有意な予測因子であった。腫瘤縮小35%が腫瘍不在の予測に最適なカットオフ値とされ、感度73.3%、特異度82.4%であった。
pmid-23021209.summary_en: This retrospective study of 32 patients analyzed factors predicting necrosis in residual retroperitoneal masses after post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for testicular germ cell tumors. Necrosis was found in 47% and teratoma in 47%. Relative change in nodal size, absence of teratoma in the orchiectomy specimen, and choriocarcinoma in the orchiectomy were significant predictors. A 35% reduction in mass size was the best cutoff for predicting tumor absence, with 73.3% sensitivity and 82.4% specificity. Surveillance may be considered in selected patients.

pmid-23025112.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（卵巣類皮嚢腫）38例を対象に、腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の安全性を前向きに比較した研究である。腹腔鏡群は入院期間が短く（平均4.05日対6.96日）、合併症の増加も認められなかった。腹腔鏡手術は、妊娠を希望する閉経前女性における妊孕性温存を伴う保存的治療として有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-23025112.summary_en: This prospective study compared laparoscopic and open surgery for 38 mature cystic teratomas (ovarian dermoid cysts) in women. Laparoscopic removal, performed in 25 cases, was associated with a shorter hospital stay (4.05 vs 6.96 days) and no increase in complications compared with open surgery. Laparoscopy patients were younger and had smaller cysts. Preoperative CA 19-9 was elevated in most tested cases, particularly in larger cysts. The authors conclude that laparoscopy is safe and allows conservative management, especially in premenopausal women wishing to conceive.

pmid-23026196.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の内部に、印環細胞型粘液性腺癌と肺型腺癌という2種類の悪性腫瘍が同時に発生した稀な症例を報告した。肺型腺癌は気管支様構造と密接に関連し、TTF1、PE10、napsin Aが陽性を示した。EGFR遺伝子変異は認められず、原発性肺癌ではないと考えられた。奇形腫の悪性転化は扁平上皮癌が多いことが背景として示されている。
pmid-23026196.summary_en: This case report describes a rare ovarian dermoid cyst in which two distinct carcinomas developed: a signet ring mucinous adenocarcinoma and a pulmonary-type adenocarcinoma. The pulmonary-type tumor was closely associated with a bronchial structure and showed positive immunostaining for TTF1, PE10, and napsin A. Molecular testing found no EGFR mutation, which argues against a primary pulmonary origin. The authors note that malignant transformation of mature teratoma is most often squamous carcinoma, making this combination unusual.

pmid-23029627.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫に、濾胞亜型の乳頭状甲状腺癌、粘液性腺癌、ストルマ性カルチノイドの3種類の悪性成分が発生した症例を報告した。甲状腺癌には甲状腺全摘と放射性ヨード治療、粘液性腺癌には病期分類後の補助化学療法が提案されている。ストルマ性カルチノイドは浸潤性の播種がなければ経過観察が妥当とされ、稀な病態への管理指針を示している。
pmid-23029627.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic ovarian teratoma that showed malignant transformation into three components: follicular variant papillary thyroid carcinoma, mucinous adenocarcinoma, and strumal carcinoid tumor. The authors review limited data on managing malignant foci within mature cystic teratomas. They propose thyroidectomy with radioiodine ablation for thyroid carcinoma, adjuvant chemotherapy after staging for mucinous adenocarcinoma, and observation for strumal carcinoid if no invasive implants are present. The report offers practical guidance for a rare clinical situation.

pmid-23031759.summary_ja: 皮様嚢腫が横行結腸に瘻孔を形成した稀な症例を報告した。感染した皮様嚢腫は虫垂膿瘍と誤診されうるが、両者の治療法は大きく異なる。一般外科医は虫垂膿瘍の鑑別診断として皮様嚢腫を念頭に置くべきだと強調している。診断の落とし穴に焦点を当てた短い症例報告であり、腫瘍そのものの生物学は扱っていない。
pmid-23031759.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst that fistulated into the transverse colon, presenting in a way that mimicked an appendiceal abscess. The authors emphasize that an infected dermoid cyst can be misdiagnosed as an appendix abscess, although treatment differs substantially between these conditions. The report is brief and focuses on this diagnostic pitfall rather than on germ cell tumor biology. Surgeons should consider dermoid cyst in the differential diagnosis of appendix abscess to avoid inappropriate management.

pmid-23032251.summary_ja: 精神症状、発熱、不随意運動を呈した21歳女性の症例で、卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。脳脊髄液で細胞数増加を認め、CTで右卵巣の石灰化病変が見つかった。早期のステロイドパルス療法を開始し、抗体陽性確認後に右付属器摘出術と免疫療法を行い回復した。原因不明の若年者の精神症状では本症を考慮すべきと強調している。
pmid-23032251.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old woman with psychiatric symptoms, fever, and involuntary movements who was diagnosed with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. Cerebrospinal fluid showed increased cell count, and abdominal CT revealed a calcified right ovarian lesion. Steroid pulse therapy was started early, and after antibody positivity was confirmed, right adnexectomy and immunotherapy led to recovery. The authors stress considering anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis in young patients with unexplained psychiatric presentations.

pmid-23032847.summary_ja: 精巣絨毛癌の既往がある患者の顎部皮膚病変を、細針吸引細胞診で診断した皮膚転移の症例報告である。細胞診では異型の強い単核細胞（栄養膜細胞）と多核の悪性細胞（合胞体栄養膜細胞）が認められ、絨毛癌に特徴的な所見であった。英文文献では皮膚転移の報告が約9例しかなく、細針吸引細胞診で診断されたのは1例のみであると述べている。
pmid-23032847.summary_en: This case report describes skin metastasis of testicular choriocarcinoma diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology from a chin lesion. Cytology showed highly atypical mononuclear cytotrophoblasts and multinucleated syncytiotrophoblasts, features characteristic of choriocarcinoma. The authors note that only about nine cutaneous metastases have been reported in the English literature, and only one previously diagnosed by FNA. The case highlights that FNA cytology can establish the diagnosis of metastatic germ cell tumor when the primary is known, avoiding more invasive biopsy.

pmid-23033467.summary_ja: 1.5歳の雌ドーベルマンに、20cmの卵巣奇形腫と顆粒膜細胞腫瘍が同時に発生し、広間膜へ転移した症例である。手術切除後にカルボプラチンを2サイクル投与したが、転移に伴う呼吸困難のため術後6週で安楽死された。卵巣奇形腫と性索間質性腫瘍の併存は稀であり、同一卵巣に原発した腹腔内転移を伴う顆粒膜細胞腫瘍との併存はイヌで初の報告と述べている。
pmid-23033467.summary_en: This veterinary case report describes a 1.5-year-old female Doberman pinscher with a 20 cm ovarian teratoma and a separate granulosa cell tumor with broad ligament metastases. Surgical removal was followed by two cycles of carboplatin, but the dog was euthanized six weeks after surgery due to metastasis-related dyspnea. The authors note that ovarian teratomas rarely coexist with sex cord-stromal tumors, and this is reported as the first canine case of an ovarian teratoma coexisting with a primary granulosa cell tumor with intra-abdominal metastasis in the same ovary.

pmid-23034492.summary_ja: 性交渉歴のない15歳女性が無月経と腹部膨満で受診し、妊娠が疑われた症例。尿中hCGと腫瘍マーカーが上昇し、21cmの卵巣腫瘍を外科的に切除した結果、非妊娠性絨毛癌と診断された。若年者でhCG高値を認めた場合は、妊娠以外に絨毛癌を考慮すべきと報告している。
pmid-23034492.summary_en: Case report of a 15-year-old girl with no sexual history who presented with six months of amenorrhea, abdominal pain, and progressive distension, initially suspected to be pregnancy. Urine hCG, CA125, and CA19-9 were elevated while serum hCG was normal. Imaging showed a large abdominal mass and pleural effusions. Salpingo-oophorectomy with omentectomy removed a 21-cm tumor, pathologically a nongestational choriocarcinoma. The authors note such tumors are more common in adolescents and advise considering choriocarcinoma when hCG is elevated without pregnancy, especially before menarche or without sexual history.

pmid-23037476.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に続発した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の24歳女性の症例報告。典型症状に加え、中枢性神経原性過換気が反復出現し、ミダゾラムとプロポフォールで軽快した。卵巣摘出術、血漿交換、免疫グロブリン療法により良好に回復した。NMDA受容体の関与が示唆され、本疾患での報告は今回が初めてと考えられる。
pmid-23037476.summary_en: Case report of a 24-year-old woman diagnosed with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis secondary to an ovarian teratoma. Alongside typical encephalitis symptoms, she had recurrent episodes of central neurogenic hyperventilation, a condition previously linked mainly to brainstem tumors. The episodes resolved with midazolam and propofol infusion. Oophorectomy, plasmapheresis, and intravenous immunoglobulin led to excellent recovery. The authors suggest NMDA receptors may contribute to the pathophysiology of central neurogenic hyperventilation, and report that this has not been described previously in this disease.

pmid-23038230.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のサーベイランス中に、正常範囲内で血清AFPが変動する現象を72例で後方視的に検討した。93%で変動がみられたが、その後に再発した例はなかった。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で平均値に差はなく、正常範囲内のAFP変動を再発と誤解すべきではないと結論している。患者や医師の不安軽減に役立つ可能性も示されている。
pmid-23038230.summary_en: Retrospective study of 72 patients with germ cell tumors in clinical remission and normal serum AFP, followed from 1991 to 2009 with median follow-up of 50 months. Fifty-seven had non-seminomatous histology and 15 had seminoma, the latter included as controls. Most patients (93%) showed fluctuations in serum AFP within normal limits, with similar mean values between seminoma and non-seminomatous groups. None of these fluctuations led to relapse in this cohort. The authors conclude that AFP variation within the normal range during surveillance should not be interpreted as relapse, and that reassurance may reduce patient and physician anxiety.

pmid-23040630.summary_ja: 8年前に左精巣の混合性胚細胞腫瘍と診断された42歳男性が、前立腺への単発転移で受診した症例報告。精巣がんの前立腺転移は極めて稀で、従来はセミノーマでのみ報告されていた。本例は非セミノーマ性悪性胚細胞腫瘍でも起こりうることを示しており、長期経過後の稀な部位への再発を念頭におくべきと示唆されている。
pmid-23040630.summary_en: Case report of a 42-year-old man who presented with a solitary prostatic metastasis from a left testicular mixed germ cell tumor diagnosed eight years earlier. The authors note that prostatic involvement by testicular cancer is exceedingly rare and has previously been described only in seminomatous germ cell tumors. This case therefore extends the reported spectrum to a non-seminomatous malignant germ cell tumor, with metastasis occurring many years after initial diagnosis. The report highlights that late recurrence in unusual sites should be considered during long-term surveillance.

pmid-23040929.summary_ja: 19歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に、濾胞変異型乳頭状甲状腺癌を認めた症例報告。術後検索で転移はなく、2か月後に準全摘術が行われた。妊孕性温存を希望する症例では片側卵巣摘出術や嚢胞摘出術が選択肢になりうると考察している。血清サイログロブリンを腫瘍マーカーとして経時的に測定することを推奨している。
pmid-23040929.summary_en: Case report of a 19-year-old woman in whom a follicular variant of papillary thyroid carcinoma was found within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma after cystectomy. Postoperative workup showed no metastasis. Near-total thyroidectomy was performed two months later, and serum thyroglobulin was used for follow-up. The authors review malignant transformation of dermoid cysts, which is more common after menopause but rare in younger women. They suggest unilateral oophorectomy or cystectomy may be reasonable when there is no capsular or vascular invasion and fertility is desired, and recommend serial thyroglobulin as a marker.

pmid-23041284.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞でAktがOct4のスレオニン235をリン酸化し、自己複製と生存を促進する機構を示した基礎研究。リン酸化Oct4は安定性と核内移行を高め、AKT1の転写を解除することでAkt経路を自己強化する。リン酸化レベルはアポトーシス抵抗性と腫瘍形成能に相関した。
pmid-23041284.summary_en: Basic research study showing that Akt phosphorylates the pluripotency factor Oct4 at threonine 235 in embryonal carcinoma cells, the malignant counterpart of embryonic stem cells. Phosphorylated Oct4 increased protein stability, nuclear localization, and interaction with Sox2, enhancing POU5F1 and NANOG transcription. Unphosphorylated Oct4 repressed AKT1 transcription, while phosphorylation released this repression, activating AKT1 and promoting survival. Phospho-Oct4 levels correlated with apoptosis resistance and tumorigenic potential. The findings suggest a feedback loop that sustains embryonal carcinoma self-renewal and survival.

pmid-23047638.summary_ja: 58歳男性の膵尾部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。CT、MRI、超音波内視鏡で多房性の嚢胞性腫瘍が描出され、術前診断は困難であった。最終的に病理所見により膵類皮嚢腫と診断された。成熟奇形腫に類する病変が膵臓に発生するまれな疾患であり、画像診断の難しさが強調されている。
pmid-23047638.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old man with epigastric and dorsal pain and a pancreatic tail mass that was difficult to diagnose preoperatively. CT showed a hypovascular lesion, MRI showed heterogeneous T1 isointensity and T2 hyperintensity, and endoscopic ultrasonography revealed a multilocular hypoechoic cystic tumor with debris. The lesion was ultimately diagnosed as a pancreatic dermoid cyst based on pathological findings. The authors highlight the diagnostic difficulty of this rare entity, a mature teratoma-type lesion arising in the pancreas.

pmid-23049638.summary_ja: 42歳男性の巨大精巣腫瘍の症例報告である。陰嚢痛と腫脹で受診し、超音波検査で精巣の著明な腫大が確認された。根治的精巣摘除術の後に腫瘍科へ紹介されている。炎症を伴った精巣腫瘍を見逃さないための慎重な診察と超音波検査の重要性が強調されている。小児期の停留精巣の既往もリスク因子として挙げられ、セミノーマでは精巣摘除術後の放射線療法により70〜100%の治癒率が報告されている。
pmid-23049638.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old man with scrotal pain and marked swelling who was initially suspected of orchitis. Ultrasound revealed a 6 × 15 cm testicular enlargement, and radical orchiectomy was performed before referral to oncology. The authors emphasize that careful examination and precise ultrasound can reveal a developing testicular tumor masked by inflammation. They also note that a history of childhood cryptorchidism is an important risk factor, and that radiotherapy after orchiectomy cures seminoma in 70 to 100% of cases.

pmid-23050178.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔奇形腫に生じた転移性結腸型腺癌が、5-フルオロウラシル系化学療法に良好に反応した初めての症例報告である。体細胞型の悪性転化を伴う胚細胞腫瘍は縦隔奇形腫の約7%に生じ、肉腫が最も多く、次いで原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍、腺癌が続く。過去の類例では、転化成分を標的とした化学療法は行われていなかった。悪性転化した成分に対する化学療法レジメンの選択の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-23050178.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with metastatic colonic-type adenocarcinoma arising in a primary mediastinal teratoma who responded well to 5-fluorouracil-based chemotherapy. Germ cell tumors with somatic malignant transformation occur in about 7% of mediastinal teratomas, with sarcoma most common, followed by PNET and adenocarcinoma. Prior reported cases of colonic-type adenocarcinoma in teratoma did not receive chemotherapy targeting the transformed histology. The authors therefore highlight the importance of selecting a chemotherapy regimen directed at the transformed component.

pmid-23059747.summary_ja: 1965〜1995年にオランダで治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍3749例の全国コホート研究。異時性対側腫瘍の標準化発生比は17.6で、20年まで高値が続いた。非セミノーマ患者では白金製剤による化学療法で対側発生リスクが低下した。対側腫瘍を生じた患者は他臓器の悪性腫瘍や死亡のリスクも高かった。
pmid-23059747.summary_en: This Dutch nationwide cohort of 3749 testicular germ cell tumor patients treated between 1965 and 1995 assessed the risk of metachronous contralateral tumors. The standardised incidence ratio was 17.6 and remained elevated for up to 20 years, with a 20-year cumulative incidence of 2.2%. Platinum-based chemotherapy was associated with reduced contralateral risk in non-seminoma patients. Patients with contralateral tumors also had higher risks of subsequent non-testicular cancer and death.

pmid-23061033.summary_ja: 30か月の男児に生じた仙尾部および仙骨前の巨大腫瘤の症例報告。超音波検査、CT、MRIで骨盤内に進展する病変を評価し、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は高値を示した。外科的切除検体の病理組織学的検査により卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断され、本腫瘍の発生部位としてはまれであることを示した。
pmid-23061033.summary_en: A 30-month-old boy presented with a large sacrococcygeal and pre-sacral mass extending into the pelvis. Ultrasound, CT, and MRI characterized the lesion, and serum alpha-fetoprotein was markedly elevated. Histopathological examination of the surgical specimen confirmed a sacrococcygeal yolk sac tumor. The report emphasizes that this neoplasm is rare at this anatomic site.

pmid-23064077.summary_ja: 右精巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍に対して精巣摘除後、化学療法を受けた37歳男性の症例。血清AFPは正常化したが肺転移は増大を続けた。肺転移の外科的切除で成熟奇形腫が確認され、growing teratoma syndromeと診断された。全切除により良好な結果が得られ、本症候群の認識が治療成功に重要であると報告した。
pmid-23064077.summary_en: A 37-year-old man with a mixed germ cell tumor of the right testis developed multiple lung metastases after orchiectomy and chemotherapy. The lung lesions kept enlarging despite normalized serum AFP. Surgical resection of the lung metastases showed mature teratoma, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. Complete resection gave a good result, and the authors emphasize that recognizing this syndrome is important for successful treatment.

pmid-23064661.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ11例と正常精巣組織11例のホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋(FFPE)組織を用いてマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現を比較した。112種のmiRNAが発現差を示し、hsa-mir-372とhsa-mir-373は著明に上昇していた。miR-21、miR-221、miR-222の上昇はRT-PCRで確認された。FFPE組織はセミノーマのmiRNA研究に有用な資源であると結論された。
pmid-23064661.summary_en: This study profiled microRNA expression in formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded seminoma tissue from 11 patients compared with 11 normal testicular samples. The authors identified 112 differentially expressed miRNAs, 52 upregulated and 60 downregulated, with hsa-mir-372 and hsa-mir-373 markedly increased. Upregulation of hsa-mir-21, hsa-mir-221, and hsa-mir-222 was validated by RT-PCR. FFPE tissue was judged a valuable resource for seminoma miRNA research.

pmid-23066729.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍113例と3種の細胞株を免疫組織化学で解析し、N-カドヘリンの発現を評価した。セミノーマでは膜局在を示し、奇形腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍も発現が認められた。胎児性癌と絨毛癌では発現が検出されなかった。N-カドヘリンは胎児性癌および絨毛癌を他の組織型と鑑別するマーカーとなりうる。
pmid-23066729.summary_en: This study used immunohistochemistry to examine N-cadherin expression in 113 malignant testicular germ cell tumors and three cell lines. Seminomas showed membrane-bound staining, while teratomas and yolk sac tumors expressed N-cadherin variably. Embryonal and chorionic carcinomas showed no expression. Mixed tumors followed the pattern of their components, suggesting that N-cadherin can help distinguish embryonal and chorionic carcinomas from other histological subtypes.

pmid-23070396.summary_ja: 1年前に右精巣の病期Iセミノーマで高位精巣摘除術を受けた36歳男性が、左精巣の無痛性腫大で受診した。超音波検査で低エコー性腫瘤2か所と微小石灰化を認め、CTでは転移はなかった。左高位精巣摘除術の病理組織学的検査で典型的なセミノーマと診断された。日本で報告された191例を文献的に考察し、長期フォローアップと対側精巣の自己検査の重要性を強調した。
pmid-23070396.summary_en: A 36-year-old man who had undergone right high orchiectomy for stage I testicular seminoma one year earlier presented with left testicular swelling. Ultrasonography showed two hypoechoic masses and microlithiasis, while CT found no metastasis. Left high orchiectomy showed typical seminoma. The authors review 191 reported Japanese cases of metachronous bilateral testicular tumors and stress long-term follow-up and self-examination of the contralateral testis.

pmid-23071246.summary_ja: 浸潤性胚細胞がんの既往があり、IGCNUを有する61例を対象に、後発精巣がんの確率を評価したコホート研究である。化学療法を受けなかった患者の5年確率は54%、受けた患者は23%であり、4サイクル以上の化学療法を受けた患者で確率が低かった。白金系化学療法が後発精巣がんのリスクを低下させる可能性が示唆された。著者らは、将来の父親となることを希望する一部の患者には待機的経過観察戦略が妥当かもしれないと述べている。
pmid-23071246.summary_en: This cohort study of 61 patients with intratubular germ cell neoplasia unclassified (IGCNU) who had previously been treated for invasive germ cell cancer evaluated the probability of subsequent testicular cancer. The 5-year probability was 54% in patients not exposed to chemotherapy versus 23% in those exposed, and 42% for patients receiving one to three cycles compared with 22% for those receiving four or more cycles. Platinum-based chemotherapy appeared to reduce the risk of subsequent testicular cancer. The authors suggest that a watch-and-wait strategy may be reasonable for selected patients who wish to preserve paternity.

pmid-23071288.summary_ja: 68歳男性の、肝転移を伴う原発性胃絨毛癌の症例報告である。予後不良な本疾患に対し胚細胞腫瘍に基づく化学療法を実施したところ、病理学的完全奏効が得られ、2年間の無病生存が得られた。標準化学療法が確立していない本疾患に対し、胚細胞腫瘍レジメンが有用な選択肢となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-23071288.summary_en: This case report describes a 68-year-old man with primary gastric choriocarcinoma and advanced liver metastases. Because this rare entity has a poor prognosis, with survival often under one month when liver metastases are present, and no defined chemotherapy, the patient was treated with germ cell tumor-based chemotherapy. The treatment achieved a pathological complete response, and the patient remained disease-free for two years. The authors suggest that germ cell tumor regimens may be a useful option for primary gastric choriocarcinoma.

pmid-23071481.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の診断時に画像で血栓塞栓症が確認された小児2例の報告である。両患者とも凝固因子異常や、原因となりうる処置・薬剤はみられなかった。1例では抗凝固療法による血栓溶解が行われ、もう1例は自然に軽快した。小児胚細胞腫瘍の初診時に血栓塞栓症が合併しうることに注意を促している。
pmid-23071481.summary_en: This report describes two children in whom thromboembolic events were identified radiographically during the diagnosis of germ cell tumors. Neither patient had coagulation factor abnormalities, contributory procedures, or medications that might explain the events. One patient received anticoagulation therapy for thrombolysis, while the thromboembolism in the other resolved spontaneously. The report highlights thromboembolism as a potentially under-recognized complication at presentation of pediatric germ cell tumors.

pmid-23074379.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍105例と性腺間質腫瘍12例を対象に、N-カドヘリンの免疫組織化学的発現を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍の99%が陽性、胎児性癌の87%が陰性であり、セミノーマは74%が陽性であった。グリピカン3およびSALL4とともに、卵黄嚢腫瘍の同定や精巣胚細胞腫瘍の分類に有用と結論された。
pmid-23074379.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined N-cadherin expression in 105 germ cell tumors of single and mixed histologies and 12 gonadal stromal tumors. Nearly all yolk sac tumors (99%) were positive, while most embryonal carcinomas (87%) were negative. Seminomas were positive in 74% of cases, and teratomas in 73% of neuroectodermal or glandular components. Nine of 12 gonadal stromal tumors stained variably. The authors conclude that N-cadherin, together with glypican-3 and SALL4, is useful for identifying yolk sac tumors and classifying testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-23082264.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が悪性転化し、大網に転移巣を形成した症例の報告である。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は0.17~2%と極めてまれで、扁平上皮癌が最も多い。大網転移を伴う悪性転化の報告はさらにまれであり、その希少性が強調されている。
pmid-23082264.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma that underwent malignant transformation and had metastatic deposits in the omentum. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is rare, with an incidence of 0.17-2%, and squamous cell carcinoma is the most common form. Omental metastasis from such a transformed tumor is extremely rare. The authors highlight this rarity in reporting the case.

pmid-23084685.summary_ja: 17歳女性の、膣と直腸の間から臀部に及ぶ巨大な嚢胞性腫瘤の症例報告である。ロボット支援下に経腹的に切除し、術後経過は良好で、機能面・整容面の結果も優れていた。直腸傍部類皮嚢腫(成熟奇形腫)の治療において、ロボット支援手術は隣接組織への障害が少なく回復が早いと考察されている。
pmid-23084685.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old adolescent with a huge cystic mass between the vagina and rectum that extended into the gluteal region and compressed the bladder, uterus, adnexae, and rectum. The mass was excised robotically through a totally transabdominal route, with uneventful recovery and excellent functional and cosmetic results. The authors describe this as the first reported case of a huge pelvic pararectal cyst reaching the gluteus excised by this approach, and suggest that robot-assisted surgery offers minimal damage to adjacent structures and rapid recovery.

pmid-23087278.summary_ja: 25歳男性が大量の心嚢水貯留と心膜腫瘤で受診した。前縦隔の嚢胞性腫瘤を胸骨正中切開下に摘出し、病理学的に良性の嚢胞性奇形腫と胸腺嚢胞と診断された。大きな縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫が心嚢内へ破裂し症状を来す稀な経過を示した症例報告である。
pmid-23087278.summary_en: A 25-year-old man presented with a large pericardial effusion and multiple pericardial masses. Imaging revealed a well-circumscribed anterior mediastinal cystic mass, which was surgically removed and diagnosed pathologically as a benign cystic teratoma with a thymic cyst. The authors note that large mediastinal cystic teratomas can compress adjacent structures or rupture into the pericardial sac, producing symptoms, although most are discovered incidentally.

pmid-23089140.summary_ja: Siglec-6の発現を正常胎盤、流産胎盤、部分奇胎、完全奇胎、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍で比較した。完全奇胎で高発現し、GTNでは低発現で、完全奇胎の鑑別に有用と示唆された。絨毛癌由来BeWO細胞では、レプチンとの相互作用により増殖、アポトーシス、浸潤が調節されることを示した。
pmid-23089140.summary_en: This study examined Siglec-6 expression across normal placentas, hydropic abortus, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Siglec-6 was higher in complete moles than in controls and low in GTN, suggesting diagnostic utility for distinguishing complete moles. In choriocarcinoma-derived BeWO cells, Siglec-6 and leptin interacted to regulate proliferation, apoptosis and invasion, implicating them in the aberrant behavior of gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-23089288.summary_ja: 44歳男性の前縦隔嚢胞性腫瘤を切除したところ、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に高分化腺癌と未分化肉腫様成分が移行していた。術後約10か月で胸膜転移をきたした。縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の悪性転化としては英文報告で初めての症例とされる。
pmid-23089288.summary_en: A 44-year-old man had a large anterior mediastinal cystic mass, which was resected. Within the mature cystic teratoma, well-differentiated tubulopapillary adenocarcinoma merged into undifferentiated sarcomatous cells. Immunohistochemistry supported adenocarcinoma with sarcomatous dedifferentiation. About 10 months later, pleural effusion and nodules were cytologically diagnosed as metastatic adenocarcinoma. The authors report this as the first English-language case of such malignant transformation arising in a mediastinal mature cystic teratoma with pleural metastasis.

pmid-23091901.summary_ja: 69歳女性が15cmの左卵巣腫瘤で受診し、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の大細胞神経内分泌癌IV期と診断された。補助化学療法を行ったが残存腫瘍は増大し、減量手術後6か月で死亡した。文献上の既報5例も同様に攻撃的であり、予後は極めて不良と結論づけられた。
pmid-23091901.summary_en: A 69-year-old woman presented with a 15-cm left ovarian mass, diagnosed as stage IV large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma. She received adjuvant paclitaxel and carboplatin, but residual tumor grew, and she died six months after debulking surgery. A literature review identified only five previous cases of this entity, all showing aggressive behavior. The authors conclude that this malignant transformation carries an exceedingly poor prognosis.

pmid-23094190.summary_ja: 若年女性に胸腺奇形腫とカルチノイド腫瘍が併存した症例を報告している。心臓外の稀な縦隔腫瘤として提示された。抄録には画像所見、治療、経過の詳細は記載されていない。縦隔の胚細胞性腫瘍と神経内分泌腫瘍の稀な合併を示す症例報告である。
pmid-23094190.summary_en: A young woman had a thymic teratoma coexisting with a carcinoid tumor, reported as a rare type of extracardiac mass. This brief case report describes both lesions in a single patient. The abstract provides no further detail on imaging, treatment, or outcome. The case highlights the unusual combination of a mediastinal germ cell neoplasm with a neuroendocrine tumor in a mediastinal location.

pmid-23097629.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるビタミンD代謝を検討したものであり、胎児生殖細胞、上皮内癌、浸潤性腫瘍でVDRと代謝酵素が発現していることを示した。上皮内癌から胎児性癌への移行過程で代謝は低下したが、非セミノーマの分化成分では回復した。インビトロでは、活性型ビタミンDがNANOGとOCT4を抑制し、中胚葉マーカーを誘導した。ヌードマウスの異種移植モデルでは、多能性因子は低下したものの、腫瘍増殖の有意な抑制は認められなかった。
pmid-23097629.summary_en: This study examined vitamin D metabolism in testicular germ cell tumors, showing that VDR and metabolizing enzymes are expressed in fetal germ cells, carcinoma in situ and invasive tumors. Metabolism declined during the transition from carcinoma in situ to embryonal carcinoma but recovered in differentiated nonseminoma components. In vitro, active vitamin D suppressed NANOG and OCT4 and induced mesodermal markers. In xenografts, pluripotency factors fell, but tumor growth was not significantly reduced.

pmid-23098982.summary_ja: 非定型的な胸痛を訴えた若年男性の症例報告である。原発性縦隔胎児性癌が外因性の肺動脈狭窄を引き起こしており、心エコー検査とコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で診断された。腫瘍は約6か月という短期間で急速に進行した。外科的切除に加え補助化学療法を行い、良好な治療経過が得られた。
pmid-23098982.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with atypical chest pain whose rapidly progressive primary mediastinal embryonal carcinoma caused extrinsic pulmonary artery stenosis. Echocardiography and computed tomography enabled diagnosis. The tumor progressed within about six months. Treatment consisted of surgical resection followed by adjuvant chemotherapy, with a successful outcome. The report highlights echocardiography as a useful imaging modality for recognizing this rare cause of pulmonary stenosis.

pmid-23102438.summary_ja: ペンシルベニア大学で1997年から2012年に診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした、データベース検索に基づく解析である。肉芽腫性疾患を合併した14例を同定した。GCTの診断時の年齢中央値は32.5歳であった。累積発症率は10万人あたり168.7と、一般集団の約10倍と推定された。両者の強い関連が示唆され、さらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-23102438.summary_en: This single-institution study from the University of Pennsylvania searched a medical database from 1997 to 2012 for patients with both granulomatous disease and testicular germ cell tumor. Fourteen patients were identified, with a median GCT diagnosis age of 32.5 years. Most granulomatous disease was diagnosed concomitantly with or after GCT. The estimated cumulative incidence was 168.7 per 100,000, about tenfold higher than the general population, suggesting a strong association that warrants further investigation.

pmid-23112259.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の2例で、精神症状期から全脳領域にわたる低電位脳波が認められたことを報告している。うち1例は卵巣成熟奇形腫の切除後に免疫療法や血漿交換で完全回復し、もう1例は奇形腫が見つからず長期の人工呼吸管理を要した。低電位脳波は早期の所見となりうることが示唆される。
pmid-23112259.summary_en: This report describes low-voltage EEG activity in two patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, presenting from the psychotic stage. Both patients had psychiatric symptoms, central hypoventilation, seizures, and autonomic instability, and conventional MRI was normal. One patient had a mature ovarian teratoma resected, and recovered completely after corticosteroids, intravenous immunoglobulins, and plasmapheresis. The other had no teratoma found and required prolonged ventilatory support. EEG voltages were reduced across all brain regions compared with healthy controls, suggesting low-voltage activity may be an early marker of this disorder.

pmid-23112468.summary_ja: 卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍で、多数のサルコイド様肉芽腫を伴った症例を穿刺細胞診で診断した報告である。ディスジャーミノーマにサルコイド様肉芽腫が稀に伴うことを示している。切除を要さない性腺腫瘤に対しては、細胞診が迅速で信頼性の高い診断法として有用と強調している。
pmid-23112468.summary_en: This report describes an ovarian germ cell tumor with abundant sarcoid-like granulomas, diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology. Ovarian germ cell tumors with two or more subtypes are uncommon, and sarcoid-like granulomas are rarely associated with dysgerminomas. The authors emphasize that FNAC is a rapid, reliable, and useful method for gonadal masses that do not require resection, such as lymphoma treatable with chemotherapy. It also helps establish the diagnosis of germ cell tumors and rule out other lesions.

pmid-23115073.summary_ja: 35歳男性で肺転移と高値のβ-hCG・LDHを認め、精巣の小病変が超音波検査で見つかった。甲状腺原発の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と病理診断され、主体は胎児性癌と絨毛癌の成分であった。BEP療法（ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン）を行ったが治療中に死亡した。甲状腺発生は稀で、シスプラチンを基盤とした化学療法が標準とされる。
pmid-23115073.summary_en: A 35-year-old man presented with lung metastases, elevated beta-hCG and LDH, and a small left testicular lesion on ultrasound. Cytology of the enlarged thyroid lobe suggested metastasis, and orchiectomy histology showed no carcinoma. Histopathology of the thyroid established a primary mixed germ cell tumor, predominantly embryonal carcinoma with choriocarcinoma foci. He received BEP chemotherapy but died during treatment. The authors note that thyroid germ cell tumors are rare, that choriocarcinoma explained the high beta-hCG, and that cisplatin-based chemotherapy remains the standard.

pmid-23117685.summary_ja: 29歳男性の両側停留精巣症例で、ロボット支援下腎盂形成術中に腹腔内の不連続性脾性腺融合が偶然見つかった。萎縮した精巣を摘除し、病理組織学的検査でセミノーマ（精細管内胚細胞腫瘍）と診断された。停留精巣に伴う場合は、併存する胚細胞腫瘍を疑う必要があると結論している。
pmid-23117685.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with bilateral cryptorchidism was found during robotic pyeloplasty to have a discontinuous intra-abdominal splenogonadal fusion. The atrophic gonad was removed along with the pyeloplasty, and the operation took 80 minutes with minimal blood loss and a stay under 36 hours. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry revealed intratubular germ cell neoplasia with seminoma. The authors note that splenogonadal fusion is uncommon, and that awareness of its association with cryptorchidism can prevent unnecessary orchiectomy while prompting evaluation for concomitant germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-23119116.summary_ja: 生後1年の男児で、仙骨部皮下の小奇形腫に未熟な腎組織が主体として含まれていた症例である。完全切除され悪性所見を認めなかったためフォローアップのみとされ、術後15か月で良好な経過であった。異所性未熟腎組織ではWilms腫瘍の発生の可能性があるため、慎重な病理組織学的評価が必要と論じている。
pmid-23119116.summary_en: The authors describe a 1-year-old boy who underwent surgery for a small sacral subcutaneous teratoma containing a prominent component of immature renal tissue. The lesion appeared completely excised, and because no features of malignancy were present, only follow-up was recommended. The patient remained well 15 months after surgery. The authors review the literature on ectopic immature renal tissue, highlighting the need for careful histological interpretation because of the potential for Wilms tumor development, and offer practical suggestions for diagnosis and management.

pmid-23119117.summary_ja: 32歳男性の前縦隔の悪性混合型胚細胞腫瘍で、呼吸上皮由来の紡錘形・類上皮様成分を伴う黒色腫が認められた症例である。縦隔の混合型胚細胞腫瘍から黒色腫が生じた初の報告とされる。黒色腫の起源として神経内分泌細胞の関与が示唆されている。体細胞型悪性腫瘍の合併は予後や治療を変えうるため、胚細胞腫瘍の慎重な評価が必要と述べている。
pmid-23119117.summary_en: The authors describe a 32-year-old man with a malignant mixed germ cell tumor of the anterior mediastinum containing a melanoma with spindle and epithelioid components arising from respiratory epithelium. This is reported as the first case of melanoma arising in a mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor. The study provides evidence that neuroendocrine cells may be the origin of melanoma in respiratory epithelium. The authors stress that all germ cell tumors should be carefully evaluated for somatic malignancies, as these can change prognosis and treatment.

pmid-23119218.summary_ja: 出産5か月後の27歳女性で、前縦隔に13 cmの巨大な腫瘤を認め、胸痛と喀血を伴った。CTで脂肪成分を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が見られ成熟奇形腫と考えられた。切除標本でエストロゲン・プロゲステロン受容体が陽性で、妊娠中のホルモン変化が急速な増大の一因と考えられている。
pmid-23119218.summary_en: The authors describe a 27-year-old woman, five months postpartum, with a large anterior mediastinal mass causing chest discomfort and hemoptysis. Computed tomography showed a cystic and soft-tissue mass with fat, consistent with a mature teratoma, and serum CA 19-9 was elevated. At median sternotomy, the tumor was adherent to the right lung and subclavian artery. Histology confirmed a mature teratoma with positive estrogen and progesterone receptors. The authors suggest that hormonal changes during pregnancy may have contributed to rapid tumor growth and hemoptysis.

pmid-23143673.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学に関する近年の進歩をまとめたレビューです。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別に有用な新規マーカー、分子異常の知見、そして抗体療法やキナーゼ阻害薬などの標的治療候補を紹介しています。特に化学療法抵抗性の症例に対する治療戦略に焦点を当てています。
pmid-23143673.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in the biology of testicular germ cell tumors, which are the most common solid malignancy in men aged 20 to 40. It describes the histological subtypes, seminoma and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, and discusses novel markers that help distinguish them. The authors also review molecular alterations identified in these tumors and emerging targeted therapies, such as humanized antibodies and kinase inhibitors. Special attention is given to strategies for chemotherapy-resistant disease, with the aim of informing diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-23143763.summary_ja: 両側卵巣胚細胞腫瘍15例を対象に、Y染色体配列の有無を解析した研究です。6例の腫瘍でY染色体DNAが検出され、悪性腫瘍では12例中5例に認められました。成熟奇形腫では検出されず、悪性例の約半数に臨床的に明らかでない性分化異常が潜在していることが示唆されています。
pmid-23143763.summary_en: This study examined 15 patients with synchronous bilateral ovarian germ cell tumors, enrolled in the German MAKEI trials, for Y-chromosomal sequences that might indicate underlying gonadal dysgenesis. Using CGH, PCR and FISH on paraffin-embedded tissue, Y-chromosomal DNA was detected in six tumors, including five of twelve malignant tumors and one immature teratoma. Both mature teratomas were negative. The authors conclude that mature teratomas arise independently of gonadal dysgenesis, whereas bilateral immature teratomas, dysgerminomas and mixed malignant tumors often carry Y-chromosomal material, suggesting clinically silent gonadal dysgenesis in about half of cases.

pmid-23148393.summary_ja: 慢性異所性妊娠として治療された女性で、摘出された卵管から絨毛癌が診断された症例報告です。術後も血清β-hCGが高値を示し、EMA-CO療法6コースとβ-hCGの経時的測定が行われました。異所性妊娠の全例で卵管組織の病理組織学的検査を行うことの重要性を強調しています。
pmid-23148393.summary_en: A woman presented with a chronic ectopic pregnancy and underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy during laparotomy. Postoperative serum β-hCG remained elevated, and histopathology showed tubal choriocarcinoma. She received six cycles of EMA-CO chemotherapy with serial β-hCG monitoring. The authors emphasize that histopathological examination of tubal tissue in all ectopic pregnancies is essential to avoid missing this rare, highly malignant but generally curable disease.

pmid-23148621.summary_ja: 下血と精巣腫大で発症した男性例で、精巣摘除術により混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、十二指腸絨毛癌と両肺転移を認めた症例報告です。シスプラチン併用化学療法後に脳転移が出現し全脳放射線療法を受けましたが、最終的に多臓器不全で死亡しました。高リスク例に対する頭部画像検査の推奨を含む文献的考察もあります。
pmid-23148621.summary_en: A man presented with melena and testicular enlargement; orchiectomy revealed mixed germ cell cancer with duodenal choriocarcinoma and bilateral lung metastases. After cisplatin-based chemotherapy he developed seizures, and MRI showed brain metastases treated with whole-brain radiotherapy. He later died of multiorgan failure after second-line chemotherapy. The authors review the disease and suggest that head CT screening be considered at diagnosis and brain MRI for high-risk patients with embryonal or choriocarcinoma histology, elevated β-hCG, or lung involvement.

pmid-23154771.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫と体細胞型悪性腫瘍の27組を対象に、12p過剰発現やi(12p)のFISH解析、マイクロサテライト解析で遺伝学的関連性を検討した研究です。78%の組で類似の変化が認められ、両者は共通の前駆細胞に由来することが示されました。体細胞型悪性腫瘍の胚細胞起源を支持する知見です。
pmid-23154771.summary_en: This study analyzed 27 pairs of testicular teratoma and somatic-type malignancies (mostly adenocarcinoma and PNET) from metastatic lesions. Using FISH for 12p overexpression and i(12p), and microsatellite loss-of-heterozygosity analysis on microdissected tissue, the authors found similar genetic alterations in 78% of pairs. Eight of twelve pairs showed identical allelic loss patterns. The findings indicate that somatic-type malignancies arising in germ cell tumors are clonally related to the teratoma and derive from a common progenitor cell, supporting germ cell origin.

pmid-23155245.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来細胞株GHにおいて、ヒト内在性レトロウイルスK(HERV-K)の発現とマイクロRNA(miRNA)の発現パターンを比較した研究です。HERV-Kと平行して変化するmiR-663およびmiR-638を同定しました。これらは腫瘍の診断・予後マーカーとなりうると考察されています。
pmid-23155245.summary_en: The authors studied the germ cell tumor cell line GH, in which human endogenous retrovirus-K (HERV-K) expression increases with prolonged culture and high cell density. Global microRNA arrays of HERV-K-high versus low samples identified two microRNAs, miR-663 and miR-638, that changed in parallel with HERV-K. Induction of HERV-K did not alter cellular senescence. The authors suggest these miRNAs could serve as diagnostic or prognostic markers in tumor patients, though this remains to be validated clinically.

pmid-23157052.summary_ja: 定期超音波検査で発見された、縦隔腫瘤による胎児水腫の症例報告。妊娠32週で帝王切開が行われ、被包性腫瘍は生後1日目に摘出された。児は8か月時点で呼吸障害なく経過している。非免疫性水腫を伴い新生児期を生存した胎児縦隔奇形腫としては4例目と報告されている。産科・新生児科・小児外科による多職種管理の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23157052.summary_en: A case report of a fetus with hydrops caused by a mediastinal mass, diagnosed on routine ultrasound. The mother underwent cesarean section at 32 weeks, and the encapsulated tumor was excised on the first day of life. The infant was healthy at eight months without respiratory difficulty. The authors identify this as only the fourth reported case of fetal mediastinal teratoma with nonimmune hydrops surviving the neonatal period, and emphasize the need for multidisciplinary surveillance and management of such fetal lesions.

pmid-23162363.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣を有する33歳男性が、化学療法後のセミノーマに対して手術を受けた。その後の病理組織学的評価で、46,XY男性に生じるまれな男性仮性半陰陽である持続性ミュラー管症候群が判明した。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の標本の病理検討で見つかった併存診断である。セミノーマが化学療法後に生じた点も含め、泌尿生殖器奇形を伴う患者での慎重な病理診断の重要性を示す。
pmid-23162363.summary_en: A 33-year-old man with bilateral cryptorchid testes was operated on for postchemotherapy seminoma. Subsequent histopathological evaluation revealed persistent Mullerian duct syndrome, a rare form of male pseudohermaphroditism in a 46,XY individual. The report highlights an unexpected coexisting diagnosis found during pathological review of a testicular germ cell tumor specimen. Because the seminoma followed chemotherapy, the case also illustrates the importance of careful pathology in patients with germ cell tumors and congenital urogenital anomalies.

pmid-23168855.summary_ja: アルコール性肝硬変に対し7年前に肝移植を受けた36歳男性が、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の精巣腫瘍を発症した。臓器移植後の悪性腫瘍は重要な合併症として認識が高まっている。治療は精巣摘除術、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、術後化学療法で行われた。移植後の継続的ながん監視の必要性を示す症例である。
pmid-23168855.summary_en: A 36-year-old man who had undergone liver transplantation seven years earlier for alcoholic cirrhosis developed a mixed germ cell testicular tumor. The case illustrates the growing recognition of malignancy as a major complication in solid organ transplant recipients, which may soon surpass cardiovascular disease as a leading cause of death. He was treated with orchiectomy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, and postoperative chemotherapy, and the report underscores the need for vigilant cancer surveillance after transplantation.

pmid-23169300.summary_ja: GnT-IVaは侵入奇胎および絨毛癌の栄養膜細胞で高発現し、胞状奇胎や正常栄養膜細胞では発現が低かった。絨毛癌細胞でのノックダウンは遊走・浸潤・接着を低下させ、β1インテグリンの糖鎖分岐を減少させた。in vivoでも腫瘍の生着と増殖が抑制された。hCGの異常糖鎖とインテグリン修飾を通じた浸潤機構を示し、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の治療標的となる可能性を示唆する。
pmid-23169300.summary_en: GnT-IVa was highly expressed in trophoblasts of invasive mole and choriocarcinoma but not in hydatidiform mole or normal trophoblasts. Knockdown in choriocarcinoma cells reduced migration, invasion, and adhesion, and decreased beta1 integrin branching without changing integrin expression. In vivo, knockdown suppressed tumor engraftment and growth. The findings link aberrant hCG glycosylation to choriocarcinoma invasiveness through integrin modification, suggesting GnT-IVa as a potential therapeutic target in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-23172164.summary_ja: 腎原発の絨毛癌の稀な症例を報告する。臨床的には多発肺転移を伴う腎細胞癌に類似していた。DNA多型解析で腫瘍DNAに父親由来の外来対立遺伝子を認め、妊娠性起源と確定した。起源の同定は予後および最適な治療の選択に重要である。
pmid-23172164.summary_en: This report describes a rare primary renal choriocarcinoma that clinically mimicked a renal cell carcinoma with multiple pulmonary metastases. It had to be distinguished from a sarcomatoid renal cell carcinoma with trophoblastic differentiation. Using the Investigator Hexaplex ESS kit for DNA polymorphism analysis, the authors detected foreign alleles in tumor DNA, confirming paternal DNA and therefore gestational rather than germ cell origin. Establishing the origin matters because it determines prognosis and the most effective therapy for this highly malignant trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-23176153.summary_ja: 24歳未経産女性で、右卵巣のディスジャーミノーマと左卵管妊娠が同時に認められた症例である。右付属器摘出術と左卵管線状切開術が行われた。化学療法開始前に自然妊娠し、満期出産に至った。化学療法を行わなくても良好な経過をたどっている。文献上の類似例は見つかっていない。
pmid-23176153.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old nulliparous woman with a dysgerminoma of the right ovary coexisting with a synchronous left tubal pregnancy. She underwent right adnexectomy and left linear salpingostomy. She later conceived spontaneously before chemotherapy was started, carried the intrauterine pregnancy to term, and had another normal pregnancy. She remained well without chemotherapy. The authors note the diagnostic and therapeutic challenges of combining an ovarian tumor with an ectopic pregnancy and state that they found no similar cases in the literature.

pmid-23185165.summary_ja: 60歳女性が腹痛、体重減少、高カルシウム血症（15.0 mg/dl）で受診し、PTHrP産生が確認された。両側成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う悪性ブレンナー腫瘍が見つかり、子宮全摘・両側卵管卵巣摘出術後にカルシウムは正常化した。悪性ブレンナー腫瘍に伴う高カルシウム血症の初報告である。
pmid-23185165.summary_en: This case report describes a 60-year-old woman with abdominal pain, weight loss and hypercalcemia (serum calcium 15.0 mg/dl) driven by PTHrP production. Imaging suggested bilateral mature cystic teratomas, and total hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a malignant Brenner tumor associated with a mature cystic teratoma. Calcium normalised after surgery, and the authors describe this as the first reported hypercalcemia linked to a malignant Brenner tumor. They review the four mechanisms of malignancy-associated hypercalcemia and stress close perioperative calcium monitoring.

pmid-23185794.summary_ja: 過去20年間に妊孕性温存治療を受けた悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍145例を後方視的に解析した。5年生存率は90.3%で、主な予後因子はFIGO病期と標準的な化学療法だった。化学療法は月経、妊娠、出産に影響せず、35児が出生した。FIGO病期にかかわらず妊孕性温存治療を検討すべきと結論している。
pmid-23185794.summary_en: This retrospective study analysed 145 women treated with fertility-preserving management for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors over 20 years, with a median follow-up of 9.5 years. The five-year overall survival was 90.3%, and the main prognostic factors were FIGO stage and standard chemotherapy. Histological type, surgery type and chemotherapy regimen did not significantly affect survival. Chemotherapy did not affect menses, pregnancy or offspring, and 35 babies were delivered. The authors conclude that fertility-preserving treatment should be considered regardless of FIGO stage.

pmid-23189072.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例272例と対照382例を用いた症例対照研究である。身長の最高四分位の人は、精巣がんのリスクが約2.2倍であった。セミノーマでは182cm超の男性で関連が強かった。BMIは組織型を問わず逆相関を示した。小児期の栄養や思春期のホルモンが関与する可能性があると考察している。
pmid-23189072.summary_en: This case-control study of 272 testicular cancer cases and 382 controls examined whether height, weight and body mass index influence the risk of testicular germ cell tumors. Men in the highest height quartile had more than twice the odds of TGCT, and the association was strongest for seminoma, where very tall men (over 182 cm) showed significantly increased risk. BMI was inversely associated with TGCT in both histological subgroups. The authors suggest that childhood nutrition and pubertal hormones may explain these findings and call for further study of postnatal exposures.

pmid-23192513.summary_ja: 22歳男性の右肺中葉に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）の症例報告である。肺原発の奇形腫は稀で、性腺やほかの性腺外原発を除外する必要がある。臨床、画像、病理所見を提示し、文献を概説している。肺奇形腫は上葉に多い傾向があるが、その理由は不明である。
pmid-23192513.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) arising in the right middle lobe of the lung in a 22-year-old man. Intrapulmonary teratomas are rare, usually seen in the mediastinum, and diagnosis requires excluding gonadal and other extragonadal primaries. The authors present the clinical, radiological and histopathological features and review the relevant literature. Lung teratomas commonly involve the upper lobe for reasons that remain unknown.

pmid-23194133.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の23歳男性が、シスプラチンとエトポシドによる化学療法の2日目に可逆性後頭葉白質脳症症候群(PRES)を発症した。シスプラチンを一時休薬しエトポシドを継続したところ、神経症状は完全に消失した。その後シスプラチンを再投与しても再発はなく、寛解に至った。シスプラチン関連PRES後の再投与に成功した初の報告である。
pmid-23194133.summary_en: A 23-year-old man with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumor developed posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome (PRES) on day 2 of cisplatin and etoposide chemotherapy. Cisplatin was withheld for two days while etoposide continued, and his neurological symptoms resolved completely. Cisplatin was then re-administered without recurrence of PRES, and he achieved remission. The authors report this as the first documented successful cisplatin re-challenge after cisplatin-associated PRES, suggesting re-treatment may be an option when platinum-based therapy is the only hope for cure.

pmid-23196490.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎に関連する腫瘍について概説している。腫瘍合併率は2008年の60%から2011年には42%へ低下し、18歳未満および男性では合併が少ない傾向があった。卵巣奇形腫のほか、精巣胚細胞腫瘍などの腫瘍も関連する。子宮癌肉腫を合併した65歳女性例も報告されている。悪性腫瘍を伴う脳炎の予後は関連腫瘍の予後に左右される可能性がある。
pmid-23196490.summary_en: This review summarizes tumors associated with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis. The tumor-associated proportion fell from 60% in 2008 to 42% in 2011, and was lower in patients under 18 and in males. Besides ovarian teratoma, associated tumors include testicular germ cell tumors and other malignancies. The authors also describe a 65-year-old woman with uterine carcinosarcoma with neuroendocrine differentiation who developed this encephalitis. They conclude that the prognosis of encephalitis with malignancy may depend on the prognosis of the associated tumor.

pmid-23196491.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の発症における卵巣奇形腫の役割を検討するため、脳炎を伴う例と伴わない例、正常卵巣を病理組織学的に評価した。ヒトおよびウシの卵母細胞の細胞質にNR2Bエピトープの強い発現が認められた。神経組織の量や炎症細胞浸潤に両群間の有意差はなかった。神経組織に富む奇形腫は、難治性脳炎のリスクを高める可能性がある。
pmid-23196491.summary_en: To clarify the role of ovarian teratomas in anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, the authors histopathologically examined ovarian teratomas with and without encephalitis and normal ovaries. Strong NR2B epitope expression was found in oocyte cytoplasm from human and bovine ovaries, and neural tissue in teratomas showed NR2B immunoreactivity, mainly in mature neurons. No significant difference in neural tissue amount or inflammatory infiltration was found between teratoma groups. The authors suggest that teratomas rich in neural tissue may increase the risk of intractable encephalitis after prodromal infection.

pmid-23197969.summary_ja: 血精症は原因不明と考えられることが多いが、本症例では陰嚢診察と超音波検査で精巣腫瘍が見つかり、セミノーマであった。血精症患者では、精巣悪性腫瘍を見落とさないために陰嚢診察と必要に応じた超音波検査を行うべきである。
pmid-23197969.summary_en: A patient presented with hemospermia, which is often considered idiopathic. Scrotal examination and ultrasonography revealed a testicular tumor, which was identified as seminoma. The case highlights that patients presenting with hemospermia should undergo scrotal examination and, when indicated, ultrasound, to avoid missing a testicular malignancy. Although hemospermia is commonly regarded as benign, this report shows it can be the first sign of a testicular germ cell tumor.

pmid-23198376.summary_ja: 17歳男性が、小児期から徐々に増大する左殿部の疼痛を伴う腫瘤を主訴に受診した。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では主に脂肪と大腸を含む境界明瞭な軟部腫瘤が認められた。腫瘍と尾骨を完全切除し、病理組織学的に成熟奇形腫と診断された。成人での仙尾部奇形腫の報告は稀である。
pmid-23198376.summary_en: A 17-year-old male presented with a painful left buttock mass that had been gradually growing since childhood. MRI showed a well-defined soft-tissue mass containing mainly fat and large intestine. Complete excision of the tumor and coccyx was performed. Gross and histologic examination confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratoma is rarely reported in adults, and this case adds to the limited data on late-presenting sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-23205081.summary_ja: 中国の単施設で巨大卵巣奇形腫330例(腫瘍径15cm超)を検討した報告。開腹群は緊急手術例が多く、腹腔鏡群では偶発的な嚢胞破裂が多かった(31.5%対19.6%)。著者らは、一塊での摘出と腫瘤破裂の回避のために開腹切除が望ましい可能性を指摘し、術前診断には画像所見の理解が有用だとしている。
pmid-23205081.summary_en: This review of 330 patients with giant ovarian teratomas (diameter over 15 cm) at a Chinese hospital compared laparotomy with laparoscopy. Emergency cases were more common in the laparotomy group, while accidental cyst rupture occurred more often with laparoscopy (31.5% vs 19.6%). The authors suggest laparotomic en bloc resection may be preferable for giant teratomas, and that familiarity with characteristic imaging features aids preoperative diagnosis.

pmid-23205135.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞株を用い、TGF-β1が細胞の浸潤能に及ぼす影響を検討した基礎研究。TGF-β1はTβR I・TβR II・Smad4の発現を低下させる一方、MMP-9とTIMP-1の発現を上昇させ、浸潤能を高めた。絨毛癌の浸潤機構の理解につながる知見である。
pmid-23205135.summary_en: Using the JEG-3 placental choriocarcinoma cell line, the authors examined how TGF-β1 affects cell invasion. TGF-β1 increased invasiveness while reducing expression of TGF-β receptors I and II and Smad4, and raising levels of MMP-9 and TIMP-1. The findings suggest TGF-β1 signaling may help drive trophoblastic invasion, with implications for understanding the invasive biology of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-23214338.summary_ja: 80歳女性が急性腹症で受診し、20cmの卵巣嚢胞性腫瘤に対して左卵管卵巣摘出術が行われた。組織学的に、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の高分化型扁平上皮癌と診断された。周囲の扁平上皮には異形成も認められた。奇形腫の悪性転化の形態学的・臨床病理学的特徴を考察し、本症は稀で、多くは偶発的所見であると述べている。
pmid-23214338.summary_en: An 80-year-old woman with acute abdomen underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy for a 20 cm cystic ovarian mass. Histology showed well-differentiated squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma, with dysplasia in the surrounding squamous epithelium. The authors review the morphologic and clinicopathologic features of malignant transformation in teratoma, noting that such squamous carcinoma is rare and often an incidental finding.

pmid-23216975.summary_ja: 49歳女性が左卵巣腫瘍に対して手術を受けた。病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と、腸型腺癌の領域が認められた。術後5年時点で無病生存中である。奇形腫の悪性転化は1〜2%とされ、消化管型腺癌は扁平上皮癌に比べ極めて稀であると述べている。文献レビューも併せて示している。
pmid-23216975.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman underwent surgery for a left ovarian tumor. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma with hair shafts and a squamous layer, and a separate area of intestinal-type adenocarcinoma. Five years after surgery she remained alive without disease. The authors note malignant transformation occurs in 1-2% of mature cystic teratomas, and that gastrointestinal-type adenocarcinoma is extremely rare compared with squamous carcinoma.

pmid-23248427.summary_ja: 縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍と腎奇形、特に馬蹄腎が併存したまれな症例を総説的に検討した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と馬蹄腎はいずれも胚発生期の細胞の異常な移動に由来すると考えられ、両者の起源の関連が論じられている。この併存例は治療上の課題であり、起源の議論から治療、フォローアップまでを扱っている。
pmid-23248427.summary_en: This case review discusses the unusual coexistence of a mediastinal germ cell tumour and a renal anomaly, particularly horseshoe kidney. Extragonadal germ cell tumours and horseshoe kidney are both thought to arise from abnormal migration of germline-associated cells during embryogenesis, which links their origin. The authors note that this combination poses therapeutic challenges and cover issues ranging from origin and treatment to follow-up.

pmid-23248619.summary_ja: ペンシルベニア大学のゲノムワイド関連解析の137例の部分集団において、シスプラチン代謝経路の遺伝子GSTP1、COMT、TPMTの変異を、シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者で検討した。COMT近傍でARVCFのイントロン内にあるSNP(rs2073743)は、初回化学療法後の難治性疾患と関連し、劣性遺伝モデルではGG遺伝子型のリスクが著しく高かった。神経障害、耳毒性、無増悪生存期間、全生存期間との関連は認められなかった。著者らは、本研究結果は仮説生成的であり、検証が必要であると述べている。
pmid-23248619.summary_en: In a 137-patient subset of a University of Pennsylvania genome-wide association study, the authors examined variants in GSTP1, COMT and TPMT, genes in the cisplatin metabolism pathway, in patients with testicular germ cell tumour treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. One SNP (rs2073743) near COMT, within an intron of ARVCF, was associated with refractory disease after first-line chemotherapy, and the GG genotype carried a markedly higher risk under recessive inheritance. No associations were found with neuropathy, ototoxicity, progression-free or overall survival. The authors describe the findings as hypothesis-generating and in need of validation.

pmid-23250246.summary_ja: モロッコの小児病院で2000年から2008年にかけて卵巣腫瘍の治療を受けた2歳から15歳の女児18例の後方視的検討である。初診時の主訴は腹痛が最も多く、腫瘍の77%は胚細胞腫瘍で、その大半は奇形腫であり、多くは良性であった。最も多い術式は片側卵管卵巣摘出術であった。悪性腫瘍の7例のうち3例は術後化学療法を受けた。治療抵抗性や死亡例はなく、転帰は概ね良好であった。著者らは、妊孕性を保つため保存的手術を推奨している。
pmid-23250246.summary_en: This retrospective review of 18 girls aged 2 to 15 years treated for ovarian tumours at a Moroccan children's hospital between 2000 and 2008 found abdominal pain to be the most common presentation. Seventy-seven percent of tumours were germ cell tumours, mostly teratomas, and most were benign. Unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was the commonest operation. Seven patients had malignant tumours, and three of them received postoperative chemotherapy. Outcomes were good, with no treatment resistance or deaths. The authors advocate conservative surgery to preserve fertility.

pmid-23251575.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞成分である胎児性癌の細胞株5種を用い、シスプラチンによる鎖間架橋を修復する能力を検討した。相同組換え修復の低下が認められ、PARP阻害薬単剤に感受性を示した。PARP阻害は、耐性の強い細胞株でシスプラチンへの反応を増強した。シスプラチン耐性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を克服する治療戦略として示唆される。
pmid-23251575.summary_en: The authors examined five embryonal carcinoma cell lines, the stem-cell component of testicular germ cell tumours, for their ability to repair cisplatin-induced interstrand crosslinks. The lines showed impaired or reduced homologous recombination, indicated by fewer RAD51 foci and a GFP-reporter assay. Consistent with this deficiency, they were sensitive to PARP inhibitor monotherapy, and sensitivity correlated with PARP1 expression and activity. PARP inhibition also enhanced cisplatin response in the most resistant lines, suggesting a way to overcome cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-23256061.summary_ja: 30歳女性の左臀部の腫脹と痛みを報告する。超音波検査とMRIで、内部に多数の結節を含む嚢胞性腫瘤が認められた。切除と病理組織学的検査により臀部奇形腫と確認された。成人の臀部奇形腫は極めてまれである。厚壁の嚢胞性腫瘤に充実性結節や脂肪を伴う場合は奇形腫を示唆すると述べ、適時の完全切除により予後は良好としている。
pmid-23256061.summary_en: A 30-year-old woman presented with two weeks of left hip swelling and pain. Ultrasonography showed a subcutaneous cystic mass with echogenic spots, and MRI revealed a heart-shaped left buttock mass containing 'pomegranate seed' inclusions that were hyperintense on diffusion-weighted imaging. Complete resection and histopathology confirmed a buttock teratoma containing sebum-like material and hair. The authors note that adult buttock teratomas are extremely rare, that thick-walled cystic masses with nodules or fat suggest teratoma on imaging, and that timely resection gives a good prognosis.

pmid-23269339.summary_ja: 35歳男性の後腹膜腫瘍症例。神経原性腫瘍が疑われ切除したところ、病理はセミノーマであった。超音波検査で精巣に病変が見つかり、両側精巣摘除術を施行したが、残存瘢痕と胚細胞腫瘍の微小病変のみで、burned-out現象と判断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を疑うと、精巣摘除術の後に全身化学療法を行う治療方針へ変わることを示した報告。
pmid-23269339.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with a retroperitoneal mass initially suspected to be a neurogenic tumor. Pathology of the resected mass showed seminoma, and subsequent scrotal ultrasonography revealed testicular microcalcifications and hypoechoic lesions. Bilateral orchiectomy found only residual scar and focal germ cell neoplasia, consistent with the burned-out phenomenon. The authors conclude that suspecting an extragonadal germ cell tumor with burned-out phenomenon changes management: orchiectomy first, then systemic chemotherapy, with surgery reserved for residual malignant tissue.

pmid-23293749.summary_ja: 進行卵巣胎児性癌の患者から採取した標本で、多能性幹細胞クローンを同定・解析した研究。TRA-1-60、SSEA-4、Oct4A、Nanogが発現し、胚性幹細胞や精巣胎児性癌と類似していた。胚様体を形成し三胚葉へ分化した。分子プロファイルは診断の精緻化や個別化治療に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-23293749.summary_en: This study identifies pluripotent stem cell clones within pure ovarian embryonal carcinomas from patients with advanced disease. Cells showed strong surface TRA-1-60 and SSEA-4 and high Oct4A and Nanog expression, similar to embryonic stem cells and testicular embryonal carcinoma. The ovarian embryonal carcinoma cells formed embryoid bodies capable of differentiating into all three germ layers and into muscle, epithelial, and neuronal cells. The authors suggest these molecular profiles could refine diagnosis and support biomarker-targeted, personalized therapy.

pmid-23293755.summary_ja: 膵臓と左腎の間に生じた後腹膜嚢胞性腫瘤で、神経節神経芽腫を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。遠位膵切除、脾摘、左副腎摘除を伴う一塊切除を施行。充実成分の神経節神経芽腫が皮様組織と密接に関連し、悪性転化を伴う成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。奇形腫内発生の神経節神経芽腫として初の報告。
pmid-23293755.summary_en: This case report describes ganglioneuroblastoma arising within a retroperitoneal mature cystic teratoma in a patient with a cystic mass between the pancreas and left kidney. En-bloc resection with distal pancreatectomy, splenectomy, and left adrenalectomy was performed. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma, with the solid component showing ganglioneuroblastoma intimately associated with dermoid tissue, classified as mature cystic teratoma with malignant transformation. The authors report it as the first such case described.

pmid-23295293.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異によりFrasier症候群と診断された4例の報告。2例で両側性の性腺腫瘍を発症し、1例は両側ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）を伴った。46,XY症例では性腺腫瘍のリスクが高く、選択的な両側性性腺摘除が推奨される。ネフローゼ症候群や思春期遅延などの非典型的な表現型を示した。
pmid-23295293.summary_en: This report describes four patients with Frasier syndrome, identified by WT1 mutations, with gonadal dysgenesis and nephropathy. One patient had horseshoe kidney and bilateral dysgerminoma; two others developed bilateral gonadal tumors. Presentations included steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome, delayed puberty, and primary amenorrhea. The authors note that 46,XY patients have a higher risk of gonadoblastoma and recommend elective bilateral gonadectomy and molecular WT1 screening for diagnosis.

pmid-23296381.summary_ja: 低腫瘍量の病期II セミノーマ15例にPEB2サイクルを施行した後方視的単施設症例集積。発熱性好中球減少症はなく、リンパ節は有意に縮小した。中央値60か月の観察で再発やセミノーマによる死亡はなく、二次悪性腫瘍は1例のみであった。治療負担軽減の可能性があるが、前向き試験での検証が必要とされる。
pmid-23296381.summary_en: This retrospective single-center case series evaluated 15 patients with low-volume stage II seminoma treated with two cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (PEB), either by patient preference or institutional practice. Chemotherapy was well tolerated, with no febrile neutropenia, and lymph node size fell significantly after treatment. With median follow-up of 60 months, no patients relapsed or died from seminoma, and one developed a second malignancy. The authors suggest this may reduce treatment burden but require prospective confirmation.

pmid-23300844.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞様細胞である胎児性癌細胞は、低用量の5-アザデオキシシチジンに高い感受性を示す。NT2/D1細胞では、DNA損傷とp53活性化が生じ、NANOGやSOX2などの多能性遺伝子が抑制され、RIN1やSOX15などの腫瘍抑制候補遺伝子が脱メチル化される。これらの作用は主にDNMT3Bの高発現に依存する。
pmid-23300844.summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells, the stem cells of nonseminoma testicular germ cell tumors, are hypersensitive to low-dose 5-aza-deoxycytidine. Using NT2/D1 cells, the authors show that low-dose treatment causes DNA damage, activates p53, represses pluripotency genes such as NANOG and SOX2, and demethylates promoters of candidate tumor suppressors including RIN1 and SOX15. These effects largely depend on high DNMT3B levels. The findings suggest that low-dose 5-aza could be a therapeutic strategy for tumors sustained by embryonic stem-like cells.

pmid-23306744.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、新たに糖尿病と診断され、経過観察中に無症状の後腹膜腫瘤が見つかった30歳男性を記述している。CTでは、腸間膜静脈を圧排する低吸収で石灰化を伴う腫瘤が認められた。腫瘤の大きさと悪性の可能性から切除が行われた。膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫はきわめてまれであり、確定診断は術中に行われた。著者らは、膵臓への近接性を考慮すると膵頭十二指腸切除術(Whipple手術)が最も適切であり、術前に組織学的診断は確立されていなかったと結論づけている。
pmid-23306744.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with newly diagnosed diabetes and an asymptomatic retropancreatic mass found during follow-up. CT showed a hypodense, calcified mass displacing the mesenteric veins. Because of its size and the possibility of malignancy, the mass was resected. Mature cystic teratomas of the pancreas are extremely rare, and the definitive diagnosis was made intraoperatively. The authors conclude that a Whipple procedure is the most appropriate approach given the mass's proximity to the pancreas, although the histological diagnosis was not established preoperatively.

pmid-23316407.summary_ja: 皮膚硬化、多発筋痛、好酸球増多、結節性再生性過形成を呈した患者で、精巣セミノーマと関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎が明らかになった。精巣がんに関連する傍腫瘍性皮膚筋炎は極めてまれである。皮膚・全身症状が潜在性胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状となりうることを示す。
pmid-23316407.summary_en: This report describes a patient whose skin tightening, polymyalgia, hypereosinophilia, and nodular regenerative hyperplasia revealed a testicular seminoma with associated paraneoplastic dermatomyositis. Paraneoplastic dermatomyositis linked to testicular cancer is extremely rare. The case highlights that cutaneous and systemic findings can be the first presentation of an occult germ cell tumor. Recognizing this association may prompt earlier testicular evaluation in patients with unexplained inflammatory myopathy-like symptoms.

pmid-23320213.summary_ja: 52歳の閉経前女性が7cmの右付属器腫瘤と不正出血で受診した。全摘術と両側付属器摘出術を含む手術が行われた。病理組織学的に卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌と診断された。病期にかかわらず化学療法が必要とされ、カルボプラチンとパクリタキセルの追加投与が計画された。
pmid-23320213.summary_en: This case report describes a 52-year-old premenopausal woman with vaginal bleeding and a 7 cm right adnexal mass. She underwent total abdominal hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy, pelvic lymphadenectomy, and debulking. Histopathology revealed squamous cell carcinoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma is rare, and its prognosis depends on surgical stage. The authors note that chemotherapy should be given regardless of stage and planned second-cycle carboplatin and paclitaxel.

pmid-23320215.summary_ja: 出生前超音波で頸部奇形腫と診断された胎児の症例報告です。腫瘍が気道を圧迫したため、胎盤循環を保ったまま子宮外での生存性を確保するEXITを実施し、気道を確保しました。胎児頸部の超音波評価は気道と消化管の把握に重要であり、早期診断が計画的な分娩と外科治療につながると述べています。
pmid-23320215.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus diagnosed with a cervical teratoma by prenatal ultrasound. The tumor compressed the airway, so the team performed ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) to secure airway control while maintaining placental support and extrauterine viability. The authors emphasize that fetal neck ultrasonography is essential for assessing the airway and digestive tract, and that early recognition of such masses allows planned delivery and surgical management.

pmid-23324369.summary_ja: 急性虫垂炎の疑いで手術された22歳男性で、腹腔内に転位した精巣捻転が判明しました。精巣と虫垂の両方が切除され、病理検査で精巣のセミノーマと正常虫垂が確認されました。まれな病態の診断と治療の原則を概説し、急性虫垂炎の鑑別診断として腫瘍性精巣捻転を考慮すべきと述べています。
pmid-23324369.summary_en: A 22-year-old man was operated on for suspected acute appendicitis, but surgery revealed intra-abdominal torsion of a testis. Both the testis and the appendix were removed. Histopathology showed seminoma of the testis with a normal appendix. The report reviews this rare condition and the principles of its diagnosis and treatment, and emphasizes that neoplastic testicular torsion should be considered in the differential diagnosis of acute appendicitis.

pmid-23326728.summary_ja: 左卵巣奇形腫がS状結腸へ自然破裂した症例報告です。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫は卵巣腫瘍の10〜20%を占め若年者に最も多い腫瘍ですが、自然破裂はまれです。腸管への進展を伴う卵巣奇形腫の非典型的な臨床像とその管理上の意義を示しています。
pmid-23326728.summary_en: This case report describes a left ovarian teratoma that spontaneously ruptured into the sigmoid colon. Mature cystic teratomas account for 10-20% of ovarian neoplasms and are the most common tumor in younger patients, but spontaneous rupture is rare. The report highlights this unusual presentation and its clinical significance for the management of ovarian teratomas with intestinal involvement.

pmid-23327057.summary_ja: 28例の卵巣類皮様嚢胞（表皮嚢腫）を15年間にわたり後方視的に検討し、類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）との鑑別点を示した論文です。表皮嚢腫は類皮嚢腫より小型で高齢女性に多く見られました。奇形腫の最大17%に表皮成分が含まれることがあります。多くは保存的手術で治療され、フォローアップ期間中の再発はありませんでした。
pmid-23327057.summary_en: This 15-year retrospective study of 28 histologically confirmed epidermoid ovarian cysts examines how to distinguish them from dermoid cysts, which are mature cystic teratomas. Epidermoid cysts were smaller and occurred in older women than dermoid cysts. Up to 17% of teratomas may contain epidermoid components. Most patients were managed conservatively, with no recurrence during follow-up, and the authors propose a new pathologic classification.

pmid-23327068.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化を術前に予測できるかを検討した論文です。悪性2例と良性76例を比較したところ、悪性例は大きく（平均130mm）、血清SCCが高値で、MRIで充実性かつ造影される成分を認めました。100mm超の腫瘍、充実性の造影病変、血清SCCとCA19-9の測定を推奨しています。
pmid-23327068.summary_en: This study examines whether malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma can be predicted before surgery. It compares two malignant cases with 76 benign cases. Malignant tumors were larger, with mean diameters of 130 mm versus 73.6 mm, and had higher serum SCC levels, solid masses, and contrast enhancement on pelvic MRI. The authors recommend checking tumors larger than 100 mm, solid enhancing masses on MRI, and serum SCC and CA19-9 levels.

pmid-23327071.summary_ja: Carney複合を有する17歳女性の卵巣成熟奇形腫の症例報告です。経腟超音波とMRIで付属器腫瘤と腹水が確認され、悪性変化が疑われました。FIGO分類に沿って子宮付属器摘出と病期分類のための開腹術を実施しました。術後は腹水や痛みが消失し、CA-125も基準値内に戻りました。
pmid-23327071.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old with Carney complex and a teratoma maturum ovarii. The adnexal mass with ascites, detected by transvaginal ultrasound and MRI, suggested malignant change. The patient underwent surgery with staging laparotomy under FIGO guidelines. Postoperatively the patient recovered well, ascites and pain resolved, and CA-125 levels returned to the reference range.

pmid-23328171.summary_ja: 2009年版精巣がん診療ガイドラインの32のCQを検証したシンポジウム報告。病期I、進行がん、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の3領域について、補助化学療法、救援化学療法、残存腫瘍に対する低侵襲手術などの治療戦略を臨床例とともに検討している。
pmid-23328171.summary_en: This Japanese symposium report validates the 2009 Japanese Testicular Cancer Clinical Practice Guidelines through 32 clinical questions. It covers three areas. For stage I disease, single-agent carboplatin adjuvant therapy is discussed for seminoma, and vascular invasion guides risk-based choices for nonseminoma. For advanced disease, high-dose chemotherapy, salvage chemotherapy for residual tumors, and minimally invasive surgery for residual masses are reviewed. Extragonadal germ cell tumors, which can be cured with multimodal therapy, are also covered, including endoscopic ultrasound-guided biopsy.

pmid-23328172.summary_ja: 病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍の補助療法を総説した。精巣摘除術のみで多くは治癒するが一部は再発する。セミノーマでは放射線療法やカルボプラチン、非セミノーマでは後腹膜リンパ節郭清や化学療法が選択肢となり、最新文献に基づいて再発抑制と有害事象の軽減を目指した管理のコンセンサスを更新している。
pmid-23328172.summary_en: This review addresses adjuvant management of stage I testicular germ cell tumors. Most are cured by orchiectomy alone, but some recur. Strategies differ for seminoma and nonseminoma. Seminoma options include radiotherapy or one to two courses of carboplatin. Nonseminoma options include retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or one to two courses of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. The authors review recent literature on these adjuvant approaches, aiming to reduce recurrence while limiting adverse events, and they update the consensus for management.

pmid-23328176.summary_ja: 転移性精巣腫瘍の化学療法後の残存腫瘍の管理を論じた総説。純粋セミノーマでは残存腫瘍は経過観察され、非セミノーマでは多くの症例で切除が行われる。日本泌尿器科学会のガイドラインに基づき、後腹膜残存腫瘍切除の適応と手術手技を検討している。
